programme.title: Football - UEFA Conference League / Fudbal - UEFA Konferencijska liga
programme.desc: From 2021, football fans enjoy the Conference League organized by UEFA. The idea for it appeared in 2015, and it involves lower-ranked national championship teams. The qualifications are divided into two parts, after which 32 teams enter the competition, which are divided into eight groups of four. 16 teams advance to the round of 16, then the quarter-finals, semi-finals and final. / Od 2021. godine ljubitelji fudbala uživaju Ligi Konferencija koju organizuje UEFA. Ideja za nju pojavila se 2015. godine, a uključuje niže rangirane timove državnih prvenstava. Kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dva dijela, nakon kojih u takmičenje ulaze 32 tima koji su podijeljeni u osam grupa po četiri. 16 timova napreduje u osminu finala, zatim četvrtfinale, polufinale i finale.

programme.title: Football - Serbian Superliga / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Superliga premiered in the 2006/2007 season. In today's system, the league has 20 teams and functions according to the two-round competition principle. The history of the Superliga was largely marked by two great Belgrade rivals, Partizan and Crvena zvezda. Historically speaking, in terms of the number of titles won, the red and white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: The Croatian Football League (HNL) was founded in 1992 and the first historical title was won by Hajduk from Split. Over the years, the competition system and the number of clubs have changed, but in recent years, the current system with 10 teams and a four-round format of the competition has been established. The transitional cup intended for the champion is the work of academic sculptor Marijan Zaradić. Dinamo from Zagreb won it the most times. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of Turkish basketball go back far before the founding of the league in 1966. As early as the beginning of the 20th century, hooping was known in Turkey. Students from Robert College in Istanbul discovered the magic of this team sport for the first time in 1904. A year after the founding of the league, the first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs began. Three years later, the second league was launched. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that play each other twice in the regular season, followed by a playoff for the eight best teams. The two lowest placed teams are eliminated from the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Fudbal - Copa Libertadores
programme.desc: "Copa Libertadores" is an annual competition founded in 1960, in which 38 of the best teams from South America compete. Throughout history, the format of the competition has changed, from the fact that only the champions in their respective leagues have the right to perform until today, when each country provides a minimum of three representatives. The most successful club with the most titles won is the Argentinian giant Independiente. Argentina also produced the most Kopa winners. The competition has an iconic status and is considered one of the most exciting football events on the planet. / "Copa Libertadores" je godišnje takmičenje osnovano 1960. godine te u njemu nastupa 38 najboljih ekipa Južne Amerike. Kroz istoriju format takmičenja se mijenjao, od toga da samo prvaci u svojim liga imaju pravo nastupa pa do danas kada svaka država daje po minimalno tri predstavnika. Najuspešniji klub sa najviše osvojenih titula je argentinski velikan Indipendijente. Argentina je dala i najviše osvajača Kope. Takmičenje ima ikonski status te se smatra jednim od nauzbudljivih fudbalskih događaja na planeti.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the suggestion of the French journalist Gabriel Hanot, the Champions Cup was founded in 1955, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. With the media popularization of this format in 1992, the UEFA Champions League was founded, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Conference League / Fudbal - UEFA Konferencijska liga
programme.desc: From 2021, football fans enjoy the Conference League organized by UEFA. The idea for it appeared in 2015, and it involves lower-ranked national championship teams. The qualifications are divided into two parts, after which 32 teams enter the competition, which are divided into eight groups of four. 16 teams advance to the round of 16, then the quarter-finals, semi-finals and final. / Od 2021. godine ljubitelji fudbala uživaju Ligi Konferencija koju organizuje UEFA. Ideja za nju pojavila se 2015. godine, a uključuje niže rangirane timove državnih prvenstava. Kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dva dijela, nakon kojih u takmičenje ulaze 32 tima koji su podijeljeni u osam grupa po četiri. 16 timova napreduje u osminu finala, zatim četvrtfinale, polufinale i finale.

programme.title: The (failure) of the champion / (Ne)uspjeh prvaka
programme.desc: The sports series of former football player Slaven Bilić brings stories of successful athletes from the region. programme.title: Fudbal - South American Cup / Fudbal - Copa Sudamericana
programme.desc: We bring a touch of atmosphere from the Cope Sudamericana, an annual soccer competition featuring the best clubs from South America. Održava se u organizaciji CONMEBOL-a od 2002. godine te važi za drugo najvažnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Južnoj Americi.

programme.title: American football - NFL / Američki fudbal - NFL
programme.desc: The largest and most popular American football league in the world, the NFL, was founded in 1920, but only by merging with the competing AFL in the middle of the last century, was the present version of the competition created. The league features 32 teams divided into two conferences. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The six best teams of the conference each enter the playoffs until the grand finale, popularly called the Super Bowl. The Super Bowl takes place at the beginning of February and is the most media-covered sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svijetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podijeljene u dvije konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plej-of do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Fudbal: Europaliga
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation UEFE from 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cities Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. From that season, the competition was officially called the UEFA Cup and was under that name until 2009, when it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the format of the competition has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. a group stage was introduced followed by eliminations. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the final of the Uefa Cup by the Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded every year to the winner who keeps it for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Evropa ligu. Tokom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. godine za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Conference League / Fudbal - UEFA Konferencijska liga
programme.desc: From 2021, football fans enjoy the Conference League organized by UEFA. The idea for it appeared in 2015, and it involves lower-ranked national championship teams. The qualifications are divided into two parts, after which 32 teams enter the competition, which are divided into eight groups of four. 16 teams advance to the round of 16, then the quarter-finals, semi-finals and final. / Od 2021. godine ljubitelji fudbala uživaju Ligi Konferencija koju organizuje UEFA. Ideja za nju pojavila se 2015. godine, a uključuje niže rangirane timove državnih prvenstava. Kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dva dijela, nakon kojih u takmičenje ulaze 32 tima koji su podijeljeni u osam grupa po četiri. 16 timova napreduje u osminu finala, zatim četvrtfinale, polufinale i finale.

programme.title: Football - French League / Fudbal - Francuska liga
programme.desc: Ligue 1 is the first French professional football league with 20 teams fighting for the French championship title. It was founded in 1932 and is considered one of the most respected European leagues. The club with the most trophies with ten titles won is AS Saint Etienne, but the "Greens" have been waiting for a new title since long ago in 1981 and the time of the great Michel Platini. The matches of the French league are an unmissable event for every fan of this magnificent game. / Ligue 1 prva je francuska profesionalna fudbalska liga koja broji 20 ekipa u borbi za titulom prvaka Francuske. Osnovana je 1932. godine i smatra se jednom od najcjenjenijih evropskih liga. Najtrofejniji klub s deset osvojenih titula je AS Sent Etjen ali "Zeleni" na novu titulu čekaju još od davne 1981. godine i vremena velikog Mišela Platinija. Susreti francuske lige nezaobilazan su događaj za svakog ljubitelja ove veličanstvene igre.

programme.title: Baseball - MLB / Bejzbol - MLB
programme.desc: MLB or "Major League Baseball" is the highest level of baseball leagues in North America. The beginnings of the league date back to the end of the 19th century, more precisely in 1876, when the first season of the then National League was played. In 1903, the current structure was formed with the first edition of the "World Series". The regular season lasts from April to August and each team plays 162 games. Out of a total of eight teams that win the playoffs, the best two play the "World Series Finals". The winner is the first to reach four wins in the series. / MLB ili "Major League Baseball" je najviši rang bejzbolskih liga na području Severne Amerike. Početci lige datitraju već pred kraj 19. veka, tačnije 1876. kada je odigrana prva sezona tadašnje Nešnal lige. 1903. godine oformljena je današnja struktura sa prvim izdanjem "World Seriesa". Regularna sezona traje od aprila do avgusta te svaka ekipa odigra 162 utakmice. Od ukupno osam ekipa koje izbore plejof dve najbolje igraju "World Series finale". Pobednik je onaj ko prvi stigne do četiri pobede u seriji.

Tvrda, brza, čvrsta, skromna, posjećena i ono najvažnije, posebna. Druga liga engleskog fudbala broji 24 ekipa u borbi za svijetim ciljem, ulaskom u Premiership.

programme.title: Football - English league / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams start the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

Regularna sezona traje od aprila do avgusta te svaka ekipa odigra 162 utakmice. Od ukupno osam ekipa koje izbore plejof dve najbolje igraju "World Series finale". Pobednik je onaj ko prvi stigne do četiri pobede u seriji.

programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams start the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of Turkish basketball go back far before the founding of the league in 1966. As early as the beginning of the 20th century, hooping was known in Turkey. Students from Robert College in Istanbul discovered the magic of this team sport for the first time in 1904. A year after the founding of the league, the first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs began. Three years later, the second league was launched. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that play each other twice in the regular season, followed by a playoff for the eight best teams. The two lowest placed teams are eliminated from the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Football - Scottish Premiership / Fudbal - Škotski Premiership
programme.desc: The Scottish Football Championship started its first season in 1890, and even then a rarity was established. The two teams then shared the championship title due to the same number of points at the end of the season. These were today's world-famous Glasgow Rangers, a team with more than 50 championship titles, and today's relatively unknown Dumbarton club. The league itself has changed names and format on a couple of occasions over the years, but since 2013 it is officially called the "Scottish Professional Football League" and is the highest level of Scottish football. The league is also marked by one of the biggest derbies in football history between two Glasgow teams, Celtic and Rangers. / Škotsko fudbalsko prvenstvo u svoju prvu sezonu su krenuli 1890. godine i već tada je postavljen jedan raritet. Dve ekipe su tada podijelile šampionsku titulu zbog istog broja bodova na kraju sezone. To su bili danas svjetski poznati Glazgov Rendžersi, ekipa sa više od 50 šampionskih titula i danas relativno nepoznati klub Dumbarton. Sama liga je kroz godine u par navrata mijenjala nazive i format, no od 2013. se službeno zove "Scottish Professional Football League" i najviši je rang škotskog fudbala. Ligu isto obilježava jedan od najvećih derbija u istoriji fudbala između dve glazgovske ekipe Seltika i Rendžersa.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA league / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name several times depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games, each against each other, one at home and one away, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differed from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: American football - NFL / Američki fudbal - NFL
programme.desc: The largest and most popular American football league in the world, the NFL, was founded in 1920, but only by merging with the competing AFL in the middle of the last century, was the present version of the competition created. The league features 32 teams divided into two conferences. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The six best teams of the conference each enter the playoffs until the grand finale, popularly called the Super Bowl. The Super Bowl takes place at the beginning of February and is the most media-covered sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svijetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podijeljene u dvije konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plej-of do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Basketball - 2nd ABA League / Košarka - 2. ABA Liga
programme.desc: The 2nd ABA League is a league of the second level of the regional basketball ABA League. Krka Novo Mesto is the historic first winner of the ABA 2nd League, a competition that was founded in the 2017/2018 season. Along with the victory in the final four and the trophy for the winner, the Krka team also achieved placement in the 1st ABA league from next season. 12 teams participate in the league, and after the two-round system of matches, they are looking for a way to the four best teams and a place in the final four. The purpose of the ABA 2nd League is to enable smaller basketball communities to compete with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Basketball - Champions League / Košarka - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is the new Fiba "Basketball Champions League". The goal of this league is to compete with the organization "Euroleague Basketball S.L." and its Euroleague, which includes the strongest European clubs. In such a league, clubs acquire the right to perform based on placement in their own national championships, while in the Euroleague, the right to perform is acquired based on licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, the regular part, the playoffs and the final tournament of the best four, or popularly called the final four. The final is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina "Basketball Champions League". Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji "Euroleague Basketball S.L." i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajnal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Sportske igre mladih BiH
programme.desc: The youth sports games are the biggest event for children and youth in this area, whose main goal is to promote a healthy lifestyle and friendship. / Sportske igre mladih najveća su manifestacija za djecu i omladinu na ovim prostorima čiji je osnovni cilj promocija zdravog načina života i prijateljstva.

programme.title: Handball: EHF Champions League / Rukomet: EHF Liga prvaka
programme.desc: The Handball League of Champions has its beginnings since 1955, when the competition was founded under the name of the Champions Cup. We got our first winner in the 1956-1957 season. year, and that was the team from Prague, because in that season only the city's selections performed. Today that club is called Dukla Prague. Until 1993, the competition was held under that name and was played according to the knockout cup system. Since 1993, in addition to changing the name to the Champions League, a group stage of the competition followed by eliminations has been introduced. The group stage has changed over the years, and the Final Four was introduced for the four best handball teams in Europe, after which the champion is awarded. / Rukometna Liga prvaka svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobjednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. Od 1993. godine osim promene naziva u Ligu prvaka, uvedena je i grupna faza takmičenja nakon koje slede eliminacije. Grupna faza se sa godinama mijenjala te je uveden i Fajnal for za četiri najbolje rukometne ekipe Evrope nakon koje se dobija prvak.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA league / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name several times depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games, each against each other, one at home and one away, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differed from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - 2nd ABA League / Košarka - 2. ABA Liga
programme.desc: The 2nd ABA League is a league of the second level of the regional basketball ABA League. Krka Novo Mesto is the historic first winner of the ABA 2nd League, a competition that was founded in the 2017/2018 season. Along with the victory in the final four and the trophy for the winner, the Krka team also achieved placement in the 1st ABA league from next season. 12 teams participate in the league, and after the two-round system of matches, they are looking for a way to the four best teams and a place in the final four. The purpose of the ABA 2nd League is to enable smaller basketball communities to compete with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Basketball - Champions League / Košarka - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is the new Fiba "Basketball Champions League". The goal of this league is to compete with the organization "Euroleague Basketball S.L." and its Euroleague, which includes the strongest European clubs. In such a league, clubs acquire the right to perform based on placement in their own national championships, while in the Euroleague, the right to perform is acquired based on licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, the regular part, the playoffs and the final tournament of the best four, or popularly called the final four. The final is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina "Basketball Champions League". Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji "Euroleague Basketball S.L." i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajnal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB league / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. In addition to the dominant Russian clubs, the league also includes clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakhstan and Latvia. Throughout the history of the league, which was launched in 2008, clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine also participated. Starting with the 2013-2014 season. The VTB League is also a national championship for Russian clubs, the best placed of which becomes the champion of Russia. In order for clubs to join the league, they must have a hall with a minimum capacity of 3,000 spectators. The name of the VTB League comes from the general sponsor of the league, VTB Bank. FIBA Europe officially recognized the league in 2013. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Football - Polish League / Fudbal - Poljska liga
programme.desc: Ekstraklasa is the highest professional football league in Poland. The first Polish football league was founded in 1927, and the league is organized by the Polish Football Association (PZPN). Currently, 16 teams participate in the league, and the winner directly wins the title of Polish champion. / Ekstraklasa je najviša profesionalna fudbalska liga Poljske. Prva liga Poljske u fudbalu osnovana je 1927. godine, a tu ligu organizuje Fudbalski savez Poljske (PZPN). Trenutno u ligi sudjeluje 16 ekipa, a pobjednik direktno osvaja titulu poljskog šampiona.

programme.title: Football - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: The Italian Serie A is a professional football competition with 20 teams in a two-round league championship. Ever since it was founded in 1929, Serie A has become synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football was considered the best in Europe due to its quality and a series of great players and coaches. With the decline of the financial power of the Italian first league teams and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly dropped in quality, but it is returning to its rightful place with sure steps. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - English league / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams start the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Basketball - 2nd ABA League / Košarka - 2. ABA Liga
programme.desc: The 2nd ABA League is a league of the second level of the regional basketball ABA League. Krka Novo Mesto is the historic first winner of the ABA 2nd League, a competition that was founded in the 2017/2018 season. Along with the victory in the final four and the trophy for the winner, the Krka team also achieved placement in the 1st ABA league from next season. 12 teams participate in the league, and after the two-round system of matches, they are looking for a way to the four best teams and a place in the final four. The purpose of the ABA 2nd League is to enable smaller basketball communities to compete with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Basketball - Champions League / Košarka - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is the new Fiba "Basketball Champions League". The goal of this league is to compete with the organization "Euroleague Basketball S.L." and its Euroleague, which includes the strongest European clubs. In such a league, clubs acquire the right to perform based on placement in their own national championships, while in the Euroleague, the right to perform is acquired based on licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, the regular part, the playoffs and the final tournament of the best four, or popularly called the final four. The final is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina "Basketball Champions League". Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji "Euroleague Basketball S.L." i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajnal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.desc: The youth sports games are the biggest event for children and youth in this area, whose main goal is to promote a healthy lifestyle and friendship. / Sportske igre mladih najveća su manifestacija za djecu i omladinu na ovim prostorima čiji je osnovni cilj promocija zdravog načina života i prijateljstva.

programme.title: Handball: EHF Champions League / Rukomet: EHF Liga prvaka
programme.desc: The Handball League of Champions has its beginnings since 1955, when the competition was founded under the name of the Champions Cup. We got our first winner in the 1956-1957 season. year, and that was the team from Prague, because in that season only the city's selections performed. Today that club is called Dukla Prague. Until 1993, the competition was held under that name and was played according to the knockout cup system. Since 1993, in addition to changing the name to the Champions League, a group stage of the competition followed by eliminations has been introduced. The group stage has changed over the years, and the Final Four was introduced for the four best handball teams in Europe, after which the champion is awarded. / Rukometna Liga prvaka svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobjednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. Od 1993. godine osim promene naziva u Ligu prvaka, uvedena je i grupna faza takmičenja nakon koje slede eliminacije. Grupna faza se sa godinama mijenjala te je uveden i Fajnal for za četiri najbolje rukometne ekipe Evrope nakon koje se dobija prvak.

U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Basketball - Champions League / Košarka - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is the new Fiba "Basketball Champions League". The goal of this league is to compete with the organization "Euroleague Basketball S.L." and its Euroleague, which includes the strongest European clubs. In such a league, clubs acquire the right to perform based on placement in their own national championships, while in the Euroleague, the right to perform is acquired based on licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, the regular part, the playoffs and the final tournament of the best four, or popularly called the final four. The final is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina "Basketball Champions League". Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji "Euroleague Basketball S.L." i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajnal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB league / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. In addition to the dominant Russian clubs, the league also includes clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakhstan and Latvia. Throughout the history of the league, which was launched in 2008, clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine also participated. Starting with the 2013-2014 season. The VTB League is also a national championship for Russian clubs, the best placed of which becomes the champion of Russia. In order for clubs to join the league, they must have a hall with a minimum capacity of 3,000 spectators. The name of the VTB League comes from the general sponsor of the league, VTB Bank. FIBA Europe officially recognized the league in 2013. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA league / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name several times depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games, each against each other, one at home and one away, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differed from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - 2nd ABA League / Košarka - 2. ABA Liga
programme.desc: The 2nd ABA League is a league of the second level of the regional basketball ABA League. Krka Novo Mesto is the historic first winner of the ABA 2nd League, a competition that was founded in the 2017/2018 season. programme.title: Football - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: The Italian Serie A is a professional football competition with 20 teams in a two-round league championship. Ever since it was founded in 1929, Serie A has become synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football was considered the best in Europe due to its quality and a series of great players and coaches. With the decline of the financial power of the Italian first league teams and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly dropped in quality, but it is returning to its rightful place with sure steps. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - English league / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams start the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: The Croatian Football League (HNL) was founded in 1992 and the first historical title was won by Hajduk from Split. Over the years, the competition system and the number of clubs have changed, but in recent years, the current system with 10 teams and a four-round format of the competition has been established. The transitional cup intended for the champion is the work of academic sculptor Marijan Zaradić. Dinamo from Zagreb won it the most times. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Serbian Superliga / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Superliga premiered in the 2006/2007 season. In today's system, the league has 20 teams and functions according to the two-round competition principle. The history of the Superliga was largely marked by two great Belgrade rivals, Partizan and Crvena zvezda. Historically speaking, in terms of the number of titles won, the red and white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Great Sporting Moments
programme.desc: A magazine about the greatest moments in sports history. / Magazin o najvećim trenucima u istoriji sporta.

programme.title: Fudbal: Europaliga
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation UEFE from 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cities Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. From that season, the competition was officially called the UEFA Cup and was under that name until 2009, when it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the format of the competition has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. a group stage was introduced followed by eliminations. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the final of the Uefa Cup by the Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded every year to the winner who keeps it for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Evropa ligu. Tokom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. godine za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB league / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. In addition to the dominant Russian clubs, the league also includes clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakhstan and Latvia. Throughout the history of the league, which was launched in 2008, clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine also participated. Starting with the 2013-2014 season. The VTB League is also a national championship for Russian clubs, the best placed of which becomes the champion of Russia. In order for clubs to join the league, they must have a hall with a minimum capacity of 3,000 spectators. The name of the VTB League comes from the general sponsor of the league, VTB Bank. FIBA Europe officially recognized the league in 2013. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Football - Romanian League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: The first football league of Romania has a long history, the first season was played back in 1909, when the now defunct Olympia Bucharest won the first title. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steaua and Dinamo Bucharest, who took most of the championship titles. Currently, the league has 14 clubs and after the "regular" part, where each team plays one game at home and one away, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is the play off for the champion, where the six best-placed clubs participate, while the rest fight in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Football - English league / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams start the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football - Serbian Superliga / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Superliga premiered in the 2006/2007 season. In today's system, the league has 20 teams and functions according to the two-round competition principle. The history of the Superliga was largely marked by two great Belgrade rivals, Partizan and Crvena zvezda. Historically speaking, in terms of the number of titles won, the red and white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. programme.title: Football - Polish League / Fudbal - Poljska liga
programme.desc: Ekstraklasa is the highest professional football league in Poland. The first Polish football league was founded in 1927, and the league is organized by the Polish Football Association (PZPN). Currently, 16 teams participate in the league, and the winner directly wins the title of Polish champion. / Ekstraklasa je najviša profesionalna fudbalska liga Poljske. Prva liga Poljske u fudbalu osnovana je 1927. godine, a tu ligu organizuje Fudbalski savez Poljske (PZPN). Trenutno u ligi sudjeluje 16 ekipa, a pobjednik direktno osvaja titulu poljskog šampiona.

programme.title: NHL
programme.desc: The "Natonal Hockey League" is the most prestigious club hockey competition in the world, which dates back to 1917, when the competition was formed and operated with two other North American hockey associations. Since 1926, the NHL has become the main and most important hockey association and thus the competition in North America. The competition itself is divided into two divisions, Western and Eastern, and after the regular part, the playoffs for the Stanley Cup trophy are played. / "Natonal Hockey League" je najprestižnije klupsko hokejaško takmičenje na svijetu koje datira još iz 1917. godine kada je takmičenje formirano i funkcionisalo je sa još dvije sjevernoameričke hokejšake asocijacije. Od 1926. NHL postaje glavna i najznačajnija hokejaška asocijacija i samim time takmičenje u Severnoj Americi. Samo takmičenje je podijeljeno u dve divizije, zapadnu i istočnu te se nakon regularnog dijela igra plejof za trofej Stenli kupa.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: The Croatian Football League (HNL) was founded in 1992 and the first historical title was won by Hajduk from Split. Over the years, the competition system and the number of clubs have changed, but in recent years, the current system with 10 teams and a four-round format of the competition has been established. The transitional cup intended for the champion is the work of academic sculptor Marijan Zaradić. Dinamo from Zagreb won it the most times. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Fudbal: Europaliga
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation UEFE from 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cities Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. From that season, the competition was officially called the UEFA Cup and was under that name until 2009, when it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the format of the competition has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. a group stage was introduced followed by eliminations. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the final of the Uefa Cup by the Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded every year to the winner who keeps it for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Evropa ligu. Tokom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. godine za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Football - England 2nd league / Fudbal - Engleska 2. liga
programme.desc: Somewhere beyond the multimillion-dollar contracts and the glittering lights of media popularity sits the Championship, the English league it once was. Hard, fast, solid, modest, visited and most importantly, special. The second league of English football has 24 teams fighting for the sacred goal of entering the Premiership. / Negde izvan multimilionskih ugovora i blještavih svijetla medijske popularnosti smjestio se Championship, engleska liga kakva je nekada bila. Tvrda, brza, čvrsta, skromna, posjećena i ono najvažnije, posebna. Druga liga engleskog fudbala broji 24 ekipa u borbi za svijetim ciljem, ulaskom u Premiership.

programme.title: Football - Serbian Superliga / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Superliga premiered in the 2006/2007 season. In today's system, the league has 20 teams and functions according to the two-round competition principle. The history of the Superliga was largely marked by two great Belgrade rivals, Partizan and Crvena zvezda. programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: The Croatian Football League (HNL) was founded in 1992 and the first historical title was won by Hajduk from Split. Over the years, the competition system and the number of clubs have changed, but in recent years, the current system with 10 teams and a four-round format of the competition has been established. The transitional cup intended for the champion is the work of academic sculptor Marijan Zaradić. Dinamo from Zagreb won it the most times. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB league / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. In addition to the dominant Russian clubs, the league also includes clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakhstan and Latvia. Throughout the history of the league, which was launched in 2008, clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine also participated. Starting with the 2013-2014 season. The VTB League is also a national championship for Russian clubs, the best placed of which becomes the champion of Russia. In order for clubs to join the league, they must have a hall with a minimum capacity of 3,000 spectators. The name of the VTB League comes from the general sponsor of the league, VTB Bank. FIBA Europe officially recognized the league in 2013. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Football - Romanian League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: The first football league of Romania has a long history, the first season was played back in 1909, when the now defunct Olympia Bucharest won the first title. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steaua and Dinamo Bucharest, who took most of the championship titles. Currently, the league has 14 clubs and after the "regular" part, where each team plays one game at home and one away, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is the play off for the champion, where the six best-placed clubs participate, while the rest fight in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Football - English league / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams start the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: NHL
programme.desc: The "Natonal Hockey League" is the most prestigious club hockey competition in the world, which dates back to 1917, when the competition was formed and operated with two other North American hockey associations. Since 1926, the NHL has become the main and most important hockey association and thus the competition in North America. The competition itself is divided into two divisions, Western and Eastern, and after the regular part, the playoffs for the Stanley Cup trophy are played. / "Natonal Hockey League" je najprestižnije klupsko hokejaško takmičenje na svijetu koje datira još iz 1917. godine kada je takmičenje formirano i funkcionisalo je sa još dvije sjevernoameričke hokejšake asocijacije. Od 1926. NHL postaje glavna i najznačajnija hokejaška asocijacija i samim time takmičenje u Severnoj Americi. Samo takmičenje je podijeljeno u dve divizije, zapadnu i istočnu te se nakon regularnog dijela igra plejof za trofej Stenli kupa.

programme.title: Arena Sport 1x2
programme.desc: Arena Sport 1x2 follows excitement and changes in results on all fields around the planet. In addition to live broadcasts, this channel is the right place to be the first to know when the ball enters the net or passes through the net. An unusual channel in this area, modeled on similar ones in England, France and Germany. Special graphics, state of the tables, current form... Special daily shows, analyses, famous guests. There are of course direct broadcasts, multicasts of matches that start at the same time, attractive replays... If you are interested in the latest results _ Arena Sport 1x2 is the right place for you. / Arena Sport 1x2 prati uzbuđenja i promene rezultata na svim terenima širom planete. Pored direktnih prenosa, ovaj kanal je pravo mesto na kome prvi možete da saznate kada lopta uđe u mrežu ili prođe kroz mrežicu. Nesvakidašnji kanal na ovim prostorima, po uzoru na slične u Engleskoj, Francuskoj i Nemačkoj. Posebna grafika, stanje na tabelama, trenutna forma… Specijalne dnevne emisije, analize, poznati gosti. Tu su naravno direktni prenosi, multiprenosi utakmica koje počinju u isto vreme, atraktivne reprize… Ukoliko vas zanimaju najnoviji rezultati _ Arena Sport 1x2 je pravo mesto za vas.

programme.title: Football - Europa League / Fudbal - Liga Evrope
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation UEFE since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cities Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and was under that name until 2009, when it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the format of the competition has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. a group stage was introduced followed by eliminations. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the final of the Uefa Cup by the Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded every year to the winner who keeps it for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Evropske fudbalske federacije UEFE od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog takmičenja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone takmičenje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Evrope. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobednika ovog takmičenja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane italijanskog umetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodeljuje pobedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Football - Russian League / Fudbal - Ruska liga
programme.desc: The Russian Football League, as the successor of the Soviet Union, records its competitive beginnings in 1936, although football has been played on the territory of the Union since the 1900s. Petersburg. The league will continue until the 2012/2013 season. played in the term spring - autumn due to the long winter, and since then it has been played classically European autumn - spring. Najuspješnija ekipa za to vreme je Moskovski Spartak iako od početka drugog dela veka uspješniji su klubovi poput CSKA Moskve i Zenita iz St. Petersburga. Liga se sve do sezone 2012./2013. igrala u terminu proleće _ jesen zbog dugačke zime te se od tada igra klasično evropski jesen _ proleće. programme.title: Football - Swiss league / Fudbal - Švajcarska liga
programme.desc: The Swiss league is one of the longest-running leagues in Europe, the first season of which started back in the 20th century, i.e. from 1897. Since 2003, the league has been played according to the system of ten teams, where each team plays four games, two at home and two away. After 36 rounds, the last team leaves the elite rank of Swiss football and is relegated to the second Swiss league. The team with the most titles is Grasshopper Club Zurich with 27, of which 19 are in the professional period. The new millennium was marked by the club from Basel with multiple consecutive championship titles and very good results in the Champions League. / Švajcarska liga je jedna od najdugovječnijih liga u Evropi čija je prva sezona krenula još u 20. veku odnosno od 1897. godine. Liga se od 2003. igra po sistemu deset ekipa gde svaki igra sa svakim četiri utakmice po dve kući i dve u gostima. Poslednja ekipa nakon 36 kola napušta elitni rang švajvarskog fudbala i ispada u drugu švajcarsku ligu. Ekipa sa najviše titula je Grasshopper Club Zurich sa 27, od kojih su 19 u razdoblju profesionalizma. Novi milenijum je obeležio klub iz Bazela sa višestrukim uzastopnim titulama prvaka i jako dobrim rezultatima u Ligi šampiona.

programme.title: Football - France 2nd League / Fudbal - Francuska 2. liga
programme.desc: Ligue 2 is the second lowest level of French club football competitions. The league was founded in 1933 and in its current format has a total of 20 clubs. The league part consists of 38 rounds in which each team plays at home and away with each of the remaining clubs in the league. The two best-placed teams achieve direct placement in Ligue 1, while three more clubs, through additional play-offs, hunt for another position for placement in the elite class of French football. The last two teams are relegated to the lower ranks of the competition. / Ligue 2 drugi je po niou razred francuskih klupskih fudbalskih takmičenja. Liga je osnovana 1933. godine i u današnjem formatu broji ukupno 20 klubova. Ligaški deo sastoji je od 38 kola u kojima svaka ekipa kod kuće i u gostima igra sa svakim od preostalih klubova u ligi. Dve najbolje plasirane ekipe ostvaruju direktna plasman u Ligue 1 dok još tri kluba kroz dodatno razigravanje lovi još jednu poziciju za plasman u elitni razred francuskog fudbala. Dve poslednje ekipe ispadaju u niži rang takmičenja.

programme.title: Football - English league / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams start the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Cycling WC Kigali (w) / Biciklizam WC Kigali (ž)
programme.desc: The World Cycling Championships in Kigali are historic because they are being held in Africa for the first time. programme.title: Velodrome - WC, Santiago de Chile / Velodrom - WC, Santijago de Čile
programme.desc: Chile is hosting the 122nd edition of the UCI Track Cycling World Championships. Performances of the world's best cyclists are expected, and the competition will be held in a modern facility that was built in 2014. / Čile je domaćin 122. izdanja UCI Svetskog prvenstva u biciklizmu na stazi. Očekuju se nastupi najboljih svetskih biciklista, a takmičenje će se održati u modernom objektu koji je izgrađen 2014. godine.

programme.title: Cycling - Tour de France (M) / Biciklizam - Tur Francuske (M)
programme.desc: The Tour de France is an annual bicycle race through France with occasional visits to neighboring countries. Trka se tradicionalno vozi u julu tokom tri nedelje, dugačka je oko 3500 km i sastoji se od 21 etape i dva slobodna dana.

programme.desc: The Tour de France is an annual bicycle race through France with occasional visits to neighboring countries. It was held for the first time in 1903 and since then it has been held every year with a break of several years during the two world wars. The race is traditionally run in July for three weeks, it is about 3500 km long and consists of 21 stages and two days off. / Tour de France je godišnja biciklistička trka kroz Francusku uz povremene posete susednim zemljama. Prvi put je održana 1903. i od tada se održava svake godine uz nekoliko godina pauze tokom dva svetska rata. Trka se tradicionalno vozi u julu tokom tri nedelje, dugačka je oko 3500 km i sastoji se od 21 etape i dva slobodna dana.

programme.title: Ples sudbine
programme.desc: The hired killer Gaspar surprises Rafael. Gaspar gives up his job and goes after Joaquim to leave Rafael alone. Isadora donates clothes, shoes and other clothing accessories, and Emília uses the donation to go to the casino and pretend to be a rich widow. Joaquim goes to the factory's anniversary celebration to comfort Isadora over Rafael's death. But Rafael appeared alive and well. Inácio spilled food on his clothes. Arminda sees him without a shirt and is petrified. Eugenio declares his love for Violeta again. Isadora asks Rafael to meet someone from his past, and he turns to his old friend Romana to help him with the lie. Lorenzo flies in a plane with Marcos, but they are attacked and the plane crashes. / Plaćeni ubojica Gaspar iznenadi Rafaela. Gaspar odustaje od posla i kreće za Joaquimom kako bi Rafaela ostavio na miru. Isadora donira odjeću, obuću i ostale odjevne dodatke, a Emília iskoristi donaciju za odlazak u kasino i glumi bogatu udovicu. Joaquim odlazi na proslavu godišnjice tvornice kako bi utješio Isadoru zbog Rafaelove smrti. Ali Rafael se pojavi živ i zdrav. Inácio ga zalije jelom po odjeći. Arminda ga vidi bez košulje i skameni se. Eugenio ponovno izjavljuje ljubav Violeti. Isadora moli Rafaela da upozna nekoga iz njegove prošlosti, a on se obrati staroj prijateljici Romani da mu pomogne oko laži. Lorenzo leti u avionu s Marcosom, ali napadnu ih i avion padne.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Júlia confides in Vitoria that Marco still claims to be Marquinho's father and says that a DNA test should be done. He also tells her that David has agreed to move in with her. But she is now afraid that Tiago will want to bring Cacau and Marquinho to the house. / Júlia se povjeri Vitoriji da Marco i dalje tvrdi da je Marquinhov otac i kaže da bi valjalo napraviti DNK test. Također joj kaže da se David pristao doseliti k njoj. Ali ona se sada boji da će Tiago htjeti dovesti u kuću Cacau i Marquinha.

programme.title: At our home / Kod nas doma
programme.desc: For more than three decades, Gazda's musical group has been performing songs that combine tradition, emotion and contemporary tambura sound. Our guests are Marko Bujanović and Damir Popović from the band Gazde. She is the new Croatian record holder in the 400 meters hurdles, and he is the fastest Croatian in the 800 meters after more than half a century. One of the most successful and most in love sports couples in Croatia, the athletic record holders Natalija Švenda and Marino Bloudek, is coming to the show. In today's world, it is increasingly difficult to separate work from private life, so many feel tired and lose the balance between these two worlds. We talk about it with psychologist Maša Tonković Grabovac. / Već više od tri desetljeća glazbeni sastav Gazde donosi pjesme koje spajaju tradiciju, emociju i suvremeni tamburaški zvuk. U goste nam dolaze Marko Bujanović i Damir Popović iz benda Gazde. Ona je nova hrvatska rekorderka na 400 metara s preponama, a on najbrži Hrvat na 800 metara nakon više od pola stoljeća. U emisiju nam dolazi jedan od najuspješnijih, ali i najzaljubljenijih sportskih parova u Hrvatskoj, atletski rekorderi Natalija Švenda i Marino Bloudek. U današnjem svijetu sve je teže odvojiti posao od privatnog života, pa mnogi osjećaju umor i gube ravnotežu između ta dva svijeta. O tome razgovaramo sa psihologinjom Mašom Tonković Grabovac.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Skica za portret
programme.desc: In the form of a short documentary film, the show presents authors important for Croatian history and culture. / U formi kratkog dokumentarnog filma emisija predstavlja autore važne za hrvatsku povijest i kulturu.

programme.title: Kulturna baština
programme.desc: About thirty kilometers from Zagreb, in the Moslavina plain, is Ivanić-Grad. In addition to being a civilian settlement, it was also a military fortress. It was mentioned for the first time in 1246 as part of the property of the Zagreb Diocese. / Tridesetak kilometara od Zagreba, u moslavačkoj ravnici, smjestio se Ivanić-Grad. Bio je, osim civilnog naselja, i vojna utvrda. Prvi put se spominje 1246. kao dio posjeda Zagrebačke biskupije.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: The brain is the center of the nervous system and the most important organ for a person's ability to think and most functions in the body. It has no pain receptors and therefore cannot feel pain, but any disease affecting that organ can be fatal. One of them is certainly meningitis, the secrets of which we reveal with infectious disease specialist Viktor Kotarski and virologist Vladimir Stevanović. / Mozak je središte živčanog sustava i najvažniji organ za čovjekovu sposobnost razmišljanja i većinu funkcija u tijelu. Nema receptore za bol i zbog toga ne može osjetiti bol, no svaka bolest koja zahvati taj organ može biti fatalna. Jedna od njih svakako je meningitis čije tajne razotkrivamo s infektologom Viktorom Kotarskim i virologom Vladimirom Stevanovićem.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Time spent cooking helps you develop a refined palate, improve your cooking skills and boost your confidence. Today, Lidia will reveal the secrets of preparing a salad of thinly sliced ​​artichokes, spinach and mortadella. He will pair that special salad with one of his favorite dishes _ mussels with sausage meat and potatoes in white wine, which is a great weekday one-pot meal. / Vrijeme provedeno u kuhanju pomaže vam da steknete istančano nepce, poboljšate kuharske vještine i povećate samopouzdanje. Lidia će danas otkriti tajne pripreme salate od tanko narezanih artičoka, špinata i mortadele. Tu posebnu salatu spojit će s jednim od svojih najdražih jela _ dagnjama s mesom kobasica i krumpirom u bijelom vinu, što je izvrsno jelo iz jednog lonca na radni dan.
