programme.title: Zlatna liga
programme.desc: Theatre, film, television and radio. These are the four threads that we will weave together today in the Golden League. It's easy to shine as an actress, but it's harder to last. We have two great actresses who have been doing it for more than half a century _ we are honored to host Ljubica Jović and Helena Buljan! / Kazalište, film, televizija i radio. To su četiri niti koje ćemo danas ispreplesti u Zlatnoj ligi. Lako je zabljesnuti kao glumica, a teže je trajati. U goste nam stižu dvije velike glumice koje to uspijevaju već više od pola stoljeća _ čast nam je ugostiti Ljubicu Jović i Helenu Buljan!

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Today, Lidia will prepare a sauce made of white beans and pesto for a spring taste. Her granddaughter Julia will stop by for raw vegetables with gravy. Lidia will then pay tribute to spring vegetables with classic spring spaghetti. Ricotta is sweetest in spring, so Lidija's frittata with spinach, bread and ricotta tastes best when prepared at that time of year. Spring has come, so let's find inspiration. / Lidia će danas pripremiti umak od bijeloga graha i pesta radi proljetnog okusa. Njezina unuka Julia svratit će na sirovo povrće s umakom. Lidia će potom odati počast proljetnom povrću klasičnim proljetnim špagetima. Ricotta je najslađa u proljeće pa Lidijina fritaja sa špinatom, kruhom i ricottom ima najbolji okus kad se priprema u to doba godine. Došlo je proljeće pa pronađimo nadahnuće.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: To the series of health topics, we add one that talks about the importance of solving problems in the field of dental medicine. How to correct irregular tooth growth, replace lost teeth or solve a dental problem that goes beyond the domain of our dentist? If you want to learn more about topics in the field of oral surgery and orthodontics, stay with us. / Nizu zdravstvenih tema dodajemo i onu koja govori o važnosti rješavanja problema s područja dentalne medicine. Kako ispraviti nepravilan rast zuba, nadomjestiti izgubljene zube ili riješiti neki stomatološki problem koji nadilazi domenu našeg stomatologa? Želite li saznati više o temama s područja oralne kirurgije i ortodoncije, budite uz nas.

programme.title: TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, broadcast daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Majoris found Rosa in tears. She tells her that Sal threatened to fire her. Sal arrives with Susan and accuses Simone of bribing Marlene to keep her secret. Investigators arrive to question Simone. / Majoris zatekne Rosu u suzama. Ona joj oda da joj je Sal prijetila otkazom. Sal dolazi sa Susanom i optuži Simone da je potkupila Marlene kako bi čuvala njezinu tajnu. Istražitelji dolaze kako bi ispitali Simone.

programme.title: La Promesa
programme.desc: Jana tells Leocadia that she is Dolores' daughter. María Fernández entered the secret room. Lorenzo returns, and Curro attacks him for secretly arranging a marriage for him. Ana kisses Ricardo, and Santos sees it. Jana has had enough, so she accuses Cruz of murdering her mother and Tomás. / Jana kaže Leocadiji da je ona Doloresina kći. María Fernández uđe u tajnu sobu. Lorenzo se vrati, a Curro ga napadne da potajno dogovara brak za njega. Ana poljubi Ricarda, a Santos to vidi. Jani je svega dosta pa optuži Cruz za ubojstvo svoje majke i Tomása.

programme.title: Najljepša europska sela
programme.desc: The stunning Andalusian white village of Setenil de las Bodegas is an incredible symbiosis of nature and man. Interspersed with rocks, it resembles a Hungarian cake. We walked through one of the world's most beautiful streets and learned what it's like to live in the rocks with pebbles in your hair. We also visited the nearby blue village of Juzcar and discovered how peasant harmony can triple the number of tourists. While we were filming spectacular scenes, the hosts were filming our companion, the world-famous actor Luka Peroš, who is the star of Messi and Modrić. These magical places soothe like a siesta. You can visit them too, only on HTV1. / Zapanjujuće andaluzijsko bijelo selo Setenil de las Bodegas nevjerojatna je simbioza prirode i čovjeka. Ispresijecano stijenama nalikuje kolaču mađarici, mljac. Prošetali smo jednom od najljepših svjetskih ulica i saznali kako je živjeti u stijenama s kamenčićima u kosi. Obišli smo i obližnje plavo selo Juzcar te otkrili kako seljačka sloga može utrostručiti broj turista. Dok smo mi snimali spektakularne prizore, domaćini su snimali našega suputnika, svjetski poznatoga glumca Luku Peroša, koji je zvijezda Messiju i Modriću. Ova čarobna mjesta umiruju kao siesta. I ti ih posjeti, samo na HTV1.

programme.title: Dnevnik Nomada
programme.desc: In the valley of the Omo river, in the extreme south of Ethiopia, Kristijan Iličić witnesses the living customs of the tribes that were ruled by the Seljan brothers on behalf of the Ethiopian emperor. In the Hamar tribe, he attends a shocking ceremony of whipping women. In the Karo tribe, he discovers the terrible practice of killing the so-called cursed "mingi" children, so he talks to a mother who killed her three children because of superstition. From the women of the Mursi tribe, he learns everything about the tradition of wearing a plate in the mouth, and in the Dasanech tribe, he discovers the horrors of genital mutilation of girls. But although the reality of tribal life is often shocking, it also contains many positive sides, the humanity that Christian manages to bring to the surface. In the Omo River Valley, he is also trying to find the girls from his tattoos, which he photographed in 2009, when he first visited the tribes in southern Ethiopia. / U dolini rijeke Omo, na krajnjem jugu Etiopije, Kristijan Iličić svjedoči i danas živim običajima plemena kojima su u ime etiopskog cara vladala braća Seljan. U plemenu Hamar nazoči šokantnoj ceremoniji bičevanja žena. U plemenu Karo otkriva strašnu praksu ubojstva tzv. uklete "mingi" djece pa razgovara s majkom koja je zbog praznovjerja ubila svoje troje djece. Od žena iz plemena Mursi saznaje sve o tradiciji nošenja tanjura u usnama, a u plemenu Dasanech otkriva užase genitalne mutilacije djevojčica. Ali iako je stvarnost plemenskog života često šokantna, ona sadrži i mnoge pozitivne strane, ljudskost koju Kristijan uspijeva izvući na površinu. U dolini rijeke Omo također pokušava pronaći djevojčice sa svojih tetovaža, koje je fotografirao 2009., kada je prvi put posjetio plemena na jugu Etiopije.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - Wild People / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: Ben traveled to South America to visit Rhona, a British actress who has turned her back on Hollywood and now lives alone in an isolated valley in Uruguay. Ben is intrigued by this contrast, and Rhona reveals that her decision to drastically change her life was driven by health problems, a difficult childhood and disillusionment with Hollywood culture. He learns that Rhona has devoted herself to rehabilitating horses. Together they will go to the auction, in search of abused animals that they can save. Rhona will also tell Ben how she adapted to the macho culture of rural Uruguay _ or vice versa. On one occasion, Rhona narrowly escaped serious injury on her home soil. Ben realizes that she wouldn't be able to call anyone for help if something really went wrong because she's so far from her first neighbors. That night he himself will experience the wrath of nature. / Ben je otputovao u Južnu Ameriku kako bi posjetio Rhonu, britansku glumicu koja je okrenula leđa Hollywoodu i sad živi sama u izoliranoj dolini u Urugvaju. Ben je zaintrigiran tim kontrastom, a Rhona otkriva da su je na odluku o drastičnoj promjeni života navele zdravstvene tegobe, teško djetinjstvo i razočaranje holivudskom kulturom. Saznaje da se Rhona posvetila rehabilitiranju konja. Zajedno će otići na aukciju, u potragu za zlostavljanim životinjama koje mogu spasiti. Rhona će ispričati Benu i kako se prilagodila mačističkoj kulturi ruralnog Urugvaja _ ili obratno. Rhona je jednom prilikom za dlaku izbjegla tešku ozljedu na svojoj zemlji. Ben uviđa da ne bi mogla nikoga pozvati u pomoć kad bi nešto zaista pošlo naopako jer je vrlo daleko od prvih susjeda. Te noći i sam će iskusiti gnjev prirode.

programme.title: RIGHTS - promet info / HAK - promet info
programme.desc: Aktualne informacije o cestovnom i trajektnom prometu, uz javljanja iz Hrvatskog autokluba.

programme.title: Vijesti
programme.desc: A short overview of news from Croatia and the world. / Kratki pregled vijesti iz Hrvatske i svijeta.

programme.title: Regionalni dnevnik
programme.desc: HTV teams from all Croatian counties bring the most interesting current events and stories from all over the country, and there is also a detailed regional weather forecast. / Ekipe HTV-a iz svih hrvatskih županija donose najzanimljivije aktualne događaje i priče iz cijele zemlje, a tu je i detaljna regionalna vremenska prognoza.

programme.title: At our home / Kod nas doma
programme.desc: What does life with ADHD or autism look like in a world that constantly expects us to adapt? We talk about this with Lea Ivančić Žic Peša, psychotherapist, speech therapist and author of the book "Stop, breathe, let go, dance _ How to (re)live neurodiversity". Yesterday in Strasbourg _ today in our studio! Professor Dejan Nemčić and his students, eighth-graders Leda Milat and Magdalena Viktoria Tadić, gave a speech in the European Parliament. We will find out today what they told the representatives. We also talk about a topic that, unfortunately, touches us more and more: hate speech, which is increasingly spilling over from the Internet into real life. Bruno Šimleša and his guests _ Monika Herceg and Maja Sever will talk about it. / Kako izgleda život s ADHD-om ili autizmom u svijetu koji od nas stalno očekuje prilagodbu? O tome razgovaramo s Leom Ivančić Žic Peša, psihoterapeutkinjom, logopedinjom i autoricom knjige "Stani, diši, pusti, pleši _ Kako (pre)živjeti neurorazličitost". Jučer u Strasbourgu _ danas u našem studiju! Profesor Dejan Nemčić i njegove učenice, osmašice Leda Milat i Magdalena Viktoria Tadić održali su govor u Europskom parlamentu. Što su poručile zastupnicima _ saznat ćemo danas. Govorimo i o temi koja nas, nažalost, sve više dotiče: govor mržnje, koji se s interneta sve češće prelijeva i u stvarni život. O tome će razgovarati Bruno Šimleša i njegove gošće _ Monika Herceg i Maja Sever.

programme.title: Potjera
programme.desc: In The Chase, four contestants answer general knowledge questions and in the process build tactics that can lead them to the final round. But the Hunter stands in their way. In an exciting game of knowledge and speed, this unusual opponent tries to knock them out one by one and send them home empty-handed. The chase is not just a quiz _ it is also a race in which the contestants have to escape the Hunter. Will he be able to keep a step or two ahead of him? Can the chosen four win, no matter how shrewd their opponent is? / U Potjeri četiri natjecatelja odgovaraju na pitanja općeg znanja i pritom grade taktiku koja ih može dovesti do finalnog kruga. No na putu im stoji Lovac. Taj neuobičajeni protivnik u uzbudljivoj igri znanja i brzine pokušava jednog po jednog izbaciti iz igre i poslati ih kući praznih ruku. Potjera nije samo kviz _ ona je i utrka u kojoj natjecatelji moraju pobjeći Lovcu. Hoće li uspjeti zadržati korak-dva prednosti pred njim? Može li četvero izabranih pobijediti, ma koliko oštrouman bio njihov protivnik?

programme.desc: After Diary 1 comes the weather forecast, along with interesting weather and warnings about dangerous weather phenomena, and before Diary 2 a condensed weekly forecast. / Nakon Dnevnika 1 slijedi vremenska prognoza, uz meteozanimljivosti i upozorenja na opasne vremenske pojave, a uoči Dnevnika 2 sažeta tjedna prognoza.

programme.desc: The most important news from the country and the world, numerous reports, guest appearances by prominent experts and commentators in Dnevnik 2, the most watched news show on HTV. Uz sportske aktualnosti pogledajte i detaljnu vremensku prognozu za sljedeće dane.

programme.title: Heart 6 / Loto 6
programme.desc: Follow the Lot 6 draw live. / Pratite izravno izvlačenje Lota 6.

programme.title: Who wants to be a millionaire? / Tko želi biti milijunaš?
programme.desc: "Who wants to be a millionaire?" offers a unique opportunity to make your dreams come true _ and win a sum of money that can change everything. Can the contestants hold up under the pressure, with a million reasons to give their best on the world's most successful game show? In Millionaire, general knowledge merges with human nature _ concentration, strategy and mental strength of the individual. Each question raises the stakes, and the boundaries shift from answer to answer. Will he be able to get to the very end and readily say, "That's my final answer!"? / "Tko želi biti milijunaš?" pruža jedinstvenu priliku za ostvarenje snova _ i osvajanje novčanog iznosa koji može promijeniti sve. Mogu li natjecatelji izdržati pod pritiskom, s milijun razloga da daju najbolje od sebe u najuspješnijem svjetskom game showu? U Milijunašu opće znanje stapaju se s ljudskom prirodom _ koncentracijom, strategijom i mentalnom snagom pojedinca. Svako pitanje podiže ulog, a granice se pomiču iz odgovora u odgovor. Hoće li uspjeti doći do samog kraja i spremno reći: "To je moj konačni odgovor!"?

programme.title: Barbiene mračne tajne
programme.desc: After the billion-dollar movie brought Barbie back into the limelight, journalist Isobel Young investigates one of history's most iconic brands and toy makers, Mattel. "Mattel" profited from the "Barbie" craze, which turned Barbie into a feminist icon of the 21st century. But does this brilliant success also have its dark side? We filmed secretly in one of Mattel's factories. We discovered how the workers who produce the famous dolls and other products actually live. / Nakon što je film koji je zaradio milijardu dolara vratio Barbie u središte pozornosti, novinarka Isobel Young istražuje jedan od najpoznatijih brendova u povijesti i proizvođača igračaka "Mattel". "Mattel" je profitirao od zaluđenosti filmom "Barbie" koji je Barbie pretvorio u feminističku ikonu 21. stoljeća. No ima li taj blistavi uspjeh i svoju mračnu stranu? Potajno smo snimali u jednoj od "Mattelovih" tvornica. Otkrili smo kako zapravo žive radnici koji proizvode slavne lutke i druge proizvode.

programme.title: Otvoreno
programme.desc: 17 years after the abolition of conscription, Croatia introduces basic military training. Whoever appeals to the appeal of conscience, will be sent to serve in the Civil Protection or in local self-government units. In addition to the appeal of conscience, part of the opposition also disputes the fact that participants of military training will have an advantage in employment in the state and public service. What will the training look like, what will they learn and what will they be trained for? Why is part of the opposition against and who will vote tomorrow in Parliament? The guests are: Branko Hrg, State Secretary in the Ministry of Defense, Tomislav Josić, Homeland Movement, Anka Mrak-Taritaš, Glas, Marin Živković, Mozemo!. / 17 godina nakon ukidanja vojnoga roka, Hrvatska uvodi temeljno vojno osposobljavanje. Tko se bude pozivao na priziv savjesti, bit će upućen na služenje pri Civilnoj zaštiti ili u jedinicama lokalne samouprave. Uz priziv savjesti, dijelu oporbe sporno je i to što će polaznici vojnog osposobljavanja imati prednost pri zapošljavanju u državnoj i javnoj službi. Kako će izgledati obuka, što će se naučiti i za što će biti osposobljeni? Zašto je dio oporbe protiv i kako će tko sutra u Saboru glasati? Gosti su: Branko Hrg, državni tajnik u Ministarstvu obrane, Tomislav Josić, Domovinski pokret, Anka Mrak-Taritaš, Glas, Marin Živković, Možemo!.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Životi svetaca s Martinom Scorsesejem
programme.desc: While the power of the Roman Empire is slowly declining, one of the commanders in the Praetorian Guard, Sebastian, is in the service of Emperor Diocletian, who is trying to restore the former glory of the Empire. / Dok moć Rimskoga Carstva polako opada, jedan od zapovjednika u pretorijanskoj gardi, Sebastijan, u službi je cara Dioklecijana, koji nastoji povratiti bivšu slavu Carstva.

programme.title: Putovanja Agathe Christie sa Sir Davidom Suchetom
programme.desc: Sir David Suchet follows in the footsteps of Agatha Christie and arrives in Hawaii, where she spent her vacation in 1922. It explores her passion for surfing and questions how travel has influenced her novels. He also bypasses clichés to discover the real Hawaii, meeting young men on beaches, cacao farmers, hula dance masters and people who make Hawaiian lei wreaths. / Sir David Suchet ide stopama Agathe Christie i stiže na Havaje, gdje je ona provela odmor 1922. godine. Istražuje njezinu strast prema surfanju i pita se kako su putovanja utjecala na njezine romane. Također zaobilazi klišeje kako bi otkrio prave Havaje, susreće mladiće na plažama, uzgajivače kakaa, majstore hula plesa i ljude koji izrađuju havajske vijence cvijeća lei.

programme.title: Ples sudbine
programme.desc: Úrsula gives Joaquim a ticket to Sao Paulo to investigate Rafael's past in order to separate him from Isadora. In Sao Paulo, Joaquim meets Margo and Yolanda, two failed actresses that Rafael knows, and suggests that they lie for him. Matias pounces on Violeta and she runs to Eugenia crying and they spend the night together. Bento goes against his sergeant's orders to rescue Lorenzo and he asks Silvana for help to cross enemy lines. Emília got Isadora's clothes and goes to the casino again. With Enrico, earn enough money to fulfill Jojo's dream of buying a bicycle. Julinha gets Constantin to buy a famous painting from the auction of the Brazilian Legion of Relief. Úrsula finds out about Eugenio and Violeta's romantic night after she finds Violeta's brooch in Eugenio's room. Romana goes to Isadora's house, and Matias recognizes her. / Úrsula daje Joaquimu kartu za Sao Paulo kako bi istražio Rafaelovu prošlost s ciljem da ga odvoji od Isadore. U Sao Paulu Joaquim upozna Margo i Iolandu, dvije propale glumice koje Rafael poznaje, i predlaže im da lažu za njega. Matias nasrne na Violetu i ona uplakana trči Eugeniju i zajedno provedu noć. Bento se protivi naredbi svoga narednika u vezi sa spašavanjem Lorenza i on zamoli Silvanu za pomoć kako bi prešao neprijateljsku liniju. Emília je dobila Isadorinu odjeću i ponovno odlazi u kasino. S Enricom zaradi dovoljno novca za ostvarenje Jojoina sna da kupi bicikl. Julinha natjera Constantina da kupi poznatu sliku s aukcije Brazilske legije za pomoć. Úrsula sazna za Eugeniovu i Violetinu romantičnu noć nakon što pronađe Violetin broš u Eugeniovoj sobi. Romana ode Isadorinoj kući, a Matias je prepozna.

O tome razgovaramo s Leom Ivančić Žic Peša, psihoterapeutkinjom, logopedinjom i autoricom knjige "Stani, diši, pusti, pleši _ Kako (pre)živjeti neurorazličitost". Jučer u Strasbourgu _ danas u našem studiju! Profesor Dejan Nemčić i njegove učenice, osmašice Leda Milat i Magdalena Viktoria Tadić održali su govor u Europskom parlamentu. Što su poručile zastupnicima _ saznat ćemo danas. Govorimo i o temi koja nas, nažalost, sve više dotiče: govor mržnje, koji se s interneta sve češće prelijeva i u stvarni život. O tome će razgovarati Bruno Šimleša i njegove gošće _ Monika Herceg i Maja Sever.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Skica za portret
programme.desc: In the form of a short documentary film, the show presents authors important for Croatian history and culture. / U formi kratkog dokumentarnog filma emisija predstavlja autore važne za hrvatsku povijest i kulturu.

programme.title: Kulturna baština
programme.desc: It represents the diversity and wealth of monuments throughout Croatia. It reveals our heritage, from prehistory to the present day. / Predstavlja raznolikost i bogatstvo spomenika diljem Hrvatske. Otkriva našu baštinu, od prapovijesti do danas.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: To the series of health topics, we add one that talks about the importance of solving problems in the field of dental medicine. How to correct irregular tooth growth, replace lost teeth or solve a dental problem that goes beyond the domain of our dentist? If you want to learn more about topics in the field of oral surgery and orthodontics, stay with us. / Nizu zdravstvenih tema dodajemo i onu koja govori o važnosti rješavanja problema s područja dentalne medicine. Kako ispraviti nepravilan rast zuba, nadomjestiti izgubljene zube ili riješiti neki stomatološki problem koji nadilazi domenu našeg stomatologa? Želite li saznati više o temama s područja oralne kirurgije i ortodoncije, budite uz nas.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Today, Lidia will prepare a sauce made of white beans and pesto for a spring taste. Her granddaughter Julia will stop by for raw vegetables with gravy. Lidia will then pay tribute to spring vegetables with classic spring spaghetti. Ricotta is sweetest in spring, so Lidija's frittata with spinach, bread and ricotta tastes best when prepared at that time of year. Spring has come, so let's find inspiration. / Lidia će danas pripremiti umak od bijeloga graha i pesta radi proljetnog okusa. Njezina unuka Julia svratit će na sirovo povrće s umakom. Lidia će potom odati počast proljetnom povrću klasičnim proljetnim špagetima. Ricotta je najslađa u proljeće pa Lidijina fritaja sa špinatom, kruhom i ricottom ima najbolji okus kad se priprema u to doba godine. Došlo je proljeće pa pronađimo nadahnuće.

programme.title: Word and life / Riječ i život
programme.desc: The show discusses problems in society and, in conversation with guests in the studio, analyzes and offers solutions in the spirit of the Church's social sciences. / Emisija razmatra probleme u društvu te, u razgovoru s gostima u studiju, analizira i nudi rješenja u duhu socijalnog nauka Crkve.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: It's always best to let the quality ingredients speak for themselves. It is the same today. Lidia will prepare a salad of steamed broccoli, white beans and eggs. This simple and nutritious dish is a great lunch or light dinner. Then we will see tuna with eggplant and zucchini in puttanesca sauce, which is a great version of the classic spicy sauce. Remember to let the ingredients speak for themselves, Lidia's way. / Uvijek je najbolje pustiti da kvalitetni sastojci govore sami za sebe. Tako je i danas. Lidia će pripremiti salatu od brokule kuhane na pari, bijeloga graha i jaja. To jednostavno i hranjivo jelo odličan je ručak ili lagana večera. Potom ćemo vidjeti tunjevinu s patlidžanom i tikvicama u umaku puttanesca, koji je sjajna inačica klasičnog pikantnog umaka. Zapamtite da morate pustiti sastojke da govore sami za sebe, i to na Lidijin način.

programme.title: Normalan život
programme.desc: The topic of the show is the improvement of the system of early intervention in childhood, for people with intellectual disabilities, especially from the autism spectrum. This will be witnessed by representatives of the MURID Center from Čakovec _ Silvija Pucko, director of the MURID center, educational rehabilitator, then Gordan Horvat, parent of a child with autism and member of the MURID center, Tomo Horvat, a child with autism, and Ivana Portolan Pajić, MD, head of the Primary Health Care Sector at the Ministry of Health. The MURID center from Čakovec is an example of good practice of the intersectoral system of care for families and children with developmental risks and difficulties, because they are well networked and cooperate with institutions and civil associations in the local community, whose common goal is systematic support for a child with difficulties and his family. / Tema emisije je unapređenje sustava rane intervencije u djetinjstvu, za osobe s intelektualnim teškoćama, osobito iz spektra autizma. O tomu će svjedočiti predstavnici Centra MURID iz Čakovca _ Silvija Pucko, ravnateljica centra MURID, edukacijska rehabilitatorica, zatim Gordan Horvat, roditelj djeteta s autizmom i član centra MURID, Tomo Horvat, dijete s autizmom te Ivana Portolan Pajić, dr. med., načelnica Sektora za primarnu zdravstvenu zaštitu u Ministarstvu zdravstva. Centar MURID iz Čakovca primjer je dobre prakse međusektorskog sustava skrbi za obitelji i djecu s razvojnim rizicima i poteškoćama, jer su dobro umreženi i surađuju s institucijama i civilnim udrugama u lokalnoj zajednici, kojima je zajednički cilj sustavna podrška djetetu s poteškoćama i njegovoj obitelji.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Guto, Lola and Valdemar celebrate Regina's recovery. She would like to name the child Justino. Tiago is shocked when he discovers Júlia's relationship with David. Susana tells Sal that she witnessed the moment Simone bribed Soraya to kill Justin. / Guto, Lola i Valdemar slave Reginin oporavak. Ona bi htjela dijete nazvati Justino. Tiago se šokira kad otkrije Júlijinu vezu s Davidom. Susana kaže Sal da je svjedočila trenutku kad je Simone potkupila Soraiju kako bi ubila Justina.

programme.title: La Promesa
programme.desc: Cruz rejects Jana's accusations and blames Leocadia for orchestrating her mother's death. Adriano prevents Count De Monteverde from evicting María Fernández and Samuel from the estate. Jana can no longer watch Curro suffer so she decides to call Lorenzo to the wedding... but the captain becomes aggressive. / Cruz odbaci Janine optužbe i okrivi Leocadiju da je režirala smrt njezine majke. Adriano spriječi grofa De Monteverde da izbaci Maríju Fernández i Samuela s imanja. Jana više ne može gledati kako Curro pati pa odluči pozvati Lorenza na red oko vjenčanja... no satnik postane agresivan.

programme.title: Put rijeka
programme.desc: The episode follows an environmental association that cleans the river Mrežnica of waste. Through their involvement, we see divers taking out various garbage from the river, while members of the association talk about the importance of preserving this beautiful river. The association faces the challenges of pollution and shows how joint efforts can contribute to the preservation of nature, emphasizing the importance of caring for the environment and future generations. / Epizoda prati ekološku udrugu koja se bavi čišćenjem rijeke Mrežnice od otpada. Kroz njihov angažman, vidimo ronioce kako iz rijeke vade razno smeće, dok članovi udruge govore o važnosti očuvanja ove prekrasne rijeke. Udruga se suočava s izazovima zagađenja i pokazuje kako zajednički trud može pridonijeti očuvanju prirode, naglašavajući važnost brige za okoliš i buduće generacije.

programme.title: Manjinski mozaik
programme.desc: They came from Bosnia for work. In the flaming dawn, they entered the facilities of the Sisak Ironworks and built a better tomorrow. That tomorrow has long been in the past that Sajo, Edo, Mirsad remember... All of them in Caprago, that workers' settlement next to the ironworks, lived through both the most beautiful years of the industrial boom and the most difficult moments of the collapse of the ironworks. Today, Caprag is at a new beginning. There is no industry, but there is a desire for this multinational city within the city to breathe again. / Dolazili su iz Bosne za poslom. U plamenim zorama ulazili su u pogone željezare Sisak i gradili neko bolje sutra. To sutra odavno je već prošlost koje se prisjećaju Sajo, Edo, Mirsad... Svi su oni u Capragu, tom radničkom naselju uz željezaru, proživjeli i najljepše godine industrijskog uzleta i najteže trenutke raspada željezare. Danas je Caprag na nekom novom početku. Industrije nema, ali ima želje da taj multinacionalni grad u gradu ponovno prodiše punim plućima.

programme.title: turizam.hrt
programme.desc: Is there any progress in the tourist valorization of the Pula fortifications? How do the few that are in operation "live" and to what extent does the cultural and historical heritage in Pula attract tourists? In the show, we also talk about the news of the Goran offer, we check how the hotels on the Dalmatian coast are operating at this time, and we also discover the new transoceanic airline from Split... Author of the project: Senka Mošnja / Ima li pomaka u turističkoj valorizaciji pulskih utvrda? Kako "žive" one malobrojne koje su u funkciji i u kojoj mjeri kulturno-povijesna baština u Pulu privlači turiste? U emisiji govorimo i o novostima goranske ponude, provjeravamo kako u ovo doba posluju hoteli na dalmatinskoj obali, a otkrivamo i novu prekooceansku zračnu liniju iz Splita... Autorica projekta: Senka Mošnja

programme.title: Our little parties / Naše male fešte
programme.desc: The episode takes us to the island of Rab, where the Rab Fair, the oldest and largest medieval summer festival in Croatia, takes place every year. We follow the preparations for the final evening of the festival, where the city revives the tradition from 1364 through craft workshops, street entertainers and traditional food. Visitors can enjoy handicrafts, jousting games and culinary delicacies, while the event ends solemnly with fireworks and dancing at the Municipium Arba Square. The atmosphere is filled with joy, togetherness and celebration of the medieval heritage that still lives in the heart of Rab. / Epizoda nas vodi na otok Rab, gdje se svake godine održava Rabska fjera, najstariji i najveći srednjovjekovni ljetni festival u Hrvatskoj. Pratimo pripreme za završnu večer festivala, gdje grad oživljava tradiciju iz 1364. godine kroz zanatske radionice, ulične zabavljače i tradicionalnu hranu. Posjetitelji mogu uživati u rukotvorinama, viteškim igrama i kulinarskim delicijama, dok na Trgu Municipium Arba svečano završava manifestacija uz vatromet i ples. Atmosfera je ispunjena veseljem, zajedništvom i slavljenjem srednjovjekovne baštine koja još uvijek živi u srcu Raba.

programme.title: Vlakom oko svijeta
programme.desc: Sir Tony Robinson begins an epic globetrotting adventure at St. Pancras in London, from where he will set out to explore the south of Europe. In this episode, they will get to know Europe in a new way, visiting interesting and lesser-known places. Even in famous cities, they will get special access and give you their special insight. His first stop is the Camargue in the south of France, where he will meet the last cowboys of Europe and their traditional way of life. Then he goes to Spain on the Costa Brava where he will visit the port city of LEscala, meet the local people and taste the best fish from the Anchovy Coast. Then he will take the train along the beautiful coast to Barcelona, ​​where he will fulfill his lifelong dream and visit the Camp Nou stadium, where he will discover how important football is to the Catalan identity. After a special tour of Barcelona and discovering the unique mark that the architect Antoni Gaudí left on the city, he goes west by train. / Sir Tony Robinson počinje epsku pustolovinu zemaljskom kuglom na kolodvoru St. Pancras u Londonu odakle će se zaputiti u istraživanje juga Europe. U ovoj epizodi upoznat će Europu na novi način, posjećujući zanimljiva i manje poznata mjesta. Čak i u poznatim gradovima dobit će poseban pristup i pružiti vam svoj poseban uvid. Prva mu je postaja Camargue na jugu Francuske gdje će upoznati zadnje kauboje Europe i njihov tradicionalan način života. Zatim odlazi u Španjolsku na Costa Bravu gdje će posjetiti lučki grad LEscalu, upoznati tamošnje ljude i kušati najbolju ribu s Obale inćuna. Zatim će vlakom proći duž prelijepe obale do Barcelone gdje će ispuniti životni san i posjetiti stadion Camp Nou na kojem će otkriti koliko je nogomet važan za katalonski identitet. Poslije posebnog obilaska Barcelone i otkrivanja jedinstvenog traga koji je arhitekt Antoni Gaudí ostavio na gradu, vlakom odlazi na zapad.

programme.title: At our home / Kod nas doma
programme.desc: The daily show Kod nas doma talks about current topics and events in our country and in the world every weekday afternoon. It brings the stories of inspiring people and follows important social events, fashion shows and premieres. In the pleasant atmosphere of the studio, the presenters discuss interesting topics with public figures and experts. / Dnevna emisija Kod nas doma svaki radni dan poslijepodne progovara o aktualnim temama i zbivanjima kod nas i u svijetu. Donosi priče inspirativnih ljudi i prate važne društvene događaje, modne revije i premijere. U ugodnoj atmosferi studija s javnim osobama i stručnjacima voditelji razgovaraju o zanimljivim temama.

programme.title: Potjera
programme.desc: In The Chase, four contestants answer general knowledge questions and in the process build tactics that can lead them to the final round. But the Hunter stands in their way. In an exciting game of knowledge and speed, this unusual opponent tries to knock them out one by one and send them home empty-handed. The chase is not just a quiz _ it is also a race in which the contestants have to escape the Hunter. Will he be able to keep a step or two ahead of him? Can the chosen four win, no matter how shrewd their opponent is? / U Potjeri četiri natjecatelja odgovaraju na pitanja općeg znanja i pritom grade taktiku koja ih može dovesti do finalnog kruga. No na putu im stoji Lovac. Taj neuobičajeni protivnik u uzbudljivoj igri znanja i brzine pokušava jednog po jednog izbaciti iz igre i poslati ih kući praznih ruku. Potjera nije samo kviz _ ona je i utrka u kojoj natjecatelji moraju pobjeći Lovcu. Hoće li uspjeti zadržati korak-dva prednosti pred njim? Može li četvero izabranih pobijediti, ma koliko oštrouman bio njihov protivnik?

programme.title: Diary 2 / Dnevnik 2
programme.desc: The most important news from the country and the world, numerous reports, guest appearances by prominent experts and commentators in Dnevnik 2, the most watched news show on HTV. In addition to sports news, see the detailed weather forecast for the following days. / Najvažnije vijesti iz zemlje i svijeta, brojne reportaže, gostovanja istaknutih stručnjaka i komentatora u Dnevniku 2, u najgledanijoj informativnoj emisiji HTV-a. Uz sportske aktualnosti pogledajte i detaljnu vremensku prognozu za sljedeće dane.

programme.title: The false face of a contract killer / Lažno lice plaćenog ubojice
programme.desc: Glen Powell plays exemplary professor Gary Johnson, who pretends to be a contract killer and cooperates with the police of the city of New Orleans. Gary skillfully changes disguises and aliases and helps the police catch people who want to eliminate their enemies. But the situation changes drastically after he is attracted to a potential new client, the young and attractive Madison (Adria Arjona). Madison falls in love with one of Gary's aliases, the mysterious and seductive Ron, and their passionate relationship sets off a chain reaction where nothing is as it seems. / Glen Powell glumi uzornog profesora Garyja Johnsona, koji se pretvara da je plaćeni ubojica te surađuje s policijom grada New Orleansa. Gary vješto mijenja krinke i aliase te pomaže policiji da uhvati ljude koji žele eliminirati svoje neprijatelje. No situacija se drastično mijenja nakon što ga privuče potencijalna nova klijentica, mlada i atraktivna Madison (Adria Arjona). Madison se zaljubi u jedan od Garyjevih aliasa, tajanstvenog i zavodljivog Rona, a njihova strastvena veza pokreće lančanu reakciju u kojoj ništa nije onako kako se čini.

programme.desc: The latest news from the country and the world, as well as a concise weather forecast for the next day. / Najnovije vijesti iz zemlje i svijeta te sažeta vremenska prognoza za sljedeći dan.

programme.title: Plavi prah
programme.desc: The action takes place in Los Angeles on the eve of Christmas. In one night, the lives of four lonely people intertwine, each of whom seeks redemption and meaning in his own way. Rose-Johnny (Jessica Biel) is a stripper trying to raise money for her sick son, Qwerty Doolittle (Eddie Redmayne) is a clumsy undertaker who falls in love with her, Charlie (Forest Whitaker) is an ex-priest planning suicide, and Jack Doheny (Ray Liotta) is an ex-criminal trying to find his estranged daughter. / Radnja se događa u Los Angelesu uoči Božića. U jednoj noći isprepliću se životi četvero usamljenih ljudi, od kojih svatko na svoj način traži iskupljenje i smisao. Rose-Johnny (Jessica Biel) je striptizeta koja pokušava skupiti novac za bolesnog sina, Qwerty Doolittle (Eddie Redmayne) nespretni pogrebnik koji se zaljubljuje u nju, Charlie (Forest Whitaker) je bivši svećenik koji planira samoubojstvo, a Jack Doheny (Ray Liotta) bivši kriminalac koji pokušava pronaći svoju otuđenu kćer.

programme.desc: Cruz rejects Jana's accusations and blames Leocadia for orchestrating her mother's death. Adriano prevents Count De Monteverde from evicting María Fernández and Samuel from the estate. Jana can no longer watch Curro suffer so she decides to call Lorenzo to the wedding... but the captain becomes aggressive. / Cruz odbaci Janine optužbe i okrivi Leocadiju da je režirala smrt njezine majke. Adriano spriječi grofa De Monteverde da izbaci Maríju Fernández i Samuela s imanja. Jana više ne može gledati kako Curro pati pa odluči pozvati Lorenza na red oko vjenčanja... no satnik postane agresivan.

programme.title: Ples sudbine
programme.desc: Wanting to find out Rafael's past, Joaquim meets Iolanda and Margo. He comes up with a plan and offers them a nice life in exchange for the lie that Iolanda's son is actually Rafael's. During the dinner that Isadora prepares for Romani, Matias appears and recognizes Davi from the trial. Rafael quickly avoids that situation. Violeta accidentally forgets the brooch in Eugenio's room, and Úrsula finds it and finds out about their relationship. Mrs. Iara tells Rafael that Joaquim is in Sao Paulo. Isadora is jealous when she discovers that she is not Rafael's first love, but he reassures her. Mariana photographs Arminda and Ináci kissing and starts blackmailing Arminda. Joaquim in a crazy plan to get his new friends to agree to come to Campos. / Želeći saznati Rafaelovu prošlost Joaquim upozna Iolandu i Margo. Smišlja plan i nudi im lijep život u zamjenu za laž o tome da je Iolandin sin zapravo i Rafaelov. Tijekom večere koju Isadora priprema Romani, pojavljuje se Matias i prepozna Davija sa suđenja. Rafael brzo izbjegne tu situaciju. Violeta slučajno zaboravi broš u Eugeniovoj sobi, a Úrsula ga nađe i sazna za njihovu vezu. Gđa Iara kaže Rafaelu da je Joaquim u Sao Paulu. Isadora je ljubomorna kad otkrije da nije ona Rafaelova prva ljubav, ali on je umiri. Mariana fotografira Armindu i Inácija kako se ljube i počine ucjenjivati Armindu. Joaquim u ludom naumu da natjera svoje nove prijateljice da pristanu doći u Campos.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Guto, Lola and Valdemar celebrate Regina's recovery. She would like to name the child Justino. Tiago is shocked when he discovers Júlia's relationship with David. Susana tells Sal that she witnessed the moment Simone bribed Soraya to kill Justin. / Guto, Lola i Valdemar slave Reginin oporavak. Ona bi htjela dijete nazvati Justino. Tiago se šokira kad otkrije Júlijinu vezu s Davidom. Susana kaže Sal da je svjedočila trenutku kad je Simone potkupila Soraiju kako bi ubila Justina.

programme.title: At our home / Kod nas doma
programme.desc: The daily show Kod nas doma talks about current topics and events in our country and in the world every weekday afternoon. It brings the stories of inspiring people and follows important social events, fashion shows and premieres. In the pleasant atmosphere of the studio, the presenters discuss interesting topics with public figures and experts. / Dnevna emisija Kod nas doma svaki radni dan poslijepodne progovara o aktualnim temama i zbivanjima kod nas i u svijetu. Donosi priče inspirativnih ljudi i prate važne društvene događaje, modne revije i premijere. U ugodnoj atmosferi studija s javnim osobama i stručnjacima voditelji razgovaraju o zanimljivim temama.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Skica za portret
programme.desc: In the form of a short documentary film, the show presents authors important for Croatian history and culture. / U formi kratkog dokumentarnog filma emisija predstavlja autore važne za hrvatsku povijest i kulturu.

programme.title: Normalan život
programme.desc: Weekly show about the family and life of people with disabilities and their opportunities and rights. It promotes human rights, sensitizes and encourages the public to act for the common good. / Tjedna emisija o obitelji i životu osoba s invaliditetom te njihovim mogućnostima i pravima. Promiče ljudska prava, senzibilizira i potiče javnost na djelovanje za opće dobro.

programme.title: turizam.hrt
programme.desc: In the weekly show about tourism, we follow, question and analyze tourist current events on the coast, islands and inland. / U tjednoj emisiji o turizmu pratimo, propitkujemo i analiziramo turističke aktualnosti na obali, otocima i u unutrašnjosti.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: It's always best to let the quality ingredients speak for themselves. It is the same today. Lidia will prepare a salad of steamed broccoli, white beans and eggs. This simple and nutritious dish is a great lunch or light dinner. Then we will see tuna with eggplant and zucchini in puttanesca sauce, which is a great version of the classic spicy sauce. Remember to let the ingredients speak for themselves, Lidia's way. / Uvijek je najbolje pustiti da kvalitetni sastojci govore sami za sebe. Tako je i danas. Lidia će pripremiti salatu od brokule kuhane na pari, bijeloga graha i jaja. To jednostavno i hranjivo jelo odličan je ručak ili lagana večera. Potom ćemo vidjeti tunjevinu s patlidžanom i tikvicama u umaku puttanesca, koji je sjajna inačica klasičnog pikantnog umaka. Zapamtite da morate pustiti sastojke da govore sami za sebe, i to na Lidijin način.

programme.title: TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, broadcast daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: Amy helps a team of gymnasts on horseback before a big competition. Caleb is struggling with a difficult decision regarding Carson. Logan realizes what he wants in the future. A stressful gallery opening awaits Lou and Jessica. / Amy pomaže ekipi gimnastičara na konjima prije velikog natjecanja. Caleba muči teška odluka u vezi s Carsonom. Logan shvaća što želi u budućnosti. Lou i Jessicu čeka stresno otvaranje galerije.

programme.title: Zajedno u duhu
programme.desc: The weekly show follows the life and activities of religious communities with an emphasis on topics related to ecumenism and interreligious dialogue, with a guest in the studio. / Tjedna emisija prati život i djelovanje vjerskih zajednica s naglaskom na teme vezane za ekumenizam i međureligijski dijalog, uz gosta u studiju.

programme.title: Pobuna u Fort Laramieju
programme.desc: The fuse is lit, and what's done can't be undone in this fascinating, suspenseful western. On the eve of the American Civil War, soldiers at Fort Laramie have a shaky truce with the Sioux Nation. As the tribes gather around the fort, Jefferson Davis becomes president of the Confederacy, and their former compatriots must decide which side they will be loyal to, wondering if the real enemy is actually among them. / Fitilj je zapaljen, a ono što je učinjeno ne može se vratiti u ovom fascinantnom, napetom vesternu. Uoči američkog Građanskog rata, vojnici u Fort Laramieju imaju nesigurno primirje s nacijom Siuoxua. Dok se plemena okupljaju oko utvrde, Jefferson Davis postaje predsjednik Konfederacije, a dotadašnji sunarodnjaci moraju odlučiti kojoj će strani biti vjerni pitajući se je li pravi neprijatelj zapravo među njima.

programme.title: Dobro jutro, Hrvatska
programme.desc: A mosaic show that brings current informative and entertaining content from Monday to Saturday, with a host couple in the studio and guests, as well as reports and live broadcasts from all over Croatia and regular sections with advice from all areas of life. / Mozaična emisija koja od ponedjeljka do subote donosi aktualne informativne i zabavne sadržaje, s voditeljskim parom u studiju i gostima te uz reportaže i javljanja uživo iz cijele Hrvatske i redovite rubrike sa savjetima iz svih područja života.

programme.title: Prizma - multinacionalni magazin
programme.desc: Multinacionalni magazin, donosi aktualnosti o manjinama i ljudskim pravima.

programme.title: TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, broadcast daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.

programme.title: Diary 1 / Dnevnik 1
programme.desc: Aktualne informacije i najnovije vijesti iz zemlje i svijeta u podnevnom Dnevniku.

programme.title: Sport
programme.desc: Daily sports reports and reports. / Dnevni sportski izvještaji i reportaže.

programme.title: Vrijeme
programme.desc: After Diary 1 comes the weather forecast, along with interesting weather and warnings about dangerous weather phenomena, and before Diary 2 a condensed weekly forecast. / Nakon Dnevnika 1 slijedi vremenska prognoza, uz meteozanimljivosti i upozorenja na opasne vremenske pojave, a uoči Dnevnika 2 sažeta tjedna prognoza.

programme.title: RIGHTS - promet info / HAK - promet info
programme.desc: Aktualne informacije o cestovnom i trajektnom prometu, uz javljanja iz Hrvatskog autokluba.

programme.title: Veterani mira
programme.desc: The weekly show, in studio conversations and reports, illuminates and tries to solve the problems faced by veterans and sensitize the public. / Tjedna emisija, u razgovoru u studiju i reportažama rasvjetljava i nastoji riješiti probleme s kojima se susreću branitelji te senzibilizirati javnost.

programme.title: The forgotten battle of Nuštar 91. / Zaboravljena bitka Nuštar 91.
programme.desc: In the fall of 1991, Croatia was fighting a battle for survival. At the very beginning of November, the Slavonian village of Nuštar found itself in an almost hopeless situation as the only unconquered stronghold between the city on the Danube and the city on Bosut. And while the ring around Vukovar tightens more and more, and the enemy, occupying village after village, is getting closer to Vinkovci and the column of exiles is getting longer, it is uncertain how long the few and poorly armed defenders will be able to resist the aggressor. In those days, Nuštar lived through his most dramatic moments in history, and this is the story of a three-day forgotten battle, of despair and hope, of miraculous heroism and the victory of the heart over the armor. Nuštar had no choice, defeat would have written a different history. Animation: Mato Granić / U jesen 1991. godine Hrvatska bije bitku za opstanak. Na samom početku mjeseca studenoga slavonsko selo Nuštar našlo se u gotovo bezizlaznoj situaciji kao jedino neosvojeno uporište između grada na Dunavu i grada na Bosutu. I dok se sve više steže obruč oko Vukovara, a neprijatelj, zauzimajući selo za selom, sve se više približava Vinkovcima te je kolona prognanika sve duža, neizvjesno je koliko dugo će malobrojni i slabo naoružani branitelji moći odolijevati agresoru. Nuštar tih dana proživljava svoje najdramatičnije trenutke u povijesti, a ovo je priča o trodnevnoj zaboravljenoj bici, o očaju i nadi, o čudesnom junaštvu i pobjedi srca nad oklopom. Nuštar nije imao izbora, poraz bi pisao drugačiju povijest. Animacija: Mato Granić

programme.title: Psi na zadatku
programme.desc: The documentary series reveals to us the world of working dogs, exploring their jobs, but also their leisure time. We follow their daily lives and find out how they contribute to our society, and through imaginative interpretations we also listen to their thoughts about it, because each dog has also been given a voice. In the second episode, we follow Greta. Her job is to find the eggs of red-eared turtles, an invasive species that threatens the life and habitat of the indigenous European pond turtle in Zagreb's Maksimir Park. / Dokumentarna serija nam otkriva svijet radnih pasa, istražujući njihove poslove, ali i dokolicu. Pratimo njihov svakodnevni život i saznajemo kako oni pridonose našem društvu, a kroz maštovite interpretacije slušamo i njihove misli o tome, jer svaki je pas dobio i glas. U drugoj epizodi pratimo Gretu. Njezin je posao pronaći jaja crvenouhih kornjača, invazivne vrste koja u zagrebačkom parku Maksimir ugrožava život i stanište autohtone europske barske kornjače.

programme.title: Profesorica glazbe
programme.desc: A romantic comedy about a creative music teacher whose program is canceled, but her students help her. Alyson Daley is disappointed that her music class at school has been cut. She created and designed that program a number of years earlier and during that time she helped many gifted students to develop in singing and dancing, and their skills were shown every year in the big final program. When her former students found out about the school's decision, they decided to stage a musical themselves and raise money to continue the program... / Romantična komedija o kreativnoj profesorici glazbe čiji je program ukinut, ali joj pomažu učenici. Alyson Daley je razočarana jer je njezin glazbeni predmet u školi ukinut. Ona je taj program kreirala i osmislila niz godina ranije i za to je vrijeme pomogla mnogim darovitim učenicima da se razvijaju u pjevanju i plesanju, a njihovo je umijeće svake godine prikazano u velikom završnom programu. Kad su njezini bivši učenici doznali za odluku škole, odlučili su na scenu sami postaviti mjuzikl i prikupiti novac za nastavak programa...

programme.title: RIGHTS - promet info / HAK - promet info
programme.desc: Aktualne informacije o cestovnom i trajektnom prometu, uz javljanja iz Hrvatskog autokluba.

programme.title: Vijesti
programme.desc: A short overview of news from Croatia and the world. / Kratki pregled vijesti iz Hrvatske i svijeta.

programme.title: Regionalni dnevnik
programme.desc: HTV teams from all Croatian counties bring the most interesting current events and stories from all over the country, and there is also a detailed regional weather forecast. / Ekipe HTV-a iz svih hrvatskih županija donose najzanimljivije aktualne događaje i priče iz cijele zemlje, a tu je i detaljna regionalna vremenska prognoza.

programme.title: Zovite babicu
programme.desc: Christmas is approaching, and the midwives in Poplar have more work than ever. An abandoned baby is found on the steps of Nonnatus House, and the whole community joins together in an effort to find the mother and collect the necessary help. At that time, Jenny Lee is handling a special heartbreaking case _ taking care of the old and wandering Mrs. Jenkins. Newly married Chummy is devotedly trying to organize a children's Christmas play and make it unforgettable. As they try to find out who abandoned the child and why, Jenny helps Mrs. Jenkins face her own past and discover the fate of the children who were taken from her long ago when she was sent to the poorhouse. / Božić se bliži, a primalje u Poplaru imaju više posla nego ikad. Na stubama Nonnatus Housea pronađena je napuštena beba, a cijela se zajednica udružuje u nastojanju da pronađe majku i prikupi potrebnu pomoć. Jenny Lee u to vrijeme vodi poseban slučaj koji slama srce _ brine se o starici i lutalici gospođi Jenkins. Svježe udana Chummy predano se trudi organizirati dječju božićnu predstavu i učiniti je nezaboravnom. Dok pokušavaju doznati tko je dijete ostavio i zašto, Jenny pomaže gospođi Jenkins da se suoči s vlastitom prošlošću i otkrije sudbinu djece koja su joj davno oduzeta kada je bila poslana u ubožnicu.

programme.title: Vrijeme
programme.desc: After Diary 1 comes the weather forecast, along with interesting weather and warnings about dangerous weather phenomena, and before Diary 2 a condensed weekly forecast. / Nakon Dnevnika 1 slijedi vremenska prognoza, uz meteozanimljivosti i upozorenja na opasne vremenske pojave, a uoči Dnevnika 2 sažeta tjedna prognoza.

programme.title: Diary 2 / Dnevnik 2
programme.desc: The most important news from the country and the world, numerous reports, guest appearances by prominent experts and commentators in Dnevnik 2, the most watched news show on HTV. In addition to sports news, see the detailed weather forecast for the following days. / Najvažnije vijesti iz zemlje i svijeta, brojne reportaže, gostovanja istaknutih stručnjaka i komentatora u Dnevniku 2, u najgledanijoj informativnoj emisiji HTV-a. Uz sportske aktualnosti pogledajte i detaljnu vremensku prognozu za sljedeće dane.

programme.title: Heart 7 / Loto 7
programme.desc: Follow the Lot 7 draw live. / Pratite izravno izvlačenje Lota 7.

programme.title: Miljenica
programme.desc: The action takes place in the English court, where the ailing Queen Anne is governed by her close adviser Sarah Churchill. When Sara's impoverished cousin Abigal arrives at court, the two begin a merciless struggle for the queen's favor and power. / Radnja se odvija na engleskom dvoru, gdje bolesnom kraljicom Anom upravlja njezina bliska savjetnica Sarah Churchill. Kad na dvor stigne Sarina siromašna rođakinja Abigal, između njih dvije počinje nemilosrdna borba za kraljičinu naklonost i moć.

programme.title: Diary 3 / Dnevnik 3
programme.desc: The latest news from the country and the world, as well as a concise weather forecast for the next day. / Najnovije vijesti iz zemlje i svijeta te sažeta vremenska prognoza za sljedeći dan.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Bandit
programme.desc: After escaping from a Michigan prison, a charming criminal switches identities and heads to Canada to rob a record 59 banks and jewelry stores while being hunted by the police... / Nakon bijega iz zatvora iz Michigana, šarmantni zločinac mijenja identitet i odlazi u Kanadu kako bi opljačkao rekordnih 59 banaka i zlatarnica dok ga lovi policija...

programme.title: Ellen
programme.desc: Ellen Cole is an 80-year-old widow who lives in seclusion on a ranch in Montana. When an unscrupulous real estate developer tries to force her to leave her ranch for a new project, she stands up to him. The investor takes extreme measures to intimidate and drive her away, but he does not know that the seemingly harmless old woman was once a professional killer. In the fight for his own home, he turns into a terrifying opponent, in his last, most personal showdown. / Ellen Cole je 80-togodišnja udovica koja povučeno živi na ranču u Montani. Kada je bezobzirni građevinski investitor želi prisiliti da napusti svoj ranč radi novog projekta, ona mu se suprotstavi. Investitor poduzima ekstremne mjere kako bi je zastrašio i otjerao, ali ne zna da je naizgled bezazlena starica nekad bila profesionalni ubojica. U borbi za vlastiti dom pretvara se u zastrašujuću protivnicu, u svom posljednjem, najosobnijem obračunu.

programme.title: All that heaven allows / Sve što nebo dopušta
programme.desc: Melodrama. The attractive and wealthy widow Cary Scott (J. Wyman) is unsuccessfully courted by the elderly Mr. Harvey (C. Nagel). She doesn't really like him, but her grown children _ son Ned (W. Reynolds) and daughter Kay (G. Talbott) _ for whom the social status of a suitor is more important than their mother's emotions, would have nothing against their mother's eventual marriage. Their mother's emotions boil over when she notices the attractive and younger gardener Ron Kirby (R. Hudson). Cary soon falls in love with the gardener... This melodrama is one of the best works of the legendary American-German director of Danish origin Douglas Sirk (1897-1987). Sirk belongs to the narrowest top of the greatest masters of film melodrama: in just 6 years, between 1954 and 1959, he signed as many masterpieces (The Magnificent Obsession, Everything the Sky Allows, Darkened Angels, The Age of Life and the Age of Death, Written on the Wind and Imitation of Life), restoring its dignity to the often undeservedly despised genre. "All that the sky allows" is an exemplary example of Sirk's directorial aesthetics, whose characteristic features are a brilliant visual style, a great handling of the viewer's emotions, a phenomenal feeling for profiling female characters, a masterful talent for talking in pictures and skillfully interweaving high and so-called low art, for which Sirk was loved by modernist and postmodernist directors like R. M. Fassbinder, whose film "Angst essen Seele auf" is a kind of remake of "All That Heaven Allows". As in The Magnificent Obsession, Oscar winner J. Wyman (Johnny Belinda) and Sirk's favorite actor R. Hudson (Written on the Wind, Dynasty) played the main roles. / Melodrama. Privlačnoj i imućnoj udovici Cary Scott (J. Wyman) bezuspješno se udvara postariji gospodin Harvey (C. Nagel). On joj se baš i ne sviđa no njezina odrasla djeca _ sin Ned (W. Reynolds) i kći Kay (G. Talbott) _ kojima je od majčinih emocija važniji društveni status udvarača, ne bi imala ništa protiv eventualne majčine udaje. Emocije njihove majke uzavru nakon što primijeti privlačnog i mlađeg vrtlara Rona Kirbyja (R. Hudson). Cary se ubrzo zaljubi u vrtlara... Ova melodrama jedno je od najboljih ostvarenja legendarnog američko-njemačkog redatelja danskoga podrijetla Douglasa Sirka (1897.-1987.). Sirk spada u najuži vrh najvećih majstora filmske melodrame: u svega 6 godina, između 1954. i 1959., potpisao je isto toliko remek-djela (Veličanstvena opsesija, Sve što nebo dopušta, Potamnjeli anđeli, Doba života i doba smrti, Zapisano na vjetru i Imitacija života), vrativši često nezasluženo prezrenom žanru njegov dignitet. "Sve što nebo dopušta" ogledni je primjer Sirkove redateljske estetike čija su karakteristična obilježja briljantan vizualni stil, sjajno baratanje gledateljevim emocijama, fenomenalan osjećaj za profiliranje ženskih likova, majstorski talent za pričanje u slikama i vješto prepletanje visoke i tzv. niske umjetnosti, zbog kojeg su Sirka voljeli modernistički i postmodernistički redatelji poput R. M. Fassbindera, čiji je film "Angst essen Seele auf" svojevrsni remake "Sve što nebo dopušta". Kao i u Veličanstvenoj opsesiji, glavne su uloge odigrali oskarovka J. Wyman (Johnny Belinda) i Sirkov najomiljeniji glumac R. Hudson (Zapisano na vjetru, Dinastija).

programme.title: Pozitivno
programme.desc: Do you know how you can relive your childhood through painting? Our guest is the author of several books and the president of the Motorcycle Club Veterani Croatia Ratko Dragović Klek. Meet the Croatian woman who returned from Colombia to the land of her ancestors. / Znate li kako se kroz slikarstvo može još jednom živjeti djetinjstvo? Gost nam je autor više knjiga i predsjednik Moto kluba Veterani Croatia Ratko Dragović Klek. Upoznajte Hrvaticu koja se iz Kolubije vratila u zemlju svojih predaka.

programme.title: Biblija
programme.desc: Every Sunday, the show introduces us to the content, messages and historical context of the Holy Scriptures. Croatian biblical scholars and theologians explain how the Bible was created, what it consists of, who wrote it and when, the differences between the Old and New Testaments, the most famous biblical terms, and who the biblical characters are and what their messages mean for us today. / Svake nedjelje emisija nas upoznaje sa sadržajem, porukama i povijesnim kontekstom Svetoga Pisma. Hrvatski bibličari i teolozi objašnjavaju kako je nastala Biblija, od čega se sastoji, tko ju je pisao i kada, razlike između Starog i Novog Zavjeta, najpoznatije biblijske pojmove te tko su biblijski likovi i što njihove poruke znače za nas danas.

programme.title: Misa
programme.desc: Reformation Day is commemorated on October 31, 1517, when Martin Luther nailed his 95 Theses to the door of the All Saints Church in Wittenberg. On this occasion, we are broadcasting the service which will be led by the pastor of the Evangelical Church Municipality in Osijek, Samir Vrabec. / Dan reformacije obilježava se u spomen na 31. listopada 1517. kada je Martin Luther pribio svojih 95 teza na vrata crkve Svih Svetih u Wittenbergu. Tim povodom prenosimo bogoslužje koje će predvoditi župnik Evangeličke crkvene općine u Osijeku Samir Vrabec.

programme.title: Zvona za mrtve
programme.desc: In the parishes of Radobilja, Žeževica and Zagvozd, in the hinterland of Omiš and Makarska, the custom of breccia for the souls of the departed is still alive, on the night of All Saints, on All Souls' Day. The bell must be rung, i.e. struck so that the bat hits only one side of the bell, and that all night long, until the morning mass, because, according to custom, the ringing of the bell must not be interrupted. It is an act of remembering the deceased and praying for them, but, of course, also a social gathering, i.e. self-affirmation of the community. The atmosphere of that night is contemplative, but still, there can also be completely "secular" moments... The scenario is based on the research of folklorist Vida Bagur. Author of original music: Samuel Sacher / U župama Radobilja, Žeževica i Zagvozd, u zaleđu Omiša i Makarske, još je živ običaj brecanja za duše pokojnih, u noći sa Svih svetih, na Dušni dan. Mora se zvoniti, tj. brecati tako da bat udara samo o jednu stranu zvona i to cijelu noć, sve do jutarnje mise, jer se, prema običaju, zvonjava ne smije prekinuti. To je čin prisjećanja na pokojne i molitve za njih, ali, dakako, i društvenog okupljanja, odnosno samopotvrđivanja zajednice. Ozračje te noći je kontemplativno, no ipak, zna biti i posve "svjetovnih" trenutaka... Scenarij je temeljen na istraživanju folklorista Vide Bagura. Autor originalne glazbe: Samuel Sacher

programme.title: Gentler among women / Blaž među ženama
programme.desc: Through Ho, Spiro finds out who Anki's crush really is and decides to do something. In order to reduce the number of angry people from the cramped house, Daria plans to move in with grandmother Bjanka, but not only Bjanka but also her cat Bajdo is wondering about it. Some of our eastern neighbors are looking for Maja in Split _ who would it be but her abandoned and grieving husband? Blaž oscillates between all these situations like a ball in a pinball machine, on the way looking for the Holy Grail _ tickets for an exclusive concert by Nene Belan... Creators of the series: Branko Ružić and Goran Kulenović / Špiro preko Ho doznaje tko je zapravo Ankičina simpatija i odlučuje nešto poduzeti. Kako bi smanjila broj čeljadi bijesne iz kuće tijesne, Daria se planira smjestiti kod bake Bjanke, ali tu se ne pita samo Bjanka nego i njezin mačak Bajdo. Maju po Splitu traži neki naš istočni susjed _ tko bi to bio nego njezin ostavljeni i ucviljeni suprug? Blaž između svih tih situacija titra kao kuglica u fliperu, usput tražeći Sveti Gral _ karte za ekskluzivni koncert Nene Belana... Tvorci serije: Branko Ružić i Goran Kulenović

programme.desc: Bruno is in love and wants to get married, school is even less important to him now. Not only Jagoda and Nikola despair, Suvi is also fatherly worried. Several ladies from the neighborhood are also upset, a young man on a bicycle sneaks up on them at night. Shy and timid, he takes unusual waste from ladies' bins... / Bruno je zaljubljen i želi se oženiti, škola mu je sad još manje važna. Ne očajavaju samo Jagoda i Nikola, očinski je zabrinut i Suvi. Uzrujano je i više dama iz kvarta, noću im se prikrada mladić na biciklu. Sramežljiv i plašljiv, gospođama iz kanti uzima neobičan otpad...

programme.title: Volim Hrvatsku
programme.desc: Sunday afternoons are again cheered up by the team of the show Volim Hrvatska. The captains are Dušan Bućan and Goran Navojec. In the sixth show in Dušan's team, Kristijan Petelin, Mada Peršić and Vanda Winter will show their knowledge. Hana Cvijanović, Roko Sikavica and Jelena Miholjević will compete in Goran's team. Contestants will try their hand at well-known games such as Guess the Song, Happy Birthday, TV and Film, Sport, Famous Compatriots, Shufflers, Average Citizen and Word Croatian. The show is hosted by Mirko Fodor. The hits of local music are performed live by the band Ante Gele. / Nedjeljna popodneva ponovno uveseljava ekipa šoua Volim Hrvatsku. Kapetani su Dušan Bućan i Goran Navojec. U šestoj emisiji u Dušanovom timu znanje će pokazati: Kristijan Petelin, Mada Peršić i Vanda Winter. U Goranovom timu natjecat će se Hana Cvijanović, Roko Sikavica i Jelena Miholjević. Natjecatelji će se okušati u dobro poznatim igrama poput Pogodi pjesmu, Sretan rođendan, TV i film, Sport, Poznati sunarodnjaci, Premetaljke, Prosječni građanin i Riječ hrvatska. Emisiju vodi Mirko Fodor. Hitove domaće glazbe uživo izvodi bend Ante Gele.

programme.desc: In the Superchase, hunters join a super team _ five top experts who act as one. Having created one of the most powerful quiz teams in the world, they are ready to face any challenger. Who among the contestants has enough knowledge, skill and concentration to defeat this unbeatable team? / U Superpotjeri lovci se udružuju u super tim _ petero vrhunskih znalaca koji djeluju kao jedan. Stvorivši jednu od najmoćnijih kvizaških ekipa na svijetu, spremni su suočiti se sa svakim izazivačem. Tko među natjecateljima ima dovoljno znanja, vještine i koncentracije da pobijedi ovaj nepobjedivi tim?

programme.title: Steel Claw / Čelična kandža
programme.desc: Biographical drama based on the true story of the Von Erich brothers, famous wrestlers who are followed by success, but also a series of personal tragedies. Kevin Von Erich (Zac Efron) tries to break the family "curse" and find peace after the loss of his brothers and pressure from an ambitious father. / Biografska drama temeljena na istinitoj priči o braći Von Erich, slavnim hrvačima koje prate uspjesi, ali i niz osobnih tragedija. Kevin Von Erich (Zac Efron) pokušava prekinuti obiteljsku "kletvu" i pronaći mir nakon gubitka braće i pritiska ambicioznog oca.

programme.title: Diary 3 / Dnevnik 3
programme.desc: The latest news from the country and the world, as well as a concise weather forecast for the next day. / Najnovije vijesti iz zemlje i svijeta te sažeta vremenska prognoza za sljedeći dan.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Christopher Reeve, vječni Superman
programme.desc: The whole world considers Christopher Reeve (1952 - 2004) to be Superman. More than 40 years after the release of Richard Donner's international hit, Christopher Reeve is still the undisputed embodiment of the superhero from Krypton. How did the American actor manage to connect the character and his name so closely? What kind of new life breathed into that hero of the novel, the embodiment of the American dream, that all actors later consider him a model for that role? Thanks to a previously unpublished interview that we managed to get just before the actor's untimely death, the film sheds light on the relationship between the two heroes, follows their development during nine years of cohabitation and afterwards, until the moment when the actor united with the superhero. / Cijeli svijet Christophera Reevea (1952. _ 2004.) smatra Supermanom. Više od 40 godina nakon izlaska međunarodnog filmskog hita Richarda Donnera, Christopher Reeve još je neosporno utjelovljenje superjunaka s Kriptona. Kako je Američki glumac uspio tako usko povezati lik i svoje ime? Kakav je to novi život udahnuo tom junaku romana, utjelovljenju američkog sna, da ga svi glumci poslije smatraju modelom za tu ulogu? Zahvaljujući dosad neobjavljenom intervjuu koji smo uspjeli dobiti netom prije preuranjene smrti glumca, film rasvjetljava veze između dva junaka, prati njihov razvoj tijekom devet godina suživota i nakon toga, sve do trenutka kad se glumac sjedinio sa superjunakom.

programme.title: Golden velvet / Zlatni baršun
programme.desc: Set in Great Britain during the glam-rock era of the early 1970s, it tells the story of fictional bisexual pop star Brian Slade, who faked his own death. / Radnja, smještena u Veliku Britaniju tijekom ere glam-rocka ranih 1970-ih, donosi priču o fiktivnoj biseksualnoj pop-zvijezdi Brianu Sladeu, koji je lažirao vlastitu smrt.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Beverly is asked out on a date, and Adam questions his friendship with Dave Kim. / Beverly pozivaju na spoj, a Adam preispituje svoje prijateljstvo s Daveom Kimom.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: A newly engaged couple from Cheshire are looking to buy their first home together in rural Northumberland, where Jules Hudson comes to the rescue and shows them a selection of properties to suit their wishes. The two most important requirements are a secluded location and enough land to start a rental business. / Upravo zaručen par iz Cheshirea želi kupiti svoj prvi zajednički dom u ruralnom Northumberlandu, gdje im Jules Hudson priskače u pomoć i pokazuje im izbor nekretnina koje odgovaraju njihovim željama. Dva najvažnija zahtjeva su mjesto na osami i dovoljno zemlje za pokretanje posla iznajmljivanja.

programme.title: George Clarke - Wonderful ideas / George Clarke - Čudesne zamisli
programme.desc: George follows two eccentric construction ventures. A couple builds a camper on the back of a tiny Italian tuk-tuk, and a father of two creates an unusual vacation space in an abandoned nuclear bunker. / George prati dva ekscentrična građevinska poduhvata. Jedan par gradi kamper na stražnjem dijelu malenog talijanskog tuk-tuka, a otac dvoje djece stvara neobičan prostor za odmor u napuštenom nuklearnom bunkeru.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: The Art of Home Cooking / Gordon Ramsay: Umijeće kuhanja kod kuće
programme.desc: Gordon's guide to cooking at home continues the theme of great dishes with intense flavors. For breakfast, he will prepare irresistible croissants stuffed with merguez sausages and fontina cheese, then spicy Mexican soup, and his eldest daughter Megan will help him prepare roasted duck with a crispy crust in black bean sauce and an impressive tarte tatin with spicy bananas. / Gordonov vodič za kuhanje kod kuće nastavlja se temom sjajnih jela intenzivnih okusa. Za doručak će pripremiti neodoljive kroasane nadjevene kobasicama merguez i sirom fontinom, potom pikantnu meksičku juhu, a njegova najstarija kći Megan pomoći će mu da pripremi pečenu patku s hrskavom koricom u umaku od crnoga graha te dojmljivi tarte tatin sa začinjenim bananama.

programme.title: Spašavatelji vrtova
programme.desc: Emma and Nathan would love to turn their run-down backyard into a Balinese paradise. Nathan recently retired from military service and works from home, and Emma is a nurse. After the pandemic spent at home, they would love to stay outside in a tropical environment with lush vegetation and a water feature. Such a garden would be unique among all the traditional English gardens surrounding them. These are all small plots that were arranged by the Lever family for the workers of the soap factory in Port Sunlight even before the First World War. The challenge is accepted by Charlie and Chris with a budget of £6,000. However, the Institute for the Protection of Cultural Monuments imposes some inconvenient restrictions. How will designers solve them? / Emma i Nathan rado bi pretvorili svoj zapušteni kućni vrt u balijski raj. Nathan se nedavno povukao iz vojne službe i radi od kuće, a Emma je medicinska sestra. Nakon pandemije provedene u kući voljeli bi boraviti vani u tropskom okruženju s bujnim raslinjem i vodenim elementom. Takav bi vrt bio jedinstven među svim tradicionalnim engleskim vrtovima koji ih okružuju. Sve su to sitne parcele koje je još prije Prvog svjetskog rata uredila obitelj Lever za radnike tvornice sapuna u Port Sunlightu. Izazova se prihvaćaju Charlie i Chris uz budžet od 6000 funta. Međutim, Zavod za zaštitu spomenika kulture nameće neka nezgodna ograničenja. Kako će ih dizajneri riješiti?

programme.title: Prue Leith - in the kitchen with friends / Prue Leith - u kuhinji s prijateljima
programme.desc: Prue welcomes the glamorous Kelly Brook into her kitchen and together with her husband John prepares two quiches _ Leith's favorite dish. / Prue dočekuje glamuroznu Kelly Brook u svojoj kuhinji i zajedno sa svojim suprugom Johnom priprema dva quichea _ Leithino omiljeno jelo.

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: The former Soviet republic of Azerbaijan is searching for a new identity. It is a region that derives its wealth from oil. There is so much black gold here that some even bathe in it. The film crew visited an oil spa, peeked behind the scenes of a silk factory, met glass masters who still master the art of making shebeka windows, and watched the employees of a street bakery at work. The film also follows a couple of newlyweds, because nowhere in South-West Asia are weddings as solemn and lavish as in Azerbaijan. / Bivša sovjetska republika Azerbajdžan traga za novim identitetom. Regija je to koja svoje bogatstvo crpi iz nafte. Ovdje ima toliko crnog zlata da se neki u njemu čak i kupaju. Filmska ekipa posjetila je naftno lječilište, zavirila iza kulisa tvornice svile, susrela majstore stakla koji još i danas vladaju umijećem izrade prozora shebeke te promatrala pri radu zaposlenice ulične pekarnice. Filmski prikaz prati i par mladenaca jer nigdje u jugozapadnoj Aziji vjenčanja nisu tako svečana i raskošna kao u Azerbajdžanu.
