programme.title: Lewis
programme.desc: Lewis and Hathaway investigate a burglary gone wrong. Cole, a university lecturer specializing in German history, is involved in a brawl outside an exclusive Oxford club when his friend Richard Helm is asked to leave, after which Helm finds him strangled. The weapon used to strangle Cole turns out to be a boxing cuff, which leads Lewis and Hathaway into a world of amateur boxing, suicide and pan-European influences. / Lewis i Hathaway istražuju slučaj provale koja je pošla po zlu. Sveučilišni predavač Cole specijaliziran za njemačku povijest upleten je u tučnjavu ispred ekskluzivna oksfordskog kluba kad su njegova prijatelja Richarda Helma zamolili da ode, nakon čega ga Helm pronalazi zadavljenog. Ispostavlja se da je oružje kojim je Cole zadavljen boksački povez za šake, što Lewisa i Hathawayja odvodi u svijet amaterskog boksa, samoubojstva i paneuropskih utjecaja.

programme.title: Kućni ljubimci
programme.desc: In the 1800th show, we visit dog breeder Rebeka Tratnik and present the Shiba Inu and Akita Inu breeds that she breeds. Anja Andrel, breeder of Bengal cats, will introduce us to a new litter of kittens. Robert Kranjčević will present the rabbits and ornamental poultry he breeds. In the veterinary clinic, we talk about bronchopneumonia in dogs. / U 1800. emisiji u posjetu smo uzgajateljici pasa Rebeki Tratnik i predstavljamo pasmine shiba inu i akita inu koje uzgaja. Anja Andrel, uzgajateljica bengalskih mačaka, upoznat će nas s novim leglom mačića. Robert Kranjčević predstavit će nam kuniće i ukrasnu perad koju uzgaja. U veterinarskoj ambulanti govorimo o bronhopneumoniji kod pasa.

programme.title: Up to the wine / Fino i vino
programme.desc: We travel Croatia in search of stories about dedication and love for work, as well as tradition in a modern guise. We also monitor the success of family farms. / Putujemo Hrvatskom u potrazi za pričama o posvećenosti i ljubavi prema poslu, kao i tradiciji u suvremenom ruhu. Usto pratimo uspjehe obiteljskih gospodarstava.

programme.title: Eko zona
programme.desc: In the new Eco Zone, see how sustainable development can be implemented in urban areas. We will find out everything about the turtle recovery center and the fish tracks. Let's get acquainted with the "Ekobeba" project, and finally we end with a music video by the Zagreb trap/rap band KuKuS, which talks about the mythical mountain Velebit. / U novoj Eko zoni pogledajte kako održivi razvoj implementirati u urbanim sredinama. Doznat ćemo sve i oporavilištu za kornjače te o ribljim stazama. Upoznajmo se i s projektom "Ekobeba", a na kraju završavamo glazbenim spotom zagrebačkog trap/rap benda KuKuS koji govori o mitskoj planini Velebit.

programme.title: Globalna Hrvatska HTV
programme.desc: A show dedicated to Croats in the homeland and the world. / Emisija posvećena Hrvatima u domovini i svijetu.

programme.title: Samo lagano
programme.desc: We hang out JUST LIGHTLY with fun, interesting, motivating stories, which will surely encourage you to stop, take a deep breath and think before taking the next step. / Družimo se SAMO LAGANO uz zabavne, zanimljive, motivirajuće priče, koje će vas sigurno potaknuti da zastanete, duboko udahnete i razmislite prije nego što učinite sljedeći korak.

programme.title: HAK - Traffic education / HAK - Prometna edukacija
programme.desc: Edukativna tjedna emisija Hrvatskog autokluba donosi reportaže, kratke savjete i zanimljivosti o cestovnom prometu i povećanju sigurnosti.

programme.title: Hit dana
programme.desc: Every weekday, Hit presents the latest from the Croatian music scene. We present the latest popular, fun and tambura songs by Croatian authors and performers. / U Hitu dana svaki radni dan najnovije s hrvatske glazbene scene. Predstavljamo najnovije pjesme popularne, zabavne i tamburaške pjesme hrvatskih autora i izvođača.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - Wild People / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: Ben traveled to South America to visit Rhona, a British actress who has turned her back on Hollywood and now lives alone in an isolated valley in Uruguay. Ben is intrigued by this contrast, and Rhona reveals that her decision to drastically change her life was driven by health problems, a difficult childhood and disillusionment with Hollywood culture. He learns that Rhona has devoted herself to rehabilitating horses. Together they will go to the auction, in search of abused animals that they can save. Rhona will also tell Ben how she adapted to the macho culture of rural Uruguay _ or vice versa. On one occasion, Rhona narrowly escaped serious injury on her home soil. Ben realizes that she wouldn't be able to call anyone for help if something really went wrong because she's so far from her first neighbors. That night he himself will experience the wrath of nature. / Ben je otputovao u Južnu Ameriku kako bi posjetio Rhonu, britansku glumicu koja je okrenula leđa Hollywoodu i sad živi sama u izoliranoj dolini u Urugvaju. Ben je zaintrigiran tim kontrastom, a Rhona otkriva da su je na odluku o drastičnoj promjeni života navele zdravstvene tegobe, teško djetinjstvo i razočaranje holivudskom kulturom. Saznaje da se Rhona posvetila rehabilitiranju konja. Zajedno će otići na aukciju, u potragu za zlostavljanim životinjama koje mogu spasiti. Rhona će ispričati Benu i kako se prilagodila mačističkoj kulturi ruralnog Urugvaja _ ili obratno. Rhona je jednom prilikom za dlaku izbjegla tešku ozljedu na svojoj zemlji. Ben uviđa da ne bi mogla nikoga pozvati u pomoć kad bi nešto zaista pošlo naopako jer je vrlo daleko od prvih susjeda. Te noći i sam će iskusiti gnjev prirode.

programme.title: Putovanja Agathe Christie sa Sir Davidom Suchetom
programme.desc: Sir David Suchet follows in the footsteps of Agatha Christie and arrives in Hawaii, where she spent her vacation in 1922. It explores her passion for surfing and questions how travel has influenced her novels. He also bypasses clichés to discover the real Hawaii, meeting young men on beaches, cacao farmers, hula dance masters and people who make Hawaiian lei wreaths. / Sir David Suchet ide stopama Agathe Christie i stiže na Havaje, gdje je ona provela odmor 1922. godine. Istražuje njezinu strast prema surfanju i pita se kako su putovanja utjecala na njezine romane. Također zaobilazi klišeje kako bi otkrio prave Havaje, susreće mladiće na plažama, uzgajivače kakaa, majstore hula plesa i ljude koji izrađuju havajske vijence cvijeća lei.

programme.title: Shalla / Šalša
programme.desc: At the center of the events is Vatroslav (Momčilo Otašević), a lifelong student who loses his job and accommodation in Zagreb and accepts an offer to come to the isolated Dalmatian island of Mala Glava to help harvest tomatoes. There he meets the dentist Irena (Ivana Gulin) and a nice "home suite", but after the "feast of poms" he quickly becomes aware that Mala Glava is hiding a dark secret for which it is best _ to run away. / U središtu zbivanja je Vatroslav (Momčilo Otašević), vječiti student koji u Zagrebu ostane bez posla i smještaja te prihvati ponudu da dođe na izolirani dalmatinski otok Mala Glava pomoći u berbi rajčica. Ondje upoznaje stomatologinju Irenu (Ivana Gulin) i simpatičan "domaći svit", no nakon "fešte od poma" brzo postane svjestan da Mala Glava skriva mračnu tajnu zbog koje je najbolje _ bježati.

programme.title: Zaljev
programme.desc: After the police find Hanna's boyfriend Cal half-dead, Jenn and the team worry that Manning has prematurely released information related to the investigation, jeopardizing the case. Also, Jenn has problems at home. Namely, in addition to the educational inspection waiting for Chris, Jenna's mother Anne makes additional confusion, which is why their relationship is very shaken. In the Major Crimes Unit, the superiors put pressure on Manning, who tries his best to prove that he did not make a mistake. Jenn decides to arrest a member of Hanna's family. And as he tries to keep the trust of the Dawson family, whose members shift suspicion from one to another, a new suspect emerges. / Nakon što policija nađe polumrtvog Hanninog dečka Cala, Jenn i ekipa strepe da je Manning prerano objavio informacije povezane s istragom i time ugrozio slučaj. K tomu, Jenn ima probleme kod kuće. Naime, osim što Chrisa čeka prosvjetna inspekcija, dodatnu zbrku radi Jennina majka Anne, zbog čega je njihova veza itekako poljuljana. U Odjelu teških zločina nadređeni pritišću Manninga, koji se svim silama trudi dokazati da nije napravio grešku. Jenn odluči uhititi jednog člana Hannine obitelji. I dok nastoji zadržati povjerenje obitelji Dawson, čiji članovi sumnju prebacuju s jednog na drugog, pojavljuje se novi osumnjičenik.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Geoff and Barry's friends try to find something in common, while Adam directs the school play and discovers that dreams do come true. / Geoff i Barryevi prijatelji nastoje pronaći nešto što im je zajedničko, dok Adam režira školsku predstavu i otkriva da se snovi ipak ostvaruju.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Beverly is asked out on a date, and Adam questions his friendship with Dave Kim. / Beverly pozivaju na spoj, a Adam preispituje svoje prijateljstvo s Daveom Kimom.

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: Tonight, The Hahas and the Blablas are performing, a band from Zagreb that at the beginning of the year released their self-titled debut album with 12 short, infectious songs in which the genres of new wave, synth punk, power pop are mixed and they alternate philosophically and satirically, commentaries on all kinds of pop culture phenomena and life's absurdities, underlined lo-fi aesthetics of sound and music videos. Debbie Harry, David Icke, Andy Kaufman, several American presidents, victims of bureaucracy, a rat family _ they all appeared on the album, and today on our stage. / Večeras nastupaju The Hahas and the Blablas, zagrebački bend koji je početkom godine izdao istoimeni debitantski album s 12 kratkih, zaraznih pjesama u kojima se žanrovski miješaju new wave, synth punk, power pop i žustro izmjenjuju filozofsko-satirične slike, komentari na svakakve pojave pop kulture i životne apsurde, podcrtani lo-fi estetikom zvuka i spotova. Debbie Harry, David Icke, Andy Kaufman, nekoliko američkih predsjednika, žrtve birokracije, jedna štakorska obitelj _ svi su se našli na albumu, a danas i na našoj sceni.

programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: At night, we show new videos, recordings of concerts and festivals, and music shows from the HTV archive. / U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Beverly's parenting style has been criticized. Barry and Adam figure out how to break free from their mother's grip. / Beverlyn stil odgoja nailazi na kritike. Barry i Adam smišljaju kako da se oslobode majčine stege.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Love and loyalty win when Lainey returns home, and Adam and Carmen reach a turning point in their relationship. / Ljubav i odanost pobjeđuju kada se Lainey vrati kući, a Adam i Carmen dolaze do prekretnice u vezi.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: Alistair Appletone is helping a buyer from Maidstone, Kent realize their dream of moving inland to Dorset. She wants a home closer to her family so she can reconnect with her loved ones. Apart from selling real estate, Alistair also meets with a young couple who himself fled to the interior three years ago. / Alistair Appletone pomaže kupcu iz Maidstonea u Kentu da ostvari svoj san i preseli se u unutrašnjost, u Dorset. Ona želi dom bliže obitelji kako bi se mogla ponovno zbližiti sa svojim najdražima. Neovisno o prodaji nekretnina, Alistair se sastaje i s mladim parom koji je i sam pobjegao u unutrašnjost prije tri godine.

programme.title: George Clarke - Wonderful ideas / George Clarke - Čudesne zamisli
programme.desc: In an incredibly ambitious construction project, one man tries to make a mini-canal and a structure to accommodate a river boat. And in Denmark, George visits a single-bed hotel that is actually an old industrial crane. / U nevjerojatno ambicioznom graditeljskom poduhvatu jedan čovjek pokušava napraviti minikanal i ustavu za smještaj riječnog broda. A u Danskoj George posjećuje jednokrevetni hotel koji je zapravo stara industrijska dizalica.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: The Art of Home Cooking / Gordon Ramsay: Umijeće kuhanja kod kuće
programme.desc: In today's sequel, Gordon will prepare his favorite classic dishes in a fantastic modern guise, including boiled eggs and anchovy toast for breakfast. Eldest daughter Megan will help him prepare sensational stuffed beef ribs and a dessert of Eton mess in the shape of a hemisphere. / Gordon će u današnjem nastavku pripremati njemu najdraža klasična jela u fantastičnom modernom ruhu, među kojima su kuhana jaja i prepečanci s inćunima za doručak. Najstarija kći Megan pomoći će mu da pripremi senzacionalna nadjevena goveđa rebra i desert Eton mess u obliku polukugle.

programme.title: Spašavatelji vrtova
programme.desc: Retired archaeologist Jane, a keen history buff, has a small Victorian garden filled with various archaeological treasures. After a 15-year career in archaeology, she fell ill with cancer. Now she has finally recovered and wants to remodel the garden from the ground up. Charlie and Lee will rise to the challenge. They will design a holiday garden that will attract wild pollinators, then a seating area and a combination potager-style flower and vegetable garden. Jane also wants her archaeological findings to be incorporated into the design. How will Lee and Charlie manage on a budget of £6,000? / Umirovljena arheologinja Jane, strastvena ljubiteljica povijesti, ima mali viktorijanski vrt ispunjen raznim arheološkim blagom. Nakon 15-godišnje karijere u arheologiji, oboljela je od karcinoma. Sad se konačno oporavila i želi iz temelja preurediti vrt. Charlie i Lee primit će se izazova. Dizajnirat će vrt za odmor koji će privlačiti divlje oprašivače, zatim prostor za sjedenje i kombinaciju cvjetnjaka i povrtnjaka u potager stilu. Jane također želi da u dizajn ubace njezine arheološke nalaze. Kako će se Lee i Charlie snaći s budžetom od 6000 funta?

programme.title: Jakarta: Svjetsko prvenstvo u gimnastici
programme.desc: The 2025 World Gymnastics Championships will be held in Jakarta from October 18 to 26 at the Indonesia Arena, within the Gelora Bung Karno Sports Complex. It will be the 53rd edition of the competition under the auspices of the World Gymnastics Federation (FIG), and it is the first time it is being organized in Southeast Asia. The championship gathers the best gymnasts and gymnasts from all over the world who will compete in men's and women's sports gymnastics, in individual and team disciplines. In addition to the sports aspect, the event carries a strong promotional message under the slogan "Move to Inspire", with the aim of encouraging young people to play sports and promote a healthy lifestyle. / Svjetsko prvenstvo u sportskoj gimnastici 2025. održat će se u Jakarti od 18. do 26. listopada u Indonesia Areni, u sklopu sportskog kompleksa Gelora Bung Karno. Bit će to 53. izdanje natjecanja pod okriljem Svjetske gimnastičke federacije (FIG), a prvi put se organizira u jugoistočnoj Aziji. Prvenstvo okuplja najbolje gimnastičare i gimnastičarke iz cijelog svijeta koji će se natjecati u muškoj i ženskoj sportskoj gimnastici, u pojedinačnim i ekipnim disciplinama. Uz sportski aspekt, događaj nosi i snažnu promotivnu poruku pod sloganom "Move to Inspire", s ciljem poticanja mladih na bavljenje sportom i promicanje zdravog načina života.

programme.title: Sportsko srce
programme.desc: Tin Srbič is the most successful Croatian gymnast in history. The 27-year-old from Zagreb has as many as 6 medals from all major gymnastics competitions: he is European and world champion, double European vice-champion and has silver from the World Championship and the Olympic Games. Of the gold medals, he still lacks only the Olympic one. How is it possible to achieve such sporting success in a sport that is on the margins of public and media attention in Croatia, how much inspiration is his role model and friend Marijo Možnik and what motivates him to still remain in top sport, he reveals only for "Sportsko srce". / Tin Srbić najuspješniji je hrvatski gimnastičar u povijesti. 27-godišnji Zagrepčanin ima čak 6 medalja sa svih najvećih gimnastičkih natjecanja: europski je i svjetski prvak, dvostruki viceprvak Europe te ima srebro sa Svjetskog prvenstva i s Olimpijskih igara. Od zlatnih odličja nedostaje mu još samo ono olimpijsko. Kako je moguće ostvariti takav sportski uspjeh u sportu koji je u Hrvatskoj na marginama javnog i medijskog zanimanja, kolika mu je inspiracija uzor i prijatelj Marijo Možnik i što ga motivira da još ostaje u vrhunskom sportu, otkriva samo za "Sportsko srce".

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: The Art of Home Cooking / Gordon Ramsay: Umijeće kuhanja kod kuće
programme.desc: In today's sequel, Gordon will prepare his favorite classic dishes in a fantastic modern guise, including boiled eggs and anchovy toast for breakfast. Eldest daughter Megan will help him prepare sensational stuffed beef ribs and a dessert of Eton mess in the shape of a hemisphere. / Gordon će u današnjem nastavku pripremati njemu najdraža klasična jela u fantastičnom modernom ruhu, među kojima su kuhana jaja i prepečanci s inćunima za doručak. Najstarija kći Megan pomoći će mu da pripremi senzacionalna nadjevena goveđa rebra i desert Eton mess u obliku polukugle.

programme.title: Spašavatelji vrtova
programme.desc: Retired archaeologist Jane, a keen history buff, has a small Victorian garden filled with various archaeological treasures. After a 15-year career in archaeology, she fell ill with cancer. Now she has finally recovered and wants to remodel the garden from the ground up. Charlie and Lee will rise to the challenge. They will design a holiday garden that will attract wild pollinators, then a seating area and a combination potager-style flower and vegetable garden. Jane also wants her archaeological findings to be incorporated into the design. How will Lee and Charlie manage on a budget of £6,000? / Umirovljena arheologinja Jane, strastvena ljubiteljica povijesti, ima mali viktorijanski vrt ispunjen raznim arheološkim blagom. Nakon 15-godišnje karijere u arheologiji, oboljela je od karcinoma. Sad se konačno oporavila i želi iz temelja preurediti vrt. Charlie i Lee primit će se izazova. Dizajnirat će vrt za odmor koji će privlačiti divlje oprašivače, zatim prostor za sjedenje i kombinaciju cvjetnjaka i povrtnjaka u potager stilu. Jane također želi da u dizajn ubace njezine arheološke nalaze. Kako će se Lee i Charlie snaći s budžetom od 6000 funta?

programme.title: Prue Leith - in the kitchen with friends / Prue Leith - u kuhinji s prijateljima
programme.desc: Prue is joined by JLS cast member JB Gill, keen to demonstrate the versatility of the seasonal dish, and then husband John eases her sushi-making woes. / Prue se pridružuje član sastava JLS, JB Gill, u želji da pokaže svestranost sezonskog jela, a zatim joj suprug John olakšava muke pripremanja sušija.

programme.title: Lewis
programme.desc: The young man Will commits suicide in the middle of the church in front of the vicar, Rev. King. Will leaves a farewell note that reads "On the road to Calvary I stumbled" on the back of a leaflet from the religious sect The Garden. Hathaway and Will were childhood friends, but Hathaway doesn't seem to know anything about the Garden. The deaths that would follow would reveal the cult that had grown up around the Garden with the goal of curing homosexuals of homosexuality. To Lewis's dismay, Hathaway has been aware of this from the beginning, leading him to question Hathaway completely, even considering suspecting him. Hathaway is removed from the case, and a serial killer is closing in on him: there will be a race against time for his life. / Mladić Will počini samoubojstvo usred crkve pred očima vikara, vlč. Kinga. Will ostavlja oproštajnu poruku koja glasi "Na putu prema kalvariji posrnuo sam" na poleđini letka religiozne sekte Vrt. Hathaway i Will u djetinjstvu su bili prijatelji, ali čini se da Hathaway ne zna ništa o Vrtu. Smrti koje će uslijediti otkrit će kult koji je rastao oko Vrta s ciljem liječenja homoseksualaca od homoseksualizma. Na Lewisovo zaprepaštenje, Hathaway je od početka bio upoznat s time, što ga navodi da u potpunosti počne preispitivati Hathawaya, čak pomišlja da ga osumnjiči. Hathaway je maknut sa slučaja, a serijski ubojica okomljuje se na njega: uslijedit će utrka s vremenom za njegov život.

programme.title: TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, broadcast daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.

programme.title: Svijet zabave
programme.desc: British Prince Andrew had to give up his titles due to new details in the "Epstein case" — but his problems don't end there. The Danish group Aqua is preparing a musical about their thirty-year career, and Bradley Cooper is returning to film direction in the new dark humor drama Is This Thing On?. TBF and Nina Badrić will provide a dose of domestic glamor this week! / Britanski princ Andrew morao se, zbog novih detalja u "slučaju Epstein", odreći svojih titula — no njegovim problemima tu nije kraj. Danska grupa Aqua priprema mjuzikl o svojoj tridesetogodišnjoj karijeri, a Bradley Cooper vraća se filmskoj režiji u novoj crnohumornoj drami Is This Thing On?. Za dozu domaćeg glamura ovoga se tjedna pobrinut će TBF i Nina Badrić!

programme.title: Who wants to be a millionaire? / Tko želi biti milijunaš?
programme.desc: "Who wants to be a millionaire?" offers a unique opportunity to make your dreams come true _ and win a sum of money that can change everything. Can the contestants hold up under the pressure, with a million reasons to give their best on the world's most successful game show? In Millionaire, general knowledge merges with human nature _ concentration, strategy and mental strength of the individual. Each question raises the stakes, and the boundaries shift from answer to answer. Will he be able to get to the very end and readily say, "That's my final answer!"? / "Tko želi biti milijunaš?" pruža jedinstvenu priliku za ostvarenje snova _ i osvajanje novčanog iznosa koji može promijeniti sve. Mogu li natjecatelji izdržati pod pritiskom, s milijun razloga da daju najbolje od sebe u najuspješnijem svjetskom game showu? U Milijunašu opće znanje stapaju se s ljudskom prirodom _ koncentracijom, strategijom i mentalnom snagom pojedinca. Svako pitanje podiže ulog, a granice se pomiču iz odgovora u odgovor. Hoće li uspjeti doći do samog kraja i spremno reći: "To je moj konačni odgovor!"?

programme.title: Labirint
programme.desc: Sleep disorders are present all over the world. A third of Europeans suffer from insomnia. Even more than eighty percent of Croats are not satisfied with the quality of their sleep. And while some people struggle with insomnia, others with respiratory arrest during sleep _ what are the consequences of sleepless nights? When and where to seek help? / Poremećaji spavanja prisutni su u cijelome svijetu. Trećina Europljana boluje od nesanice. Čak više od osamdeset posto Hrvata nije zadovoljno kvalitetom svojeg sna. I dok se jedni bore s nesanicom, drugi sa zastojem disanja tijekom spavanja _ koje su posljedice neprospavanih noći? Kada i gdje potražiti pomoć?

programme.title: Rekreacija
programme.desc: In today's "Recreation" show, we bring a detailed report from the Sport Fest in Poreč, where several hundred athletes from all over Croatia, as well as the countries of the region, presented themselves to the public during the two days of the event. We introduce you to unusual sports such as dodgeball, hybrid race and arm wrestling, as well as an attractive sports show program such as BMX show and basketball acrobats. We also deal with the topic of the impact of stress on heart health _ find out how to recognize it and the easiest way to get rid of it. We also bring the story of women's boxing along with the attractive fights of our athletes. We also attended the unique Blind Run Race, in which the blind run is simulated by blindfolded participants. The race is of a humanitarian nature, and all funds collected are donated to the Croatian Association of the Visually Impaired and the Blind. In the column from our Gyms4You gym, we bring exercises that actively stimulate the brain. We talk about the connection between physical activity and brain functions and provide advice for optimal brain functioning. / U današnjoj emisiji "Rekreacija" donosimo iscrpan izvještaj sa Sport Festa u Poreču, gdje se tijekom dva dana održavanja javnosti predstavilo više stotina sportaša iz cijele Hrvatske, ali i zemalja regije. Upoznajemo vas s neobičnim sportovima poput dodgeballa, hybrid racea i obaranja ruke, te atraktivnim sportskim show-programom kao što su BMX show i košarkaški akrobati. Bavimo se i temom utjecaja stresa na zdravlje srca _ saznajte kako ga prepoznati i kako ga se najlakše riješiti. Donosimo i priču o ženskom boksu uz atraktivne borbe naših sportašica. Bili smo i na jedinstvenoj utrci Blind Run Race, u kojoj se simulira trčanje slijepih tako što sudionici nose poveze na očima. Utrka je humanitarnog karaktera, a sva prikupljena sredstva doniraju se Hrvatskoj udruzi slabovidnih i slijepih. U rubrici iz naše teretane Gyms4You donosimo vježbe kojima aktivno potičemo i rad mozga. Govorimo o povezanosti tjelesne aktivnosti i moždanih funkcija te donosimo savjete za optimalno funkcioniranje mozga.

programme.title: Stories from Croatia / Priče iz Hrvatske
programme.desc: In the show, we combine the virtual and the real, the present and the past. We find out why social networks have become indispensable in the sports world as well. We meet four migrants who started the podcast Over every border. In October, the month of the fight against breast cancer, we present the association Marra Altrui, which provides support to women during and after chemotherapy. Urban legends and the mystique of the Zadar Sphinx are revealed by Edi Škovrlj. / U emisiji spajamo virtualno i stvarno, sadašnjost i prošlost. Doznajemo zašto su društvene mreže postale nezaobilazne i u sportskom svijetu. Upoznajemo četvero migranata koji su pokrenuli podcast Preko svake granice. U listopadu, mjesecu borbe protiv raka dojke, predstavljamo udrugu Marra Altrui koja pruža potporu ženama tijekom i nakon kemoterapije. Urbane legende i mistiku zadarske sfinge otkriva Edi Škovrlj.

programme.title: Hit dana
programme.desc: Every weekday, Hit presents the latest from the Croatian music scene. We present the latest popular, fun and tambura songs by Croatian authors and performers. / U Hitu dana svaki radni dan najnovije s hrvatske glazbene scene. Predstavljamo najnovije pjesme popularne, zabavne i tamburaške pjesme hrvatskih autora i izvođača.

programme.title: Vlakom oko svijeta
programme.desc: Sir Tony Robinson begins an epic globetrotting adventure at St. Pancras in London, from where he will set out to explore the south of Europe. In this episode, they will get to know Europe in a new way, visiting interesting and lesser-known places. Even in famous cities, they will get special access and give you their special insight. His first stop is the Camargue in the south of France, where he will meet the last cowboys of Europe and their traditional way of life. Then he goes to Spain on the Costa Brava where he will visit the port city of LEscala, meet the local people and taste the best fish from the Anchovy Coast. Then he will take the train along the beautiful coast to Barcelona, ​​where he will fulfill his lifelong dream and visit the Camp Nou stadium, where he will discover how important football is to the Catalan identity. After a special tour of Barcelona and discovering the unique mark that the architect Antoni Gaudí left on the city, he goes west by train. / Sir Tony Robinson počinje epsku pustolovinu zemaljskom kuglom na kolodvoru St. Pancras u Londonu odakle će se zaputiti u istraživanje juga Europe. U ovoj epizodi upoznat će Europu na novi način, posjećujući zanimljiva i manje poznata mjesta. Čak i u poznatim gradovima dobit će poseban pristup i pružiti vam svoj poseban uvid. Prva mu je postaja Camargue na jugu Francuske gdje će upoznati zadnje kauboje Europe i njihov tradicionalan način života. Zatim odlazi u Španjolsku na Costa Bravu gdje će posjetiti lučki grad LEscalu, upoznati tamošnje ljude i kušati najbolju ribu s Obale inćuna. Zatim će vlakom proći duž prelijepe obale do Barcelone gdje će ispuniti životni san i posjetiti stadion Camp Nou na kojem će otkriti koliko je nogomet važan za katalonski identitet. Poslije posebnog obilaska Barcelone i otkrivanja jedinstvenog traga koji je arhitekt Antoni Gaudí ostavio na gradu, vlakom odlazi na zapad.

programme.title: Crime Friday: Marlowe detectives / Krimi petak: Istražiteljice iz Marlowa
programme.desc: Retired archaeologist Judith Potts' peaceful evening in Marlow is disrupted when she witnesses a brutal murder. While the local police _ led by newly promoted sergeant Tanika Malik _ are reluctant to believe her story, Judith begins her own investigation, questioning local suspects and investigating a key piece of evidence from the crime scene. The vicar's wife Becks and dog walker Suzie, who has a personal connection to the murder, come to her aid. Despite Tanika's warnings, the trio follow new leads, investigate the owner of an auction house and a local gun collector, and with the help of enthusiastic magnet fishermen, uncover evidence that leads to a gruesome discovery. / Mirna večer umirovljene arheologinje Judith Potts u Marlowu poremeti se kada postane svjedokinjom brutalnog ubojstva. Dok lokalna policija _ koju vodi novopromaknuta narednica Tanika Malik _ nije sklona povjerovati u njezinu priču, Judith započinje vlastitu istragu, ispituje lokalne sumnjivce i istražuje ključni dokaz s mjesta zločina. U pomoć joj priskaču vikarova supruga Becks i šetačica pasa Suzie, koja ima osobnu vezu s ubojstvom. Unatoč Tanikinim upozorenjima, trojka slijedi nove tragove, istražuje vlasnika aukcijske kuće i lokalnog kolekcionara oružja, a uz pomoć entuzijastičnih pecača magnetima otkrivaju dokaze koji vode do jezivog otkrića.

programme.title: Krimi petak: Nijemi svjedok
programme.desc: The team from Lyell explores the dark side of social networks, where the seemingly perfect lives of influencers open up a series of new questions. The pregnant inspector asks for their help, but their time is slowly running out. Nikki manages to unmask the prime suspect, while Jack uncovers a key clue at a music festival. When Nikki decides to play with fire, the investigation takes an unexpected turn, and a sudden event in Lyell brings a glimmer of hope. / Ekipa iz Lyella istražuje mračnu stranu društvenih mreža, gdje naizgled savršeni životi influencera otvaraju niz novih pitanja. Trudna inspektorica traži njihovu pomoć, no vrijeme im polako istječe. Nikki uspijeva raskrinkati prvoosumnjičenog, dok Jack na glazbenom festivalu otkriva ključni trag. Kada se Nikki odluči poigrati vatrom, istraga poprima neočekivani zaokret, a iznenadni događaj u Lyellu donosi tračak nade.

programme.title: Plot crime: Mode / Krimi petak: Modus
programme.desc: Ingvar is forced, against his will, to work with Warren if he wants to find Inger Johanne and Helen Tyler. Inger Johanne now understands what is behind the president's disappearance and realizes that dangerous forces are looking for him. / Ingvar je primoran, protiv svoje volje, surađivati s Warrenom ako želi pronaći Inger Johanne i Helen Tyler. Inger Johanne sada shvaća što je u pozadini predsjedničina nestanka i uviđa da za njim tragaju opasne sile.

programme.desc: The young man Will commits suicide in the middle of the church in front of the vicar, Rev. King. Will leaves a farewell note that reads "On the road to Calvary I stumbled" on the back of a leaflet from the religious sect The Garden. Hathaway and Will were childhood friends, but Hathaway doesn't seem to know anything about the Garden. The deaths that would follow would reveal the cult that had grown up around the Garden with the goal of curing homosexuals of homosexuality. To Lewis's dismay, Hathaway has been aware of this from the beginning, leading him to question Hathaway completely, even considering suspecting him. Hathaway is removed from the case, and a serial killer is closing in on him: there will be a race against time for his life. / Mladić Will počini samoubojstvo usred crkve pred očima vikara, vlč. Kinga. Will ostavlja oproštajnu poruku koja glasi "Na putu prema kalvariji posrnuo sam" na poleđini letka religiozne sekte Vrt. Hathaway i Will u djetinjstvu su bili prijatelji, ali čini se da Hathaway ne zna ništa o Vrtu. Smrti koje će uslijediti otkrit će kult koji je rastao oko Vrta s ciljem liječenja homoseksualaca od homoseksualizma. Na Lewisovo zaprepaštenje, Hathaway je od početka bio upoznat s time, što ga navodi da u potpunosti počne preispitivati Hathawaya, čak pomišlja da ga osumnjiči. Hathaway je maknut sa slučaja, a serijski ubojica okomljuje se na njega: uslijedit će utrka s vremenom za njegov život.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Beverly's parenting style has been criticized. Barry and Adam figure out how to break free from their mother's grip. / Beverlyn stil odgoja nailazi na kritike. Barry i Adam smišljaju kako da se oslobode majčine stege.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Love and loyalty win when Lainey returns home, and Adam and Carmen reach a turning point in their relationship. / Ljubav i odanost pobjeđuju kada se Lainey vrati kući, a Adam i Carmen dolaze do prekretnice u vezi.

programme.title: Izvan formata
programme.desc: Otti Berger _ the forgotten Bauhaus artist from Baranja "I need to know that you haven't forgotten me!" _ these are the words to Otti Berger from the last letter sent by Isa Gropius on February 22, 1941 from her native Zmajevec in Baranja. Her colleagues from the famous Bauhaus art school did everything to get the talented and successful textile designer to the USA. However, at the very end of the war, in 1944, Otti Berger was taken from her birthplace to Auschwitz, where she was killed. Who was Otti Berger and why do we know so little about her? We try to answer that question in the show, whose thirty minutes are not enough to cover the life and work of the artist who was admired by Alvar Aalto, Marcel Breuer and Walter Gropius. Speaking in the show are Ph.D. Antonija Mlikota, author of the book about Otta Berger, and Darko Šimičić, who has been dedicatedly working to ensure that her name is not forgotten in recent years. We were also with the camera at Otti Berger's birthday in the Zagreb park named after her, where the artist and poet Vlado Martek presented the installation "Doubly present / Tribute to Otti". / Otti Berger _ zaboravljena Bauhaus umjetnica iz Baranje "Moram znati da me niste zaboravili!" _ riječi su to Otti Berger iz posljednjeg pisma koje je 22. veljače 1941. iz rodnog Zmajevca u Baranji poslala Isi Gropius. Njezini kolege iz glasovite umjetničke škole Bauhaus činili su sve kako bi talentirana i uspješna dizajnerica tekstila stigla u SAD. No, Otti Berger je u samom završetku rata, 1944. godine, odvedena iz rodne kuće u Auschwitz, gdje je ubijena. Tko je bila Otti Berger i zašto o njoj znamo tako malo? Na to pitanje pokušavamo odgovoriti u emisiji čijih trideset minuta nije dovoljno da obuhvati život i stvaralaštvo umjetnice kojoj su se divili Alvar Aalto, Marcel Breuer i Walter Gropius. U emisiji govore dr. sc. Antonija Mlikota, autorica knjige o Otti Berger, te Darko Šimičić, koji posljednjih godina predano radi na tome da se njezino ime ne zaboravi. S kamerom smo bili i na rođendanu Otti Berger u zagrebačkom parku koji nosi njezino ime, gdje je umjetnik i pjesnik Vlado Martek predstavio instalaciju "Dvostruko prisutna / Posveta Otti".

programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: At night, we show new videos, recordings of concerts and festivals, and music shows from the HTV archive. / U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Beverly struggles with her feelings for her new crush. Barry rents the apartment without consulting Joanne. / Beverly se bori sa svojim osjećajima prema novoj simpatiji. Barry unajmljuje stan, a da se o tome nije posavjetovao s Joanne.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Adam can't wait to introduce Carmen to the family, but is shocked to learn that his sister has clashed with her in the past. Geoff helps Grandpa stay in the house. / Adam jedva čeka da Carmen predstavi obitelji, no šokira se kad dozna da se njegova sestra sukobila s njom u prošlosti. Geoff pomaže djedu da ostane u kući.

programme.title: Dom na kvadrat
programme.desc: We investigate how much artificial intelligence has influenced architecture and what kind of transformation playgrounds will experience — first in Zagreb, and then throughout Croatia. We also take you to an apartment for a family of four, decorated in the style of modern classics. / Istražujemo koliko je umjetna inteligencija utjecala na arhitekturu te kakvu će transformaciju doživjeti igrališta — najprije u Zagrebu, a potom i diljem Hrvatske. Vodimo vas i u stan četveročlane obitelji uređen u stilu moderne klasike.

programme.title: Poslovni plan
programme.desc: The show brings the latest news from the economy, talks about perspectives, economic forecasts, GDP trends, problems and growth generators. / Emisija donosi najnovije vijesti iz ekonomije, govori o perspektivama, ekonomskim prognozama, kretanju BDP-a, problemima i generatorima rasta.

programme.title: Koordinacija
programme.desc: Little Magdalena and her dad Johannes are the stars of our today's story about brick production in one of the oldest brickyards in Germany. Let's go to the brick factory to learn about the production process. The guest of Notes is Mislav Stepinac, a professor at the Faculty of Civil Engineering in Zagreb. In Miljokaz, we take you to the tunnel through which the gladiators passed and the amphitheater of the Salon. Civil engineer Adela Roginić will reveal how to repair cracks in the Tips and Tricks column. Ante Cash is a quality tool for electricians. / Malena Magdalena i njezin tata Johannes zvijezde su naše današnje priče o proizvodnji opeke u jednoj od najstarijih ciglana u Njemačkoj. Idemo u ciglanu upoznati proizvodni postupak. Gost Notesa je profesor na Građevinskom fakultetu u Zagrebu Mislav Stepinac. U Miljokazu vas vodimo u tunel kroz koji su prolazili gladijatori i amfiteatar Salona. Kako sanirati pukotine, u rubrici Tips and Tricks otkrit će nam inženjerka građevinarstva Adela Roginić. Ante Cash predstavlja kvalitetan alat za električare.

programme.title: Auto Market Magazin
programme.desc: Every week, the show for car enthusiasts presents new car models, technological innovations, tests new vehicles, and provides advice on maintenance. / U emisiji za ljubitelje automobila svaki tjedan predstavljaju se novi modeli automobila, tehnološke inovacije, testiraju nova vozila, donose savjeti o održavanju.

programme.title: Hotel Portofino
programme.desc: After the stock market crash, Bella, aware of the fact that she could lose the hotel, desperately struggles to start a new business venture. Cecil is visited by a ghost from his past. Alice struggles to overcome her fear of horses and learn to ride, and Lucian finally realizes that he loves Constance, but too late. Filled with emotion, Lucian takes revenge on the kidnapped blackshirt Antonio and reveals some key information about Nish. / Nakon sloma burze Bella se, svjesna činjenice da bi mogla izgubiti hotel, očajnički bori da pokrene novi poslovni pothvat. Cecila posjeti duh iz njegove prošlosti. Alice se trudi pobijediti strah od konja i naučiti jahati, a Lucian konačno shvaća da voli Constance, ali prekasno. Ispunjen emocijama, Lucian se iskaljuje na otetom crnokošuljašu Antoniju i otkriva neke ključne informacije o Nishu.

programme.title: Jakarta: Svjetsko prvenstvo u gimnastici
programme.desc: The 2025 World Gymnastics Championships will be held in Jakarta from October 18 to 26 at the Indonesia Arena, within the Gelora Bung Karno Sports Complex. It will be the 53rd edition of the competition under the auspices of the World Gymnastics Federation (FIG), and it is the first time it is being organized in Southeast Asia. The championship gathers the best gymnasts and gymnasts from all over the world who will compete in men's and women's sports gymnastics, in individual and team disciplines. In addition to the sports aspect, the event carries a strong promotional message under the slogan "Move to Inspire", with the aim of encouraging young people to play sports and promote a healthy lifestyle. / Svjetsko prvenstvo u sportskoj gimnastici 2025. održat će se u Jakarti od 18. do 26. listopada u Indonesia Areni, u sklopu sportskog kompleksa Gelora Bung Karno. Bit će to 53. izdanje natjecanja pod okriljem Svjetske gimnastičke federacije (FIG), a prvi put se organizira u jugoistočnoj Aziji. Prvenstvo okuplja najbolje gimnastičare i gimnastičarke iz cijelog svijeta koji će se natjecati u muškoj i ženskoj sportskoj gimnastici, u pojedinačnim i ekipnim disciplinama. Uz sportski aspekt, događaj nosi i snažnu promotivnu poruku pod sloganom "Move to Inspire", s ciljem poticanja mladih na bavljenje sportom i promicanje zdravog načina života.

programme.title: Skiing, World Cup: Soelden (W) / Skijanje, Svjetski Kup: Soelden (Ž)
programme.desc: The Women's Skiing World Cup has fascinated fans of this sport since 1967. Competitions are held in four basic disciplines: slalom, giant slalom, super giant slalom and downhill. In addition, special matches are organized in alpine and team combinations. Watch the season opener in Solden. / Svjetski kup žena u skijanju fascinira ljubitelje ovog sporta od 1967. Natjecanja se održavaju u četiri osnovne discipline: slalom, veleslalom, superveleslalom i spust. Osim toga, organiziraju se posebni mečevi u alpskim i timskim kombinacijama. Otvaranje sezone gledajte u Soldenu.
