Otvaranje sezone gledajte u Soldenu.

programme.title: Krimi matineja: Nijemi svjedok
programme.desc: The team from Lyell explores the dark side of social networks, where the seemingly perfect lives of influencers open up a series of new questions. The pregnant inspector asks for their help, but their time is slowly running out. Nikki manages to unmask the prime suspect, while Jack uncovers a key clue at a music festival. When Nikki decides to play with fire, the investigation takes an unexpected turn, and a sudden event in Lyell brings a glimmer of hope. / Ekipa iz Lyella istražuje mračnu stranu društvenih mreža, gdje naizgled savršeni životi influencera otvaraju niz novih pitanja. Trudna inspektorica traži njihovu pomoć, no vrijeme im polako istječe. Nikki uspijeva raskrinkati prvoosumnjičenog, dok Jack na glazbenom festivalu otkriva ključni trag. Kada se Nikki odluči poigrati vatrom, istraga poprima neočekivani zaokret, a iznenadni događaj u Lyellu donosi tračak nade.

programme.title: Karl Lagerfeld: Razotkrivanje
programme.desc: Karl took over the house of Chanel in 1983 and made it world famous. He breathed new life into an outdated name by adding a hint of his own more modern style. He was the first to realize that haute couture could be much more lucrative. Glasses, handbags, makeup, watches, jewelry _ everything was successful. With him, haute couture entered a new era. After the death of his lover Jacques and his mother, Karl withdrew and became lonely. He spent his days drawing and searching for successful ideas. / Karl je 1983. preuzeo kuću Chanel i učinio je svjetski popularnom. Udahnuo je novi život zastarjelom imenu dodavši mu tračak svojeg modernijeg stila. Prvi je shvatio da visoka moda može biti mnogo unosnija. Naočale, torbice, šminka, satovi, nakit _ sve je bilo uspješno. S njime je visoka moda ušla u novo razdoblje. Nakon smrti ljubavnika Jacquesa i majke Karl se povukao i osamio. Dane je provodio crtajući i tragajući za uspješnim zamislima.

programme.title: Volim Hrvatsku
programme.desc: Sunday afternoons are again cheered up by the team of the show Volim Hrvatska. The captains are Dušan Bućan and Goran Navojec. In the fifth show, Dušan's team will feature: Antonela Đinđić, Romina Tonković and Goran Grgić, while Laura Sučec, Dino Antonić and Jelena Perčin will be in Goran's team. Contestants will try their hand at well-known games such as Guess the Song, Happy Birthday, TV and Film, Sport, Famous Compatriots, Shufflers, Average Citizen and Word Croatian. The show is hosted by Mirko Fodor. The hits of local music are performed live by the band Ante Gele. / Nedjeljna popodneva ponovno uveseljava ekipa šoua Volim Hrvatsku. Kapetani su Dušan Bućan i Goran Navojec. U petoj emisiji u Dušanovom timu nastupaju: Antonela Đinđić, Romina Tonković i Goran Grgić, dok će u Goranovom timu biti Laura Sučec, Dino Antonić i Jelena Perčin. Natjecatelji će se okušati u dobro poznatim igrama poput Pogodi pjesmu, Sretan rođendan, TV i film, Sport, Poznati sunarodnjaci, Premetaljke, Prosječni građanin i Riječ hrvatska. Emisiju vodi Mirko Fodor. Hitove domaće glazbe uživo izvodi bend Ante Gele.

programme.title: Ne zaboravite ostaviti recenziju
programme.desc: What happens in the virtual world rarely stays there. For a once hidden heavenly place like Blue Cave, the echo in reality means that after a series of reviews and likes, it will be at the top of the list of top five undiscovered destinations of Croatian islands in a flash. But when the hidden paradise becomes only a backdrop for selfies, and the sea _ soup of tourists _ there is a fine line between discovery and destruction. Can our fantastic natural beauty survive its own popularity if every star has consequences? / Ono što se dogodi u virtualnom svijetu, rijetko ondje i ostane. Za nekada skriveno rajsko mjesto poput Modre špilje, odjek u stvarnosti znači da će nakon niza recenzija i lajkova, munjevito biti na vrhu liste top pet neotkrivenih destinacija hrvatskih otoka. No kada skriveni raj postane tek kulisa za selfije, a more _ juha od turista _ tanka je granica između otkrivanja i uništavanja. Mogu li naše fantastične prirodne ljepote preživjeti vlastitu popularnost ako svaka zvjezdica ima posljedice?

programme.title: Dnevnik Nomada
programme.desc: In the valley of the Omo river, in the extreme south of Ethiopia, Kristijan Iličić witnesses the living customs of the tribes that were ruled by the Seljan brothers on behalf of the Ethiopian emperor. In the Hamar tribe, he attends a shocking ceremony of whipping women. In the Karo tribe, he discovers the terrible practice of killing the so-called cursed "mingi" children, so he talks to a mother who killed her three children because of superstition. From the women of the Mursi tribe, he learns everything about the tradition of wearing a plate in the mouth, and in the Dasanech tribe, he discovers the horrors of genital mutilation of girls. But although the reality of tribal life is often shocking, it also contains many positive sides, the humanity that Christian manages to bring to the surface. In the Omo River Valley, he is also trying to find the girls from his tattoos, which he photographed in 2009, when he first visited the tribes in southern Ethiopia. / U dolini rijeke Omo, na krajnjem jugu Etiopije, Kristijan Iličić svjedoči i danas živim običajima plemena kojima su u ime etiopskog cara vladala braća Seljan. U plemenu Hamar nazoči šokantnoj ceremoniji bičevanja žena. U plemenu Karo otkriva strašnu praksu ubojstva tzv. uklete "mingi" djece pa razgovara s majkom koja je zbog praznovjerja ubila svoje troje djece. Od žena iz plemena Mursi saznaje sve o tradiciji nošenja tanjura u usnama, a u plemenu Dasanech otkriva užase genitalne mutilacije djevojčica. Ali iako je stvarnost plemenskog života često šokantna, ona sadrži i mnoge pozitivne strane, ljudskost koju Kristijan uspijeva izvući na površinu. U dolini rijeke Omo također pokušava pronaći djevojčice sa svojih tetovaža, koje je fotografirao 2009., kada je prvi put posjetio plemena na jugu Etiopije.

programme.title: Heavy industry - 50 years - KDVL / Teška industrija - 50 godina - KDVL
programme.desc: There are few popular and rock groups that can boast of such a long duration on the music scene. This special concert marked the 50th anniversary of the group's recognizable musical expression. On March 1, 2024, a concert was held with the most loyal audience at Vatroslav Lisinski's KD in Zagreb, which recalled the unforgettable songs and old hits of Ivica Propadalo, Vedad Hadžiavdić, the former singer of the group Seid Memić Vajta, the current singer of the group Lee Mijatović and others. / Malo je popularnih i rock grupa koje se mogu pohvaliti tako dugim trajanjem na glazbenoj sceni. Ovim posebnim koncertom obilježeno je čak 50 godina postojanja grupe prepoznatljivog glazbenog izričaja. Uz najvjerniju publiku u KD Vatroslava Lisinskog u Zagrebu je 1. ožujka 2024. održan koncert koji je podsjetio na nezaboravne pjesme i davne hitove Ivice Propadala, Vedada Hadžiavdića, nekadašnjeg pjevača grupe Seida Memića Vajte, sadašnje pjevačice grupe Lee Mijatović i drugih.

programme.title: Španjolska s Evom Longorijom
programme.desc: Eva Longoria explores her Spanish roots in her ancestral homeland to discover how that beautiful country and its rich culture shaped one of the world's best cuisines. Four hundred years after her ancestor Lorenzo left Asturias for the New World, Eva Longoria returns to that land of majestic mountains, lush orchards, wild seas and brave people. / Eva Longoria u postojbini svojih predaka istražuje svoje španjolske korijene kako bi otkrila kako su ta prekrasna zemlja i njezina bogata kultura oblikovale jednu od najboljih svjetskih kuhinja. Četiristo godina nakon što je njezin predak Lorenzo napustio Asturiju i zaputio se u Novi svijet, Eva Longoria vraća se u tu zemlju veličanstvenih planina, bujnih voćnjaka, divljeg mora i hrabrih ljudi.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain - Upoznavanje nepoznatog
programme.desc: As peace and hope spread across Sri Lanka following the end of a brutal civil war, Bourdain travels through the once-divided regions to experience the well-fed people, delicious food and vast expanses. He starts from Colombo in the south, the capital, where he discovers the changes on the liberated island, sampling the street food at Nanas King _ light curries and lots of seafood. He takes a ten-hour train ride to the northern time-capsule city of Jaffna, where he enjoys crab curry — the holy grail of Sri Lankan cuisine, known for its spicy and fiery flavors. / Kako se mir i nada šire Šri Lankom nakon završetka okrutnoga građanskog rata, Bourdain putuje nekada podijeljenim regijama kako bi doživio osokoljeni narod, slasnu hranu i nepregledna prostranstva. Kreće od Colomba na jugu, glavnog grada, gdje otkriva promjene na oslobođenom otoku, kušajući uličnu hranu u Nanas Kingu _ lagane curryje i mnogo morskih plodova. Vozi se deset sati vlakom do sjevernog grada-vremenske kapsule Jaffne, gdje uživa u curryju od rakova _ svetom gralu šrilankanske kuhinje, poznate po začinjenim i vatrenim okusima.

programme.title: Clarksonova farma
programme.desc: Jeremy's restaurant opens in a few days, but everything is done in strict secrecy. Jeremy doesn't want the council to know about it until the opening, so he and Kaleb install the plumbing and wiring in the dead of night. Heifer Pepper is still alive and enjoying the company of Heartbreaker. Two days before the restaurant opens, Jeremy informs the council and the game begins. Alan and his builders are working hard, Pip and her team of cooks too... A mixture of excitement and panic grips them all. That day is coming. Will the restaurant be successful? Or will the council shut it down before they throw the first steak on the grill? / Jeremyjev restoran otvara se za nekoliko dana, no sve se odvija u strogoj tajnosti. Jeremy ne želi da vijeće sazna za to do samog otvaranja pa on i Kaleb postavljaju vodovodne i elektroinstalacije u gluho doba noći. Junica Pepper još je na životu i uživa u društvu Srcolomca. Dva dana prije otvaranja restorana Jeremy obavještava vijeće i igra počinje. Alan i njegovi građevinci rade punom parom, Pip i njezin tim kuhara također... Sve ih obuzima mješavina uzbuđenja i panike. Stiže i taj dan. Hoće li restoran biti uspješan? Ili će ga vijeće zatvoriti prije nego što bace prvi odrezak na roštilj?

programme.title: Kompilacija
programme.desc: Mixtapes played an exceptional role in the creation of hip-hop in the world. Before radio, the internet and social media, there were mix tapes. No matter where you lived, you could put a tape in the cassette player and find yourself at a party on the other side of the world. DJs were tastemakers, they dictated trends and created a sound that became the biggest music genre in the world. The meteoric rise of an art form that is not yet 50 years old. The importance of mix tapes goes beyond the cassettes themselves. Mixed ribbons were a form of currency. The culture was too strong to be stopped and the artists too gifted to be ignored. That's why they turned the subculture into the mainstream, and hip hop became what it is today. / Miješane vrpce imale su iznimnu ulogu u stvaranju hip-hopa u svijetu. Prije radija, interneta i društvenih mreža postojale su miješane vrpce. Gdje god da ste živjeli, mogli ste ubaciti kasetu u kasetofon i naći se na zabavi na drugom kraju svijeta. DJ-i su bili kreatori ukusa, diktirali su trendove i kreirali zvuk koji je postao najveći glazbeni žanr na svijetu. Meteorski uspon umjetničke forme koja još nije napunila 50 godina. Važnost miješanih vrpci nadilazi same kazete. Miješane vrpce bile su oblik valute. Kultura je bila prejaka da bi se zaustavila, a umjetnici previše daroviti da bi ih se ignoriralo. Zato su subkulturu pretvorili u glavnu struju, a hip hop je postao ono što je danas.

programme.title: Vitić dances / Vitić pleše
programme.desc: The feature-length documentary film follows an interdisciplinary community project for twenty years, the goal of which is to restore the common spaces of the Narodna banka residential block at Laginjina 7 and 9 in Zagreb, considering tangible and intangible heritage as a resource for sustainable renovation, maintenance and use. The film documents the restoration of a masterpiece of modern architecture by the excellent Sibenik architect Ivan Vitić, a protected cultural monument, which for years has been one of the most desirable residential addresses for numerous Croatian architects, artists, musicians, journalists and university professors. / Dugometražni dokumentarni film tijekom dvadeset godina prati interdisciplinarni projekt zajednice kojemu je cilj obnova zajedničkih prostora stambenog Bloka Narodne banke u Laginjinoj 7 i 9 u Zagrebu, promišljajući materijalnu i nematerijalnu baštinu kao resurs održive obnove, održavanja i korištenja. Film dokumentira obnovu remek-djela moderne arhitekture, vrsnog šibenskog arhitekta Ivana Vitića, zaštićenog spomenika kulture, koji je godinama jedna od najpoželjnijih adresa za stanovanje brojnih hrvatskih arhitekata, umjetnika, glazbenika, novinara i sveučilišnih profesora.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Beverly struggles with her feelings for her new crush. Barry rents the apartment without consulting Joanne. / Beverly se bori sa svojim osjećajima prema novoj simpatiji. Barry unajmljuje stan, a da se o tome nije posavjetovao s Joanne.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Adam can't wait to introduce Carmen to the family, but is shocked to learn that his sister has clashed with her in the past. Geoff helps Grandpa stay in the house. / Adam jedva čeka da Carmen predstavi obitelji, no šokira se kad dozna da se njegova sestra sukobila s njom u prošlosti. Geoff pomaže djedu da ostane u kući.

programme.title: Svijet zabave
programme.desc: We guide you through the world of music, film, fashion, glamour, famous public figures, events, red carpets... / Vodimo vas kroz svijet glazbe, filma, mode, glamura, poznatih javnih osoba, događaja, crvenih tepiha...

programme.title: Peti dan
programme.desc: A weekly show in which given topics from science, art and culture, as well as social and political events that directly affect our lives, are discussed by intellectuals, with moderation. / Tjedna emisija u kojoj zadane teme iz znanosti, umjetnosti i kulture te društvena i politička zbivanja koja izravno utječu na naš život promišljaju intelektualci, uz moderiranje.

programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: At night, we show new videos, recordings of concerts and festivals, and music shows from the HTV archive. / U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: When the Flyers reach the Stanley Cup Finals, Barry superstitiously asks the family to observe certain rituals. Geoff asks Lou and Linda to spend more time with Muriel. / Kad Flyersi stignu do finala Stanleyeva kupa, Barry iz praznovjerna traži od obitelji da se pridržava određenih rituala. Geoff traži od Loua i Linde da provode više vremena s Muriel.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: In his grandfather's apartment, Adam finds something that his grandfather wrote a long time ago and realizes that they have more in common than he thought. Erica and Geoff want some alone time. / Adam u djedovu stanu pronalazi nešto što je djed davno napisao i shvaća da imaju više zajedničkog nego što je mislio. Erica i Geoff žele biti malo sami.

programme.title: Kućni ljubimci
programme.desc: In the 1800th show, we visit dog breeder Rebeka Tratnik and present the Shiba Inu and Akita Inu breeds that she breeds. Anja Andrel, breeder of Bengal cats, will introduce us to a new litter of kittens. Robert Kranjčević will present the rabbits and ornamental poultry he breeds. In the veterinary clinic, we talk about bronchopneumonia in dogs. / U 1800. emisiji u posjetu smo uzgajateljici pasa Rebeki Tratnik i predstavljamo pasmine shiba inu i akita inu koje uzgaja. Anja Andrel, uzgajateljica bengalskih mačaka, upoznat će nas s novim leglom mačića. Robert Kranjčević predstavit će nam kuniće i ukrasnu perad koju uzgaja. U veterinarskoj ambulanti govorimo o bronhopneumoniji kod pasa.

programme.title: DW: Tomorrow is today / DW: Sutrašnjica danas
programme.desc: Deutsche Welle's show about the European way of life brings interesting things from European cities. / Emisija Deutsche Wellea o europskom načinu života, donosi zanimljivosti iz europskih gradova.

programme.title: Svijet znanosti
programme.desc: Introducing young Croatian innovators! We also take you to an interesting exhibition in London, where the dresses, jewelry and personal belongings of the French Queen Marie Antoinette will be presented at the Victoria and Albert Museum. Find out how a lone female iguana gave birth to as many as eight cubs through parthenogenesis — without mating — and how cockatoos live in the urban parks of Hong Kong. / Predstavljamo mlade hrvatske inovatore! Vodimo vas i na zanimljivu izložbu u Londonu, gdje će biti predstavljene haljine, nakit i osobne stvari francuske kraljice Marije Antoanete u Muzeju Victoria i Albert. Doznajte i kako je usamljena ženka iguane partenogenezom — bez parenja — okotila čak osam mladunaca te kako žive kakadui u urbanim parkovima Hong Konga.

programme.title: Up to the wine / Fino i vino
programme.desc: We travel Croatia in search of stories about dedication and love for work, as well as tradition in a modern guise. We also monitor the success of family farms. / Putujemo Hrvatskom u potrazi za pričama o posvećenosti i ljubavi prema poslu, kao i tradiciji u suvremenom ruhu. Usto pratimo uspjehe obiteljskih gospodarstava.

programme.title: Rekreacija
programme.desc: Recreation is a show dedicated to a healthy and active lifestyle and the entire lifestyle related to recreational activities. It is intended for a wider active community, with the aim of encouraging regular physical activity and health care. / Rekreacija je emisija posvećena zdravom i aktivnom načinu života te cjelokupnom lifestyleu vezanom uz rekreativne aktivnosti. Namijenjena je široj aktivnoj zajednici, s ciljem poticanja na redovitu tjelesnu aktivnost i brigu o zdravlju.

programme.title: Hotel Portofino
programme.desc: Lucian, Virat and Marco discover Nish's body buried in the forest. In his pain, Lucian rushes to Constance and begs her to run away with him, asking her to choose between Vito and him. Alice proves her love to Carl, but realizes that he has been manipulating her. Shaken by Nish's death, Bella mends her relationship with her sister and confesses her relationship with Marco, not realizing that Danioni has plans for Marco. / Lucian, Virat i Marco otkriju Nishovo tijelo zakopano u šumi. U svojoj boli Lucian odjuri do Constance i moli je da pobjegne s njim, tražeći da izabere između Vita i njega. Alice dokazuje svoju ljubav Carlu, ali shvaća da je on manipulirao njome. Potresena Nishevom smrću, Bella popravlja odnose sa sestrom i priznaje vezu s Marcom, ne sluteći da Danioni ima planove za Marca.

programme.title: Hotel Portofino
programme.desc: On the day of the party where Claudine presents her perfume, Bella makes a presentation in front of Mr. Fleuryi to try to get his financial support. Cecil prepares a deadly plan against Danioni, but Jack tricks him. Lucian prepares to escape with Constance while Cecil tries to kill Danioni himself, but is caught by the Blackshirts. Bella finds out she's been granted support, Cecil is taken away, and a grieving Virat bursts into the party with a stolen gun to kill Danioni. / Na dan zabave na kojoj Claudine predstavlja svoj parfem Bella održi prezentaciju pred g. Fleuryijem kako bi pokušala dobiti njegovu financijsku potporu. Cecil priprema smrtonosni plan protiv Danionija, ali Jack ga prevari. Lucian se sprema pobjeći s Constance dok Cecil pokušava sam ubiti Danionija, ali ga uhvate crnokošuljaši. Bella sazna da je dobila potporu, Cecila odvedu, a ožalošćeni Virat uleti na zabavu s ukradenim pištoljem kako bi ubio Danionija.

programme.title: Skiing, World Cup: Soelden (M) / Skijanje, Svjetski Kup: Soelden (M)
programme.desc: The Men's Skiing World Cup has fascinated fans of the sport since 1967. Competitions are held in four basic disciplines: slalom, giant slalom, super giant slalom and downhill. In addition, special races are organized in alpine and team combinations. / Svjetski kup u skijanju za muškarce fascinira ljubitelje ovog sporta od 1967. godine. Natjecanja se održavaju u četiri osnovne discipline: slalom, veleslalom, superveleslalom i spust. Osim toga, organiziraju se posebne utrke u alpskim i timskim kombinacijama.

programme.title: Krimi matineja: Foyleov rat
programme.desc: Pilots and their girlfriends live fast and die young in a tale of lust and passion, and Foyle discovers that appearances can sometimes be deceiving. / Piloti i njihove djevojke žive brzo i umiru mladi u priči o pohoti i strasti, a Foyle otkriva da privid katkad vara.

programme.title: Skiing, World Cup: Soelden (M) / Skijanje, Svjetski Kup: Soelden (M)
programme.desc: Skiing, World Cup: Soelden _ giant slalom (M), broadcast of the 2nd run / Skijanje, Svjetski Kup: Soelden _ veleslalom (M), prijenos 2. vožnje

programme.title: Sportsko srce
programme.desc: The series brings us closer to the life and sports career of young athletes whose sports are not so well-known and followed. We find out how they decided on a certain sports discipline, what their expectations are... / Serija nam približava život i sportsku karijeru mladih sportaša čiji sportovi nisu toliko praćeni i poznati. Saznajemo kako su se odlučili za određenu sportsku disciplinu, koja su im očekivanja…

programme.title: Španjolska s Evom Longorijom
programme.desc: Eva Longoria explores her Spanish roots in her ancestral homeland to discover how that beautiful country and its rich culture shaped one of the world's best cuisines. Four hundred years after her ancestor Lorenzo left Asturias for the New World, Eva Longoria returns to that land of majestic mountains, lush orchards, wild seas and brave people. / Eva Longoria u postojbini svojih predaka istražuje svoje španjolske korijene kako bi otkrila kako su ta prekrasna zemlja i njezina bogata kultura oblikovale jednu od najboljih svjetskih kuhinja. Četiristo godina nakon što je njezin predak Lorenzo napustio Asturiju i zaputio se u Novi svijet, Eva Longoria vraća se u tu zemlju veličanstvenih planina, bujnih voćnjaka, divljeg mora i hrabrih ljudi.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain - Upoznavanje nepoznatog
programme.desc: As peace and hope spread across Sri Lanka following the end of a brutal civil war, Bourdain travels through the once-divided regions to experience the well-fed people, delicious food and vast expanses. He starts from Colombo in the south, the capital, where he discovers the changes on the liberated island, sampling the street food at Nanas King _ light curries and lots of seafood. He takes a ten-hour train ride to the northern time-capsule city of Jaffna, where he enjoys crab curry — the holy grail of Sri Lankan cuisine, known for its spicy and fiery flavors. / Kako se mir i nada šire Šri Lankom nakon završetka okrutnoga građanskog rata, Bourdain putuje nekada podijeljenim regijama kako bi doživio osokoljeni narod, slasnu hranu i nepregledna prostranstva. Kreće od Colomba na jugu, glavnog grada, gdje otkriva promjene na oslobođenom otoku, kušajući uličnu hranu u Nanas Kingu _ lagane curryje i mnogo morskih plodova. Vozi se deset sati vlakom do sjevernog grada-vremenske kapsule Jaffne, gdje uživa u curryju od rakova _ svetom gralu šrilankanske kuhinje, poznate po začinjenim i vatrenim okusima.

programme.title: SuperSport HNL
programme.desc: Follow the SuperSport Croatian Football League, the highest ranking football competition in Croatia, which has been held since 1992 under the leadership of the Croatian Football Association. Until 2022, the league was called the First Croatian Football League. The ten best football clubs from Croatia participate in SuperSport HNL. The club that is crowned national champion has the opportunity to try out for the 2nd preliminary round of the UEFA Champions League, while the second and third placed teams enter the 2nd preliminary round of the UEFA European Conference League. / Pratite SuperSport hrvatsku nogometnu ligu, nogometno natjecanje najvišeg ranga u Hrvatskoj koje se održava od 1992. godine pod vodstvom Hrvatskoga nogometnog saveza. Liga je do 2022. godine nosila naziv Prva hrvatska nogometna liga. U SuperSport HNL-u sudjeluje deset najboljih nogometnih klubova iz Hrvatske. Klub koji se okruni titulom državnoga prvaka ima priliku okušati se u 2. pretkolu UEFA Lige prvaka, dok drugoplasirani i trećeplasirani ulaze u 2. pretkolo kvalifikacija za UEFA Europsku konferencijsku ligu.

programme.title: Europsko prvenstvo u stolnom tenisu
programme.desc: European table tennis championship, reportage / Europsko prvenstvo u stolnom tenisu, reportaža

programme.title: SuperSport HNL
programme.desc: Follow the SuperSport Croatian Football League, the highest ranking football competition in Croatia, which has been held since 1992 under the leadership of the Croatian Football Association. Until 2022, the league was called the First Croatian Football League. The ten best football clubs from Croatia participate in SuperSport HNL. The club that is crowned national champion has the opportunity to try out for the 2nd preliminary round of the UEFA Champions League, while the second and third placed teams enter the 2nd preliminary round of the UEFA European Conference League. / Pratite SuperSport hrvatsku nogometnu ligu, nogometno natjecanje najvišeg ranga u Hrvatskoj koje se održava od 1992. godine pod vodstvom Hrvatskoga nogometnog saveza. Liga je do 2022. godine nosila naziv Prva hrvatska nogometna liga. U SuperSport HNL-u sudjeluje deset najboljih nogometnih klubova iz Hrvatske. Klub koji se okruni titulom državnoga prvaka ima priliku okušati se u 2. pretkolu UEFA Lige prvaka, dok drugoplasirani i trećeplasirani ulaze u 2. pretkolo kvalifikacija za UEFA Europsku konferencijsku ligu.

programme.title: Magazin LP
programme.desc: It provides an overview and summaries of all Champions League matches, as well as stories about the best football players and reports about the actors of the competition. / Donosi pregled i sažetke svih utakmica Lige prvaka te priče o najboljim nogometašima i reportaže o akterima natjecanja.

programme.title: Dulum zemlje
programme.desc: The Knežević family from Šiškovci has been cultivating beekeeping for four generations. Their story was not without challenges, the head of the family survived a heart attack twice and returned to his work each time. Today, the whole family works side by side, producing top quality honey and at the same time contributing to the preservation of nature and biodiversity. The episode tells a story about perseverance, togetherness and love for work that overcomes obstacles. / Obitelj Knežević iz Šiškovaca već četiri generacije njeguje pčelarstvo. Njihova priča nije bila bez izazova, glava obitelji dvaput je preživio infarkt i svaki put se vraćao svom poslu. Danas cijela obitelj radi rame uz rame, proizvodeći vrhunski med i istodobno pridonoseći očuvanju prirode i bioraznolikosti. Epizoda donosi priču o ustrajnosti, zajedništvu i ljubavi prema poslu koji nadilazi prepreke.

programme.title: Svijet zabave
programme.desc: We guide you through the world of music, film, fashion, glamour, famous public figures, events, red carpets... / Vodimo vas kroz svijet glazbe, filma, mode, glamura, poznatih javnih osoba, događaja, crvenih tepiha...

programme.title: Christopher Reeve, vječni Superman
programme.desc: The whole world considers Christopher Reeve (1952 - 2004) to be Superman. More than 40 years after the release of Richard Donner's international hit, Christopher Reeve is still the undisputed embodiment of the superhero from Krypton. How did the American actor manage to connect the character and his name so closely? What kind of new life breathed into that hero of the novel, the embodiment of the American dream, that all actors later consider him a model for that role? Thanks to a previously unpublished interview that we managed to get just before the actor's untimely death, the film sheds light on the relationship between the two heroes, follows their development during nine years of cohabitation and afterwards, until the moment when the actor united with the superhero. / Cijeli svijet Christophera Reevea (1952. _ 2004.) smatra Supermanom. Više od 40 godina nakon izlaska međunarodnog filmskog hita Richarda Donnera, Christopher Reeve još je neosporno utjelovljenje superjunaka s Kriptona. Kako je Američki glumac uspio tako usko povezati lik i svoje ime? Kakav je to novi život udahnuo tom junaku romana, utjelovljenju američkog sna, da ga svi glumci poslije smatraju modelom za tu ulogu? Zahvaljujući dosad neobjavljenom intervjuu koji smo uspjeli dobiti netom prije preuranjene smrti glumca, film rasvjetljava veze između dva junaka, prati njihov razvoj tijekom devet godina suživota i nakon toga, sve do trenutka kad se glumac sjedinio sa superjunakom.

programme.title: Stadion
programme.desc: Weekly overview of the strongest European football leagues, as well as smaller national championships, and other current sports topics. / Tjedni pregled najjačih europskih nogometnih liga, kao i manjih nacionalnih prvenstava, te druge aktualne sportske teme.

programme.title: In the arena: Serena Williams / U areni: Serena Williams
programme.desc: While Serena struggled to continue her winning streak after winning her first Grand Slam tournament, Venus won four in two years. Serena finally found a winning formula, but that will mean nothing when she takes the court against the number one player in the world, her sister. Only one will emerge from that match as the winner. / Dok se Serena mučila nastaviti pobjednički niz nakon osvajanja prvog Grand Slam turnira, Venus je u dvije godine osvojila četiri. Serena je na koncu pronašla dobitničku formulu, ali to neće ništa značiti kad izađe na teren protiv prve igračice svijeta, svoje sestre. Samo će jedna iz tog meča izaći kao pobjednica.

programme.title: Foyleov rat
programme.desc: Pilots and their girlfriends live fast and die young in a tale of lust and passion, and Foyle discovers that appearances can sometimes be deceiving. / Piloti i njihove djevojke žive brzo i umiru mladi u priči o pohoti i strasti, a Foyle otkriva da privid katkad vara.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: When the Flyers reach the Stanley Cup Finals, Barry superstitiously asks the family to observe certain rituals. Geoff asks Lou and Linda to spend more time with Muriel. / Kad Flyersi stignu do finala Stanleyeva kupa, Barry iz praznovjerna traži od obitelji da se pridržava određenih rituala. Geoff traži od Loua i Linde da provode više vremena s Muriel.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: In his grandfather's apartment, Adam finds something that his grandfather wrote a long time ago and realizes that they have more in common than he thought. Erica and Geoff want some alone time. / Adam u djedovu stanu pronalazi nešto što je djed davno napisao i shvaća da imaju više zajedničkog nego što je mislio. Erica i Geoff žele biti malo sami.

programme.title: Klub čitatelja
programme.desc: This Wednesday in the Reader's Club we are discussing the book Philosophy of Walking by Frederic Gros. Philosopher and writer Kristijan Vujičić, art historian and producer Paola Orlić, lawyer and Croatian language professor Zoran Maljković and literary critic Bozena Matijević are guests. / Ove srijede u Klubu čitatelja razgovaramo o knjizi Frederica Grosa Filozofija hodanja. Gostuju filozof i književnik Kristijan Vujičić, povjesničarka umjetnosti i producentica Paola Orlić, pravnik i profesor hrvatskog jezika Zoran Maljković te književna kritičarka Božena Matijević.

programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: At night, we show new videos, recordings of concerts and festivals, and music shows from the HTV archive. / U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Beverly decides to start dating again, but soon realizes that adult relationships are complicated and full of pitfalls. Barry discovers a new passion. / Beverly odlučuje ponovno krenuti na spojeve, no ubrzo shvaća da su odnosi među odraslima komplicirani i prepuni zamki. Barry otkriva novu strast.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Erica is thinking about what she will do in life. She finds inspiration in the movie "Baby Boom" and thinks she has discovered how to have it all. Adam is shooting a remake of the music video for the song "Uptown Girl". He meets Carmen's father and decides to ingratiate himself with him by pretending to be something he is not. / Erica razmišlja čime će se baviti u životu. Nadahnuće pronađe u filmu "Baby Boom" te misli da je otkrila kako imati sve. Adam snima remake spota za pjesmu "Uptown Girl". Upoznaje Carmenina oca i odlučuje mu se dodvoriti glumeći da je nešto što nije.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: Looking to escape south London, mother and son meet Sonali Shah in The Lothians, where they search for their ideal country escape, including an artist's studio. Sonali also explores the legacy of the 19th century Scottish conservationist known in America as the Father of National Parks. / Želeći pobjeći iz južnog Londona, majka i sin susreću Sonali Shah u The Lothians, gdje traže svoj idealni seoski bijeg, uključujući i umjetnički atelje. Sonali također istražuje naslijeđe škotskog konzervatora iz 19. stoljeća, poznatog u Americi kao Otac nacionalnih parkova.

programme.title: George Clarke - Wonderful ideas / George Clarke - Čudesne zamisli
programme.desc: George meets the couple who are turning the ship's wheelhouse into a glamping house, revisits the designer from the first season to see his beautiful new eco-buildings, and finally shows us his completed house in the air. / George upoznaje par koji kormilarnicu broda pretvara u kućicu za glamping, ponovno posjećuje dizajnera iz prve sezone kako bi razgledao njegove prekrasne nove ekograđevine, a napokon će nam pokazati i svoju dovršenu kućicu u zraku.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: The Art of Home Cooking / Gordon Ramsay: Umijeće kuhanja kod kuće
programme.desc: Today's dishes are inspired by French cuisine, which Gordon fell in love with as a young chef. We will see a wonderful salad from Nice with tuna, and Gordon's youngest daughter Tilly will help him prepare the perfect chicken fricassee with a side of fried potatoes and a sensational "crème caramel" with lavender. / Današnja su jela nadahnuta francuskom kuhinjom, u koju se Gordon zaljubio još kao mladi kuhar. Vidjet ćemo krasnu salatu iz Nice s tunjevinom, a Gordonova najmlađa kći Tilly pomoći će mu da pripremi savršeni pileći frikase s prilogom od prženog krumpira te senzacionalni "crème caramel" s lavandom.

programme.title: Spašavatelji vrtova
programme.desc: Sisters Julia and Angela have a deep connection with Crete, which they have been visiting since childhood. Even after the loss of the parents, this annual tradition continued. Their garden is currently in disarray, full of construction debris. It is crying out for a makeover and the sisters would be happy to bring it the atmosphere of a vacation in Crete: blue and white colors, a pergola, olive trees, lush greenery and corners bathed in the sun. On a budget of £6,000, can Charlie and Chris bring the spirit of Crete to Yateley and transform the space into a Mediterranean dream garden? / Sestre Juliju i Angelu veže duboka povezanost s Kretom koju posjećuju još od djetinjstva. Čak i nakon gubitka roditelja ta se godišnja tradicija nastavila. Vrt im je trenutačno u rasulu, pun građevinskog smeća. Vapi za preobrazbom i sestre bi u njega rado unijele atmosferu ljetovanja na Kreti: plave i bijele boje, pergolu, drvo masline, bujno zelenilo i kutke okupane suncem. Mogu li uz budžet od 6000 funta Charlie i Chris prenijeti duh Krete u Yateley i pretvoriti prostor u mediteranski vrt iz snova?

programme.title: 50. Samobor musical autumn / 50. Samoborska glazbena jesen
programme.desc: The Samobor music autumn is a festival that has been promoting top musical art for five decades and turning Samobor into a musical center where classical music and the historical sights of the city are ideally combined. Over the years, the scope, quality and diversity of the program has developed the festival into an event whose content represents a cultural value of national importance. In front of the altar of the parish church of St. Anastasia, on September 26, 2025, in the festival's 50th jubilee year, the renowned Zagreb Soloists ensemble performed at the opening ceremony, and they were joined by one of the most internationally sought-after double bassists, Božo Paradžik, in top-level chamber music. The repertoire of the Zagreb soloists includes compositions from the baroque, classical and romantic periods, as well as works of the contemporary genre, and on this occasion they performed compositions by J.S. Bach, J. Brahms, F. Schubert, D. Pejačević, G. Puccini, A. Vivaldi and O. Respighi. / Samoborska glazbena jesen festival je koji već pet desetljeća promiče vrhunsku glazbenu umjetnost te pretvara Samobor u glazbeno središte u kojemu se idealno sjedinjuju klasična glazba i povijesne znamenitosti grada. Tijekom godina, festival se opsegom, kvalitetom i raznolikošću programa razvio u manifestaciju koja svojim sadržajem predstavlja kulturnu vrijednost od nacionalnoga značaja. Pred oltarom župne crkve sv. Anastazije, 26. rujna 2025., u jubilarnoj 50. festivalskoj godini, na svečanom otvorenju nastupili su renomirani ansambl Zagrebački solisti, a u vrhunskoj razini komornog muziciranja pridružio im se jedan od međunarodno najtraženijih kontrabasista Božo Paradžik. Repertoar Zagrebačkih solista obuhvaća skladbe baroknog, klasičnog i romantičnog razdoblja, ali i djela suvremenog žanra, a tom prigodom izveli su skladbe J. S. Bacha, J. Brahmsa, F. Schuberta, D. Pejačević, G. Puccinija, A. Vivaldija i O. Respighija.

programme.title: Put
programme.desc: Doctor Thomas Avery (M. Sheen) comes from California to France because his son Daniel (E. Estevez) was killed in a storm in the Pyrenees on a pilgrimage. Overwhelmed by grief, Thomas decides to go on a pilgrimage on behalf of his son and reach Santiago de Compostela, where he will spread Daniel's ashes. Like many pilgrims before him, he set off on foot on the Way of Saint James. He met people from all over the world in search of the meaning of his life, and was joined by Dutchman Joost (Y. van Wageningen), Canadian Sarah (D. Kara Unger) and Irishman Jack (J. Nesbitt). Pilgrimage changes them... / Liječnik Thomas Avery (M. Sheen) dolazi iz Kalifornije u Francusku jer mu je u oluji u Pirenejima na hodočašću stradao sin Daniel (E. Estevez). Shrvan tugom, Thomas odluči u ime svojega sina krenuti na hodočašće i stići do Santiaga de Compostele gdje će prosuti Danielov pepeo. Kao i mnogi hodočasnici prije njega, krenuo je pješice na Put svetog Jakova. Susreo je ljude sa svih strana svijeta u potrazi za smislom svog života, a pridružili su mu se Nizozemac Joost (Y. van Wageningen), Kanađanka Sarah (D. Kara Unger) i Irac Jack (J. Nesbitt). Hodačašće ih mijenja...

programme.title: Veliki brodolomi Jadrana
programme.desc: The passenger steamer Baron Gautsch is the true Titanic of the Adriatic. Baron Gautsch, the pride of Austrian Lloyd, which in 1914, due to the incomprehensible carelessness of the ship's command, ran into an Austro-Hungarian minefield, was the first maritime casualty of the First World War in the Adriatic. In the tragedy that took place in calm and beautiful weather, 177 passengers died, mostly family members of Austro-Hungarian officers who were on vacation in Dalmatia. Most of them were women and children. Those responsible for the sinking of the Baron Gautsch were never punished, and all documentation about the investigation was lost in World War II. The wreck of that beautiful steamship still lies on the seabed not far from Rovinj as a memorial to the ancient maritime tragedy and the innocent victims who disappeared forever in the depths of the Adriatic. / Putnički parobrod Baron Gautsch pravi je jadranski Titanic. Baron Gautsch, ponos Austrijskog Lloyda koji je 1914., neshvatljivom neopreznošću zapovjedništva broda naletio na austro-ugarsko minsko polje, prva je pomorska žrtva 1. svjetskog rata na Jadranu. U tragediji koja se odigrala po mirnom i lijepom vremenu poginulo je 177 putnika, mahom članova obitelji austro-ugarskih časnika koje su bile na odmoru u Dalmaciji. Među njima najviše je bilo žena i djece. Krivci za potonuće Barona Gautscha nikada nisu kažnjeni, a sva dokumentacija o istrazi propala je u 2. svjetskom ratu. Olupina toga lijepog parobroda i danas leži na morskome dnu nedaleko od Rovinja kao spomen na davnu pomorsku tragediju i nevine žrtve koje su zauvijek nestale u dubinama Jadrana.

programme.title: Notes on language / Bilješke o jeziku
programme.desc: The show shows how the standard language was created, why the official language in the Republic of Croatia is called the Croatian standard language, whether standard is the same as literary language, and which of our linguists dealt with the theory of standards. / Emisija pokazuje kako je došlo do stvaranja standardnog jezika, zašto se službeni jezik u Republici Hrvatskoj zove hrvatski standardni jezik, je li standardni isto što i književni jezik te koji su se naši jezikoslovci bavili teorijom standarda.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories about sound, heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called the "Sound Collector", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he is very hard of hearing. This little creature spends his days discovering and learning the new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are mostly the sounds of the sea, sounds made by creatures in the sea, sounds made by insects, including the snoring of his best friend and pet Myrtle. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: The kittens join the dogs on their visit to the jungle where they help save an injured baby monkey. // After Humdinger repairs Meow-Meow to break into Mayor Goodway's new safe, the Cat Pack joins the pups on their mission. / Mačići se pridruže psićima u njihovom posjetu džungli gdje pomognu spasiti ozlijeđenu bebu majmuna. // Nakon što Humdinger popravi Mijau-Mijau, kako bi provalio u novi sef gradonačelnice Goodway, Mačji se čopor pridruži psićima na njihovoj misiji.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: The class was assigned the task of making useful things from waste, so Timmy decides to turn a cereal box into a tractor. / Razred je za zadatak dobio izradu korisnih stvari od otpada, pa Timmy kutiju žitarica odlučuje pretvoriti u traktor.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krcek are a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanut. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they get into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem they always invent some kind of machine. The machine doesn't always work the way they imagined and many funny and unforeseen situations arise. We wish you great fun with Krcek! Songs and a computer game also await you! / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije. Želimo vam odličnu zabavu s Krcekima! Također vas očekuju i pjesmice i računalna igra!

programme.title: Krceki - a song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: Along with the animated series Krceki, we also have seven songs: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljko and Hrabrica. Each song sings about the characteristics of a character from the Krceki series. / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki.

programme.title: Volim životinje
programme.desc: Dokumentarno-animirana serija upoznaje najmlađe sa životinjskim vrstama.

programme.title: Lu and the merry band / Lu i vesela družina
programme.desc: Lu declines the snack, which turns out to be tastier than she thought. / Lu odbije zakusku koja ispadne finija nego što je mislila.

programme.title: Hej Dagi
programme.desc: Meet Dagi, a big and adorable dog who leads the preschool club and encourages children to have fun, be full of energy and _ most of all _ to do anything! Each episode of this colorful and sometimes surreal animated series begins with Dagi welcoming the Squirrels, a group of little curios left at the club by their parents. Then there is laughter and learning as the Squirrels discover something new about the world around them, and Dagi patiently watches over them. / Upoznajte Dagija, velikog i dražesnog psa koji vodi klub predškolaca i potiče djecu da se zabave, budu puna energije i _ više od svega _ da svašta rade! Svaka epizoda ove šarene i katkad nadrealne animirane serije počinje tako da Dagi dočeka Vjeverice, skupinu malenih znatiželjnika koje u klubu ostave njihovi roditelji. Zatim slijedi smijeh i učenje dok Vjeverice otkrivaju nešto novo o svijetu koji ih okružuje, a Dagi strpljivo pazi na njih.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a charming and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: In search of his favorite squeaky button, Muc jumps into the boot, but he can't get out! Help is coming to Tweed! / U potrazi za najdražim fijukavim gumbom Muc uskoči u čizmu, ali više odande ne može izaći! Tvidi stiže upomoć!

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Oggy Oggy
programme.desc: Oggy Oggy is a computer-animated series for preschoolers by Jean Cayrol and Cedric Guarneri. The series follows the kitten Oggy who goes on an adventure with his friends Mallow and Sporty in a world where everything is made of children's toys. / Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka.

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter's Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother Georg, their parents and other animal families living in their town. / "Peppa Praščić" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: He is beautifully sad because he injured two of his arms in a drumming accident. Wanting to cheer him up and surprise him, Štefi asks Brojčić to look for instruments that Ljepko can play with the remaining six arms. / Ljepko je tužan jer je ozlijedio dva kraka u bubnjarskoj nezgodi. Želeći ga oraspoložiti i iznenaditi, Štefi zamoli Brojčiće da potraže instrumente koje Ljepko može svirati s preostalih šest krakova.

programme.title: Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Red We will go on a winter walk and get to know the magic of the color red. / Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje.

programme.title: A love monster / Ljubavno čudovište
programme.desc: Naughty Dog wants the Love Monster to teach him how to play music, but he is a very disobedient student. / Nestašni Psić želi da ga Ljubavno Čudovište nauči puštati glazbu, ali vrlo je neposlušan učenik.

programme.title: Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Police chief Berko has his hands full trying to stop the rascals Zip and Pop who are making a lot of noise in Zanatograd. / Šef policije Berko ima pune ruke posla pokušavajući zaustaviti nevaljalce Zipa i Popa koji neobuzdano prave buku u Zanatogradu.

programme.title: Dinoranč
programme.desc: The Dinoranchers organize the Dinofriends Competition, a series of games where the Dinoranchers and their dinosaurs prove how well they fit together as a team. The prize is a big shiny goblet full of juicy berry beans, watched from nearby bushes by Wicked Sonny, who wants to steal the goblet, while his stealthy raptor Bero wants the fruits. The two rogues decide to join forces and enter the competition, with Sonny cheating every game to advance to the next round. Jon and Blitz suspect that Sonny isn't playing fair, but they can't prove it until the final race between him and Jon. Sonny then tries to cheat by clinging to Bera's saddle, but when he freaks out and runs straight into danger, Sonny loses control! Despite his cheating, Jon and the Dinoranchers bravely come to his and Bera's aid, and this act of kindness prompts Sonny to accept defeat and admit to Jon that he cheated. / Dinorančeri organiziraju natjecanje dinoprijatelja, niz igara u kojima Dinorančeri i njihovi dinosauri dokazuju koliko su usklađeni kao tim. Nagrada je veliki sjajni pehar pun sočnih boba zoba, a iz obližnjih grmova sve to promatra Opaki Sonny, koji želi ukrasti pehar, dok njegov kradljivi raptor Bero želi plodove. Dvojica nevaljalaca odluče udružiti snage i prijaviti se na natjecanje, a Sonny u svakoj igri vara kako bi prošao u sljedeći krug. Jon i Blitz posumnjaju da Sonny ne igra pošteno, ali to ne mogu dokazati sve do posljednje utrke između njega i Jona. Sonny tada pokuša varati tako što se zalijepi za Berino sedlo, no kad se on prepadne i jurne ravno u opasnost, Sonny gubi kontrolu! Unatoč njegovu varanju, Jon i Dinorančeri hrabro priskoče njemu i Beri u pomoć, a taj čin dobrote potakne Sonnyja da prihvati poraz i prizna Jonu da je varao.

programme.title: Shasavi Hotel / Šašavi hotel
programme.desc: Silly Hotel is a British-American-Canadian series made for CBeebies (the BBC's pre-school programme). After the adventures of Sesame Street, Elmo and Keksomlat move to England to help Elmo's aunt and uncle run a "half-star" hotel, whose staff are especially good at solving problems. The hotel is run by members of the Šašava-Frka family with the help of Elmo and Keksomlat, who left Sesame Street to help solve the problems faced by the guests of the Šašava Hotel. / Šašavi Hotel je britansko-američko-kanadska serija snimljena za CBeebies (BBC-jev program za predškolsku dob). Nakon dogodovština u Ulici Sezam, Elmo i Keksomlat sele se u Englesku pomoći Elmovoj teti i tetku voditi hotel "s pola zvjezdice", čije osoblje posebno dobro zna rješavati probleme. Hotel vode članovi obitelji Šašava-Frka uz pomoć Elma i Keksomlata, koji su napustili Ulicu Sezam da bi pomogli rješavati probleme s kojima se suočavaju gosti Šašavog hotela.

programme.title: The song I'll do everything myself / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a
programme.desc: In the witty song "I'll do it all by myself" you will meet a girl and a boy who proudly sing about what they love, can and know how to do by themselves _ without the help of adults. And they are great at that. They know how to skillfully put on shoes, peel a banana, brush their teeth, go down a slide and much more. They are curious, love to learn and want to send an important message _ that they can do it themselves. And besides, they have a great time! / U duhovitoj pjesmici Sve ću sam/a upoznat ćete djevojčicu i dječaka koji ponosno pjevaju o onome što vole, mogu i znaju napraviti sami _ bez pomoći odraslih. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku _ da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju!

programme.title: Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela
programme.desc: "Daniel the Tiger's Neighborhood" is an animated series for preschoolers ages two to four based on the groundbreaking PBS series "Mister Rogers' Neighborhood." / "Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela" animirana je serija za djecu predškolske dobi od dvije do četiri godine koja se temelji na revolucionarnoj PBS-ovoj seriji "Susjedstvo gospodina Rogersa".

programme.title: Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela
programme.desc: "Daniel the Tiger's Neighborhood" is an animated series for preschoolers ages two to four based on the groundbreaking PBS series "Mister Rogers' Neighborhood." / "Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela" animirana je serija za djecu predškolske dobi od dvije do četiri godine koja se temelji na revolucionarnoj PBS-ovoj seriji "Susjedstvo gospodina Rogersa".

programme.title: Pjesmica Palačinke
programme.desc: Sing and dance to the new song Pancakes. A cheerful family of dogs and a silly cook enjoy preparing sweet and savory pancakes. And they have a great time. / Zapjevajte i zaplešite uz novu pjesmicu Palačinke. Vesela obitelj psića i jedan šašavi kuhar uživaju u pripremi slatkih i slanih palačinki. I odlično se zabavljaju.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Pablo can't find his Big Book of Animals. He must make sure that everything in it is correct as always. The animals, his friends, come from the Book, so they also want to find it. / Pablo ne može naći svoju Veliku knjigu životinja. Mora se uvjeriti da je u njoj sve točno kao i uvijek. Iz Knjige potječu životinje, njegovi prijatelji, pa je i oni žele naći.

programme.title: Edmond i Luce
programme.desc: Playing ball, Edmund and Luce spill Ed's pot of stew for tonight's dinner. They decide to make the stew again to correct their mistake, but there are only rotten vegetables in the garden. / Igrajući se loptom, Edmund i Luce proliju Edin lonac s varivom za večerašnju večeru. Oni odluče ponovno napraviti varivo kako bi ispravili svoju grešku, ali u vrtu je samo trulo povrće.

programme.title: Grizzly bear and small attacks / Medo Grizli i male napasti
programme.desc: "Medo Grizzly and Small Attacks" is a French animated series created by Josselin Charier and produced by Studio Harry for France Televisions and Boomerang France. The series follows the adventures of the Grizzly bear and the little lemmings, who live in a forest ranger's log cabin while he is away. / "Medo Grizli i male napasti" francuska je animirana serija koju je osmislio Josselin Charier, a producirao Studio Hari za France Televisions i Boomerang France. Serija prati dogodovštine medvjeda Grizlija i malih napasti _ leminga, koji žive u brvnari šumskog rendžera dok je on odsutan.
