Despite his cheating, Jon and the Dinoranchers bravely come to his and Bera's aid, and this act of kindness prompts Sonny to accept defeat and admit to Jon that he cheated. / Dinorančeri organiziraju natjecanje dinoprijatelja, niz igara u kojima Dinorančeri i njihovi dinosauri dokazuju koliko su usklađeni kao tim. Nagrada je veliki sjajni pehar pun sočnih boba zoba, a iz obližnjih grmova sve to promatra Opaki Sonny, koji želi ukrasti pehar, dok njegov kradljivi raptor Bero želi plodove. Dvojica nevaljalaca odluče udružiti snage i prijaviti se na natjecanje, a Sonny u svakoj igri vara kako bi prošao u sljedeći krug. Jon i Blitz posumnjaju da Sonny ne igra pošteno, ali to ne mogu dokazati sve do posljednje utrke između njega i Jona. Sonny tada pokuša varati tako što se zalijepi za Berino sedlo, no kad se on prepadne i jurne ravno u opasnost, Sonny gubi kontrolu! Unatoč njegovu varanju, Jon i Dinorančeri hrabro priskoče njemu i Beri u pomoć, a taj čin dobrote potakne Sonnyja da prihvati poraz i prizna Jonu da je varao.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: The kittens join the dogs on their visit to the jungle where they help save an injured baby monkey. // After Humdinger repairs Meow-Meow to break into Mayor Goodway's new safe, the Cat Pack joins the pups on their mission. / Mačići se pridruže psićima u njihovom posjetu džungli gdje pomognu spasiti ozlijeđenu bebu majmuna. // Nakon što Humdinger popravi Mijau-Mijau, kako bi provalio u novi sef gradonačelnice Goodway, Mačji se čopor pridruži psićima na njihovoj misiji.

programme.title: Pjesmica Palačinke
programme.desc: Sing and dance to the new song Pancakes. A cheerful family of dogs and a silly cook enjoy preparing sweet and savory pancakes. And they have a great time. / Zapjevajte i zaplešite uz novu pjesmicu Palačinke. Vesela obitelj psića i jedan šašavi kuhar uživaju u pripremi slatkih i slanih palačinki. I odlično se zabavljaju.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Najgora vještica
programme.desc: A stunning adaptation of Jill Murphy's favorite Mildred Hubble books. Now Mildred is back at Cackle and is a better witch than before. / Zadivljujuća prerada omiljenih knjiga Jill Murphy o Mildred Hubble. Sad se Mildred vratila u Cackle i bolja je vještica nego prije.

programme.title: Notes on language / Bilješke o jeziku
programme.desc: The show shows how the standard language was created, why the official language in the Republic of Croatia is called the Croatian standard language, whether standard is the same as literary language, and which of our linguists dealt with the theory of standards. / Emisija pokazuje kako je došlo do stvaranja standardnog jezika, zašto se službeni jezik u Republici Hrvatskoj zove hrvatski standardni jezik, je li standardni isto što i književni jezik te koji su se naši jezikoslovci bavili teorijom standarda.

programme.title: Veliki brodolomi Jadrana
programme.desc: The passenger steamer Baron Gautsch is the true Titanic of the Adriatic. Baron Gautsch, the pride of Austrian Lloyd, which in 1914, due to the incomprehensible carelessness of the ship's command, ran into an Austro-Hungarian minefield, was the first maritime casualty of the First World War in the Adriatic. In the tragedy that took place in calm and beautiful weather, 177 passengers died, mostly family members of Austro-Hungarian officers who were on vacation in Dalmatia. Most of them were women and children. Those responsible for the sinking of the Baron Gautsch were never punished, and all documentation about the investigation was lost in World War II. The wreck of that beautiful steamship still lies on the seabed not far from Rovinj as a memorial to the ancient maritime tragedy and the innocent victims who disappeared forever in the depths of the Adriatic. / Putnički parobrod Baron Gautsch pravi je jadranski Titanic. Baron Gautsch, ponos Austrijskog Lloyda koji je 1914., neshvatljivom neopreznošću zapovjedništva broda naletio na austro-ugarsko minsko polje, prva je pomorska žrtva 1. svjetskog rata na Jadranu. U tragediji koja se odigrala po mirnom i lijepom vremenu poginulo je 177 putnika, mahom članova obitelji austro-ugarskih časnika koje su bile na odmoru u Dalmaciji. Među njima najviše je bilo žena i djece. Krivci za potonuće Barona Gautscha nikada nisu kažnjeni, a sva dokumentacija o istrazi propala je u 2. svjetskom ratu. Olupina toga lijepog parobroda i danas leži na morskome dnu nedaleko od Rovinja kao spomen na davnu pomorsku tragediju i nevine žrtve koje su zauvijek nestale u dubinama Jadrana.

programme.title: Neženja
programme.desc: Paolo, a 36-year-old from Rome, keeps telling anyone who doesn't want to hear it that he's a perpetual bachelor. He even expressed his condolences to his best friend when he was best man at his wedding. After an adventure with a flight attendant, Paolo goes to live with his mother in the countryside, who realizes that he is actually lonely and afraid of independence and tries to find him a wife... / Paolo, 36-godišnjak iz Rima, neprestano govori svima koji to ne žele čuti da je vječni neženja. Čak je izrazio sućut najboljem prijatelju kad mu je bio kum na vjenčanju. Nakon avanture sa stjuardesom Paolo odlazi živjeti s majkom na selu, koja shvati da je on zapravo usamljen i da se boji neovisnosti te mu pokuša naći ženu...

programme.title: Istarske freske
programme.desc: The documentary film shows a special Croatian gem of a time and creativity, which is much more than simply depicting the space intended to convey the Christian faith and messages from the Old Testament and the New Testament. In Istria, there are approximately 140 locations where there are frescoes, from large and sumptuous to individual scenes and small fragments. The first frescoes in Istria were painted at the turn of the 8th to the 9th century, while the golden age of painting sacred buildings began in the 11th century and lasted until the 16th century. Scenes were filmed in churches in Bala, Božje polje, Vižinada, Berm, Batvači, Dvigrad, Kanfanar, Lovran, Hum, Roč, Draguć, Oprtlje, Lindar, Vodnjan, Poreč, Pula, St. Lovreč, Svetvinčent, Kloštra above Lim, Žminj and Peroj. / Dokumentarni film prikazuje poseban hrvatski dragulj jednoga vremena i stvaralaštva, koji je mnogo više od samoga oslikavanja prostora namijenjen prenošenju kršćanske vjere i poruka iz Staroga zavjeta i Novoga zavjeta. U Istri postoji približno 140 lokaliteta na kojima se nalaze freske, od velikih i raskošnih do pojedinačnih scena i sitnih fragmenata. Prve freske u Istri naslikane su na prijelazu iz 8. u 9. stoljeće dok zlatno doba oslikavanja sakralnih objekata počinje u 11. stoljeću i traje sve do 16. stoljeća. Prizori su snimljeni u crkvama u Balama, Božjemu polju, Vižinadi, Bermu, Batvačima, Dvigradu, Kanfanaru, Lovranu, Humu, Roču, Draguću, Oprtlju, Lindaru, Vodnjanu, Poreču, Puli, Sv. Lovreču, Svetvinčentu, Kloštru iznad Lima, Žminju i Peroju.

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: Art _ your address for culture! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 20.10 we bring you the best from the world of art and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music. / Art _ vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu.

programme.title: Razgovor s razlogom
programme.desc: The guest of Razgovor with a reason is the director of the Zagreb Youth Theater Snježana Abramović Milković. We talk about the role played by boards that mean life in society. Should provocation and criticism be avoided or encouraged in the theater? Why is it important for the theater to be brave, to be a space of freedom and truth? Why does it have to question social movements and political power? Why should you feel for a person? Can we purify traumas and unresolved relationships through theater? Why is international cooperation important to ZKM? From drama to dance, from provocation to artistic freedom, there are many reasons to talk to Snježana Abramović Milković. / Gošća Razgovora s razlogom je ravnateljica Zagrebačkog kazališta mladih Snježana Abramović Milković. Razgovaramo o ulozi koju u društvu igraju daske koje život znače. Treba li u kazalištu izbjegavati provokaciju i kritiku ili ih poticati? Zašto je važno da kazalište bude hrabro, da bude prostor slobode i istine? Zašto mora preispitivati društvena kretanja i političku moć? Zašto treba imati osjećaj za čovjeka? Možemo li kroz kazalište pročistiti traume i neriješene odnose? Zašto je ZKM-u važna međunarodna suradnja? Od drame do plesa od provokacije do umjetničke slobode, mnogo je razloga za razgovor sa Snježanom Abramović Milković.

programme.title: Klub čitatelja
programme.desc: This Wednesday in the Reader's Club we are discussing the book Philosophy of Walking by Frederic Gros. Philosopher and writer Kristijan Vujičić, art historian and producer Paola Orlić, lawyer and Croatian language professor Zoran Maljković and literary critic Bozena Matijević are guests. / Ove srijede u Klubu čitatelja razgovaramo o knjizi Frederica Grosa Filozofija hodanja. Gostuju filozof i književnik Kristijan Vujičić, povjesničarka umjetnosti i producentica Paola Orlić, pravnik i profesor hrvatskog jezika Zoran Maljković te književna kritičarka Božena Matijević.

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: The former Soviet republic of Azerbaijan is searching for a new identity. It is a region that derives its wealth from oil. There is so much black gold here that some even bathe in it. The film crew visited an oil spa, peeked behind the scenes of a silk factory, met glass masters who still master the art of making shebeka windows, and watched the employees of a street bakery at work. The film also follows a couple of newlyweds, because nowhere in South-West Asia are weddings as solemn and lavish as in Azerbaijan. / Bivša sovjetska republika Azerbajdžan traga za novim identitetom. Regija je to koja svoje bogatstvo crpi iz nafte. Ovdje ima toliko crnog zlata da se neki u njemu čak i kupaju. Filmska ekipa posjetila je naftno lječilište, zavirila iza kulisa tvornice svile, susrela majstore stakla koji još i danas vladaju umijećem izrade prozora shebeke te promatrala pri radu zaposlenice ulične pekarnice. Filmski prikaz prati i par mladenaca jer nigdje u jugozapadnoj Aziji vjenčanja nisu tako svečana i raskošna kao u Azerbajdžanu.

programme.title: Svijet klasike
programme.desc: For years now, the Dubrovnik Summer Games have been closing in the most spectacular way possible: with a festive "Opera Gala" concert with world vocal stars before our HRT Symphony Orchestra, on an open stage next to the Dubrovnik Cathedral. This was also the case on August 25, when an attractive program of well-known arias was conducted by the German maestro Sebastian Lang Lessing, a good friend and close associate of the Games' intendant, Martina Filjak as a pianist. Georgian soprano Nino Machaidze, who is already a well-known favorite of all opera lovers here, passionate Italian tenor Vittorio Grigolo, and "our top sheet", bass-baritone of international repute, Marko Mimica from Omiš, test their interpretive and vocal capabilities here. At the dress rehearsal, we "captured" their impressions, as well as the comments of tourists-passers-by who pressed against the fence in order to experience and absorb as much as possible through the magical Dubrovnik night of the opera, in the ideal combination of music and enchanting architecture. / Dubrovačke ljetne igre već se godinama zatvaraju na najspektakularniji mogući način: svečanim koncertom "Opera gala" sa svjetskim vokalnim zvijezdama pred našim Simfonijskim orkestrom HRT-a, na otvorenoj pozornici smještenoj uz bok Dubrovačkoj katedrali. Tako je bilo i ovoga 25. kolovoza, kad je atraktivnim programom poznatih arija dirigirao njemački maestro Sebastian Lang Lessing, dobar prijatelj i bliski suradnik intendantice Igara, Martine Filjak kao pijanistice. Svoje interpretativne i glasovne mogućnosti ovdje odmjeravaju gruzijska sopranistica Nino Machaidze pri svojem prvom dolasku u Hrvatsku, već poznati miljenik svih ovdašnjih ljubitelja opere, strastveni talijanski tenor Vittorio Grigolo, te "naše gore list", basbariton međunarodnog ugleda, inače Omišanin, Marko Mimica. Na generalnoj probi "uhvatili" smo njihove dojmove, kao i komentare turista-slučajnih prolaznika koji su se stisnuli uz ogradu kako bi što više toga doživjeli i upili kroz čarobnu dubrovačku noć opere, u idealnom spoju glazbe i arhitekture koja očarava.

programme.title: Svijet jazza
programme.desc: All those who love music will remember the period of the pandemic, among other things, as the time of the painful longing for a live concert. Jazz fans must have felt it, given that it is a music that lives on the inimitability of live performance, instead of fixed recordings. Sporadic internet broadcasts of the occasional concert or home performance were a welcome but insufficient consolation. All that was changed by a weekly stream from a New York apartment, where friends and acquaintances — some of the best musicians in the world's jazz metropolis — gathered to play a short live-streamed session. Named after the originator and leader of the whole project, the young pianist Emmet Cohen, Live at Emmets Place became a piece of much-needed musical sustenance in the era of isolation. On the wave of that internet fame, Cohen meanwhile profiled himself as one of the world's leading jazz pianists. On that wave, he came to Zagreb for the first time, where he closed the 15th edition of the Zagreb Jazz Festival in an exciting way. / Svi oni koji vole glazbu sjećat će se razdoblja pandemije, među ostalim i kao doba bolne žudnje za živom svirkom. Svakako su to morali osjećati ljubitelji jazza, s obzirom na to da je riječ o glazbi koja živi od neponovljivosti izvedbe uživo, umjesto od fiksiranih snimki. Sporadični internetski prijenosi pokojeg koncerta ili kućne izvedbe bili su dobrodošla, ali nedostatna utjeha. Sve to promijenio je tjedni stream iz jednog njujorškog stana u kojem su se prijatelji i znanci _ redom neki od najboljih glazbenika u toj svjetskoj metropoli jazza _ okupljali kako bi odsvirali kraći session koji se prenosio uživo. Nazvan po začetniku i predvodniku cijelog projekta, mladom pijanistu Emmetu Cohenu, Live at Emmets Place postao je komadić prijeko potrebne glazbene hrane u doba izolacije. Na valu te internetske slave, Cohen se u međuvremenu profilirao u jednog od vodećih svjetskih jazz-pijanista. Na tom je valu došao prvi put i u Zagreb, gdje je na uzbudljiv način zaključio sjajno 15. izdanje Zagreb Jazz Festivala.

programme.title: Jelena Dorotka - From Konal to Montparnasse / Jelena Dorotka - Od Konala do Montparnassea
programme.desc: This film presents for the first time the interesting biography of the Croatian painter Jelena Dorotka Hoffmann, who lived in Paris from 1907 to 1914 and had her own studio in Montparnasse. There she met many leading figures of world painting (Matisse, Chagall, Picasso, Van Dongen, Laurencin and others), and she worked for some time in Matisse's painting school. In Paris, she became friends with Marie Vassilieff, the founder of the famous Parisian Academie Russe (Academie Vassilieff), and she also met the Croatian sculptor Ivan Meštrović. After the outbreak of the First World War, she left France and after wandering around Europe for several years, she returned in 1922 to her native Dubrovnik, where she lived bohemianly, as a "native", until her death in 1965, neglecting herself, her property and destroying her paintings. / U ovom se filmu prvi put iznosi zanimljiva biografija hrvatske slikarice Jelene Dorotke Hoffmann koja je od 1907. do 1914. godine živjela u Parizu i imala vlastiti atelje na Montparnasseu. Ondje je upoznala mnoge vodeće ličnosti svjetskog slikarstva (Matisse, Chagall, Picasso, Van Dongen, Laurencin i druge), a radila je neko vrijeme u Matisseovoj slikarskoj školi. U Parizu je prijateljevala s Marie Vassilieff, osnivačicom poznate pariške Academie Russe (Academie Vassilieff), a upoznala je i hrvatskog kipara Ivana Meštrovića. Po izbijanju Prvog svjetskog rata napustila je Francusku i nakon višegodišnjih lutanja po Europi vratila se 1922. godine u rodni Dubrovnik u kojemu sve do smrti 1965. godine živi boemski, kao "oriđino", zanemarujući sebe, svoju imovinu i uništavajući svoje slikarske radove.

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: Tonight, The Hahas and the Blablas are performing, a band from Zagreb that at the beginning of the year released their self-titled debut album with 12 short, infectious songs in which the genres of new wave, synth punk, power pop are mixed and they alternate philosophically and satirically, commentaries on all kinds of pop culture phenomena and life's absurdities, underlined lo-fi aesthetics of sound and music videos. Debbie Harry, David Icke, Andy Kaufman, several American presidents, victims of bureaucracy, a rat family _ they all appeared on the album, and today on our stage. / Večeras nastupaju The Hahas and the Blablas, zagrebački bend koji je početkom godine izdao istoimeni debitantski album s 12 kratkih, zaraznih pjesama u kojima se žanrovski miješaju new wave, synth punk, power pop i žustro izmjenjuju filozofsko-satirične slike, komentari na svakakve pojave pop kulture i životne apsurde, podcrtani lo-fi estetikom zvuka i spotova. Debbie Harry, David Icke, Andy Kaufman, nekoliko američkih predsjednika, žrtve birokracije, jedna štakorska obitelj _ svi su se našli na albumu, a danas i na našoj sceni.

programme.title: Na prvom kolosijeku
programme.desc: Marija Vrlja's family lives in a house located six meters from the first track. The golden Pavelić trains passing by the window bring back memories of childhood, and Branko Škala spent his entire working life on the railway. This is a story about the people of Osijek who live in the immediate vicinity of the railway station and for whom trains and the clatter of wheels are a part of their lives. And while they can't imagine everyday life without trains, a group of their neighbors signed a petition against the noise. But even though the trains bother them a lot, none of the organizers of the petition wanted to be in front of the camera. Thanks to them, we recorded a story about people for whom trains are a symbol of childhood and travel. / Obitelj Marije Vrlja živi u kući koja je smještena šest metara od prvog kolosijeka. Zlati Pavelić vlakovi što kraj prozora prolaze bude sjećanja na djetinjstvo, a Branko Škala je cijeli radni vijek proveo na željeznici. Ovo je priča o Osječanima koji žive u neposrednoj blizini željezničkog kolodvora i kojima su vlakovi i klepet kotača dio života. I dok oni ne mogu zamisliti svakodnevicu bez vlakova, skupina njihovih susjeda potpisala je peticiju protiv buke. No iako im vlakovi jako smetaju, nitko od organizatora peticije nije želio pred kameru. Zahvaljujući njima, snimili smo priču o ljudima kojima su vlakovi simbol djetinjstva i putovanja.

programme.title: Legende Pariškog romantizma
programme.desc: Paris, 1834 _ 1848. Romantics are everywhere. Their works are performed in theaters, published in newspapers and fill the windows of bookstores. Hugo became a member of the French Academy, Dumas opens his own theater, Balzac has already written 50 novels and intends to write twice as many because "Human Comedy" completely occupies his thoughts. Recently divorced George Sand opens the doors of the Nohant estate to her friends, which becomes a kind of artistic residence. Delacroix's paintings mingle there with Chopin's music, while George's pen constantly pours out words. Nerval and Gautier in Paris, on the other hand, raise bohemianism to the level of a new lifestyle. Together they create myths about their own lives, sometimes, admittedly, romanticizing them... / Pariz, 1834. _ 1848. Romantičari su posvuda. Njihova se djela izvode u kazalištima, objavljuju u novinama i pune izloge knjižara. Hugo je postao član Francuske akademije, Dumas otvara vlastito kazalište, Balzac je već napisao 50 romana i namjerava napisati još dvostruko više jer mu "Ljudska komedija" sasvim zaokuplja misli. Nedavno razvedena George Sand svojim prijateljima otvara vrata imanja Nohant koje postaje svojevrsna umjetnička rezidencija. Delacroixove slike ondje se miješaju sa Chopinovom glazbom, dok se iz Georgeina pera neprestano prelijevaju riječi. Nerval i Gautier u Parizu pak boemštinu uzdižu na razinu novog životnog stila. Zajedno stvaraju mitove o vlastitim životima, ponekad ih, doduše, i romansirajući...

programme.title: An evening of countless awards: Annette / Večer bezbroj nagrada: Annette
programme.desc: The plot follows Henry McHenry (AdamDriver), a stand-up comedian, and Ann Defrasnoux (Marion Cotillard), a world-famous soprano. Their passionate and turbulent relationship culminates in the birth of a daughter, Annette, a girl with unreal talent who changes their lives. Annette is depicted through a marionette doll, which further emphasizes her surreal and symbolic nature. / Radnja prati Henryja McHenryja (AdamDriver), stand-up komičara, i Ann Defrasnoux (Marion Cotillard), svjetski poznatu sopranisticu. Njihova strastvena i turbulentna veza kulminira rođenjem kćeri Annette, djevojčice nestvarnog talenta koji mijenja njihove živote. Annette je prikazana kroz lutku marionetu, što dodatno naglašava njezinu nadrealnu i simboličku prirodu.

programme.title: Simpsoni
programme.desc: Cletus learns that his wife Brandine has been hiding a love... of learning. / Cletus doznaje da je njegova žena Brandine tajila ljubav... prema učenju.

programme.title: 5:7:5 for Croatia / 5:7:5 za Hrvatsku
programme.desc: If there was a Croatian haiku team, it would be among the most successful in the world. That Croatian haiku poets are not "cat's cough", shows the documentary film of screenwriter and director Mladen Santrić. What is so intriguing about a miniature three-verse from faraway Japan that amateurs and professionals, academics, professors, pensioners, children, officials, ladies and gentlemen try their hand at writing it? The documentary film about haiku poetry in Croatia was supported by the Japanese government foundation, and it was filmed for almost two years in a co-production of Croatian Television and 4 Film. / Kada bi postojala hrvatska haiku reprezentacija, bila bi među najuspješnijima u svijetu. Da hrvatski haiku pjesnici nisu "mačji kašalj", pokazuje dokumentarni film scenarista i redatelja Mladena Santrića. Što je to tako intrigantno u jednom minijaturnom trostihu iz dalekog Japana da se u njegovom pisanju okušavaju amateri i profesionalci, akademici, profesori, penzioneri, djeca, službenici, dame i gospoda? Dokumentarni film o haiku poeziji u Hrvatskoj podržala je japanska vladina fondacija, a sniman je gotovo dvije godine u koprodukciji Hrvatske televizije i 4 Filma.

programme.title: Svijet klasike
programme.desc: For years now, the Dubrovnik Summer Games have been closing in the most spectacular way possible: with a festive "Opera Gala" concert with world vocal stars before our HRT Symphony Orchestra, on an open stage next to the Dubrovnik Cathedral. This was also the case on August 25, when an attractive program of well-known arias was conducted by the German maestro Sebastian Lang Lessing, a good friend and close associate of the Games' intendant, Martina Filjak as a pianist. Georgian soprano Nino Machaidze, who is already a well-known favorite of all opera lovers here, passionate Italian tenor Vittorio Grigolo, and "our top sheet", bass-baritone of international repute, Marko Mimica from Omiš, test their interpretive and vocal capabilities here. At the dress rehearsal, we "captured" their impressions, as well as the comments of tourists-passers-by who pressed against the fence in order to experience and absorb as much as possible through the magical Dubrovnik night of the opera, in the ideal combination of music and enchanting architecture. / Dubrovačke ljetne igre već se godinama zatvaraju na najspektakularniji mogući način: svečanim koncertom "Opera gala" sa svjetskim vokalnim zvijezdama pred našim Simfonijskim orkestrom HRT-a, na otvorenoj pozornici smještenoj uz bok Dubrovačkoj katedrali. Tako je bilo i ovoga 25. kolovoza, kad je atraktivnim programom poznatih arija dirigirao njemački maestro Sebastian Lang Lessing, dobar prijatelj i bliski suradnik intendantice Igara, Martine Filjak kao pijanistice. Svoje interpretativne i glasovne mogućnosti ovdje odmjeravaju gruzijska sopranistica Nino Machaidze pri svojem prvom dolasku u Hrvatsku, već poznati miljenik svih ovdašnjih ljubitelja opere, strastveni talijanski tenor Vittorio Grigolo, te "naše gore list", basbariton međunarodnog ugleda, inače Omišanin, Marko Mimica. Na generalnoj probi "uhvatili" smo njihove dojmove, kao i komentare turista-slučajnih prolaznika koji su se stisnuli uz ogradu kako bi što više toga doživjeli i upili kroz čarobnu dubrovačku noć opere, u idealnom spoju glazbe i arhitekture koja očarava.

programme.title: Svijet jazza
programme.desc: All those who love music will remember the period of the pandemic, among other things, as the time of the painful longing for a live concert. Jazz fans must have felt it, given that it is a music that lives on the inimitability of live performance, instead of fixed recordings. Sporadic internet broadcasts of the occasional concert or home performance were a welcome but insufficient consolation. All that was changed by a weekly stream from a New York apartment, where friends and acquaintances — some of the best musicians in the world's jazz metropolis — gathered to play a short live-streamed session. Named after the originator and leader of the whole project, the young pianist Emmet Cohen, Live at Emmets Place became a piece of much-needed musical sustenance in the era of isolation. On the wave of that internet fame, Cohen meanwhile profiled himself as one of the world's leading jazz pianists. On that wave, he came to Zagreb for the first time, where he closed the 15th edition of the Zagreb Jazz Festival in an exciting way. / Svi oni koji vole glazbu sjećat će se razdoblja pandemije, među ostalim i kao doba bolne žudnje za živom svirkom. Svakako su to morali osjećati ljubitelji jazza, s obzirom na to da je riječ o glazbi koja živi od neponovljivosti izvedbe uživo, umjesto od fiksiranih snimki. Sporadični internetski prijenosi pokojeg koncerta ili kućne izvedbe bili su dobrodošla, ali nedostatna utjeha. Sve to promijenio je tjedni stream iz jednog njujorškog stana u kojem su se prijatelji i znanci _ redom neki od najboljih glazbenika u toj svjetskoj metropoli jazza _ okupljali kako bi odsvirali kraći session koji se prenosio uživo. Nazvan po začetniku i predvodniku cijelog projekta, mladom pijanistu Emmetu Cohenu, Live at Emmets Place postao je komadić prijeko potrebne glazbene hrane u doba izolacije. Na valu te internetske slave, Cohen se u međuvremenu profilirao u jednog od vodećih svjetskih jazz-pijanista. Na tom je valu došao prvi put i u Zagreb, gdje je na uzbudljiv način zaključio sjajno 15. izdanje Zagreb Jazz Festivala.

programme.title: An island in Greece / Otok u Grčkoj
programme.desc: A drama about three women and their fate. An Australian woman, a Greek woman and a Sri Lankan woman meet on the barren island of Astypalea in the Dodecanese Islands and soon become entangled in a web of their own desires, harsh locations and threats from the outside world... / Drama o trima ženama i njihovoj sudbini. Australka, Grkinja i Šrilančanka upoznaju se na neplodnu otoku Astipalei u otočju Dodekanez i ubrzo se zapletu u mrežu vlastitih želja, surove lokacije i prijetnje vanjskog svijeta...

programme.title: Split Blues Festival
programme.desc: "Evo ruke _ Split Blues Festival 2022.", Bosak And The Second Hand Band

programme.title: Veliki brodolomi Jadrana
programme.desc: It would be difficult to find a more famous warship that was sunk in the Adriatic in one of the war conflicts and countless battles than the Austro-Hungarian battleship Szent Istvan, whose sea grave has always attracted numerous research teams with its magical mystery. Protected from unwanted visitors by the unpredictable moods of the open sea and great depth, this large ship still attracts many divers. Szent Istvan was one of the most modern battleships of the Austro-Hungarian Navy and in June 1918 it was supposed to take part in the attack on the "Otranto Barrage", an obstacle that the Entente forces placed at the entrance to the Adriatic Sea to prevent the possible exit of the Austro-Hungarian fleet to the Mediterranean. However, Szent Istvan did not get far from its home port of Pula because it was ambushed by two Italian torpedo boats near the island of Premuda and sunk. In Italy, the sinking of the Szent Istvan is considered their greatest naval success, and they celebrate that day as Navy Day, while it signaled Austria-Hungary's imminent collapse. The Great Shipwrecks of the Adriatic team was joined on that part of the expedition by Mario Saletto, legendary journalist of Croatian Television and author of the well-known documentary series Secrets of the Adriatic. / Teško bi se mogao naći poznatiji ratni brod koji je potopljen u Jadranu u nekom od ratnih sukoba i bezbrojnih bitaka od austro-ugarskog bojnog broda Szent Istvana, čiji je morski grob magičnom tajanstvenošću oduvijek privlačio brojne istraživačke ekipe. Zaštićen od neželjenih posjetitelja nepredvidivim ćudima otvorenog mora i velikom dubinom, ovaj veliki brod i dalje privlači mnoge ronioce. Szent Istvan bio je jedan od najmodernijih bojnih brodova austro-ugarske mornarice i u lipnju 1918. trebao je sudjelovati u napadu na "Otrantsku baražu", prepreku koju su snage Antante postavile na ulazu u Jadransko more kako bi spriječile mogući izlazak Austro-Ugarske flote u Sredozemlje. Međutim, Szent Istvan nije dospio daleko od svoje matične pulske luke jer su ga u zasjedi kod otoka Premude dočekala dva talijanska torpedna čamca i potopila. U Italiji potapanje Szent Istvana smatraju svojim najvećim pomorskim uspjehom, te taj dan slave kao Dan mornarice, dok je Austro-Ugarskoj nagovijestilo njezin skori slom. Ekipi Velikih brodoloma Jadrana na tom se dijelu ekspedicije pridružio i Mario Saletto, legendarni novinar Hrvatske televizije i autor poznate dokumentarne serije Tajne Jadrana.

programme.title: Notes on language / Bilješke o jeziku
programme.desc: The topic of today's "Notes on Language" is translation: theory and history. We will never determine when man first translated a sentence from a language. In our cultural circle, the first book to be translated is the Bible. Everything starts from it, even the theory of translation. In our older literature, translation as an activity does not exist. The works are edited and published under the name of the editor. After all, this was a completely acceptable procedure at that time. Nataša Pavlović, Niko Bilić and Leo Rafolt talk about the translation. / Tema je današnjih "Bilježaka o jeziku" prevođenje: teorija i povijest. Nikada nećemo utvrditi kada je čovjek prvi put preveo rečenicu s nekog jezika. U našem kulturnom krugu prva knjiga koja se prevodi je Biblija. Od nje sve kreće pa i teorija prevođenja. U našoj starijoj književnosti prevođenje kao djelatnost ne postoji. Djela se prerađuju i objavljuju pod imenom onoga tko prerađuje. To je, uostalom, u to doba sasvim prihvatljiv postupak. O prevođenju govore Nataša Pavlović, Niko Bilić i Leo Rafolt.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories about sound, heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called the "Sound Collector", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he is very hard of hearing. This little creature spends his days discovering and learning the new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are mostly the sounds of the sea, sounds made by creatures in the sea, sounds made by insects, including the snoring of his best friend and pet Myrtle. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: The pups save Mayor Humdinger from Big Hairy who thinks he's his puppet. // When Mayor Humdinger tries to cheat at the Adventure Bay Sand Sculpture Contest, his machine goes wild. It's up to the puppies to save the day. / Psići spašavaju gradonačelnika Humdingera od Velikog Hairyja koji misli da je on njegova lutka. // Kada gradonačelnik Humdinger pokuša varati na Natjecanju pješčanih skulptura u Zaljevu pustolovina, njegov stroj podivlja. Na psićima je da spase dan.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Mittens lost the bell on her necklace, so her friends try to find it. / Mittens je izgubila zvonce na ogrlici, pa ga njezini prijatelji pokušavaju pronaći.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krcek are a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanut. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they get into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem they always invent some kind of machine. The machine doesn't always work the way they imagined and many funny and unforeseen situations arise. We wish you great fun with Krcek! Songs and a computer game also await you! / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije. Želimo vam odličnu zabavu s Krcekima! Također vas očekuju i pjesmice i računalna igra!

programme.title: Krceki - a song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: Along with the animated series Krceki, we also have seven songs: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljko and Hrabrica. Each song sings about the characteristics of a character from the Krceki series. / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki.

programme.title: Volim životinje
programme.desc: Dokumentarno-animirana serija upoznaje najmlađe sa životinjskim vrstama.

programme.title: Lu and the merry band / Lu i vesela družina
programme.desc: Lu tries to cheer Damir up, but he doesn't want to be cheered up. / Lu pokušava razvedriti Damira, ali on ne želi da ga se razvedri.

programme.title: Hej Dagi
programme.desc: Meet Dagi, a big and adorable dog who leads the preschool club and encourages children to have fun, be full of energy and _ most of all _ to do anything! Each episode of this colorful and sometimes surreal animated series begins with Dagi welcoming the Squirrels, a group of little curios left at the club by their parents. Then there is laughter and learning as the Squirrels discover something new about the world around them, and Dagi patiently watches over them. / Upoznajte Dagija, velikog i dražesnog psa koji vodi klub predškolaca i potiče djecu da se zabave, budu puna energije i _ više od svega _ da svašta rade! Svaka epizoda ove šarene i katkad nadrealne animirane serije počinje tako da Dagi dočeka Vjeverice, skupinu malenih znatiželjnika koje u klubu ostave njihovi roditelji. Zatim slijedi smijeh i učenje dok Vjeverice otkrivaju nešto novo o svijetu koji ih okružuje, a Dagi strpljivo pazi na njih.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a charming and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Muc gets all stained with chocolate spread, and Tweedy accidentally discovers that it's best to wash him with lots of love and a little soap. / Muc se sav umrlja čokoladnim namazom, a Tvidi slučajno otkrije da ga je najbolje oprati s mnogo ljubavi i malo sapuna.

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Oggy Oggy
programme.desc: Oggy Oggy is a computer-animated series for preschoolers by Jean Cayrol and Cedric Guarneri. The series follows the kitten Oggy who goes on an adventure with his friends Mallow and Sporty in a world where everything is made of children's toys. / Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka.

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter's Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother Georg, their parents and other animal families living in their town. / "Peppa Praščić" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: Captain Redbeard's coins have disappeared. Marko does not know how many there are or where they might be. Can Brojčić help him? / Kovanice kapetana Riđobradog su nestale. Marko ne zna koliko ih je ni gdje bi mogle biti. Mogu li mu Brojčići pomoći?

programme.title: Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Red We will go on a winter walk and get to know the magic of the color red. / Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje.

programme.title: A love monster / Ljubavno čudovište
programme.desc: The Love Monster dressed up as a superhero, but he wonders if he ruined the fun for the others. / Ljubavno Čudovište se odjenuo kao superjunak, no pita se je li time pokvario zabavu ostalima.

programme.title: Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Bitz and Bisera found the Incredible Owl Club with a special badge that allows members to join that exclusive club. / Bitz i Bisera osnuju Nevjerojatni klub sove s posebnom značkom koja članovima omogućuje ulazak u taj ekskluzivni klub.

programme.title: Dinoranč
programme.desc: When a wild spinosaur sneaks up on Dinoranch, little Rita pulls off an amazing rescue, which gives Blitz the idea to start training her as a young Dinoranch. But every time he tries to show her how to do something, Rita does it completely in her own way, which is why Blitz starts to think that he is not a good teacher. However, soon both he and Jon realize that, although Rita does everything differently, her ways always lead to success. This proves true when the spinosaur returns to the ranch and Blitz tries to drive it away thinking it is dangerous. But it turns out that the dinosaur is just hungry and grumpy, and Blitz has now made him angry! Blitz finally listens to Rita's miraculous way and together they manage to appease the hungry spinosaurus. So does Blitz and they learn a lot about how to be a great rancher. / Kad se jedan divlji spinosaur potajno ušulja na Dinoranč, mala Rita izvede nevjerojatno spašavanje, što Blitzu daje ideju da je počne obučavati kao mladu Dinorančericuu. No svaki put kad joj pokuša pokazati kako se nešto radi, Rita to učini na potpuno svoj način, zbog čega Blitz počinje misliti da nije dobar učitelj. Međutim, ubrzo i on i Jon shvate da, iako Rita sve drukčije radi, njezini načini uvijek dovedu do uspjeha. To se pokaže istinitim kad se spinosaur vrati na ranč, a Blitz ga pokuša otjerati misleći da je opasan. No ispostavi se da je dinosaur samo gladan i mrzovoljan, a Blitz ga je sada i naljutio! Blitz napokon posluša Ritin čudesan način i zajedno uspiju umiriti gladnog spinosaura. Tako i Blitz i nauče puno o tome kako biti sjajan rančer.

programme.title: Shasavi Hotel / Šašavi hotel
programme.desc: Silly Hotel is a British-American-Canadian series made for CBeebies (the BBC's pre-school programme). After the adventures of Sesame Street, Elmo and Keksomlat move to England to help Elmo's aunt and uncle run a "half-star" hotel, whose staff are especially good at solving problems. The hotel is run by members of the Šašava-Frka family with the help of Elmo and Keksomlat, who left Sesame Street to help solve the problems faced by the guests of the Šašava Hotel. / Šašavi Hotel je britansko-američko-kanadska serija snimljena za CBeebies (BBC-jev program za predškolsku dob). Nakon dogodovština u Ulici Sezam, Elmo i Keksomlat sele se u Englesku pomoći Elmovoj teti i tetku voditi hotel "s pola zvjezdice", čije osoblje posebno dobro zna rješavati probleme. Hotel vode članovi obitelji Šašava-Frka uz pomoć Elma i Keksomlata, koji su napustili Ulicu Sezam da bi pomogli rješavati probleme s kojima se suočavaju gosti Šašavog hotela.

programme.title: The song I'll do everything myself / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a
programme.desc: In the witty song "I'll do it all by myself" you will meet a girl and a boy who proudly sing about what they love, can and know how to do by themselves _ without the help of adults. And they are great at that. They know how to skillfully put on shoes, peel a banana, brush their teeth, go down a slide and much more. They are curious, love to learn and want to send an important message _ that they can do it themselves. And besides, they have a great time! / U duhovitoj pjesmici Sve ću sam/a upoznat ćete djevojčicu i dječaka koji ponosno pjevaju o onome što vole, mogu i znaju napraviti sami _ bez pomoći odraslih. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku _ da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju!

programme.title: Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela
programme.desc: "Daniel the Tiger's Neighborhood" is an animated series for preschoolers ages two to four based on the groundbreaking PBS series "Mister Rogers' Neighborhood." / "Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela" animirana je serija za djecu predškolske dobi od dvije do četiri godine koja se temelji na revolucionarnoj PBS-ovoj seriji "Susjedstvo gospodina Rogersa".

programme.title: Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela
programme.desc: "Daniel the Tiger's Neighborhood" is an animated series for preschoolers ages two to four based on the groundbreaking PBS series "Mister Rogers' Neighborhood." / "Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela" animirana je serija za djecu predškolske dobi od dvije do četiri godine koja se temelji na revolucionarnoj PBS-ovoj seriji "Susjedstvo gospodina Rogersa".

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Muc gets all stained with chocolate spread, and Tweedy accidentally discovers that it's best to wash him with lots of love and a little soap. / Muc se sav umrlja čokoladnim namazom, a Tvidi slučajno otkrije da ga je najbolje oprati s mnogo ljubavi i malo sapuna.

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter's Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Red We will go on a winter walk and get to know the magic of the color red. / Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje.

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother Georg, their parents and other animal families living in their town. / "Peppa Praščić" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: Captain Redbeard's coins have disappeared. Marko does not know how many there are or where they might be. Can Brojčić help him? / Kovanice kapetana Riđobradog su nestale. Marko ne zna koliko ih je ni gdje bi mogle biti. Mogu li mu Brojčići pomoći?

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: After bathing, Pablo gets upset because his smell has disappeared. Ask for the help of Buć-Boć _ a bottle of bath foam and a friend to find his scent by following his trail into the bathtub drain. / Nakon kupanja Pablo se uznemiri jer mu je nestao miris. Zatraži pomoć Buć-Boća _ bočice pjene za kupanje i prijatelja da mu pronađu miris prateći njegov trag u odvod kade.

programme.title: Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Bitz and Bisera found the Incredible Owl Club with a special badge that allows members to join that exclusive club. / Bitz i Bisera osnuju Nevjerojatni klub sove s posebnom značkom koja članovima omogućuje ulazak u taj ekskluzivni klub.

programme.title: The song I'll do everything myself / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a
programme.desc: In the witty song "I'll do it all by myself" you will meet a girl and a boy who proudly sing about what they love, can and know how to do by themselves _ without the help of adults. And they are great at that. They know how to skillfully put on shoes, peel a banana, brush their teeth, go down a slide and much more. They are curious, love to learn and want to send an important message _ that they can do it themselves. And besides, they have a great time! / U duhovitoj pjesmici Sve ću sam/a upoznat ćete djevojčicu i dječaka koji ponosno pjevaju o onome što vole, mogu i znaju napraviti sami _ bez pomoći odraslih. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku _ da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju!
