Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Edmond i Luce
programme.desc: Edmund and Luce are very excited as they get out of bed. Today is the Festival of Togetherness, a day when everyone cares about everyone else! They can't wait to see what others have prepared for that special day. / Edmund i Luce su jako uzbuđeni dok ustaju iz kreveta. Danas je Festival zajedništva, dan kad svatko brine o svakom drugom! Jedva čekaju da vide što su drugi pripremili za taj poseban dan.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: The pups save Mayor Humdinger from Big Hairy who thinks he's his puppet. // When Mayor Humdinger tries to cheat at the Adventure Bay Sand Sculpture Contest, his machine goes wild. It's up to the puppies to save the day. / Psići spašavaju gradonačelnika Humdingera od Velikog Hairyja koji misli da je on njegova lutka. // Kada gradonačelnik Humdinger pokuša varati na Natjecanju pješčanih skulptura u Zaljevu pustolovina, njegov stroj podivlja. Na psićima je da spase dan.

programme.title: Pjesmica Palačinke
programme.desc: Sing and dance to the new song Pancakes. A cheerful family of dogs and a silly cook enjoy preparing sweet and savory pancakes. And they have a great time. / Zapjevajte i zaplešite uz novu pjesmicu Palačinke. Vesela obitelj psića i jedan šašavi kuhar uživaju u pripremi slatkih i slanih palačinki. I odlično se zabavljaju.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Najgora vještica
programme.desc: A stunning adaptation of Jill Murphy's favorite Mildred Hubble books. Now Mildred is back at Cackle and is a better witch than before. / Zadivljujuća prerada omiljenih knjiga Jill Murphy o Mildred Hubble. Sad se Mildred vratila u Cackle i bolja je vještica nego prije.

programme.title: Notes on language / Bilješke o jeziku
programme.desc: The topic of today's "Notes on Language" is translation: theory and history. We will never determine when man first translated a sentence from a language. In our cultural circle, the first book to be translated is the Bible. Everything starts from it, even the theory of translation. In our older literature, translation as an activity does not exist. The works are edited and published under the name of the editor. After all, this was a completely acceptable procedure at that time. Nataša Pavlović, Niko Bilić and Leo Rafolt talk about the translation. / Tema je današnjih "Bilježaka o jeziku" prevođenje: teorija i povijest. Nikada nećemo utvrditi kada je čovjek prvi put preveo rečenicu s nekog jezika. U našem kulturnom krugu prva knjiga koja se prevodi je Biblija. Od nje sve kreće pa i teorija prevođenja. U našoj starijoj književnosti prevođenje kao djelatnost ne postoji. Djela se prerađuju i objavljuju pod imenom onoga tko prerađuje. To je, uostalom, u to doba sasvim prihvatljiv postupak. O prevođenju govore Nataša Pavlović, Niko Bilić i Leo Rafolt.

programme.title: Veliki brodolomi Jadrana
programme.desc: It would be difficult to find a more famous warship that was sunk in the Adriatic in one of the war conflicts and countless battles than the Austro-Hungarian battleship Szent Istvan, whose sea grave has always attracted numerous research teams with its magical mystery. Protected from unwanted visitors by the unpredictable moods of the open sea and great depth, this large ship still attracts many divers. Szent Istvan was one of the most modern battleships of the Austro-Hungarian Navy and in June 1918 it was supposed to take part in the attack on the "Otranto Barrage", an obstacle that the Entente forces placed at the entrance to the Adriatic Sea to prevent the possible exit of the Austro-Hungarian fleet to the Mediterranean. However, Szent Istvan did not get far from its home port of Pula because it was ambushed by two Italian torpedo boats near the island of Premuda and sunk. In Italy, the sinking of the Szent Istvan is considered their greatest naval success, and they celebrate that day as Navy Day, while it signaled Austria-Hungary's imminent collapse. The Great Shipwrecks of the Adriatic team was joined on that part of the expedition by Mario Saletto, legendary journalist of Croatian Television and author of the well-known documentary series Secrets of the Adriatic. / Teško bi se mogao naći poznatiji ratni brod koji je potopljen u Jadranu u nekom od ratnih sukoba i bezbrojnih bitaka od austro-ugarskog bojnog broda Szent Istvana, čiji je morski grob magičnom tajanstvenošću oduvijek privlačio brojne istraživačke ekipe. Zaštićen od neželjenih posjetitelja nepredvidivim ćudima otvorenog mora i velikom dubinom, ovaj veliki brod i dalje privlači mnoge ronioce. Szent Istvan bio je jedan od najmodernijih bojnih brodova austro-ugarske mornarice i u lipnju 1918. trebao je sudjelovati u napadu na "Otrantsku baražu", prepreku koju su snage Antante postavile na ulazu u Jadransko more kako bi spriječile mogući izlazak Austro-Ugarske flote u Sredozemlje. Međutim, Szent Istvan nije dospio daleko od svoje matične pulske luke jer su ga u zasjedi kod otoka Premude dočekala dva talijanska torpedna čamca i potopila. U Italiji potapanje Szent Istvana smatraju svojim najvećim pomorskim uspjehom, te taj dan slave kao Dan mornarice, dok je Austro-Ugarskoj nagovijestilo njezin skori slom. Ekipi Velikih brodoloma Jadrana na tom se dijelu ekspedicije pridružio i Mario Saletto, legendarni novinar Hrvatske televizije i autor poznate dokumentarne serije Tajne Jadrana.

programme.title: Delicija
programme.desc: At the dawn of the French Revolution, Pierre Manceron, a daring and proud cook, is fired by his master, the Duke of Chamfort. An encounter with an incredible woman, who wants to learn culinary skills from him, restores his self-confidence and encourages him to emancipate himself and start a personal revolution. Together, the two will design a place for socializing and enjoying culinary specialties open to all: the first restaurant. That idea will bring them clients... and enemies. / U osvit Francuske revolucije, Pierrea Mancerona, odvažnog i ponosnog kuhara, otpušta njegov gospodar, vojvoda Chamfort. Susret s nevjerojatnom ženom, koja od njega želi naučiti kulinarsko umijeće, vraća mu samopouzdanje i potiče ga da se emancipira i pokrene osobnu revoluciju. Njih će dvoje zajedno osmisliti mjesto druženja i uživanja u kulinarskim specijalitetima otvoreno za sve: prvi restoran. Ta će im ideja donijeti klijente... i neprijatelje.

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: Tonight, The Hahas and the Blablas are performing, a band from Zagreb that at the beginning of the year released their self-titled debut album with 12 short, infectious songs in which the genres of new wave, synth punk, power pop are mixed and they alternate philosophically and satirically, commentaries on all kinds of pop culture phenomena and life's absurdities, underlined lo-fi aesthetics of sound and music videos. Debbie Harry, David Icke, Andy Kaufman, several American presidents, victims of bureaucracy, a rat family _ they all appeared on the album, and today on our stage. / Večeras nastupaju The Hahas and the Blablas, zagrebački bend koji je početkom godine izdao istoimeni debitantski album s 12 kratkih, zaraznih pjesama u kojima se žanrovski miješaju new wave, synth punk, power pop i žustro izmjenjuju filozofsko-satirične slike, komentari na svakakve pojave pop kulture i životne apsurde, podcrtani lo-fi estetikom zvuka i spotova. Debbie Harry, David Icke, Andy Kaufman, nekoliko američkih predsjednika, žrtve birokracije, jedna štakorska obitelj _ svi su se našli na albumu, a danas i na našoj sceni.

programme.title: In memoriam M.Sc. Miroslava Hadžihusejnović Valašek: The female dengubica / In memoriam mr.sc. Miroslava Hadžihusejnović Valašek: Samica dangubica
programme.desc: In a documentary show about the past and present of playing the tambourine by a single person in the area of ​​Kordun and Lika _ which is called tambur (in Kordun), or kozarica, dangubica, kuterevka (in Lika) - we will find out what memories its older players have with the times when this instrument opened their way to girls, and for some it was a source of income, and with which everything today's, especially the younger generations approach the motifs of that musical instrument, when times are completely different, but, despite this, that musical instrument still plays in the area of Lika and Kordun. Participating: The local association of Korduna people "Korana", Zagreb, KUD "Lađevčani", Lađevac, KUD "Cetingradska tamburica", Cetingrad and KUD "Dangubice", Kuterevo. / U dokumentarnoj emisiji o prošlosti i sadašnjosti sviranja tambure samice na području Korduna i Like _ koju ondje nazivaju tamburom (na Kordunu), ili kozaricom, dangubicom, kuterevkom (u Lici) _ doznat ćemo kakve sve uspomene vežu njezine starije svirače s vremenima kad im je to glazbalo otvaralo put do djevojaka, a nekima bilo i izvor prihoda, te s kojim sve motivima tom glazbalu pristupaju današnji, pogotovo mlađi naraštaji, kad su vremena sasvim drukčija ali, unatoč tome, to glazbalo na području Like i Korduna, eto, još uvijek svira. Sudjeluju: Zavičajna udruga Kordunaša "Korana", Zagreb, KUD "Lađevčani", Lađevac, KUD "Cetingradska tamburica", Cetingrad te KUD "Dangubice", Kuterevo.

programme.title: Legende Pariškog romantizma
programme.desc: Paris, 1834 _ 1848. Romantics are everywhere. Their works are performed in theaters, published in newspapers and fill the windows of bookstores. Hugo became a member of the French Academy, Dumas opens his own theater, Balzac has already written 50 novels and intends to write twice as many because "Human Comedy" completely occupies his thoughts. Recently divorced George Sand opens the doors of the Nohant estate to her friends, which becomes a kind of artistic residence. Delacroix's paintings mingle there with Chopin's music, while George's pen constantly pours out words. Nerval and Gautier in Paris, on the other hand, raise bohemianism to the level of a new lifestyle. Together they create myths about their own lives, sometimes, admittedly, romanticizing them... / Pariz, 1834. _ 1848. Romantičari su posvuda. Njihova se djela izvode u kazalištima, objavljuju u novinama i pune izloge knjižara. Hugo je postao član Francuske akademije, Dumas otvara vlastito kazalište, Balzac je već napisao 50 romana i namjerava napisati još dvostruko više jer mu "Ljudska komedija" sasvim zaokuplja misli. Nedavno razvedena George Sand svojim prijateljima otvara vrata imanja Nohant koje postaje svojevrsna umjetnička rezidencija. Delacroixove slike ondje se miješaju sa Chopinovom glazbom, dok se iz Georgeina pera neprestano prelijevaju riječi. Nerval i Gautier u Parizu pak boemštinu uzdižu na razinu novog životnog stila. Zajedno stvaraju mitove o vlastitim životima, ponekad ih, doduše, i romansirajući...

programme.title: Soba za Nenada
programme.desc: A documentary film about the legacy of the famous and beloved Croatian architect Stjepan Planić, as a culture of housing, the impact of architecture on the daily life of the families who were his investors and those who still live in his premises, as well as on the dynamics of relationships and socializing within the community. Throughout the film, we follow the testimonies of several people who were connected to Planić in different ways, this is a film about them as well. Several people of different generations are having fun in a villa in Samobor. They remember the legacy left to them by the famous Croatian architect Stjepan Planić. In addition to living in houses designed by him, they are connected even more strongly by the most important element of Planić's legacy _ togetherness and companionship. People associated with him and his projects are still around today, forty years after his death, and they leave the same values ​​as a legacy to new generations. / Dokumentarni film o naslijeđu poznatog i omiljenog hrvatskog arhitekta Stjepana Planića, kao kulture stanovanja, utjecaja arhitekture na svakodnevni život obitelji koje su bile njegovi investitori i onih koji i danas žive u njegovim prostorima pa i na dinamiku odnosa i druženja unutar zajednice. Kroz film pratimo svjedočanstva nekoliko osoba koje su na različite načine bile povezane s Planićem, ovo je film i o njima. U jednoj samoborskoj vili zabavlja se nekoliko ljudi različitih naraštaja. Prisjećaju se naslijeđa koje im je ostavio poznati hrvatski arhitekt Stjepan Planić. Osim što žive u kućama koje je on projektirao, još ih jače povezuje najvažnija stavka Planićevog naslijeđa _ zajedništvo i druženje. Ljudi povezani s njim i njegovim projektima nalaze se i danas, četrdeset godina nakon njegove smrti te ostavljaju iste vrijednosti u naslijeđe i novim generacijama.

programme.title: Klasika mundi
programme.desc: We are showing a recording of the Irish Baroque Orchestra's concert at the opening of the 52nd Varaždin Baroque Evenings. An ambassador for Ireland's musical past, the IBO uses its unique perspective to create a growing body of knowledge about the music of Ireland from the Baroque and Classical periods, and research, recordings and performances offer audiences around the world new content to re-examine, embrace and enjoy the country's rich cultural heritage. Positive reviews come from all over the world, especially from magazines such as Gramophone Magazine, France Musique and BR Klassik. In February 2022, IBO made his debut at the Linbury Theatre, Royal Opera House, London in Vivaldi's Bajazet, a co-production of the Irish National Opera and the Royal Opera House, immediately winning the Olivier Award for Outstanding Achievement in Opera. The conductor and artistic director of the ensemble is Tom Foster, and the soloist is British mezzo-soprano Katie Bray. Winner of the Dame Joan Sutherland Audience Award at the BBC Singer of the World Competition 2019 in Cardiff, she is known for her magnetic stage presence and sparkling expressive tone. She performs in different opera houses and in a variety of repertoire, and is especially appreciated as an interpreter of the baroque repertoire. The program includes works by G. F. Handel, N. Pasquali, T. Giordani, A. Vivaldi, Ch. W. Gluck, J. K. Vanhal, T. Arne and P. van Malderea. / Prikazujemo snimku koncerta Irskog baroknog orkestra s otvorenja 52. Varaždinskih baroknih večeri. Ambasador irske glazbene prošlosti, IBO, koristi svoju jedinstvenu perspektivu za stvaranje sve veće zaklade znanja o glazbi u Irskoj iz razdoblja baroka i klasicizma, a istraživanja, snimke i izvedbe nude publici diljem svijeta novi sadržaj za preispitivanje, prihvaćanje i uživanje u bogatom kulturnom nasljeđu ove zemlje. Pozitivne kritike stižu sa svih strana svijeta, posebice iz časopisa kao što su Gramophone Magazine, France Musique i BR Klassik. U veljači 2022. IBO je uz pohvalne kritike debitirao u Linbury Theatreu, Royal Opera Houseu u Londonu u Vivaldijevoj operi Bajazet, koprodukciji Irske nacionalne opere i Royal Opera House i odmah osvojio Nagradu Olivier za iznimno postignuće u operi. Dirigent i umjetnički voditelj ansambla je Tom Foster, a solistica je britanska mezzosopranistica Katie Bray. Dobitnica nagrade publike Dame Joan Sutherland na BBC-jevu natjecanju Singer of the World 2019. u Cardiffu, poznata je po svojoj magnetičnoj pojavi na pozornici i blistavom izražajnom tonu. Nastupa u različitim opernim kućama i u raznovrsnom repertoaru, a osobito je cijenjena kao interpretkinja baroknog repertoara. Na programu su djela G. F. Handela, N. Pasqualija, T. Giordanija, A. Vivaldija, Ch. W. Glucka, J. K. Vanhala, T. Arnea i P. van Malderea.

programme.title: Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: Photographer Ante Verzotti from Split has been involved in photography since 1958. He has been doing photo montages since the 70s, motivated by his other interest and subject of interest _ experimental film. In his photomontages, he comments on the global political environment, criticizes consumerism and the control system, and touches upon all the important themes of activist art. His photo-collages are like rebuses, they require deciphering with the help of iconography from the past as well as the present. / Splitski fotograf Ante Verzotti fotografijom se bavi od 1958. godine. Fotomontaže radi od 70-ih godina, potaknut svojim drugim interesom i predmetom zanimanja _ eksperimentalnim filmom. U fotomontažama komentira globalno političko okruženje, kritizira konzumerizam i sustav kontrole te zahvaća sve bitne teme aktivističke umjetnosti. Njegovi su foto-kolaži poput rebusa, zahtijevaju dešifriranje uz pomoć ikonografije proteklog ali i suvremenog doba.

programme.title: Peti dan
programme.desc: The topics of this Fifth Day are: 1. Trump the king 2. Harari the prophet The commentators are: Aleksandar Musić, Marijana Bijelić and Erik Brezovec. / Teme su ovoga Petog dana: 1. Trump kralj 2. Harari prorok Komentatori su: Aleksandar Musić, Marijana Bijelić i Erik Brezovec.

programme.title: Margaret Atwood: Word by word - power / Margaret Atwood: Riječ po riječ - moć
programme.desc: The works of Margaret Atwood have never been more relevant than today. Readers turn to her books in the face of growing authoritarianism, rapidly developing new technologies, and gradual but inexorable climate change. Her poetry and novels are about the art of survival, but they are also survival tools themselves. The success of the television adaptation of her novel "The Handmaid's Tale" made her famous all over the world. Nearly two million fans check her Twitter posts as soon as they wake up. Who is the woman and writer behind these stories? How does he always know what the future holds for us? This documentary follows M. Atwood over twelve months as she travels with partner Graeme Gibson and lectures around the world. Audiences of all ages welcome her with enthusiasm: from college students in Chicago and Boston to birders in Vancouver and fans of the Cooperstown Opera Festival in New York State. M. Atwood visits the set of The Handmaid's Tale, where she meets lead actress Elisabeth Moss and costume designer Anne Crabtree, who designed the iconic red capes in which feminists protest around the world. The film also deals with the author's youth in the Canadian wilderness, her beginnings as a poet at Harvard, meeting her partner Graeme Gibson, their political activism and writing The Handmaid's Tale. The film analyzes her most important works and sheds light on the personal and social factors that influenced their creation. There will also be talk about the novel "Testimonies", the long-awaited sequel to "The Handmaid's Tale", which he claims was inspired by "the world we live in". / Djela Margaret Atwood nikada nisu bila aktualnija nego danas. Čitatelji se okreću njezinim knjigama suočeni s rastućim autoritarizmom, novim tehnologijama koje se ubrzano razvijaju i postupnim, ali neumitnim klimatskim promjenama. Njezina poezija i romani govore o umijeću preživljavanja, ali su ujedno i sami alati za preživljavanje. Uspjeh televizijske adaptacije njezina romana "Sluškinjina priča" proslavio ju je diljem svijeta. Gotovo dva milijuna obožavatelja čim se probude provjeravaju njezine objave na Twitteru. Tko je žena i spisateljica koja stoji iza ovih priča? Kako uvijek zna što nam nosi budućnost? Ovaj dokumentarac prati M. Atwood tijekom dvanaest mjeseci, dok putuje s partnerom Graemeom Gibsonom i drži predavanja diljem svijeta. Publika svih dobi dočekuje je s oduševljenjem: od studenata u Chicagu i Bostonu do ljubitelja ptica u Vancouveru i obožavatelja opernog festivala u Cooperstownu u državi New York. M. Atwood posjećuje set na kojem se snima "Sluškinjina priča", gdje upoznaje glavnu glumicu Elisabeth Moss i kostimografkinju Ane Crabtree, koja ja dizajnirala kultne crvene ogrtače u kojima feministice prosvjeduju diljem svijeta. Film se također bavi autoričinom mladošću u kanadskoj divljini, njezinim pjesničkim počecima na Harvardu, susretom s partnerom Graemeom Gibsonom, njihovim političkim aktivizmom i pisanjem "Sluškinjine priče". U filmu se analiziraju njezina najvažnija djela te rasvjetljavaju osobni i društveni čimbenici koji su utjecali na njihov nastanak. Bit će riječi i o romanu "Svjedočanstva", dugoočekivanom nastavku "Sluškinjine priče", za koji tvrdi da je inspiriran "svijetom u kojem živimo".

programme.title: Gladna srca
programme.desc: Jude is American, Mina is Italian. They fall in love in New York and soon have a child. Their relationship begins to unravel when Mina develops an obsessive need to protect the child from the "toxic world", refusing to give him regular food and medical care. Jude tries to save his son, which leads to an increasing conflict and tragic consequences. / Jude je Amerikanac, Mina je Talijanka. Zaljube se u New Yorku i ubrzo dobiju dijete. Njihova se veza počinje raspadati kada Mina razvije opsesivnu potrebu da dijete zaštiti od "toksičnog svijeta", odbijajući mu davati uobičajenu hranu i osigurati medicinsku skrb. Jude pokušava spasiti sina, što dovodi do sve većeg sukoba i tragičnih posljedica.

programme.title: Klasika mundi
programme.desc: We are showing a recording of the Irish Baroque Orchestra's concert at the opening of the 52nd Varaždin Baroque Evenings. An ambassador for Ireland's musical past, the IBO uses its unique perspective to create a growing body of knowledge about the music of Ireland from the Baroque and Classical periods, and research, recordings and performances offer audiences around the world new content to re-examine, embrace and enjoy the country's rich cultural heritage. Positive reviews come from all over the world, especially from magazines such as Gramophone Magazine, France Musique and BR Klassik. In February 2022, IBO made his debut at the Linbury Theatre, Royal Opera House, London in Vivaldi's Bajazet, a co-production of the Irish National Opera and the Royal Opera House, immediately winning the Olivier Award for Outstanding Achievement in Opera. The conductor and artistic director of the ensemble is Tom Foster, and the soloist is British mezzo-soprano Katie Bray. Winner of the Dame Joan Sutherland Audience Award at the BBC Singer of the World Competition 2019 in Cardiff, she is known for her magnetic stage presence and sparkling expressive tone. She performs in different opera houses and in a variety of repertoire, and is especially appreciated as an interpreter of the baroque repertoire. The program includes works by G. F. Handel, N. Pasquali, T. Giordani, A. Vivaldi, Ch. W. Gluck, J. K. Vanhal, T. Arne and P. van Malderea. / Prikazujemo snimku koncerta Irskog baroknog orkestra s otvorenja 52. Varaždinskih baroknih večeri. Ambasador irske glazbene prošlosti, IBO, koristi svoju jedinstvenu perspektivu za stvaranje sve veće zaklade znanja o glazbi u Irskoj iz razdoblja baroka i klasicizma, a istraživanja, snimke i izvedbe nude publici diljem svijeta novi sadržaj za preispitivanje, prihvaćanje i uživanje u bogatom kulturnom nasljeđu ove zemlje. Pozitivne kritike stižu sa svih strana svijeta, posebice iz časopisa kao što su Gramophone Magazine, France Musique i BR Klassik. U veljači 2022. IBO je uz pohvalne kritike debitirao u Linbury Theatreu, Royal Opera Houseu u Londonu u Vivaldijevoj operi Bajazet, koprodukciji Irske nacionalne opere i Royal Opera House i odmah osvojio Nagradu Olivier za iznimno postignuće u operi. Dirigent i umjetnički voditelj ansambla je Tom Foster, a solistica je britanska mezzosopranistica Katie Bray. Dobitnica nagrade publike Dame Joan Sutherland na BBC-jevu natjecanju Singer of the World 2019. u Cardiffu, poznata je po svojoj magnetičnoj pojavi na pozornici i blistavom izražajnom tonu. Nastupa u različitim opernim kućama i u raznovrsnom repertoaru, a osobito je cijenjena kao interpretkinja baroknog repertoara. Na programu su djela G. F. Handela, N. Pasqualija, T. Giordanija, A. Vivaldija, Ch. W. Glucka, J. K. Vanhala, T. Arnea i P. van Malderea.

programme.title: Soba za Nenada
programme.desc: A documentary film about the legacy of the famous and beloved Croatian architect Stjepan Planić, as a culture of housing, the impact of architecture on the daily life of the families who were his investors and those who still live in his premises, as well as on the dynamics of relationships and socializing within the community. Throughout the film, we follow the testimonies of several people who were connected to Planić in different ways, this is a film about them as well. Several people of different generations are having fun in a villa in Samobor. They remember the legacy left to them by the famous Croatian architect Stjepan Planić. In addition to living in houses designed by him, they are connected even more strongly by the most important element of Planić's legacy _ togetherness and companionship. People associated with him and his projects are still around today, forty years after his death, and they leave the same values ​​as a legacy to new generations. / Dokumentarni film o naslijeđu poznatog i omiljenog hrvatskog arhitekta Stjepana Planića, kao kulture stanovanja, utjecaja arhitekture na svakodnevni život obitelji koje su bile njegovi investitori i onih koji i danas žive u njegovim prostorima pa i na dinamiku odnosa i druženja unutar zajednice. Kroz film pratimo svjedočanstva nekoliko osoba koje su na različite načine bile povezane s Planićem, ovo je film i o njima. U jednoj samoborskoj vili zabavlja se nekoliko ljudi različitih naraštaja. Prisjećaju se naslijeđa koje im je ostavio poznati hrvatski arhitekt Stjepan Planić. Osim što žive u kućama koje je on projektirao, još ih jače povezuje najvažnija stavka Planićevog naslijeđa _ zajedništvo i druženje. Ljudi povezani s njim i njegovim projektima nalaze se i danas, četrdeset godina nakon njegove smrti te ostavljaju iste vrijednosti u naslijeđe i novim generacijama.

programme.title: Delicija
programme.desc: At the dawn of the French Revolution, Pierre Manceron, a daring and proud cook, is fired by his master, the Duke of Chamfort. An encounter with an incredible woman, who wants to learn culinary skills from him, restores his self-confidence and encourages him to emancipate himself and start a personal revolution. Together, the two will design a place for socializing and enjoying culinary specialties open to all: the first restaurant. That idea will bring them clients... and enemies. / U osvit Francuske revolucije, Pierrea Mancerona, odvažnog i ponosnog kuhara, otpušta njegov gospodar, vojvoda Chamfort. Susret s nevjerojatnom ženom, koja od njega želi naučiti kulinarsko umijeće, vraća mu samopouzdanje i potiče ga da se emancipira i pokrene osobnu revoluciju. Njih će dvoje zajedno osmisliti mjesto druženja i uživanja u kulinarskim specijalitetima otvoreno za sve: prvi restoran. Ta će im ideja donijeti klijente... i neprijatelje.

programme.title: Klapa Cesarica concert - 30 years of activity / Koncert Klape Cesarice - 30 godina djelovanja
programme.desc: In November 2023, Zagreb's longest-running female singing group "Cesarice" celebrated its thirtieth anniversary. In the Kerempuh Theater, nine Empresses presented themselves with songs, from Dalmatian folk to Macedonian, Ukrainian and Japanese songs... They were accompanied by guitarist Tamara Perc, percussionist and drummer Borna Šercar and Ivan Judaš on handpan. / Najdugovječnija zagrebačka ženska pjevačka klapa "Cesarice" obilježila je u studenom 2023. tridesetu obljetnicu djelovanja. U Kazalištu Kerempuh devet Cesarica predstavilo se pjesmama, od dalmatinskih narodnih do makedonske, ukrajinske i japanske pjesme... Pratili su ih gitaristica Tamara Perc, udaraljkaš i bubnjar Borna Šercar i na handpanu Ivan Judaš.Odjel Glazbenih sadržaja HRT-a priredio je snimku, jednog sasvim posebnog koncerta, posebnog za ljubitelje ženske klapske pjesme.

programme.title: Veliki brodolomi Jadrana
programme.desc: During 1944, the German army had strong naval forces in the Adriatic, the backbone of which was flotillas of fast and well-armed torpedo boats. They were equipped with strong torpedo armament and intended to attack slower enemy ships. They were also used for other purposes _ escorting transport ships, laying minefields, and for defense against submarines and allied light naval forces. This is the story of two twin ships _ the Italian torpedo boats TA 36 Stella Polare and TA 45 Spica which the Germans completed in our shipyards and immediately involved them in dangerous war tasks in the most difficult days of the German struggle for survival in the Adriatic. TA 36 sank in the northern Adriatic after only two months of sailing, encountering a sea mine, while TA 45 perished in the last naval conflict with the Allies, becoming a victim of the modern technology at the disposal of the Allies _ radar. / Njemačka je vojska tijekom 1944. godine na Jadranu raspolagala jakim pomorskim snagama, čiju su okosnicu činile flotile brzih i dobro naoružanih torpiljarki. Bile su opremljene jakim torpednim naoružanjem i namijenjene za napad na sporije neprijateljske brodove. Korištene su i za drugu namjenu _ pratnja transportnih brodova, polaganje minskih polja, te za obranu od podmornica i savezničkih lakih pomorskih snaga. Ovo je priča o dva broda blizanca _ talijanskim torpiljarkama TA 36 Stella Polare i TA 45 Spica koje su Nijemci dovršili u našim brodogradilištima i odmah ih uključili u opasne ratne zadatke u najtežim danima njemačke borbe za opstanak na Jadranu. TA 36 potonula je u sjevernom Jadranu nakon samo dva mjeseca plovidbe, nailaskom na morsku minu, dok je TA 45 nastradala u posljednjem pomorskom sukobu sa Saveznicima, postavši žrtvom suvremene tehnologije kojom je raspolagala saveznička strana _ radara.

programme.title: Notes on language / Bilješke o jeziku
programme.desc: In the last few decades, English has become somehow close to everyone. We listen to it all the time, so it gets into our ears no matter how we say it. In order to better understand it, today we will show its historical development, which is most closely connected with the history of the British island. How did the Celts, Romans, Vikings, Danes, Germans, French influence its development? What is the origin of today's English vocabulary, is there an English standard language and how is it determined? English speaker Dora Maček speaks in the show. / Engleski je u posljednjih nekoliko desetljeća postao svima nekako blizak. Stalno ga slušamo pa uđe u uho bez obzira kako ga govorimo. Kako bismo ga bolje razumjeli, danas ćemo pokazati njegov povijesni razvitak koji je najuže povezan s poviješću britanskog otoka. Kako su na njegov razvoj utjecali Kelti, Rimljani, Vikinzi, Danci, Nijemci, Francuzi? Koje je podrijetlo današnjeg engleskog vokabulara, postoji li engleski standardni jezik i kako se određuje? U emisiji govori anglistica Dora Maček.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories about sound, heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called the "Sound Collector", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he is very hard of hearing. This little creature spends his days discovering and learning the new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are mostly the sounds of the sea, sounds made by creatures in the sea, sounds made by insects, including the snoring of his best friend and pet Myrtle. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: The dogs use their new trucks and with the help of the new dog Al, they repair the dam before the water floods the Adventure Bay. / Psići koriste svoje nove kamione i uz pomoć novog psića Ala popravljaju branu prije negoli voda poplavi Zaljev pustolovina.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: When he sees Osbourne's magic trick, Timmy also wants to practice tricks, but it's not so easy. / Kad vidi Osbourneov mađioničarski trik, i Timmy želi uvježbati trikove, ali to nije tako lagano.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krcek are a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanut. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they get into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem they always invent some kind of machine. The machine doesn't always work the way they imagined and many funny and unforeseen situations arise. We wish you great fun with Krcek! Songs and a computer game also await you! / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije. Želimo vam odličnu zabavu s Krcekima! Također vas očekuju i pjesmice i računalna igra!

programme.title: Krceki - a song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: Along with the animated series Krceki, we also have seven songs: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljko and Hrabrica. Each song sings about the characteristics of a character from the Krceki series. / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki.

programme.title: Lu and colorful company / Lu i šareno društvo
programme.desc: Lu and Branimir have an argument during art class at School in the House. / Lu i Branimir se posvađaju tijekom sata likovnog u Školi u kućici.

programme.title: Hej Dagi
programme.desc: Meet Dagi, a big and adorable dog who leads the preschool club and encourages children to have fun, be full of energy and _ most of all _ to do anything! Each episode of this colorful and sometimes surreal animated series begins with Dagi welcoming the Squirrels, a group of little curios left at the club by their parents. Then there is laughter and learning as the Squirrels discover something new about the world around them, and Dagi patiently watches over them. / Upoznajte Dagija, velikog i dražesnog psa koji vodi klub predškolaca i potiče djecu da se zabave, budu puna energije i _ više od svega _ da svašta rade! Svaka epizoda ove šarene i katkad nadrealne animirane serije počinje tako da Dagi dočeka Vjeverice, skupinu malenih znatiželjnika koje u klubu ostave njihovi roditelji. Zatim slijedi smijeh i učenje dok Vjeverice otkrivaju nešto novo o svijetu koji ih okružuje, a Dagi strpljivo pazi na njih.

programme.title: Pjesmica Palačinke
programme.desc: Sing and dance to the new song Pancakes. A cheerful family of dogs and a silly cook enjoy preparing sweet and savory pancakes. And they have a great time. / Zapjevajte i zaplešite uz novu pjesmicu Palačinke. Vesela obitelj psića i jedan šašavi kuhar uživaju u pripremi slatkih i slanih palačinki. I odlično se zabavljaju.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a charming and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Muc is playing with something small and soft, and Tweedy doesn't know where he found it. Will he figure it out and put it back in the right place? / Muc se igra s nečime malim i mekanim, a Tvidi ne zna gdje je on to našao. Hoće li se domisliti i vratiti to na pravo mjesto?

programme.title: Pepe, Bubi and Lu at Dr. Zdravka's / Pepe, Bubi i Lu kod dr. Zdravke
programme.desc: PEPE, BUBI AND LU by Dr. Zdravka Puppet series A series for the youngest about going to the doctor. Her main characters are Pepe, Bubi and Lu, little ones who are still growing their milk teeth. They are a little mischievous and very afraid of doctors and injections, but with dear doctor Zdravka and funny uncle Boža, they will master all the lessons and overcome their fear of the doctor's office. Three fun songs await you in the series! / PEPE, BUBI I LU kod dr. Zdravke Lutkarska igrana serija Serija za najmlađe o odlasku liječniku. Njezini su glavni junaci Pepe, Bubi i Lu, mališani kojima još rastu mliječni zubi. Malo su nestašni i jako se boje doktora i injekcije, ali uz dragu doktoricu Zdravku i smiješnog ujaka Božu savladat će sve lekcije i pobijediti strah od ordinacije. U serijalu vas očekuju i tri zabavne pjesmice!

programme.title: Oggy Oggy
programme.desc: Oggy Oggy is a computer-animated series for preschoolers by Jean Cayrol and Cedric Guarneri. The series follows the kitten Oggy who goes on an adventure with his friends Mallow and Sporty in a world where everything is made of children's toys. / Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka.

programme.title: Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Red We will go on a winter walk and get to know the magic of the color red. / Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje.

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter's Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother Georg, their parents and other animal families living in their town. / "Peppa Praščić" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. programme.title: Najbolji dan
programme.desc: Iskra is an ordinary girl and like children her age, she likes cartoons, games and sweets. What distinguishes her from her peers is her long red hair. Her sister Stella is also red-haired. Iskra is overjoyed when they go on trips with Stella and her parents because she enjoys nature, likes hiking and fishing on the lakes. She goes to school accompanied by her parents, but she also looks forward to the day when she will start going alone. He wants to try as soon as possible, but for the first time in the company of DigiDigi. / Iskra je obična djevojčica i poput djece njezine dobi voli crtiće, igru i slatkiše. Ono što ju razlikuje od vršnjaka je duga riđa kosa. Riđokosa je i njezina seka Stela. Iskra je presretna kad sa Stelom i roditeljima putuju na izlete jer uživa u prirodi, voli planinariti i pecati na jezerima. U školu ide u pratnji roditelja, ali se i veseli danu kad će početi ići sama. Želi što prije pokušati, ali prvi put u društvu DigiDigija.

programme.title: A love monster / Ljubavno čudovište
programme.desc: Why is it so hard for the Love Monster to have fun during Super Fun Day? / Zašto je Ljubavnom Čudovištu toliko teško zabaviti se tijekom Super zabavnog dana?

programme.title: Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Bitz, Bob, Berko, Zip and Pop surprised Pearl with the best birthday hair clip. / Bitz, Bob, Berko, Zip i Pop iznenadili su Biseru najboljom rođendanskom kopčom za kosu.

programme.title: It's at the hotel / Ho ho ho hotel
programme.desc: HO HO HO HOTEL This fall, we invite you to a hotel like you've never seen before! What kind of guests will be welcomed by the best and funniest hosts of Hotel Ruža i Franc and what funny, silly and impossible wishes and problems will be faced by their guests - you will see in 20 episodes of the new humorous and educational series for children! Ruža and Franc can solve any problem, but in their own special and funny way. Dramatic-educational series of 20 ten-minute episodes produced by the Program for Children and Young People takes place in a hotel with the most unusual, best and sweetest hosts Ruža and Franco and their guests with even more unusual crazy wishes and problems! Through the funny and silly incidents of a clumsy magician, a silly scientist, an opera diva who lost her voice and many others, we will learn what is warm and what is cold, what is quiet and what is loud, fast or slow, big or small, high or low, near or far, heavy or light, visible or invisible! / HO HO HO HOTEL Ove vas jeseni pozivamo u hotel kakav još nikada niste vidjeli! Kakve će sve goste dočekati najbolji i i najzabavniji domaćini Hotela Ruža i Franc i koje će smiješne, šašave i nemoguće želje i probleme imati njihovi gosti- vidjet ćete u 20 epizoda nove humoristično- edukativne serije za djecu ! Ruža i Franc mogu riješiti svaki problem, ali , na a svoj posebni i smiješni način. Igrano- edukativna serija od 20 desetominutnih epizoda u produkciji Programa za djecu i mlade događa se u hotelu s najneobičnijim, najboljim i najsješnijim domaćinima Ružom i Francom te njihovim gostima s još neobičnijim luckastim željama i problemima! Kroz smiješne i šašave zgode nespretnog mađioničara, šašavog znanstvenika, operne dive koja je ostala bez glasa i mnogih drugih, naučit ćemo što je toplo, a što hladno, što tiho, a što glasno, brzo ili sporo, veliko il malo, visoko i nisko, blizu ili daleko, teško ili lagano, vidljivo ili nevidljivo!

programme.title: The song I'll do everything myself / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a
programme.desc: In the witty song "I'll do it all by myself" you will meet a girl and a boy who proudly sing about what they love, can and know how to do by themselves _ without the help of adults. They are curious, love to learn and want to send an important message _ that they can do it themselves. And besides, they have a great time! / U duhovitoj pjesmici Sve ću sam/a upoznat ćete djevojčicu i dječaka koji ponosno pjevaju o onome što vole, mogu i znaju napraviti sami _ bez pomoći odraslih. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku _ da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju!

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: Go on a treasure hunt on the Hexagon Island with dice and counters. This episode combines adventure, pirate themes and learning how to count at least through an exciting adventure. / S kockicama brojalicama krenite u lov na blago na Šesterokutni otok. Ova epizoda kombinira pustolovine, teme s piratima i uči najmanje kako brojati kroz uzbudljivu pustolovinu.

programme.title: Dinoranč
programme.desc: When Thunderbird crashes Clover and Mina's sleepover at the Kennel, Clover's plans for a quiet night are disrupted by a playful little spinosaur. Clover is excited about a sleepover with little watermelons, but is surprised when Gazigrom and his daughter Gazigromica appear, who ask her to join them. Min lets her participate, but the little spinosaur is a real temptation and disrupts all of Clover's quiet and gentle games that he has prepared for himself and the other minions. Clover eventually gets so upset that she sends Thunderbird to the corner for punishment, which makes her so sad that she throws a true spinosaurian tantrum, running and crying all over the ranch. Clover feels terrible and realizes that Gazigromica just wanted to play with others. He quickly finds a way to adapt his games so she can participate too, stopping her tears and turning the sleepover into a real success! / Kad Gromgromica bane na Cloverov i Minin prespavanac u Uzgajalištu, Cloverovi planovi za mirnu noć poremete se zbog razigrane male spinosaurice. Clover je uzbuđen zbog prespavanca s malim dinićima, no iznenadi se kad se pojave Gazigrom i njegova kći Gazigromica, koji zamole da im se i ona pridruži. Min dopusti da sudjeluje, ali mala spinosaurica je prava napast i poremeti sve Cloverove tihe i nježne igre koje je pripremio za sebe i druge diniće. Clover se naposljetku toliko uzruja da pošalje Gromgromicu u kut za kaznu, a nju to toliko rastuži da dobije pravi spinosaurski napadaj bijesa, trčeći i plačući po cijelome ranču. Clover se osjeća užasno i shvati da se Gazigromica samo htjela igrati s drugima. Brzo pronađe način da prilagodi svoje igre kako bi i ona mogla sudjelovati, čime zaustavi njezine suze i pretvori prespavanac u pravi uspjeh!

programme.title: Shasavi Hotel / Šašavi hotel
programme.desc: Silly Hotel is a British-American-Canadian series made for CBeebies (the BBC's pre-school programme). After the adventures of Sesame Street, Elmo and Keksomlat move to England to help Elmo's aunt and uncle run a "half-star" hotel, whose staff are especially good at solving problems. The hotel is run by members of the Šašava-Frka family with the help of Elmo and Keksomlat, who left Sesame Street to help solve the problems faced by the guests of the Šašava Hotel. / Šašavi Hotel je britansko-američko-kanadska serija snimljena za CBeebies (BBC-jev program za predškolsku dob). Nakon dogodovština u Ulici Sezam, Elmo i Keksomlat sele se u Englesku pomoći Elmovoj teti i tetku voditi hotel "s pola zvjezdice", čije osoblje posebno dobro zna rješavati probleme. Hotel vode članovi obitelji Šašava-Frka uz pomoć Elma i Keksomlata, koji su napustili Ulicu Sezam da bi pomogli rješavati probleme s kojima se suočavaju gosti Šašavog hotela.

programme.desc: We know you know all sorts of super heroes! And we know that all of them are great! programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Notes on language / Bilješke o jeziku
programme.desc: In the last few decades, English has become somehow close to everyone. We listen to it all the time, so it gets into our ears no matter how we say it. In order to better understand it, today we will show its historical development, which is most closely connected with the history of the British island. How did the Celts, Romans, Vikings, Danes, Germans, French influence its development? What is the origin of today's English vocabulary, is there an English standard language and how is it determined? English speaker Dora Maček speaks in the show. / Engleski je u posljednjih nekoliko desetljeća postao svima nekako blizak. Stalno ga slušamo pa uđe u uho bez obzira kako ga govorimo. Kako bismo ga bolje razumjeli, danas ćemo pokazati njegov povijesni razvitak koji je najuže povezan s poviješću britanskog otoka. Kako su na njegov razvoj utjecali Kelti, Rimljani, Vikinzi, Danci, Nijemci, Francuzi? Koje je podrijetlo današnjeg engleskog vokabulara, postoji li engleski standardni jezik i kako se određuje? U emisiji govori anglistica Dora Maček.

programme.title: Veliki brodolomi Jadrana
programme.desc: During 1944, the German army had strong naval forces in the Adriatic, the backbone of which was flotillas of fast and well-armed torpedo boats. They were equipped with strong torpedo armament and intended to attack slower enemy ships. They were also used for other purposes _ escorting transport ships, laying minefields, and for defense against submarines and allied light naval forces. This is the story of two twin ships _ the Italian torpedo boats TA 36 Stella Polare and TA 45 Spica which the Germans completed in our shipyards and immediately involved them in dangerous war tasks in the most difficult days of the German struggle for survival in the Adriatic. TA 36 sank in the northern Adriatic after only two months of sailing, encountering a sea mine, while TA 45 perished in the last naval conflict with the Allies, becoming a victim of the modern technology at the disposal of the Allies _ radar. / Njemačka je vojska tijekom 1944. godine na Jadranu raspolagala jakim pomorskim snagama, čiju su okosnicu činile flotile brzih i dobro naoružanih torpiljarki. Bile su opremljene jakim torpednim naoružanjem i namijenjene za napad na sporije neprijateljske brodove. Korištene su i za drugu namjenu _ pratnja transportnih brodova, polaganje minskih polja, te za obranu od podmornica i savezničkih lakih pomorskih snaga. Ovo je priča o dva broda blizanca _ talijanskim torpiljarkama TA 36 Stella Polare i TA 45 Spica koje su Nijemci dovršili u našim brodogradilištima i odmah ih uključili u opasne ratne zadatke u najtežim danima njemačke borbe za opstanak na Jadranu. TA 36 potonula je u sjevernom Jadranu nakon samo dva mjeseca plovidbe, nailaskom na morsku minu, dok je TA 45 nastradala u posljednjem pomorskom sukobu sa Saveznicima, postavši žrtvom suvremene tehnologije kojom je raspolagala saveznička strana _ radara.

programme.title: Margaret Atwood: Word by word - power / Margaret Atwood: Riječ po riječ - moć
programme.desc: We are showing a recording of the Irish Baroque Orchestra's concert at the opening of the 52nd Varaždin Baroque Evenings. An ambassador for Ireland's musical past, the IBO uses its unique perspective to create a growing body of knowledge about the music of Ireland from the Baroque and Classical periods, and research, recordings and performances offer audiences around the world new content to re-examine, embrace and enjoy the country's rich cultural heritage. Positive reviews come from all over the world, especially from magazines such as Gramophone Magazine, France Musique and BR Klassik. In February 2022, IBO made his debut at the Linbury Theatre, Royal Opera House, London in Vivaldi's Bajazet, a co-production of the Irish National Opera and the Royal Opera House, immediately winning the Olivier Award for Outstanding Achievement in Opera. The conductor and artistic director of the ensemble is Tom Foster, and the soloist is British mezzo-soprano Katie Bray. Winner of the Dame Joan Sutherland Audience Award at the BBC Singer of the World Competition 2019 in Cardiff, she is known for her magnetic stage presence and sparkling expressive tone. She performs in different opera houses and in a variety of repertoire, and is especially appreciated as an interpreter of the baroque repertoire. The program includes works by G. F. Handel, N. Pasquali, T. Giordani, A. Vivaldi, Ch. W. Gluck, J. K. Vanhal, T. Arne and P. van Malderea. / Prikazujemo snimku koncerta Irskog baroknog orkestra s otvorenja 52. Varaždinskih baroknih večeri. Ambasador irske glazbene prošlosti, IBO, koristi svoju jedinstvenu perspektivu za stvaranje sve veće zaklade znanja o glazbi u Irskoj iz razdoblja baroka i klasicizma, a istraživanja, snimke i izvedbe nude publici diljem svijeta novi sadržaj za preispitivanje, prihvaćanje i uživanje u bogatom kulturnom nasljeđu ove zemlje. Pozitivne kritike stižu sa svih strana svijeta, posebice iz časopisa kao što su Gramophone Magazine, France Musique i BR Klassik. U veljači 2022. IBO je uz pohvalne kritike debitirao u Linbury Theatreu, Royal Opera Houseu u Londonu u Vivaldijevoj operi Bajazet, koprodukciji Irske nacionalne opere i Royal Opera House i odmah osvojio Nagradu Olivier za iznimno postignuće u operi. Dirigent i umjetnički voditelj ansambla je Tom Foster, a solistica je britanska mezzosopranistica Katie Bray. Dobitnica nagrade publike Dame Joan Sutherland na BBC-jevu natjecanju Singer of the World 2019. u Cardiffu, poznata je po svojoj magnetičnoj pojavi na pozornici i blistavom izražajnom tonu. Nastupa u različitim opernim kućama i u raznovrsnom repertoaru, a osobito je cijenjena kao interpretkinja baroknog repertoara. Na programu su djela G. F. Handela, N. Pasqualija, T. Giordanija, A. Vivaldija, Ch. W. Glucka, J. K. Vanhala, T. Arnea i P. van Malderea.

programme.title: Dobra djeca
programme.desc: After the death of their mother, a middle-aged brother and sister who haven't seen each other in years spend three days cleaning their family home _ as well as their relationship. They are slowly starting to behave like children again... / Nakon smrti majke, sredovječni brat i sestra koji se nisu vidjeli godinama provode tri dana čisteći svoj obiteljski dom _ kao i svoj odnos. Polako se opet počinju ponašati kao djeca...

programme.title: 25. sat
programme.desc: On the last weekend in October, on the night from Saturday to Sunday, while almost the whole world switches from summer to winter time and the clocks move from 3 o'clock to 2 o'clock that night, and while most people do not even notice the change, the passengers of the train on the Vinkovci-Zagreb line got stuck at the 25th hour at the train station in Nova Gradiška. / Posljednjeg vikenda u listopadu, u noći sa subote na nedjelju, dok gotovo cijeli svijet prelazi s ljetnog na zimsko računanje vremena i kazaljke se te noći pomiču s 3 na 2 sata te dok većina tu promjenu ni ne primjećuje, putnici vlaka na pruzi Vinkovci-Zagreb zaglavili su u 25. satu na željezničkoj postaji u Novoj Gradiški.

programme.title: Šahovski komentar
programme.desc: Analiza najboljih šahovskih partija uz komentare velemajstora Alojzija Jankovića.

programme.title: Filmovi Woodyja Allena: Radijski dani
programme.desc: The family of student Joe (S. Green) lives in the suburbs of New York. She is overwhelmed by everyday problems, especially relationships with numerous relatives. In this group, young Sally White (M. Farrow) who wants to pursue a career as a singer and aunt (D. Wiest) who is approaching middle age and who wants to find a husband at all costs stand out. The beginning of World War II will bring a change in their lives. world war... / Obitelj učenika Joea (S. Green) živi u predgrađu New Yorka. Obuzeta je svakodnevnim problemima, a posebno odnosima s mnogobrojnom rodbinom. U toj skupini izdvajaju se mlada Sally White (M. Farrow) koja želi ostvariti karijeru pjevačice i teta (D. Wiest) koja se bliži srednjim godinama i koja pod svaku cijenu želi naći muža. Promjenu u njihove živote unijet će početak II. svjetskog rata...

programme.title: Posebni dodaci
programme.desc: The weekly show follows attractive movie marathons until the early hours of the morning with our best film critics and film experts. / Tjedna emisija, prati atraktivne filmske maratone do ranih jutarnjih sati uz naše najbolje filmske kritičare i filmologe.

programme.title: Veličanstvena opsesija
programme.desc: Bob Merrick (R. Hudson) inherited four million dollars from his father who died early and did not enjoy his wealth. So Bob decided to just enjoy life. One day he gets the idea to drive his super-modern motorboat on the lake at top speed. But he has an accident. While helping him, first aiders had to use medical equipment that could simultaneously save the life of the world-renowned neurosurgeon, Dr. Phillips. While recovering in the hospital, Merrick meets Phillips' widow Helen (J. Wyman). When he realizes that he inadvertently covered up her husband's death, he offers her a large sum of money, which she rejects indignantly. Regardless, Merrick is irresistibly drawn to Helen Phillips... / Bob Merrick (R. Hudson) naslijedio je četiri milijuna dolara od oca koji je rano umro i nije uživao u svom bogatstvu. Zato je Bob odlučio samo uživati u životu. Jednog dana padne mu na pamet da svoj supermoderni motorni čamac vozi po jezeru maksimalnom brzinom. No, doživi nesreću. Pomažući njemu, ljudi iz prve pomoći morali su upotrijebiti medicinsku opremu koja je istodobno mogla spasiti život neurokirurgu svjetskg ugleda, dr. Phillipsu. Dok se oporavlja u bolnici, Merrick upozna Phillipsovu udovicu Helen (J. Wyman). Kad shvati da je nenamjerno skrivio smrt njezina muža, ponudi joj velik novac, što ona uvrijeđeno odbije. Bez obzira na sve, Merricka neodoljivo privlači Helen Phillips...

programme.title: Imitacija života
programme.desc: The beach at Coney Island in the summer of 1947. Among the crowd of bathers excitedly looking for her six-year-old daughter Susie (T. Burnham), Lora Meredith (L. Turner) meets the dark-skinned maid Annie Johnson (J. Moore) and her daughter Sarah Jane (K. Dicker), a girl with unusually light skin. Lora is an ambitious actress who, not wanting to agree to compromises, has been out of work for a long time and survives by filming commercials, but agrees to hire Annie in exchange for an apartment and food. On the same day, Lora also meets Steve Archer (J. Gavin), who captures the girls' play with his camera, and is immediately attracted to the beautiful blonde. Lora receives a call from producer Allen Loomis (R. Aldo), who lets her know that if she wants to pursue an acting career, she will have to forget morality and any considerations. While Lora rejects Allen's immoral offer, Annie has more and more problems with Sarah Jane, a hung child unhappy because her mother is black. Moreover, Sarah Jane increasingly appropriates Susie's toys and demands that Lora treat her as her own daughter. While enjoying a romantic relationship with Steve, Lora learns that playwright David Edwards (D. OHerlihy) is interested in her... / Plaža na Coney Islandu ljeta 1947. godine. Među mnoštvom kupača uzbuđeno tražeći svoju šestogodišnju kćer Susie (T. Burnham), Lora Meredith (L. Turner) upozna tamnoputu spremačicu Annie Johnson (J. Moore) i njezinu kći Sarah Jane (K. Dicker), djevojčicu neobično svijetle puti. Lora je ambiciozna glumica koja, ne želeći pristati na kompromise, već dugo nema posla i preživljava snimajući reklame, ali pristane u zamjenu za stan i hranu zaposliti Annie. Istog dana Lora upozna i Stevea Archera (J. Gavin), koji fotoaparatom ovjekovječi igru djevojčica, i kojeg lijepa plavuša smjesta privuče. Lora primi poziv od producenta Allena Loomisa (R. Alda) koji joj daje do znanja da će, želi li ostvariti glumačku karijeru, morati zaboraviti moral i bilo kakve obzire. Dok Lora odbija Allenovu nemoralnu ponudu, Annie ima sve više problema sa Sarah Jane, obijesnom klinkom nesretnom jer joj je majka crnkinja. Štoviše, Sarah Jane sve češće prisvaja Susieine igračke i traži da se Lora prema njoj odnosi kao prema vlastitoj kćeri. Dok uživa u romantičnoj vezi sa Steveom, Lora dozna da se za nju zanima dramatičar David Edwards (D. OHerlihy)...

programme.title: Lola
programme.desc: Germany in the fall of 1957 at the time of the economic miracle. Adenauer era. Coburg, a city under renewal. Everyone seems to benefit from it. Mr. Schuckert is a successful and friendly construction businessman. He is the secret ruler of the city. He has something in his hand for everyone and is open to all kinds of cooperation. Lola is the star of "Villa Fink". Her name is actually Marie-Louise and she has a daughter Mariechen. Men go crazy for her when she dances and sings. She is very seductive. Mr. Esslin is her companion, and not only on the piano. The little employee of the local construction office is always close to Lola. But Schuckert has money. Nobody can do anything to him. Esslin is a dreamer, a moralist and an opponent of war. He is angry because of the situation that surrounds him. And yet, he knows what kind of game is being played in this town. Everyone is talking about Mr. von Bohm, the new construction czar of the city. It is not similar to its predecessor. They say he is not corrupt. Will they adapt and play the same game? / Njemačka u jesen 1957. u vrijeme gospodarskog čuda. Adenauerova era. Coburg, grad u obnovi. Čini se da svi imaju koristi od toga. G. Schuckert uspješan je i druželjubiv poslovni čovjek koji se bavi građevinom. On je tajni vladar grada. Svakoga drži nečime u šaci i otvoren je za sve vrste suradnje. Lola je zvijezda "Ville Fink". Ona se zapravo zove Marie-Louise i ima kćerkicu Mariechen. Muškarci luduju za njom kad pleše i pjeva. Ona je jako zavodljiva. G. Esslin je njezin pratitelj, i to ne samo na klaviru. Maleni zaposlenik mjesnog građevinskog ureda uvijek je blizu Lole. No Schuckert ima novac. Nitko mu ništa ne može. Esslin je sanjar, moralist i protivnik rata. Ljutit je zbog situacije koja ga okružuje. Pa ipak, zna kakva se igra igra u ovome gradu. Svi govore o g. von Bohmu, novom građevinskom caru grada. Nije sličan svojem prethodniku. Kažu da nije korumpiran. Hoće li se prilagoditi i zaigrati istu igru?

programme.title: Kaos
programme.desc: Adaptation of five novels by Luigi Pirandello based on the screenplay by the Taviani brothers. The film was shot in Sicily, where Pirandello's stories take place. In the first story, "The Second Son", an old woman sends a letter to two sons who have gone to America and refuses the help of the third son, whom she carried away with an outlaw, the murderer of her husband during the Garibaldi Revolution. The hero of the second story experiences suffering with his young wife because he becomes a werewolf during the full moon. The third story is about an unusual dispute over a broken and reassembled pitcher. "Requiem", the fourth story, follows the dispute between a rich landowner and his shepherds who have settled on the edge of the estate for years. Now he does not allow them to have a cemetery. "Conversation with Mother" is the fifth and last story of that omnibus. Luigi Pirandello returns to his Sicilian homeland, remembers his childhood and shares his grief with the ghost of his mother. / Ekranizacija pet novela Luigia Pirandella prema scenariju braće Taviani. Film je snimljen na Siciliji, gdje se odvijaju Pirandellove priče. U prvoj priči, "Drugi sin", starica šalje pismo dvojici sinova koji su otišli u Ameriku i odbija pomoć trećeg sina, kojega je zanijela s odmetnikom, ubojicom njezina muža u doba Garibaldijeve revolucije. Junak druge priče proživljava patnje sa svojom mladom ženom jer za puna Mjeseca postaje vukodlak. Treća priča govori o neobičnom sporu zbog razbijenog i ponovno sastavljenog vrča. "Rekvijem", četvrta priča, prati spor bogatog posjednika i njegovih pastira koji su se godinama naseljavali na rubu imanja. Sad im ne dopušta da imaju groblje. "Razgovor s majkom" peta je i posljednja priča tog omnibusa. Luigi Pirandello vraća se u svoj sicilijanski zavičaj, sjeća se djetinjstva i dijeli tugu s duhom svoje majke.

programme.title: Veliki brodolomi Jadrana
programme.desc: The Second World War brought to our sea new weapons and tactics of modern warfare. The small wooden partisan ships could not stand up to the much larger and better armed enemy warships. Only after the capitulation of Italy and the arrival of the Allies on the island of Vis did a new era of naval warfare begin, in which German and British naval forces clashed between the Adriatic islands almost every night. In the attacks on German convoys, British torpedo boats stood out in particular, bearing the brunt of the fight against similar German opponents. Our team investigated the wreck of the German torpedo boat S 57, a veteran of naval battles fought with the Allies since the beginning of the war, which sank in August 1944 near the Pelješac peninsula. Today, S 57 is one of the best preserved such wrecks in the world. By researching an unknown wreck of a torpedo boat that was recently found in the North Adriatic, the Great Shipwrecks of the Adriatic expedition determined that it was the remains of the British torpedo boat MTB 655, which sank just before the end of World War II. In Great Britain, we also found its commander, who told us a tragic story about the shipwreck and the rescue of his crew. / Drugi svjetski rat donio je u naše more nova oružja i taktiku suvremenog ratovanja. Mali drveni partizanski brodovi nisu se mogli suprotstaviti mnogo većim i bolje naoružanim neprijateljskim ratnim brodovima. Tek poslije kapitulacije Italije i dolaskom Saveznika na otok Vis započela je nova era pomorskog ratovanja, u kojoj su se među jadranskim otocima gotovo svake noći sukobljavale njemačke i britanske pomorske snage. U napadima na njemačke konvoje osobito su se istaknuli britanski torpedni čamci koji su podnijeli glavni teret borbe sa sličnim njemačkim protivnicima. Naša ekipa istraživala je olupinu njemačkog torpednog čamca S 57, veterana pomorskih bitaka koje je vodio sa Saveznicima od početka rata, a koji je u kolovozu 1944. potonuo kod poluotoka Pelješca. Danas je S 57 jedna od najbolje očuvanih takvih olupina u svijetu. Istraživanjem nepoznate olupine torpednog čamca koja je nedavno pronađena u Sjevernom Jadranu ekspedicija Velikih brodoloma Jadrana utvrdila je da se radi o ostacima britanskog torpednog čamca MTB 655 koji je potonuo neposredno pred kraj Drugog svjetskog rata. U Velikoj Britaniji pronašli smo i njegovog zapovjednika koji nam je ispričao tragičnu priču o brodolomu i spašavanju njegove posade.

programme.title: Notes on language / Bilješke o jeziku
programme.desc: This show was recorded in 2016 at the Institute for Croatian Language and Linguistics, where the project Database of Contemporary Croatian Names was underway. It was led by Dr. sc. Ankica Čilaš Šimpraga (1970 - 2020). The database was used to create the Dictionary of Personal Names, which was published in 2018 at Interliber. / Ova emisija snimana je 2016. godine u Institutu za hrvatski jezik i jezikoslovlje gdje je bio u tijeku projekt Baza suvremenih hrvatskih imena. Vodila ga je dr. sc. Ankica Čilaš Šimpraga (1970. _ 2020.). Baza je poslužila za izradu Rječnika osobnih imena koji je objavljen 2018. godine na Interliberu.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories about sound, heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called the "Sound Collector", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he is very hard of hearing. This little creature spends his days discovering and learning the new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are mostly the sounds of the sea, sounds made by creatures in the sea, sounds made by insects, including the snoring of his best friend and pet Myrtle. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy helps Osbourne recycle the waste, but concludes that the old cans are really good toys, not trash. / Timmy pomaže Osbourneu reciklirati otpad, ali zaključuje da su stare limenke baš dobre igračke, a ne smeće.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krcek are a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanut. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they get into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem they always invent some kind of machine. The machine doesn't always work the way they imagined and many funny and unforeseen situations arise. We wish you great fun with Krcek! Songs and a computer game also await you! / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije. Želimo vam odličnu zabavu s Krcekima! Također vas očekuju i pjesmice i računalna igra!

programme.title: Krceki - a song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: Along with the animated series Krceki, we also have seven songs: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljko and Hrabrica. Each song sings about the characteristics of a character from the Krceki series. / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki.

programme.title: Lu and the merry band / Lu i vesela družina
programme.desc: Lu is upset that no one seems to like her new shoes. / Lu se uzruja što se izgleda nikome ne sviđaju njene nove cipele.

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter's Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Hej Dagi
programme.desc: Meet Dagi, a big and adorable dog who leads the preschool club and encourages children to have fun, be full of energy and _ most of all _ to do anything! Each episode of this colorful and sometimes surreal animated series begins with Dagi welcoming the Squirrels, a group of little curios left at the club by their parents. Then there is laughter and learning as the Squirrels discover something new about the world around them, and Dagi patiently watches over them. / Upoznajte Dagija, velikog i dražesnog psa koji vodi klub predškolaca i potiče djecu da se zabave, budu puna energije i _ više od svega _ da svašta rade! Svaka epizoda ove šarene i katkad nadrealne animirane serije počinje tako da Dagi dočeka Vjeverice, skupinu malenih znatiželjnika koje u klubu ostave njihovi roditelji. Zatim slijedi smijeh i učenje dok Vjeverice otkrivaju nešto novo o svijetu koji ih okružuje, a Dagi strpljivo pazi na njih.

programme.title: The song I'll do everything myself / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a
programme.desc: In the witty song "I'll do it all by myself" you will meet a girl and a boy who proudly sing about what they love, can and know how to do by themselves _ without the help of adults. And they are great at that. They know how to skillfully put on shoes, peel a banana, brush their teeth, go down a slide and much more. They are curious, love to learn and want to send an important message _ that they can do it themselves. And besides, they have a great time! Music and lyrics: Andrija Vujević Singers: Juhuhuovci and Vojko V Director and animator: Marija Ivšić Editor: Ana Macan / U duhovitoj pjesmici Sve ću sam/a upoznat ćete djevojčicu i dječaka koji ponosno pjevaju o onome što vole, mogu i znaju napraviti sami _ bez pomoći odraslih. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku _ da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju! Glazba i stihovi: Andrija Vujević Pjevaju: Juhuhuovci i Vojko V Redatelj i animator: Marija Ivšić Urednica: Ana Macan

programme.title: Mališani

Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.desc: Tweedy and Muc find God's lamb in the little room.
