programme.title: Octopus in danger - searching for clues around the Mediterranean / Oktopus in Gefahr - Spurensuche rund ums Mittelmeer
programme.desc: The octopus is considered a delicacy - whether grilled, boiled or as calamari. But the increasing demand has consequences: the intelligent cephalopod is being overfished in several regions of Europe. Stocks are shrinking dramatically, especially in the Mediterranean region. In Greece, trapping is often done using forbidden traps. Together with the Coast Guard, Sea Shepherd has removed thousands of these traps from the seabed in an effort to combat environmental crime. Whether cooked, grilled or in salads, octopus is one of the most popular seafood around the Mediterranean. In Germany, too, it often ends up on the plate as calamari from the freezer. But where do the squid actually come from - and what about their populations? A team from "planet e." embarks on an investigative journey along the coasts of Europe and Africa. In Galicia, northwest Spain, there are several large fish processing plants that cut up octopuses, freeze them and prepare them for the international market - including Germany. Catching is subject to strict regulations because natural stocks are shrinking rapidly. In order to meet the high demand, factories are increasingly relying on imports from African waters. One company is planning to breed octopuses in aquaculture. But the project met with strong criticism from environmentalists - the project was stopped for the time being. Breeding octopuses is ethically and ecologically questionable: the animals are highly intelligent and sensitive, suffer from stress in captivity and there are no humane slaughter methods. In addition, their meat-based diet puts a strain on marine ecosystems and contradicts sustainable aquaculture. In the Mediterranean, the common octopus (Octopus vulgaris) is caught in many places. In Greece, for example, special plastic traps are used that lie on kilometer-long lines on the seabed. A local fisherman shows the camera team that the yield is getting smaller and smaller - a direct result of overfishing. The ecological consequences are already visible: the invasive blue crab is spreading uncontrollably in Italy. It is one of the octopuses' favorite foods - but without natural enemies it is now destroying mussel cultivation in the Po Delta. Mussel farmers are facing an existential crisis. Could the return of the octopuses be the solution? An organization from Austria is testing exactly this off the Croatian island of Krk. Researchers there are investigating whether octopuses can settle in artificial shelters, reproduce and contribute to the long-term stabilization of the ecosystem. The experiments are still in their early stages, but there is great hope: a sustainable model for the entire Mediterranean region could emerge. / Der Oktopus gilt als Delikatesse - ob gegrillt, gekocht oder als Calamares. Doch die steigende Nachfrage hat Folgen: In mehreren Regionen Europas wird der intelligente KopffuSSer uberfischt.Besonders im Mittelmeerraum schrumpfen die Bestande dramatisch. In Griechenland wird oft mit verbotenen Fallen gefangen. Gemeinsam mit der Kustenwache hat Sea Shepherd Tausende dieser Fallen vom Meeresgrund entfernt - ein Einsatz gegen Umweltkriminalitat.Ob gekocht, gegrillt oder als Salat - rund ums Mittelmeer gehort Oktopus zu den beliebtesten Meeresfruchten. Auch in Deutschland landet er haufig als Calamares aus der Tiefkuhltruhe auf dem Teller. Doch woher stammen die Tintenfische eigentlich - und wie steht es um ihre Bestande?Ein Team von "planet e." begibt sich auf eine investigative Reise entlang der Kusten Europas und Afrikas.In Galizien, Nordwestspanien, befinden sich mehrere groSSe Fischverarbeitungsbetriebe, die Oktopusse zerlegen, einfrieren und fur den internationalen Markt - auch fur Deutschland - vorbereiten. Der Fang unterliegt strengen Regulierungen, denn die naturlichen Bestande schrumpfen rapide. Um die hohe Nachfrage zu decken, greifen die Fabriken zunehmend auf Importe aus afrikanischen Gewassern zuruck.Ein Konzern plant, Oktopusse in Aquakultur zu zuchten. Doch das Vorhaben stoSSt auf heftige Kritik von Umweltschutzern - das Projekt wurde vorerst gestoppt. Die Zucht von Oktopussen ist ethisch und okologisch bedenklich: Die Tiere sind hochintelligent und empfindsam, leiden in Gefangenschaft unter Stress und es gibt keine humane Schlachtmethoden. Zudem belastet ihre fleischbasierte Ernahrung die Meeresokosysteme und widerspricht nachhaltiger Aquakultur.Im Mittelmeer wird der Gemeine Krake (Octopus vulgaris) vielerorts gefangen. In Griechenland etwa kommen spezielle Plastikfallen zum Einsatz, die an kilometerlangen Grundleinen auf dem Meeresboden liegen. Ein lokaler Fischer zeigt dem Kamerateam, dass die Ausbeute immer geringer wird - eine direkte Folge der Überfischung.Die okologischen Folgen sind bereits sichtbar: In Italien breitet sich die invasive Blaukrabbe unkontrolliert aus. Sie zahlt zu den Lieblingsspeisen der Kraken - doch ohne naturliche Feinde zerstort sie nun den Muschelanbau im Po-Delta. Die Muschelfarmer stehen vor einer existenziellen Krise.Konnte die Ruckkehr der Oktopusse die Losung sein? Eine Organisation aus Österreich testet genau das vor der kroatischen Insel Krk. Dort untersuchen Forschende, ob sich Kraken in kunstlichen Unterschlupfen ansiedeln, vermehren und langfristig zur Stabilisierung des Ökosystems beitragen konnen. Die Versuche stehen noch am Anfang, doch die Hoffnung ist groSS: Ein nachhaltiges Modell fur den gesamten Mittelmeerraum konnte entstehen.

programme.title: Die Rosenheim-Cops
programme.desc: The entrepreneur Ludwig Hubachner is found dead in the company in the morning. A conversation with secretary Bettina Reimers puts the cops on the trail of the dead man's son and heir. Since Karl-Friedrich Hubachner has been running the company, the company has been in the red. It would be easy to imagine that this would lead to a fatal argument between father and son. But authorized signatory Jurgen Wieland also comes under suspicion because he was recently fired. Has he now taken revenge on Hubachner? A tip from Marie suddenly gives the case a new twist: Secretary Reimers is said to have had a relationship with Hubacher. When asked about this, Reimers admits to having spent the night with her boss, whereupon the victim's widow, Lea Hubachner, comes under suspicion. A tricky case for the investigators, while Controller Ortmann is the subject of conversation in the police station: After she met the owner of a car dealership, Jens Fischer, he gave her various convertibles to test drive Disposal. Secretary Stockl then hears the wedding bells ringing. Ortmann and Stockl don't yet know that the boss of the car dealership has already been taken. / Der Unternehmer Ludwig Hubachner wird morgens erschlagen in der Firma aufgefunden. Ein Gesprach mit Sekretarin Bettina Reimers bringt die Cops auf die Spur des Sohnes und Erben des Toten.Seit Karl-Friedrich Hubachner die Firma leitet, schreibt der Konzern rote Zahlen. Dass es daruber zwischen Vater und Sohn zum todlichen Streit kam, ware gut vorstellbar. Doch auch Prokurist Jurgen Wieland gerat unter Verdacht, weil ihm kurzlich gekundigt wurde.Hat er sich jetzt an Hubachner geracht? Durch einen Hinweis von Marie bekommt der Fall plotzlich eine neue Wendung: Sekretarin Reimers soll ein Verhaltnis mit Hubacher gehabt haben. Darauf angesprochen, gibt Reimers zu, die Nacht mit ihrem Chef verbracht zu haben, woraufhin die Witwe des Opfers, Lea Hubachner, unter Verdacht gerat.Ein kniffliger Fall fur die Ermittler, wahrend im Kommissariat Controllerin Ortmann fur Gesprachsstoff sorgt: Nachdem sie den Besitzer eines Autohauses, Jens Fischer, kennengelernt hat, stellt dieser ihr diverse Cabrios zur Probefahrt zur Verfugung. Sekretarin Stockl hort daraufhin bereits die Hochzeitsglocken lauten. Dass der Chef des Autohauses allerdings bereits vergeben ist, wissen Ortmann und Stockl noch nicht.

programme.title: 12 years alone in the forest / 12 Jahre allein im Wald
programme.desc: Marc has been living in the forest for 12 years. Psychologist Leon Windscheid visits him in the Odenwald and wants to know why he took such a radical step and what the forest has changed for him. Nature photographer Ulla Lohmann often looked for answers in the forest after her father's suicide. Today, the local forest is a place of rest, a source of energy and an adventure playground for them. The forest is deeply anchored in us Germans. History, myths and fairy tales as well as pop culture show this. Leon Windscheid discusses what the forest does to us as humans and why it is good for us as humans - including our psyche - with environmental medicine specialist Dr. Daniela Haluza from Vienna. She researches green public health and explains why the forest should become a component of preventative medicine: as a de-stressor in a stressful, increasingly digital life. Studies have shown that just 15 to 20 minutes in the forest can have a positive effect on us. Marc also went into the forest to find himself again and get healthy. Depression and burnout have shown him that he can no longer live as before. The forest was his lifeline. Prof. Dr. explains how much the forest influences us. Simone Kuhn, head of the environmental neuroscience research area at the Max Planck Institute for Human Development in Berlin. She shows us her study results clearly on the MRI scanner - how the influence of the forest has a positive effect on our brains. Especially in a world that is becoming increasingly urban, it is important to give nature space in the city - for our health. / Marc lebt seit 12 Jahren im Wald. Psychologe Leon Windscheid besucht ihn im Odenwald und will wissen, wieso er so einen radikalen Schritt gegangen ist, und was der Wald fur ihn verandert hat.Naturfotografin Ulla Lohmann hat nach dem Suizid ihres Vaters oft im Wald nach Antworten gesucht. Heute ist der heimische Wald fur sie ein Ruheort, Energiegeber und Abenteuerspielplatz.Der Wald ist tief in uns Deutschen verankert. Das zeigen Geschichte, Mythen und Marchen und auch die Popkultur. Was der Wald mit uns Menschen macht und warum er uns Menschen - auch unserer Psyche - guttut, bespricht Leon Windscheid mit der Umweltmedizinerin Dr. Daniela Haluza aus Wien. Sie forscht zu Green Public Health und erklart, warum der Wald ein Bestandteil der Vorsorgemedizin werden sollte: als Entstressor in einem stressigen, immer digitaler werdenden Leben. Studien haben gezeigt, dass schon 15 bis 20 Minuten im Wald einen positiven Effekt auf uns haben konnen.Auch Marc ist in den Wald gegangen, um wieder zu sich selbst zu finden und gesund zu werden. Depressionen und Burnout haben ihm gezeigt, dass er nicht mehr weiterleben kann wie zuvor. Der Wald war sein Rettungsanker.Wie sehr der Wald Einfluss auf uns nimmt, erklart auch Prof. Dr. Simone Kuhn, Leiterin des Forschungsbereichs Umweltneurowissenschaften des Max-Planck-Instituts fur Bildungsforschung in Berlin. Sie zeigt uns ihre Studienergebnisse ganz plastisch am MRT-Scanner - wie sich der Einfluss des Waldes positiv auf unsere Gehirne auswirkt. Denn gerade in einer immer urbaner werdenden Welt ist es wichtig, der Natur Platz in der Stadt zu geben - fur unsere Gesundheit.

programme.title: Der Alte
programme.desc: Sylvia Kramer is found bludgeoned to death near a cemetery. The committed journalist traveled worldwide. Does the murder have something to do with this? Shortly before her death, Sylvia wanted to speak to her daughter Laura, whose baby had died six months earlier. The question of guilt is being examined in the ongoing court proceedings. The questioning requires great sensitivity from Voss and his team, because Laura is said to have shaken her baby to death. Voss feels that the death of the infant will be the key to solving the murder of Sylvia Kramer. The presiding judge in the trial against Laura Fischer, Emma Horvath, states that there was an argument in the courtroom between Laura and her mother. Before her murder, the journalist wrote an article about the trial against her daughter. Did Sylvia Kramer blame her daughter Laura for the death of her grandchild and did she have to die because of that? The exact research documents that would shed light on the matter have disappeared from her apartment. Steffen Polter, a colleague of Sylvia Kramer, behaves extremely strangely. In addition, the court expert Hannes Maier, who was commissioned in the trial, is more interested in money and fame than in his work. And why does Emma Horvath regularly go for a walk by the cemetery to relax? The deeper the investigators dig, the more mysterious the case becomes. / Sylvia Kramer wird in der Nahe eines Friedhofs erschlagen aufgefunden. Die engagierte Journalistin war weltweit unterwegs. Hat der Mord damit zu tun?Kurz vor ihrem Tod wollte Sylvia ihre Tochter Laura sprechen, deren Baby ein halbes Jahr zuvor zu Tode gekommen war. Im laufenden Gerichtsverfahren wird die Schuldfrage gepruft.Die Befragung verlangt von Voss und seinem Team ein groSSes Fingerspitzengefuhl, denn Laura soll ihr Baby totgeschuttelt haben. Voss spurt, dass der Tod des Sauglings der Schlussel zur Aufklarung des Mordes an Sylvia Kramer sein wird.Die im Prozess gegen Laura Fischer Vorsitzende Richterin Emma Horvath gibt zu Protokoll, dass es zwischen Laura und deren Mutter einen Streit im Gerichtssaal gegeben habe. Vor ihrer Ermordung schrieb die Journalistin an einem Artikel, der sich mit dem Prozess gegen ihre Tochter befasste. Gab Sylvia Kramer ihrer Tochter Laura die Schuld am Tod des Enkelkindes, und musste sie deshalb sterben?Aus ihrer Wohnung sind genau die recherchierten Unterlagen verschwunden, die Licht ins Dunkel bringen wurden. Steffen Polter, ein Kollege von Sylvia Kramer, verhalt sich auSSerst seltsam. AuSSerdem ist der im Prozess beauftragte Gerichtsgutachter Hannes Maier mehr an Geld und Ruhm interessiert als an seiner Arbeit. Und warum geht Emma Horvath regelmaSSig zur Entspannung am Friedhof spazieren?Je tiefer die Ermittler graben, desto ratselhafter wird der Fall.

programme.title: Welten-Saga
programme.desc: Christopher Clark encounters fire-breathing volcanoes, wild nature and solemn rituals in Indonesia. It shows the island state's major world heritage sites between modernity and tradition. The Buddhist temple of Borobudur bears witness to the ancient history of Indonesia, as do the Hindu temples of Prambanan, as well as mosques and colonial buildings. The historian Clark researches the rainforest and irrigation systems in Bali and immerses himself in the culture. The eternal rattling of motorbikes alongside meditative immersion in ancient rituals. Modern metropolises next to rice cultivation like thousands of years ago. An almost paradisiacal island world and the constant threat of volcanoes, earthquakes and tsunamis - Indonesia's diversity is difficult to fully grasp. Sir Christopher travels to the Ujung Kulon National Park and meets people who take a very close look at the Anak Krakatau volcano. He visits the world famous temples of Borobudur and Prambanan. He also encounters the exuberant creative joy of Indonesian artists from many centuries in the Kotagede Mosque and the Taman Sari Water Palace. The colonial buildings of Yogyakarta tell of the cruel history of the rule of European powers in Indonesia. Both the Dutch and the British exploited the land and people. Time seems to have stood still on the island of Bali. The Subak irrigation cooperative still regulates the communal cultivation of rice and is just as ritually structured as the everyday life of the Balinese. In order to understand the special nature of Indonesia, Christopher Clark asks many questions. How do the Indonesians, 90 percent of whom are Muslims, manage to preserve their diverse religious heritage? Is this due to their history with ancient trade relationships with the Chinese, Portuguese and Arabs? Does the harmonious coexistence also have something to do with the mixing of religions, which is so old that it has become a permanent tradition? The prime example of this is Wayang Kulit, the shadow theater popular throughout Indonesia. Everything flows together here: ancestor worship, Hindu epics, Islamic heroes, traditional music and a puppeteer who has the responsibility of a priest.Second and final part "Terra X: World Saga" / Feuerspeiende Vulkane, wilde Natur und feierliche Rituale begegnen Christopher Clark in Indonesien. Er zeigt die groSSen Weltkulturerbestatten des Inselstaates zwischen Moderne und Tradition.Der buddhistische Tempel von Borobudur zeugt ebenso von der uralten Geschichte Indonesiens wie die Hindutempel von Prambanan, wie Moscheen und koloniale Bauten. Der Historiker Clark erforscht den Regenwald und Bewasserungssysteme auf Bali und taucht in die Kultur ein.Das ewige Geknatter der Motorrader neben meditativer Versenkung in uralte Rituale. Moderne Metropolen neben Reisanbau wie vor tausenden von Jahren. Eine fast paradiesische Inselwelt und die standige Bedrohung durch Vulkane, Erdbeben und Tsunamis - Indonesien ist in seiner Vielfaltigkeit kaum vollstandig zu erfassen.Sir Christopher bereist den Ujung Kulon Nationalpark und trifft Menschen, die einen ganz genauen Blick auf den Vulkan Anak Krakatau werfen. Er besucht die weltberuhmten Tempel von Borobudur und Prambanan. Auch in der Kotagede Moschee und im Taman Sari Wasserpalast begegnet er der uberbordenden Gestaltungsfreude indonesischer Kunstler aus vielen Jahrhunderten. Die Kolonialbauten Yogyakartas erzahlen von der grausamen Geschichte der Herrschaft europaischer Machte in Indonesien. Sowohl die Hollander als auch die Briten beuteten Land und Menschen aus.Auf der Insel Bali scheint die Zeit stehen geblieben zu sein. Die Subak-Bewasserungsgenossenschaft regelt immer noch den gemeinschaftlichen Anbau des Reises und ist ebenso rituell strukturiert wie etwa das Alltagsleben der Balinesen.Um die Besonderheit Indonesiens zu verstehen, stellt Christopher Clark viele Fragen. Wie schaffen es die Indonesier, die doch zu 90 Prozent dem Islam angehoren, ihr so vielschichtiges religioses Erbe zu bewahren? Liegt dies an ihrer Geschichte mit uralten Handelsbeziehungen zu Chinesen, Portugiesen und Arabern? Hat das harmonische Miteinander auch etwas mit der Vermischung der Religionen zu tun, die so alt ist, dass sie feste Tradition geworden ist?Das Paradebeispiel hierfur ist Wayang Kulit, das uberall in Indonesien beliebte Schattentheater. Hier flieSSt alles zusammen: Ahnenkult, hinduistische Epen, islamische Helden, traditionelle Musik und ein Puppenspieler, der die Verantwortung eines Priesters tragt.Zweiter und letzter Teil "Terra X: Welten-Saga"

programme.title: Inga Lindstrom: Heart over head / Inga Lindstrom: Herz uber Kopf
programme.desc: When Nora loses her job as a veterinarian, she travels to the country to sell her Grandma Alma's house. There she meets her childhood sweetheart Samu again, who once left her. But she also meets Ole, a charming skipper of the world's oceans. Then Nora learns that Samu is to lose guardianship of Binta, his late sister's daughter. While searching for the girl's unknown father, the two become closer. / Als Nora ihren Job als Tierarztin verliert, reist sie aufs Land, um das Haus ihrer Oma Alma zu verkaufen. Dort trifft sie ihre Jugendliebe Samu wieder, der sie einst verlassen hat.Sie begegnet aber auch Ole, einem charmanten Skipper der Weltmeere. Dann erfahrt Nora, dass Samu die Vormundschaft fur Binta, die Tochter seiner verstorbenen Schwester, verlieren soll. Bei der Suche nach dem unbekannten Vater des Madchens nahern die beiden sich an.

programme.title: Weiss and Morales
programme.desc: Free TV premiereThe murder of an entrepreneur worries the German community on Gran Canaria. Once again, Nina Weiss is supposed to interrupt her vacation and support Raúl Morales in his investigation. The dead person is Sebastián Santana, co-founder of a coliving start-up for digital nomads - people who only need their smartphone and a laptop to do their work and who can choose where they settle. Together with the Canarian investigator Raúl Morales (Miguel Ángel Silvestre), Nina (Katia Fellin) comes across a web of lies, affairs and blackmail. The focus is on German vacationer Maren Schultz (Valerie Huber), who claims to be on the island for trail running. But their statements contradict each other, and their connection to the victim is revealed through a dating app and a fake profile. The investigation leads to a network of blackmailers who put men under pressure with compromising videos. Raúl doesn't have it easy in his private life either: his daughter Vivi (Iria Santana) senses that her parents' marriage is not going well - even if her father tries to resolve the disputes between him and his wife While Nina and Raúl try to reconstruct the truth, Nina also wants to face her own past: She is looking for her biological father - possibly a man who her mother Margarethe (Margarita Broich) only knew as "El Pintor" - "The Painter". Free TV premiere. / Free-TV-PremiereDer Mord an einem Unternehmer beunruhigt die deutsche Community auf Gran Canaria. Erneut soll Nina Weiss ihren Urlaub unterbrechen und Raúl Morales bei seinen Ermittlungen unterstutzen.Bei dem Toten handelt es sich um Sebastián Santana, Mitgrunder eines Coliving-Start-ups fur digitale Nomaden - Menschen, die nur ihr Smartphone und einen Laptop brauchen, um ihre Arbeit zu machen und die es sich aussuchen konnen, wo sie sich niederlassen.Gemeinsam mit dem kanarischen Ermittler Raúl Morales (Miguel Ángel Silvestre) stoSSt Nina (Katia Fellin) auf ein Geflecht aus Lugen, Affaren und Erpressung. Im Zentrum steht die deutsche Urlauberin Maren Schultz (Valerie Huber), die behauptet, zum Trailrunning auf der Insel zu sein. Doch ihre Aussagen widersprechen sich, und ihre Verbindung zum Opfer wird durch eine Dating-App und ein gefalschtes Profil aufgedeckt.Die Ermittlungen fuhren zu einem Netzwerk von Erpressern, das Manner mit kompromittierenden Videos unter Druck setzt.Raúl hat es auch privat nicht leicht: Seine Tochter Vivi (Iria Santana) spurt, dass es nicht gut um die Ehe ihrer Eltern steht - auch wenn ihr Vater versucht, die Streitigkeiten zwischen ihm und seiner Frau kleinzureden.Wahrend Nina und Raúl versuchen, die Wahrheit zu rekonstruieren, will Nina sich auch ihrer eigenen Vergangenheit stellen: Sie ist auf der Suche nach ihrem leiblichen Vater - moglicherweise einem Mann, den ihre Mutter Margarethe (Margarita Broich) nur als "El Pintor" - "Der Maler" - kannte.Free-TV-Premiere.

programme.title: Precht
programme.sub-title: Soziale Ungleichheit - Sprengstoff fur die Demokratie?
programme.desc: Wealth is very unequally distributed in Germany. How dangerous is this for our democracy? Richard David Precht discusses this with the political scientist Martyna Linartas. In hardly any other western country is wealth distributed as unequally as in Germany. Scientists see this as a big problem. Because: The more unequal a society becomes, the more social tensions develop and even endanger democracy. Linartas argues that Germany has developed from a performance society to a society of heirs. More than half of the wealth in Germany now comes from inheritances and donations. Wealth is therefore not earned, not earned, but inherited. Being born into a wealthy family determines life chances. It is therefore incomprehensible why social spending is seen as a problem - but the extremely unevenly distributed wealth is not. Because a policy that favors the rich and does little to combat poverty and social inequality is poison for social cohesion and undermines trust in democracy. In terms of the degree of wealth inequality, Germany is on the same level as countries like Mexico, warns Linartas. The richest 10 percent of households own more than half of all net wealth. The top 1 percent holds about 18 percent of the wealth. That is more than the poorest 75 percent combined. In principle, there is a consensus that taxes are the democratic means of choice not only to fill public coffers, but also to alleviate inequalities. However, Linartas attests that current politics lacks the will to ensure more justice, for example through a wealth tax, as it existed until the end of the 1990s. How fair is inheriting? How fair is it that the very rich cause disproportionately high levels of climate damage, to which all people are equally exposed? What is the relationship between wealth and power if you cut social benefits for those at the bottom, but do not hold the top 10 percent of Germans accountable accordingly? How urgent is it currently to counteract the tendencies of a society that is becoming dysfunctional due to inequality? Richard David Precht discusses this with the political scientist Martyna Linartas.Biography of Martyna Linartas: The political scientist Martyna Linartas was born in Poland in 1990 and now teaches at the Free University of Berlin. Linartas came to Germany with her family when she was just one year old and spent a whole year in a homeless shelter. She studied at the Free University of Berlin and received her doctorate summa cum laude in 2023. Between 2018 and 2021, Linartas worked as a press officer for Bundnis90/The Greens and for Annalena Baerbock's Bundestag office. In 2022 she founded the knowledge platform inequality.info. This year her book “Unearned Inequality” was published by Rowohlt Verlag. / Vermogen ist in Deutschland hochst ungleich verteilt. Wie gefahrlich ist das fur unsere Demokratie? Daruber diskutiert Richard David Precht mit der Politologin Martyna Linartas.In kaum einem anderen westlichen Land ist das Vermogen so ungleich verteilt wie in Deutschland. Wissenschaftler sehen darin ein groSSes Problem. Denn: Je ungleicher eine Gesellschaft wird, umso mehr entwickeln sich soziale Spannungen bis hin zur Gefahrdung der Demokratie.Linartas argumentiert, dass sich Deutschland von einer Leistungsgesellschaft zu einer Erbengesellschaft entwickelt hat. Das Vermogen in Deutschland ergibt sich mittlerweile zu mehr als der Halfte aus Erbschaften und Schenkungen. Vermogen wird demnach nicht erarbeitet, nicht verdient, sondern vererbt. Die Geburt in eine wohlhabende Familie entscheidet uber Lebenschancen.Es sei daher nicht nachzuvollziehen, warum ausgerechnet die Sozialausgaben als Problem angesehen werden - die extrem ungleich verteilten Vermogen aber nicht. Denn eine Politik, die Reiche bevorzugt und wenig gegen Armut und soziale Ungleichheit unternimmt, sei Gift fur den gesellschaftlichen Zusammenhalt und untergrabe das Vertrauen in die Demokratie.Bezogen auf den Grad der Vermogensungleichheit bewege sich Deutschland auf dem Niveau von Landern wie Mexiko, warnt Linartas. Die reichsten 10 Prozent der Haushalte besitzen mehr als die Halfte des gesamten Nettovermogens. Das oberste 1 Prozent halt etwa 18 Prozent des Vermogens. Das ist mehr als die armsten 75 Prozent zusammen.Grundsatzlich bestehe der Konsens, dass Steuern das demokratische Mittel der Wahl sind, um nicht nur die offentlichen Kassen zu fullen, sondern auch Ungleichheiten abzumildern. Linartas attestiert der aktuellen Politik jedoch einen mangelnden Willen, etwa durch eine Vermogenssteuer, wie sie bis Ende der 1990er Jahre noch bestand, fur mehr Gerechtigkeit zu sorgen.Wie gerecht ist erben? Wie gerecht ist es, dass etwa gerade die Überreichen unverhaltnismaSSig hohe Klimaschaden verursachen, denen aber alle Menschen gleichermaSSen ausgesetzt sind? In welchem Verhaltnis stehen Vermogen und Macht, wenn man die Sozialleistungen fur die ganz unten beschneidet, aber die oberen 10 Prozent der Deutschen nicht entsprechend in die Pflicht nimmt? Wie dringlich ist es gegenwartig, den Tendenzen einer durch Ungleichheit dysfunktional werdenden Gesellschaft entgegenzuwirken? Daruber diskutiert Richard David Precht mit der Politologin Martyna Linartas.Biografie Martyna Linartas: Die Politikwissenschaftlerin Martyna Linartas wurde 1990 in Polen geboren und lehrt heute an der Freien Universitat Berlin. Linartas kam bereits im ersten Lebensjahr mit ihrer Familie nach Deutschland und verbrachte ein ganzes Jahr in einer Obdachlosenunterkunft. Sie studierte an der Freien Universitat Berlin und wurden 2023 mit summa cum laude promoviert. Zwischen 2018 und 2021 arbeitete Linartas als Pressereferentin fur Bundnis90/Die Grunen sowie fur das Bundestagsburo von Annalena Baerbock. 2022 grundete sie die Wissensplattform ungleichheit.info. In diesem Jahr erschien ihr Buch "Unverdiente Ungleichheit" im Rowohlt Verlag.

Description: Sotiris Kostavaras. / UEFA Europa League 2025-26. League Phase, 3η Αγωνιστική. programme.title: Sports Classics: Football Countdowns Ε6
programme.desc: Football is a numbers game. Goals scored, points, transfer amounts or even the number on the shirt, all are incorporated into the fascinating background of football culture. Κάθε επεισόδιο απαριθμεί τις 10 καλύτερες και χειρότερες από αυτές τις στιγμές.

programme.desc: The show for all developments in the motorsport championships hosted by COSMOTE TV (MotoGP, WRC, ERC, DTM). / Η εκπομπή για όλες τις εξελίξεις στα πρωταθλήματα μηχανοκίνητου αθλητισμού που φιλοξενεί η COSMΟΤΕ TV (MotoGP, WRC, ERC, DTM).

programme.title: Motorsports: Moto3 2025 (Ζ)
programme.desc: Malaysian Grand Prix (1st Free Practice). The 2025 FIM Moto3 World Championship brings together 13 teams from 2 manufacturers, as well as 27 riders, competing in 22 Grands Prix. Description: Thanasis Kelafis. / Γκραν Πρι Μαλαισίας (1ες Ελεύθερες Δοκιμές). Το Παγκόσμιο Πρωτάθλημα FIM Moto3 του 2025 συγκεντρώνει 13 ομάδες από 2 κατασκευαστές, αλλά και 27 αναβάτες, οι οποίοι διαγωνίζονται σε 22 Γκραν Πρι. Περιγραφή: Θανάσης Κελάφης.

programme.title: Motorsports: Moto2 2025 (Ζ)
programme.desc: Malaysian Grand Prix (1st Free Practice). The 2025 FIM Moto2 World Championship features 15 teams from 3 manufacturers and a total of 30 riders. The final winner will be decided through 22 exciting Grand Prix. Description: Thanasis Kelafis. / Γκραν Πρι Μαλαισίας (1ες Ελεύθερες Δοκιμές). Το Παγκόσμιο Πρωτάθλημα FIM Moto2 2025 περιλαμβάνει 15 ομάδες από 3 κατασκευαστές και συνολικά 30 αναβάτες. Ο τελικός νικητής θα κριθεί μέσα από 22 συναρπαστικά Γκραν Πρι. Περιγραφή: Θανάσης Κελάφης.

programme.title: Motorsports: MotoGP 2025 (Ζ)
programme.desc: Malaysian Grand Prix (1st Free Practice). The 2025 FIM MotoGP World Championship comprises 11 teams and a total of 22 riders, competing for the title through 22 Grands Prix. Description: Dimitris Diatsidis. / Γκραν Πρι Μαλαισίας (1ες Ελεύθερες Δοκιμές). Το Παγκόσμιο Πρωτάθλημα FIM MotoGP 2025 περιλαμβάνει 11 ομάδες και συνολικά 22 αναβάτες, που διεκδικούν τον τίτλο μέσα από 22 Γκραν Πρι. Περιγραφή: Δημήτρης Διατσίδης.

programme.title: Necessary Light (E) / Απαραίτητο Φως (Ε)
programme.desc: Louisa Lascaratou is and works. daughter of a great lawyer of Athens. His sudden death forces her to return from abroad, where she lives and works. Based on the book of the same title by Dorina Papaliou. / Η Λουίζα Λασκαράτου είναι και εργάζεται. κόρη μεγαλοδικηγόρου της Αθήνας. Ο ξαφνικός θάνατός του την αναγκάζει να επιστρέψει από το εξωτερικό, όπου ζει και εργάζεται. Βασισμένο στο ομότιτλο βιβλίο της Ντορίνας Παπαλιού.

programme.title: PDO Cooking K9 (E) / ΠΟΠ Μαγειρική Κ9 (Ε)
programme.desc: Chef Andreas Lagos cooks with certified Greek products and together with derivatives, nutritionists and specialized scientists, teach us the secrets of proper nutrition. / Ο chef Ανδρέας Λαγός μαγειρεύει με πιστοποιημένα ελληνικά προϊόντα και μαζί με παράγωγους, διατροφολόγους και εξειδικευμένους επιστήμονες, μας μαθαίνουν τα μυστικά της σωστής διατροφής.

programme.title: And Yet I'm Still Here E16 (E) / Κι Όμως Είμαι Ακόμα Εδώ Ε16 (Ε)
programme.desc: Just before Alexander and Katerina's first kiss, a fire alarm goes off and they leave the roof. The alarm has been raised by Natasha, who has seen them, and Markella covers her. / Λίγο πριν το πρώτο φιλί του Αλέξανδρου και της Κατερίνας χτυπάει συναγερμός για φωτιά και φεύγουν απ την ταράτσα. Τον συναγερμό έχει χτυπήσει η Νατάσα, που τους έχει δει, και η Μαρκέλλα την καλύπτει.

programme.title: In Foreign Hands E79 (E) / Σε Ξένα Χέρια Ε79 (Ε)
programme.desc: The revelations at Fegoudis' house become an avalanche that threatens to sweep everyone away. Dioni tries to fight off the attacks, while Dando struggles to reveal the truth. / Οι αποκαλύψεις στο σπίτι του Φεγκούδη γίνονται χιονοστιβάδα που απειλεί να παρασύρει τους πάντες. Η Διώνη προσπαθεί να αντικρούσει τις επιθέσεις, όσο η Ντάντω πασχίζει να έρθει στο φως η αλήθεια.

programme.title: In Foreign Hands E80 (E) / Σε Ξένα Χέρια Ε80 (Ε)
programme.desc: Those in Fegoudi's house are disturbed by the shots that are heard. During a fight, Charalambos pushes Piperopoulos and loses consciousness. / Όσοι βρίσκονται στο σπίτι του Φεγκούδη αναστατώνονται από τους πυροβολισμούς που ακούγονται. Πάνω σε έναν καυγά, ο Χαράλαμπος σπρώχνει τον Πιπερόπουλο και χάνει τις αισθήσεις του.

programme.title: Early - Early / Νωρίς - Νωρίς
programme.desc: Hosted by Krateros Katsoulis and Maria Iliakis - a dynamic duo with chemistry, experience and endless humor - the show offers daily, positive energy, happy news and many daily moments that make us smile. / Με οικοδεσπότες τον Κρατερό Κατσούλη και τη Μαρία Ηλιάκη -ένα δυναμικό δίδυμο με χημεία, εμπειρία και αστείρευτο χιούμορ - η εκπομπή προσφέρει καθημερινά, θετική ενέργεια, ευχάριστες ειδήσεις και πολλές καθημερινές στιγμές που μας κάνουν να χαμογελάμε.

programme.title: See you in the morning / Πρωίαν Σε Είδον
programme.desc: The favorite morning magazine returns for the fourth year and for three hours every day, Fotis Sergoulopoulos and Jenny Melita welcome us with their familiar smile, in a show that stands out. / Το αγαπημένο πρωινό μαγκαζίνο επιστρέφει για τέταρτη χρονιά και για τρεις ώρες καθημερινά, ο Φώτης Σεργουλόπουλος και η Τζένη Μελιτά μάς υποδέχονται με το γνώριμο χαμόγελό τους, σε μια εκπομπή που ξεχωρίζει.

programme.title: News - Sports - Weather / Ειδήσεις - Αθλητικά - Καιρός
programme.desc: Follow the latest developments at national and international level and be informed in a timely and objective manner about the important issues of current affairs from the ERT news team. / Παρακολουθήστε τις τελευταίες εξελίξεις σε εθνικό αλλά και διεθνές επίπεδο και ενημερωθείτε έγκαιρα και αντικειμενικά για τα σημαντικά ζητήματα της επικαιρότητας από την ειδησεογραφική ομάδα της ΕΡΤ.

programme.title: Electra K3 E24 (E) / Ηλέκτρα Κ3 Ε24 (Ε)
programme.desc: Pilidis signs his statement. Sotiris was in the last stage of leukemia, there are also the relevant tests. Nikolas is sure of what has happened, that this was all a plan of his brother. / Ο Πιλίδης υπογράφει την κατάθεση του. Ο Σωτήρης ήταν στο τελευταίο στάδιο λευχαιμίας, υπάρχουν και οι σχετικές εξετάσεις. Ο Νικόλας, είναι σίγουρος για το τι έχει συμβεί, ότι όλο αυτό ήταν ένα σχέδιο του αδελφού του.

programme.title: PDO Cooking K9 / ΠΟΠ Μαγειρική Κ9
programme.desc: Episode: Theodora Tzimou. The suggestive actress brings to the kitchen of chef Andreas Lagos the interiority and delicacy that characterize her. Aristotelian cheese from Halkidiki and Kissouri PDO honey are combined in dishes with depth, contrasts and sweet harmony. / Επεισόδιο: Θεοδώρα Τζήμου. Η υποβλητική ηθοποιός φέρνει στην κουζίνα του σεφ Ανδρέα Λαγού την εσωτερικότητα και τη λεπτότητα που τη χαρακτηρίζουν. Αριστοτέλειον τυρί Χαλκιδικής και μέλι Κισσούρι ΠΟΠ συνδυάζονται σε πιάτα με βάθος, αντιθέσεις και γλυκιά αρμονία.

programme.title: Studio 4 / Στούντιο 4
programme.desc: Nancy Zampetoglou and Thanasis Anagnostopoulos return for the fifth year to talk about everything that concerns us, inspires us, amuses us or moves us. / H Νάνσυ Ζαμπέτογλου και ο Θανάσης Αναγνωστόπουλος επιστρέφουν για πέμπτη χρονιά για να μιλήσουν για όλα όσα μας απασχολούν, μας εμπνέουν, μας διασκεδάζουν ή μας συγκινούν.

programme.title: Central News Bulletin - Sports - Weather / Κεντρικό Δελτίο Ειδήσεων - Αθλητικά - Καιρός
programme.desc: With correspondents in every corner of Greece and all over the world, ERT's central news bulletin brings to every home the daily report, the breaking news, but also what affects our lives. / Με ανταποκριτές σε κάθε γωνιά της Ελλάδας και σε όλο τον κόσμο το κεντρικό δελτίο ειδήσεων της ΕΡΤ μεταφέρει σε κάθε σπίτι το καθημερινό ρεπορτάζ, τις έκτακτες ειδήσεις, αλλά και όσα επηρεάζουν τη ζωή μας.

programme.title: The Guy with the Tricycle / Ο Μάγκας με το Τρίκυκλο
programme.desc: Motivated by his love for a beautiful woman, George, a kind but uncouth fellow, zealously devotes himself to learning the rules of good behavior. But will he finally be able to charm the chosen one of his heart? (101) / Με κίνητρο τον έρωτά του για μια όμορφη γυναίκα, ο Γιώργος, ένας αγαθός μα άξεστος μάγκας, επιδίδεται με ζήλο στην εκμάθηση των κανόνων καλής συμπεριφοράς. Μα θα καταφέρει τελικά να γοητεύσει την εκλεκτή της καρδιάς του; (101)

programme.title: The Adventures of Hercule Poirot K12 E3 / Οι Περιπέτειες του Ηρακλή Πουαρό Κ12 Ε3
programme.desc: Episode: Crime On The Horizon Express. Hercule Poirot hastily travels back to England from Constantinople. During the trip, an American businessman is found murdered and the famous detective is called upon to solve the mystery. / Επεισόδιο: Έγκλημα Στο Όριαν Εξπρές. Ο Ηρακλής Πουαρό ταξιδεύει εσπευσμένα πίσω στην Αγγλία από την Κων/πολη. Στη διάρκεια του ταξιδιού ένας Αμερικανός επιχειρηματίας βρίσκεται δολοφονημένος και ο διάσημος ντετέκτιβ καλείται να εξιχνιάσει το μυστήριο.

programme.title: The Network K2 E6 / Το Δίχτυ Κ2 Ε6
programme.desc: Episode: Missing. Anthi, a teenager, disappears from her home one night and the next morning her father, Stefanos, reports her abduction to Antigone. He is sure that someone broke into the house at night and took her. Time is running backwards. / Επεισόδιο: Αγνοούμενη. Η Ανθή, μία έφηβη, εξαφανίζεται από το σπίτι της ένα βράδυ και το επόμενο πρωί ο πατέρας της, Στέφανος, καταγγέλλει την απαγωγή της στην Αντιγόνη. Είναι σίγουρος πως κάποιος μπήκε στο σπίτι τη νύχτα και την πήρε. Ο χρόνος κυλά αντίστροφα.

programme.title: See How the Other Half Steals / Δες Πώς Κλέβουν οι Άλλοι Μισοί
programme.desc: Two brothers stage a risky heist during a NASCAR race in North Carolina. (114) / Δύο αδέρφια οργανώνουν μια ριψοκίνδυνη ληστεία στη διάρκεια ενός αγώνα ΝASCAR στη Βόρεια Καρολίνα. (114)

programme.desc: Katerina is hurt as soon as she learns that Alexandros is leaving with his fiancee for Switzerland, so she agrees to marry Dimitris. She finds flowers on her mother's grave and hopes that her father left them. / Η Κατερίνα πληγώνεται μόλις μαθαίνει πως ο Αλέξανδρος φεύγει με την αρραβωνιαστικιά του για την Ελβετία κι έτσι δέχεται να παντρευτεί τον Δημήτρη. Στον τάφο της μητέρας της βρίσκει λουλούδια κι ελπίζει ότι τα έχει αφήσει ο πατέρας της.

programme.title: And Yet I'm Still Here E18 (E) / Κι Όμως Είμαι Ακόμα Εδώ Ε18 (Ε)
programme.desc: As soon as Katerina hears that she will not die, she is shocked, faints and Alexandros takes her to the clinic. Katerina is in a coma and when she wakes up, she doesn't remember anything about the conversation with Alexander. / Η Κατερίνα μόλις ακούει ότι δεν θα πεθάνει, παθαίνει σοκ, λιποθυμάει κι ο Αλέξανδρος την πηγαίνει στην κλινική. Η Κατερίνα είναι σε λήθαργο κι όταν συνέρχεται, δεν θυμάται τίποτα απ την συζήτηση με τον Αλέξανδρο.

Ολοκληρώνει το ταξίδι της στην γραφική και παραδοσιακή Αρναία.

programme.desc: Informative broadcast which focuses daily on current affairs and special topics, in concentric circles, with an emphasis on Thessaloniki, the regions of the country, our neighboring countries and the Community. / Ενημερωτική εκπομπή η οποία επικεντρώνει καθημερινά στην επικαιρότητα και σε ειδικά θέματα, σε ομόκεντρους κύκλους, με έμφαση τη Θεσσαλονίκη, τις περιφέρειες της χώρας, τις γειτονικές μας χώρες και την Ομογένεια.

programme.title: News from the Region / Ειδήσεις από την Περιφέρεια
programme.desc: Find out about all the latest news from the region. / Ενημερωθείτε για όλα τα τελευταία νέα από την περιφέρεια.

programme.title: The Salt of the Earth K11 (E) / Το Αλάτι της Γης Κ11 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The Three Goods of the Earth: Wheat, Wine, Oil. A tribute to songs about the three goods of the Earth: the wheat, the vine and the olive. At a time when the climate crisis is becoming a permanent threat, these songs reconnect us with the matrix of nature. / Επεισόδιο: Τα Τρία Αγαθά της Γης: Σίτος, Οίνος, Έλαιον. Ένα αφιέρωμα σε τραγούδια για τα τρία αγαθά της Γης: το σιτάρι, το αμπέλι και την ελιά. Σε μία εποχή που η κλιματική κρίση εξελίσσεται σε μόνιμη απειλή, τα τραγούδια αυτά μάς επανασυνδέουν με τη μήτρα της φύσης.

programme.title: Wild Greece K3 E10 (E) / Άγρια Ελλάδα Κ3 Ε10 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Rhodes. Elias and Grigoris visit the Dodecanese and the island of Colossus, Rhodes. In the highlands they find rare, endemic plants and on the south side they spot and closely observe the island's wild deer. / Επεισόδιο: Ρόδος. Ο Ηλίας και ο Γρηγόρης επισκέπτονται τα Δωδεκάνησα και το νησί του Κολοσσού, τη Ρόδο. Στα ορεινά βρίσκουν σπάνια, ενδημικά φυτά και στη νότια πλευρά εντοπίζουν και παρατηρούν από κοντά τα άγρια ελάφια του νησιού.

programme.title: Waterscapes in Europe E5 (E) / Υδάτινα Τοπία στην Ευρώπη Ε5 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The Spreewald. A network of river branches and canals, with a total length of almost 1,000 km: the Spreewald. Fed by the River Spree, an outstanding natural and cultural waterscape has emerged in southeastern Brandenburg. / Επεισόδιο: Το Σπρέεβαλντ. Ένα δίκτυο ποτάμιων κλάδων και καναλιών, με συνολικό μήκος σχεδόν 1.000 χιλιομέτρων: το Σπρέεβαλντ. Τροφοδοτούμενο από τον ποταμό Σπρέε, ένα εξαιρετικό φυσικό και πολιτιστικό υδάτινο τοπίο έχει αναδυθεί στο νοτιοανατολικό Βρανδεμβούργο.

programme.title: News from the Region / Ειδήσεις από την Περιφέρεια
programme.desc: Find out about all the latest news from the region. / Ενημερωθείτε για όλα τα τελευταία νέα από την περιφέρεια.

programme.title: Acrites E3 (E) / Ακρίτες Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Fracto: The Acrites of the Forest. In the Rhodope Fence, on the border with Bulgaria, is the country's only virgin forest, with dozens of animals and birds, abundant water and untouched places. Logging is allowed around the perimeter and the place becomes the home of forest workers. / Επεισόδιο: Φρακτό: Οι Ακρίτες του Δάσους. Στο Φρακτό της Ροδόπης, στα σύνορα με τη Βουλγαρία, βρίσκεται το μοναδικό παρθένο δάσος της χώρας, με δεκάδες ζώα και πτηνά, άφθονα νερά και ανέγγιχτα μέρη. Περιμετρικά επιτρέπεται η υλοτομία και το μέρος γίνεται το σπίτι των δασεργατών.

programme.title: The Vineyards of the World E20 (E) / Οι Αμπελώνες του Κόσμου Ε20 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The Imperial Elixir. 250 kilometers northeast of Budapest, Mount Tokai towers over the Hungarian plains. There they make a sweet wine exceptional for its history and the only wine featured in the country's national anthem. / Επεισόδιο: Το Αυτοκρατορικό Ελιξήριο. 250 χιλιόμετρα βορειοανατολικά της Βουδαπέστης, το όρος Τοκάιγ δεσπόζει πάνω από τις πεδιάδες της Ουγγαρίας. Εκεί φτιάχνουν ένα γλυκό κρασί εξαιρετικό για την ιστορία του και το μοναδικό κρασί που εμφανίζεται στον εθνικό ύμνο της χώρας.

programme.title: Incredible Train Journeys K3 E4 (E) / Απίθανα Ταξίδια με Τρένο Κ3 Ε4 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Philippines. The Philippines consists of over seven thousand islands. So it's hard to imagine going by train! And yet it is possible. Starting from the capital, Manila, Philippe begins his journey at a particularly quiet station, despite the rush hour. / Επεισόδιο: Φιλιππίνες. Οι Φιλιππίνες αποτελούνται από πάνω από επτά χιλιάδες νησιά. Έτσι είναι δύσκολο να φανταστούμε να πηγαίνουμε με τρένο! Και όμως είναι δυνατό. Ξεκινώντας από την πρωτεύουσα, τη Μανίλα, ο Philippe ξεκινάει το ταξίδι του σε έναν ιδιαίτερα ήσυχο σταθμό, παρά την ώρα αιχμής.

programme.title: Hope E3 / Ελπίδα Ε3
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Episode: Metamorphosis. Behind these changes there is always an impenetrable barrier: the economy and the financial system. We explore the economic theory of the donut and understand how to prosper without depleting the planet's resources. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Επεισόδιο: Μεταμόρφωση. Πίσω από αυτές τις αλλαγές υπάρχει πάντα ένα αδιαπέραστο εμπόδιο: η οικονομία και το χρηματοπιστωτικό σύστημα. Εξερευνούμε την οικονομική θεωρία του ντόνατ και κατανοούμε πώς θα ευημερήσουμε χωρίς να εξαντλούμε τους πόρους του πλανήτη.

programme.title: In the Deep Garden / Στο Βάθος Κήπος
programme.desc: Phaedonas and Anastasia, a young couple, decide to stay together and start a family. But things will soon go off schedule, due to a hole that Phaedon digs in the garden to plant a palm tree. (90) / Ο Φαίδωνας και η Αναστασία, ένα νέο ζευγάρι, αποφασίζουν να μείνουν μαζί και να κάνουν οικογένεια. Όμως τα πράγματα σύντομα θα βγουν εκτός προγράμματος, με αφορμή μια τρύπα που σκάβει ο Φαίδωνας στον κήπο για να φυτέψει ένα φοίνικα. (90)

programme.title: Short Stories / Μικρές Ιστορίες
programme.desc: Pilala. Against the backdrop of the magical summer of 2000, in a village in Crete, the boy is running against time. He has to overcome all the obstacles in his way to reach his grandfather's cafe in time. / Πιλάλα. Με φόντο το μαγικό καλοκαίρι του 2000, σε ένα χωριό της Κρήτης, το αγόρι τρέχει με αντίπαλο τον χρόνο. Πρέπει να ξεπεράσει όλα τα εμπόδια που βρίσκει στον δρόμο του, για να φτάσει εγκαίρως στο καφενείο του παππού του.

programme.title: Short Stories / Μικρές Ιστορίες
programme.desc: It's a shame to see the bride before the wedding. Wedding dress rehearsal before the wedding. A phone call that changes everything. The angry bride decides to take revenge. As she passes, she scans what is in front of her. After all, it is important to see the bride before the wedding. / Είναι Γρουσουζιά να Δεις τη Νύφη Πριν το Γάμο. Πρόβα νυφικού πριν το γάμο. Ένα τηλεφώνημα που αλλάζει τα πάντα. Η νύφη οργισμένη αποφασίζει να εκδικηθεί. Στο πέρασμα της σαρώνει ότι βρίσκεται μπροστά της. Τελικά, είναι γρουσουζιά να δεις τη νύφη πριν το γάμο.

programme.title: Landscapes from High K2 E10 (E) / Τοπία από Ψηλά Κ2 Ε10 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Northern Spain - Part B We head into Spain covering the northern and southern half of the country. Spain is a country of huge contrasts - from idyllic beaches to snow-capped mountains, from lush green valleys to arid plains. / Επεισόδιο: Βόρεια Ισπανία - Μέρος Β. Κατευθυνόμαστε προς την Ισπανία καλύπτοντας το βόρειο και το νότιο μισό της χώρας. Η Ισπανία είναι μια χώρα τεράστιων αντιθέσεων - από ειδυλλιακές παραλίες μέχρι χιονισμένα βουνά, από καταπράσινες κοιλάδες μέχρι άνυδρες πεδιάδες.

programme.title: Enthymion Thessaloniki E1 (E) / Ενθύμιον Θεσσαλονίκης Ε1 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: 1912-1945: From Liberation to Occupation and Civil War. The first part of the tribute to the 100 years since the liberation of Thessaloniki starts with the decisive battles that led to the liberation of Thessaloniki and describes the events until the end of the Second World War. / Επεισόδιο: 1912-1945: Από την Απελευθέρωση έως την Κατοχή και τον Εμφύλιο. Το πρώτο μέρος του αφιερώματος στα 100 χρόνια από την απελευθέρωση της Θεσσαλονίκης έχει ως αφετηρία τις καθοριστικές μάχες που οδήγησαν στην απελευθέρωση της Θεσσαλονίκης και περιγράφει τα γεγονότα ως το τέλος του Β Παγκοσμίου Πολέμου.

programme.title: Solemn High Priestly Clerk (G) / Πανηγυρικό Αρχιερατικό Συλλείτουργο (Ζ)
programme.desc: Doxology for the Anniversary of the Liberation of the City of Thessaloniki. Connection with the Holy Church of Agios Dimitrios Poliouchos of Thessaloniki. / Δοξολογία για την Επέτειο Απελευθέρωσης της Πόλης της Θεσσαλονίκης. Σύνδεση με τον Ιερό Ναό Αγίου Δημητρίου Πολιούχου Θεσσαλονίκης.

programme.title: With Virtue and Courage / Με Αρετή και Τόλμη
programme.desc: Update on the activities of the Ministry of National Defense and the Armed Forces. / Ενημέρωση για τις δραστηριότητες του Υπουργείου Εθνικής Άμυνας και των Ένοπλων Δυνάμεων.

programme.title: Two Centuries of History (E) / Δύο Αιώνες Ιστορίας (Ε)
programme.desc: The show takes us on a tour of the very interesting collection of Vassilis Nikoltsios, with military and other historical relics, which is housed in the War Museum of Thessaloniki. / Η εκπομπή μας ξεναγεί στην πολύ ενδιαφέρουσα συλλογή του Βασίλη Νικόλτσιου, με στρατιωτικά και άλλα ιστορικά κειμήλια, η οποία φιλοξενείται στο Πολεμικό μουσείο Θεσσαλονίκης.

programme.title: The Century of Thessaloniki (E) / Ο Αιώνας της Θεσσαλονίκης (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Thessaloniki emerging 1900 - 1912. The 20th century was for Thessaloniki a decisive period in its 23 centuries of existence. The episode covers the period from 1900 to the Balkan wars, describing the conditions prevailing in the city at the turn of the century. / Επεισόδιο: Θεσσαλονίκη αναδυόμενη 1900 - 1912. Ο 20ός αιώνας ήταν για την Θεσσαλονίκη μια αποφασιστική περίοδος στους 23 αιώνες της ύπαρξής της. Το επεισόδιο καλύπτει την περίοδο από το 1900 έως τους Βαλκανικούς πολέμους, περιγράφονται οι συνθήκες που επικρατούσαν στην πόλη στο γύρισμα του αιώνα.

programme.title: Perimeter / Περίμετρος
programme.desc: Informative broadcast which focuses daily on current affairs and special topics, in concentric circles, with an emphasis on Thessaloniki, the regions of the country, our neighboring countries and the Community. / Ενημερωτική εκπομπή η οποία επικεντρώνει καθημερινά στην επικαιρότητα και σε ειδικά θέματα, σε ομόκεντρους κύκλους, με έμφαση τη Θεσσαλονίκη, τις περιφέρειες της χώρας, τις γειτονικές μας χώρες και την Ομογένεια.

programme.title: News from the Region / Ειδήσεις από την Περιφέρεια
programme.desc: Find out about all the latest news from the region. / Ενημερωθείτε για όλα τα τελευταία νέα από την περιφέρεια.

programme.title: Sunday in Chorio Xana K5 / Κυριακή στο Χωριό Ξανά Κ5
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Episode: Neohorouda. The show maps culture in ever-shrinking places. The village, however, remains a vibrant cell of well-being. Kostis Zafeirakis travels and traces the stories of those who live and create in the village. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Επεισόδιο: Νεοχωρούδα. Η εκπομπή χαρτογραφεί τον πολιτισμό σε τόπους που μικραίνουν χρόνο με τον χρόνο. Το χωριό, όμως, παραμένει ένα ολοζώντανο κύτταρο ευζωίας. Ο Κωστής Ζαφειράκης ταξιδεύει κι ανιχνεύει τις ιστορίες εκείνων που ζουν και δημιουργούν στο χωριό.

programme.title: From Field to Shelf K3 E3 / Από το Χωράφι στο Ράφι Κ3 Ε3
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Episode: Best Of - Part 3. The show presents all links in the chain of a product, from the seed selection stage to the final product that will take its place on the retail shelf. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Επεισόδιο: Best Of - Μέρος 3ο. Η εκπομπή παρουσιάζει όλους κρίκους της αλυσίδας ενός προϊόντος, από το στάδιο της επιλογής του σπόρου μέχρι και το τελικό προϊόν που θα πάρει θέση στο ράφι του λιανεμπορίου.

programme.title: Agios Oros - Vatopedi Monastery / Άγιο Όρος - Μονή Βατοπαιδίου
programme.desc: PREMIERE. A trek in the wonderful world of Mount Athos. A penetration into centuries-old history, traditions, treasures, precious archives. An introduction to the Athonian State starting from the Holy Great Monastery of Vatopedi. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Ένα οδοιπορικό στον θαυμαστό κόσμο του Αγίου Όρους. Μια διείσδυση στη μακραίωνη ιστορία, τις παραδόσεις, τους θησαυρούς, τα πολύτιμα αρχεία. Μια γνωριμία με την την Αθωνική Πολιτεία με αφετηρία την Ιερά Μεγίστη Μονή Βατοπαιδίου.

programme.title: The North Stream (E) / Το Βόρειο Ρεύμα (Ε)
programme.desc: After a defining experience in the Lofoten Islands, German filmmaker Steffen Krones begins building buoys to follow the journey of plastic waste from Dresden and through German and international waters. / Μετά από μία καθοριστική εμπειρία στα νησιά Λοφότεν, ο Γερμανός σκηνοθέτης Στέφεν Κρόνες αρχίζει να κατασκευάζει σημαδούρες για να ακολουθήσει το ταξίδι των πλαστικών αποβλήτων από τη Δρέσδη και μέσα από τα γερμανικά και διεθνή ύδατα.

programme.title: News from the Region / Ειδήσεις από την Περιφέρεια
programme.desc: Find out about all the latest news from the region. / Ενημερωθείτε για όλα τα τελευταία νέα από την περιφέρεια.

programme.title: Borders (Ε)
programme.desc: Our show travels every week beyond borders! The border as a meeting point of diversity is a fertile space where cultures interact to create a very rich social, economic and cultural context. / Η εκπομπή μας ταξιδεύει κάθε εβδομάδα πέρα από τα σύνορα! Τα σύνορα ως ένα σημείο συνάντησης διαφορετικοτήτων αποτελούν ένα γόνιμο χώρο όπου οι κουλτούρες συνδιαλέγονται για να δημιουργήσουν ένα πολύ πλούσιο κοινωνικό, οικονομικό και πολιτισμικό πλαίσιο.

programme.title: Fellow Humans K3 E5 (E) / Συν-Άνθρωποι Κ3 Ε5 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The System. A music learning system created from the vision of an economist and music teacher, to save as many children as he could from poverty and crime by teaching them classical music for free. / Επεισόδιο: Το Σύστημα. Ένα σύστημα εκμάθησης μουσικής που δημιουργήθηκε από το όραμα ενός οικονομολόγου και καθηγητή μουσικής, να σώσει όσα περισσότερα παιδιά μπορούσε από τη φτώχεια και την εγκληματικότητα, μαθαίνοντάς τους δωρεάν κλασική μουσική.

programme.title: The Vineyards of the World E3 (E) / Οι Αμπελώνες του Κόσμου Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Kosu, the Wine of the Rains. Kosu, a unique and exclusively Japanese wine variety, frames the landscape, perched two meters above the ground in vast trellises at the foot of Mount Fuji. Here, every harvest becomes a small miracle. / Επεισόδιο: Κόσου, το Κρασί των Βροχών. Το Κόσου, μια μοναδική ποικιλία κρασιού και αποκλειστικά ιαπωνική, διαμορφώνει το τοπίο, σκαρφαλωμένο δύο μέτρα πάνω από το έδαφος σε τεράστιες πέργκολες στους πρόποδες του όρους Φούτζι. Εδώ, κάθε συγκομιδή γίνεται ένα μικρό θαύμα.

programme.title: Incredible Train Journeys K3 E6 (E) / Απίθανα Ταξίδια με Τρένο Κ3 Ε6 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Madagascar. Madagascar, more than an island or a country, is a whole people to discover. In Madagascar, there are few trains left, but they are a real lifeline, useful and vital to many villages. / Επεισόδιο: Μαδαγασκάρη. Η Μαδαγασκάρη, περισσότερο από ένα νησί ή μια χώρα, είναι ένας ολόκληρος λαός να ανακαλύψετε. Στη Μαδαγασκάρη, υπάρχουν λίγα τρένα που έχουν απομείνει, αλλά είναι μια πραγματική γραμμή ζωής, χρήσιμη και ζωτικής σημασίας για πολλά χωριά.

programme.title: Hope E4 / Ελπίδα Ε4
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Episode: The Invisible. Although once invisible, climate change is now a scientific reality. We explore key solutions that make the invisible visible, actions that bring us closer to victory against climate change. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Επεισόδιο: Το Αόρατο. Αν και κάποτε που ήταν αόρατη, η κλιματική αλλαγή αποτελεί πλέον μια επιστημονική πραγματικότητα. Εξερευνούμε βασικές λύσεις που κάνουν ορατό το αθέατο, δράσεις που μας φέρνουν πιο κοντά στη νίκη κατά της κλιματικής αλλαγής.

programme.desc: It is an entertainment show, which will try to advise and entertain the viewers. The aim is for the viewers to relax and have fun in the hour and a half, in order to escape from the daily problems. It is intended for all generations and families. In numerous sections, we deal with interesting and current topics, and with the help of our interlocutors, we share tips for a simpler life. Along with simple and concrete advice for the viewers, in the show we will host numerous individuals or groups engaged in humanitarian work, as well as celebrities who we will present in a slightly different light, giving them the opportunity to share with the viewers their life experiences and small secrets in the functioning of the household. / Riječ je o emisiji Zabavnog programa, koja će pokušati da savjetuje i razonodi gledaoce. Želja je da se u sat i po gledaoci relaksiraju i zabave, kako bi pobjegli od dnevnih problema. Namijenjena je svim generacijama i porodici. U brojnim rubrikama bavimo se zanimljivim i aktuelnim temama, a uz pomoć sagovornika dijelimo savjete za jednostavniji život. Uz jednostavne i konkretne savjete za gledaoce, u emisiji ćemo ugostiti brojne individualce ili grupe koje se bave humanitarnim radom, kao i poznate ličnosti koje ćemo predstavljati u nešto drugačijem svjetlu, pružiti im mogućnost da sa gledaocima dijele svoja životna iskustva i male tajne u funkcionisanju domaćinstva.

programme.title: Alo Alo
programme.desc: France, World War II. René Artois is the owner of a small cafe, with unusual hardships. In his small cafe, a collection of various characters meet, from fighters of the French resistance movement, through Gestapo officers and German soldiers to British paratroopers. All of them try not to be discovered in their intentions, while Rene tries not to be discovered by his father-in-law and his wife in affairs with waitresses. / Francuska, II Svjetski rat. Rene Artoa je vlasnik malog kafea, sa nesvakidašnjim mukama. U njegovom malom kafeu se sastaje bulumenta raznih likova, od boraca francuskog pokreta otpora, preko oficira Gestapoa i njemačkih vojnika do britanskih padobranaca. Svi oni pokušavaju da ne budu otkriveni u svojim namjerama, dok se Rene trudi da ga tašta i žena ne otkriju u aferama sa konobaricama.

programme.desc: The series intended for our youngest population is designed to popularize and propagate a healthy lifestyle through sports and proper nutrition. Episodes aimed at children who play sports, no matter what level of success, will show the essential benefits of sports and proper nutrition. We are of the opinion that there are many talented children in Montenegro who do not have adequate conditions for the development of their talent. The series would be a modest initiator to raise the current situation to at least one level higher. We want to draw attention to the potential that belongs only to us, that is undeniable, a potential that deserves much more. / Serijal namijenjen našoj najmlađoj populaciji koncipiran je da popularizuje i propagira zdrav način života kroz sport i pravilnu ishranu. Mišljenja smo da u Crnoj Gori ima mnogo talentovane djece koja nemaju adekvatne uslove za razvoj njihovog talenta. Serijal bi bio skroman inicijator da se trenutna situacija podigne na bar za jednu stepenicu veći nivo. Želimo da skrenemo pažnju na potencijal koji pripada samo nama, koji je neosporan, potencijal koji zaslužuje mnogo više.

programme.title: Pepa prase na romskom jeziku
programme.desc: Peppa is a cute pig, she loves to play and have fun, she has a younger brother, George, whom we will hardly see without his favorite toy, the green dinosaur. Enjoy the adventures of Peppa, George, their family and friends! / Pepa je simpatično prase, ona mnogo voli da se igra i zabavlja, ima mlađeg brata Džordža kog ćemo teško videti bez njegove omiljene igračke, zelenog dinosaurusa. programme.title: Portilova Andaluzija
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores Andalusia, and in meeting the local population, shares their passions and interests. He tries his hand at pottery, visits a writer whose main theme is food, and takes part in the biggest street party in Spain at the Feria. / Majkl Portiljo istražuje Andaluziju, i u susretu s lokalnim stanovništom, dijeli njihove strasti i zanimanja. Oprobava se u grnčarstvu, posjećuje pisca čija je glavni tema hrana, a u Feriji učestvuje u najvećoj uličnoj žurki u Španiji.

programme.title: Alo Alo
programme.desc: France, World War II. René Artois is the owner of a small cafe, with unusual hardships. In his small cafe, a collection of various characters meet, from fighters of the French resistance movement, through Gestapo officers and German soldiers to British paratroopers. All of them try not to be discovered in their intentions, while Rene tries not to be discovered by his father-in-law and his wife in affairs with waitresses. / Francuska, II Svjetski rat. Rene Artoa je vlasnik malog kafea, sa nesvakidašnjim mukama. U njegovom malom kafeu se sastaje bulumenta raznih likova, od boraca francuskog pokreta otpora, preko oficira Gestapoa i njemačkih vojnika do britanskih padobranaca. Svi oni pokušavaju da ne budu otkriveni u svojim namjerama, dok se Rene trudi da ga tašta i žena ne otkriju u aferama sa konobaricama.

programme.title: Advokado
programme.desc: Brane and Beli are faithful friends, whose adventures we follow in this comic series. The two will try to find their way in a world where every attempt by an individual to break away from established conservative norms is viewed with fierce criticism. / Brane i Beli su verni drugovi, čije dogodovštine pratimo u ovoj komičnoj seriji. Njih dvojica probaće da se snađu u svijetu u kome se na svaki pokušaj pojedinca da se otrgne od ustanovljenih konzervativnih normi gleda sa žestokom kritikom.

programme.title: The biggest robberies in the world / Najveće pljačke Svijeta

programme.desc: Love brings two people together. After the wedding, what they already had is also combined - and that is their children. One of the most watched Spanish series of all time. Jedna od najgledanijih španskih serija, svih vremena. Koktel smijeha, ljubavi i optimizma koji nastaje spajanjem naizgled nespojivog.

programme.title: Laf the heart / Laf u srcu
programme.desc: After he is kicked out of the student dormitory, Vladimir will have to find a way to avoid being left on the street. He is employed in the house of Sava Mitrović, where his task is to perform household chores. Complicated interpersonal relationships will lead to many comical situations. / Nakon što ga izbace iz studentskog doma, Vladimir će morati da se snađe kako ne bi ostao na ulici. Zapošljava se u kući Save Mitrovića gdje mu je zadatak da obavlja kućne poslove. Komplikovani međuljudski odnosi dovešće do mnogo komičnih situacija.

programme.title: Lokalni hodači
programme.desc: Combining their professional skills (Ivana is a political scientist, Ivan an audio-video creator) and personal interests with the pleasure of going to selected locations, over time they began to share their records with the general public through digital services and social networks and met with general enthusiasm and support. Thanks to their short travel clips in "vlog" form, many of us have discovered new hiking trails, and visiting their content pages is a perfect brochure for locals and tourists looking for alternatives to popular and overcrowded picnic spots. Ivana and Ivan address the audience in a language free of form, simple, friendly and often using local "slang" speech, but without rude or offensive expressions. / Spajajući svoje profesinalne vještine (Ivana je politikološkinja, Ivan audio-video stvaralac) i lična interesovanja sa zadovoljstvom odlaska na odabrane lokacije, vremenom su putem digitalnih servisa i društvenih mreža sa širom javnošću počeli da dijele svoje zapise i naišli na opšte oduševljenje i podršku. programme.desc: The EDP Lisbon Marathon is already considered one of the most beautiful marathons in the world by international entities. Com início Cascais e meta instalada na simbolica Praça do Comercio, a Maratona de Lisboa tem um percurso 100% à beira mar/rio, oferecendo aos seus atletas um cenário único no mundo.

programme.title: Hora dos Portugueses
programme.desc: Daily magazine, with different perspectives, with Portuguese communities spread around the world, to portray the current ways of experiencing Portugueseness in different territories and recognize the achievements and achievements of the Portuguese who make up these groups of citizens. / Magazine diário, com diferentes olhares, junto de comunidades de portugueses espalhados pelo mundo, para retratar as atuais formas de viver a portugalidade nos diferentes territorios e reconhecer os feitos e conquistas dos portugueses que compõem estes grupos de cidadaos.

programme.title: Here Portugal - The Best Moments / Aqui Portugal - Os Melhores Momentos
programme.desc: Remember the best moments of the program that covers and warms hearts from north to south of the country, showcasing the best that Portugal has to offer. programme.title: Jornal da Tarde
programme.desc: Every day, at 1pm, your lunch hour is completed with updates on national and global news, from politics, economics, society and not forgetting sport. programme.sub-title: The Appearance of the Virus / O Aparecimento do Vírus
programme.desc: When AIDS appeared, Portugal was experiencing total freedom following April 25, 1974 and the country was making the most of the joy of those moments. programme.title: Insolaçao Mortal
programme.desc: Ted and Amanda's intense work finally shows results and Jong Min's remains are found in the river. Amanda is convinced that there is a connection between this death and that of her friend Lars. / O intenso trabalho de Ted e Amanda finalmente mostra resultados e sao encontrados no rio os restos mortais de Jong Min. programme.desc: A documentary that seeks to answer a question about the most important figure in the History of Art in Portugal in the 20th century: who is the enigma Jose-Augusto França? The teacher and writer and his vast work, the courses he created and the disciples he left behind. / Um documentário que procura responder a uma pergunta sobre a mais importante figura da Historia de Arte em Portugal no seculo XX: quem e o enigma Jose-Augusto França? O professor e escritor e a sua vasta obra, os cursos que criou e os discípulos que deixou.

programme.sub-title: The Coronation of Popeia / A Coroaçao de Popeia
programme.desc: Porgy and Bess, is a production different from anything that had been presented in Super Diva until now. Starting with the fact that it is the work of an American composer, George Gershwin, and then because it has only black characters as protagonists. / Porgy and Bess, e uma produçao diferenciada de tudo o que ate aqui se tinha apresentado em Super Diva. A começar pelo facto de ser obra de um compositor norte-americano, George Gershwin, e de seguida por ter como protagonistas apenas personagens negros.

Com a ajuda das suas bolhas de sabao mágicas, Tommy leva as crianças a viver aventuras maravilhosas para ajudá-las a descobrir um mundo vasto e cativante, a combater os seus medos e inibições e a aprender valores familiares.

Em cada episodio, a equipa de resgate da vila salva alguns dos habitantes.

Water Polo - Regional League: Primorac - Red Star / Vaterpolo - Regionalna liga: Primorac - Crvena zvezda
programme.desc: The Adriatic Water Polo League or the sponsor name Triglav Regional League is a regional water polo competition in which Montenegrin, Croatian, Slovenian clubs compete, later also Italian and Serbian clubs. The first season, which began on September 26, 2008, gathered 12 clubs, 8 from Croatia, 3 from Montenegro and 1 from Slovenia. The year of establishment is taken as the same year 2008, when the decision was made in Dubrovnik at the qualifying tournament for the European Championship. After the first season, Italian representatives also joined the league, who soon gave up, while since 2014, the league has also included clubs from Serbia. / Jadranska vaterpolo liga ili sponzorski naziv Triglav regionalna liga je regionalno vaterpolo takmičenje u kojoj se od jeseni 2008. godine takmiče crnogorski, hrvatski, slovenački klubovi, kasnije i talijanski te srpski klubovi. Prva sezona, koja je počela 26. septembra 2008., okupljala je 12 klubova, 8 iz Hrvatske, 3 iz Crne Gore i 1 iz Slovenije. Za godinu osnutka se uzima ista ta 2008. godina kada je odluka donešena u Dubrovniku na kvalifikacionom turniru za Evropsko prvenstvo. Nakon prve sezone ligi su se priključili i italijanski predstavnici koji si ubrzo odustali, dok od 2014. godine liga broji i klubove iz Srbije.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA league: Igokea - Krka / Košarka - ABA liga: Igokea - Krka
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name on several occasions depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is the Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games each, against each other, one on the home field and one on the away field, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football - Montenegrin league: Petrovac - Sutjeska / Fudbal - Crnogorska liga: Petrovac - Sutjeska
programme.desc: The Montenegrin Football League was founded in 2004, but the first season was played in the 2006/2007 season. after the independence of the country. 12 clubs in the three-round competition system fought for the championship title, which was eventually won by Zeta from Golubovac, which remained the only championship title of Montenegro. Today, the number of clubs is reduced to 10, and 30 rounds are played. / Crnogorska fudbalska liga osnovana je 2004. godine ali prva sezona odigrana je u sezoni 2006./2007. nakon osamostaljenja države. 12 klubova se u trokružnom sistemu takmičenja borilo za titulu prvaka koji je na kraju osvojila Zeta iz Golubovaca, kojoj je to ostala jedina titula prvaka Crne Gore. Današnji broj klubova smanjen je na 10 te se igra 30 kola.

programme.title: Football - Croatian League: Dinamo - Osijek / Fudbal - Hrvatska liga: Dinamo - Osijek
programme.desc: The Croatian Football League was founded in 1992 and the first historic title was won by Hajduk from Split. Over the years, the competition system and the number of clubs have changed, but in recent years, the current system with 10 teams and a four-round format of the competition has been established. The transitional cup intended for the champion is the work of academic sculptor Marijan Zaradić. Dinamo from Zagreb won it the most times. The absolute record holder for the number of goals scored is Varteksa legend Davor Vugrinec with 144 goals. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se menjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prelazni kup namenjen prvaku delo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo. Apsolutni rekorder po broju postignutih pogodaka legenda je Varteksa Davor Vugrinec sa 144 gola.

programme.title: Football: WWIN Liga BIH: Široki Brijeg - Rudar / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Široki Brijeg - Rudar
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking football competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. With the entry of clubs from Republika Srpska two years later, the league got a format with 16 clubs in a two-round competition system. Today, 12 teams compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and the Survival League. The first historical champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The biggest European success was the placement of Železničar in the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Water polo - Regional league: Jadran - Novi Beograd / Vaterpolo - Regionalna liga: Jadran - Novi Beograd
programme.desc: The Adriatic Water Polo League or the sponsor name Triglav Regional League is a regional water polo competition in which Montenegrin, Croatian, Slovenian clubs compete, later also Italian and Serbian clubs. The first season, which began on September 26, 2008, gathered 12 clubs, 8 from Croatia, 3 from Montenegro and 1 from Slovenia. The year of establishment is taken as the same year 2008, when the decision was made in Dubrovnik at the qualifying tournament for the European Championship. Nakon prve sezone ligi su se priključili i italijanski predstavnici koji si ubrzo odustali, dok od 2014. godine liga broji i klubove iz Srbije.

programme.title: Fudbal - Bundesliga: Hoffenheim - Heidenheim
programme.desc: Along with all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga also stands proudly. The highest rank of the football competition, founded in 1963, has 18 teams that start the race for the popular plate every August. It was won the most times by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. Najviši rang fudbalskog takmičenja osnovanog 1963. godine broji 18 ekipa koje svakog avgusta kreću u trku za popularnim tanjirom. Najviše puta ga je osvajao minhenski Bajern, čak 24 puta. Kultura navijanja, pune tribine i vrhunski fudbal je ono što krasi Bundesligu od njenih početaka, pa sve do danas. Ne propustite svakom mogućom prilikom da uživate u bundesligaškim susretima. Sigurno nećete požaliti.

programme.desc: The Champions League for the best women's teams of the Old Continent has been held under the authority of the European Handball Organization since 1961. The format of the competition is such that the 16 best teams through the group stage and quarter-finals hunt for one of the four positions for the final tournament of the Champions League, where the new champion of Europe is obtained through the semi-finals and final. / Pod ingerencijom Evropske rukometne organizacije od 1961. godine održava se Liga šampiona za najbolje ženske ekipe Starog kontinenta. Prvi istorijski prvak Evrope je bukureštanska Stinta dok ukupno najviše titula pobednika takmičenja ima Spartak iz Kijeva koji je 70-ih i 80-ih godina prošlog veka osvojio čak 13 titula. Format takmičenja je takav da 16 najboljih ekipa kroz grupnu fazu i četvrtfinala lovi jednu od četiri pozicije za završni turnir Lige šampiona na kojem se preko polufinala i finala dobija novi prvak Evrope.

programme.title: Basketball - KLS: Radnički - Vršac / Košarka - KLS: Radnički - Vršac
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest level of professional basketball in that country. The league itself was founded in 2006 and as such has 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the two-round point system, and in the matches each club is the host once and the guest once. Broj klubova koji će se plasirati u Superligu zavisi o broju predstavnika u regionalnoj ligi, no u tom delu takmičenja se uvek nalazi 8 timova.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: The Bonanza series takes place around 1860 in Nevada. Ben Cartwright lives with his three sons on the Ponderosa Ranch near Virginia City on the shores of Lake Tahoe. / Serija Bonanza se dogaja okoli leta 1860 v Nevadi.Ben Cartwright skupaj s tremi sinovi živi na ranču Ponderosa v bližini mesta Virginia City ob obali jezera Tahoe.

programme.title: The Little House on the Prairie / Hišica v preriji
programme.desc: Charles moves to Kansas with his wife and daughters. During the journey, he begins to like the lush Indian landscape. They quickly settle in with their wife and three daughters. In their new environment, they experience both happy and less happy moments, from births, celebrations, to fires, but they have to face the fact that it is not as easy to create a stable home as it seems at first glance. / Charles se z ženo in hčerkami preseli v Kansas. Bujna indijanska pokrajina mu že med potjo postane všeč. Z ženo in tremi hčerami se hitro ustalijo.V novem okolju doživljajo tako srečne kot manj srečne trenutke, od rojstev, praznovanj, do požarov, soočiti pa se morajo predvsem z dejstvom, da si ni tako lahko ustvariti stabilen dom kot izgleda na prvi pogled.

programme.title: Klepet ob kavi
programme.desc: Open the treasury of interesting ideas, ideas and information that Jasmina Kandorfer teaches together with interesting guests in the show Klepet ob kava. In each show, they discuss several current topics related to health, personal growth and spirituality. The creators of the show are also researchers who devote themselves to both old wisdom and modern approaches. They believe in good stories and exceptional people, so in every show we will be able to listen to interesting personalities and their experiences and life stories. / Odprite zakladnico zanimivih zamisli, idej in informacij, ki jih Jasmina Kandorfer predaja skupaj z zanimivimi gosti v oddaji Klepet ob kavi. V vsaki oddaji obravnavajo več aktualnih tematik, ki se navezujejo na zdravje, osebnostno rast in duhovnost. Ustvarjalci oddaje so hkrati raziskovalci, ki se posvečajo tako starim modrostim kot sodobnim pristopom. Verjamejo v dobre zgodbe in izjemne ljudi, zato bomo v vsaki oddaji lahko prisluhnili zanimivim osebnostim ter njihovim izkušnjam in življenjskim zgodbam.

programme.title: I'm still alive / Še vedno sem živ
programme.desc: An inspiring documentary narrative testifies to the effectiveness of music therapy for people with Alzheimer's disease. Dan Cohen, co-founder of the American non-profit organization Music and Memory, visits residents in nursing homes and hospitals, puts headphones on their ears, and a miracle happens - even after several years of numbness, complete immersion in some distant world, people come alive again, their lips he smiles, a spark of joy shines in his eyes. / Navdihujoča dokumentarna pripoved priča o učinkovitosti glasbene terapije pri obolelih za Alzheimerjevo boleznijo.Dan Cohen, soustanovitelj ameriške neprofitne organizacije Glasba in spomin, obišče stanovalce v domovih za ostarele in bolnišnicah, na ušesa jim namesti slušalke in zgodi se čudež - tudi po več letih otopelosti, popolne pogreznjenosti v nek oddaljeni svet, ljudje spet oživijo, na ustnicah se jim izriše nasmeh, v očeh se zablešči iskra veselja.
