programme.title: Football (M): Koper - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Koper - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian First League was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent country with the breakup of the former Yugoslavia. Until 1990, the Slovenian Republic League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the country at the time. After the establishment of independence, only two clubs were never relegated from the top tier of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each of which plays four matches - two at home and two away, the last team in the standings is relegated, and the penultimate team fights for survival in the qualifiers. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Mura - Celje, First League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Mura - Celje, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian First League was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent country with the breakup of the former Yugoslavia. Until 1990, the Slovenian Republic League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the country at the time. After the establishment of independence, only two clubs were never relegated from the top tier of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each of which plays four matches - two at home and two away, the last team in the standings is relegated, and the penultimate team fights for survival in the qualifiers. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): B. Leverkusen - Freiburg, Bundesliga 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): B. Leverkusen - Freiburg, Bundesliga 2025/2026
programme.desc: Next to everything that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga also stands proud. In the top tier of the football competition, founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, which start matches for the popular plate every year in August. It was won by Bayern Munich the most times, 24 times. The culture of cheering, full stands and top-class football is what adorns the Bundesliga from its beginnings to the present day. Don't miss the chance to enjoy Bundesliga matches. You certainly won't regret it. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. Ne zamudite priložnosti, da uživate v tekmah Bundeslige. Zagotovo vam ne bo žal.

programme.title: Football (M): Mura - Celje, First League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Mura - Celje, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian First League was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent country with the breakup of the former Yugoslavia. Until 1990, the Slovenian Republic League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the country at the time. After the establishment of independence, only two clubs were never relegated from the top tier of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each of which plays four matches - two at home and two away, the last team in the standings is relegated, and the penultimate team fights for survival in the qualifiers. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Mura - Celje, First League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Mura - Celje, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian First League was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent country with the breakup of the former Yugoslavia. Until 1990, the Slovenian Republic League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the country at the time. After the establishment of independence, only two clubs were never relegated from the top tier of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each of which plays four matches - two at home and two away, the last team in the standings is relegated, and the penultimate team fights for survival in the qualifiers. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.desc: The show Dobro jutro introduces modern television formats with an emphasis on quality content and is among the best-watched programs on national television, taking into account the share of television viewers. programme.title: On to the beautiful: Obkolpske villages and Oglarska dežela, Mon. / Na lepše: Obkolpske vasice in Oglarska dežela, pon.
programme.desc: The Na lepše show team visited the little-known Obkolp villages in the vicinity of Poljanska dolina and Kostel. On both banks of the river Kolpa are scattered almost empty hamlets in which elderly residents still persist. The border did cut their space, but the bonds of life were never truly severed. In the show, you will also learn more about Oglarska deželja in Litija and the unique Zeleni Raj park in Posavski hribovje, which offers more than two thousand plant species from all over the world. / Ekipa oddaje Na lepše je obiskala malo znane obkolpske vasice v okolici Poljanske doline in Kostela. Na obeh bregovih reke Kolpe so posejani skorajda izpraznjeni zaselki v katerih še vztrajajo ostareli prebivalci. Meja je sicer prerezala njihov prostor, toda življenjske vezi se nikoli niso zares pretrgale. V oddaji tudi več o Oglarski deželi v Litiji ter o edinstvenem parku Zeleni Raj v Posavskem hribovju, ki ponuja več kot dva tisoč rastlinskih vrst z vseh koncev sveta.

programme.title: Environments, pon. / Ambienti, pon.
programme.sub-title: Ambiences; Home is more than just a roof over your head – it is a reflection of our personality, our story, it is the melody of a place where we feel safe and comfortable. This time we found such a home in Zgornja Savinjska dolina - in a home where there is really no shortage of melodies. They intertwine in it / Ambienti; Dom je več kot le streha nad glavo – je odsev naše osebnosti, naše zgodbe, je melodija prostora, kjer se počutimo varno in prijetno. Tokrat smo tak dom našli v Zgornji Savinjski dolini - v domu, kjer melodij res ne manjka. V njem se prepletajo
programme.desc: The architect decided to buy an apartment in Trieste because life in the seaside city is close to her, and in addition, real estate prices there are more bearable than in Slovenia. From an old apartment with furniture from the 70s of the last century, she has created a bright, colorful home with a unique atmosphere through renovation. On a sunny slope, he will reveal to us the importance of water motifs, present a rich collection of cacti and highlight the plant peculiarities that give the park its unique charm. / Za nakup stanovanja v Trstu se je arhitektka odločila, ker ji je življenje v obmorskem mestu blizu, poleg tega pa so tamkajšnje cene nepremičnin znosnejše kot v Sloveniji. Iz postaranega stanovanja z opremo iz 70. let prejšnjega stoletja je s prenovo ustvarila svetel, barvit dom z edinstvenim vzdušjem.Znova se odpravljamo v Zeleni raj nad Litijo, kjer nas bo lastnik Miha Kos popeljal skozi slikovit rastlinski park na 600 metrih nadmorske višine. Na sončnem pobočju nam bo razkril pomen vodnih motivov, predstavil bogato zbirko kaktusov in izpostavil rastlinske posebnosti, ki parku dajejo edinstven čar.

programme.title: Let's listen to the silence: Slovenian heroes at the Deaf Olympics, Mon. / Prisluhnimo tišini: Slovenski junaki na olimpijadi gluhih, pon.
programme.desc: This year, for the first time, the Deaf Summer Olympics will be held in Tokyo, Japan, from November 14 to 27. On it, Slovenian colors will be represented by seven outstanding Slovenian athletes in various disciplines. Leja Glojnarič, Iris Breganski, Tadej Enci and young Isabela Mord will compete in athletics, Marino Kegl will represent Slovenia in tennis, and Viktorija Horvat will be the first deaf Slovenian to run a marathon. The youngest member of the team is swimmer Alessandro Ambrožič, who will also proudly represent Slovenia. Each of them has their own story of courage, perseverance and passion for sports. Don't miss the show Prisluhnimo silučni, which will be broadcast on October 22 at approximately 3:40 PM on the first program of Television Slovenia. / V Tokiu na Japonskem bodo letos prvič priredili poletno olimpijado gluhih, ki bodo od 14. do 27. novembra. Na njej bo slovenske barve zastopalo sedem izjemnih slovenskih športnikov v različnih disciplinah. V atletiki bodo tekmovali Leja Glojnarič, Iris Breganski, Tadej Enci in mlada Isabela Mord, v tenisu bo Slovenijo zastopal Marino Kegl, Viktorija Horvat pa bo kot prva gluha Slovenka tekla maraton. Najmlajši član ekipe je plavalec Alessandro Ambrožič, ki bo prav tako ponosno zastopal Slovenijo. Vsak izmed njih nosi svojo zgodbo poguma, vztrajnosti in strasti do športa. Ne zamudite oddaje Prisluhnimo tišini, ki bo na sporedu 22. oktobra ob predvidoma 15.40 na prvem programu Televizije Slovenija.

programme.title: Horizons of the Spirit: Missions - A Two-Way Road, Mon. / Obzorja duha: Misijoni – dvosmerna cesta, pon.
programme.desc: The modern view of missions goes beyond the once one-way aid to "rich" developing countries and emphasizes reciprocity between Churches around the world. Today, missionary mission means the exchange of faith, experience, solidarity and shared responsibility for the Gospel. The developed world gives material support and knowledge to missionary countries, and receives from them an example of living faith, simplicity and hope. In this way, missions become a place for a real encounter between cultures and a witness to God's love. / Sodobni pogled na misijone presega nekoč enosmerno pomoč »bogatih« državam v razvoju in poudarja vzajemnost med Cerkvami po svetu. Danes misijonsko poslanstvo pomeni izmenjavo vere, izkušenj, solidarnosti in skupne odgovornosti za evangelij. Razviti svet misijonskim deželam daje materialno podporo in znanje, od njih pa prejema zgled žive vere, preprostosti in upanja. Tako misijoni postajajo prostor resničnega srečanja med kulturami in pričevanja o Božji ljubezni.

programme.title: What are you talking about? = So vakeres?, Mon. / Kaj govoriš? = So vakeres?, pon.
programme.sub-title: The fact that Roma settlements are not legalized is still one of the biggest reasons why families do not have access to basic infrastructure. This does not apply to the village of Griček in the municipality of Kočevje, where a multi-purpose Roma center was also opened in September. / Da romska naselja niso legalizirana, je še vedno eden od največjih razlogov, da družine nimajo dostopa do osnovne infrastrukture. To pa ne velja za naselje Griček v občini Kočevje, kjer so septembra odprli tudi večnamenski romski center.
programme.desc: We talked to stand-up comedian Andrej Bajic Šarkezij, who is better known to the public under the nickname Andrej Bakreni - he chose this nickname because of his Roma ancestry. We will also watch a shorter recording of the concert of flamenco guitarist Vicente Amigo, who performed in Križanke in Ljubljana in the summer. / Pogovarjali smo se s stand up komikom Andrejem Bajičem Šarkezijem, ki je v javnosti bolj znan pod vzdevkom Andrej Bakreni – ta vzdevek si je izbral zaradi romskega rodu. Ogledali si bomo še krajši posnetek koncerta kitarista flamenka Vicenteja Amiga, ki je poleti nastopil v Križankah v Ljubljani.

programme.title: Our Dyslexic Mind, British Documentary, Mon. / Naš dislektični um, britanska dokumentarna oddaja, pon.
programme.sub-title: It is estimated that as many as one in seven people are neurodivergent - their brains simply work differently than most people. However, they often encounter misunderstanding from those close to them, which is why many deal with depression, anxiety and even suicidal thoughts. Televisions / Ocenjujejo, da je kar sedmina ljudi nevrorazličnih – njihovi možgani preprosto delujejo drugače kot pri večini. Vendar pogosto naletijo na nerazumevanje bližnjih, zato se številni spoprijemajo z depresijo, tesnobo in celo samomorilnimi mislimi. Televizi
programme.desc: In this show, Packham explores dyslexia, one of the most common forms of neurodiversity. He meets the builder Lee, who only learned at the age of fifty why he could only read one book in his life and why he barely made it through school and learned to be a carpenter. Even school counselors Suiki diagnosed dyslexia only in adulthood. She finds it difficult to tell her relatives what problems orientation and planning of daily tasks cause her. With the help of filmmakers, animators and composers, the two dyslexic people create short, emotional films to show their relatives and friends how their brains really work. INSIDE OUR MINDS, DYSLEXIA / Great Britain / 2025 / Director: Joe Myerscough. / V tej oddaji Packham raziskuje disleksijo, ki je ena najpogostejših oblik nevrorazličnosti. Spozna gradbinca Leeja, ki je šele pri petdesetih letih izvedel, zakaj je v življenju lahko prebral samo eno knjigo in zakaj je komaj izdelal šolo ter se izučil za tesarja. Tudi šolski svetovalki Suiki so diagnozo disleksije postavili šele v odrasli dobi. Svojcem težko dopove, kakšne težave ji povzročata orientacija in načrtovanje vsakodnevnih opravil. Obe osebi z disleksijo s pomočjo filmskih ustvarjalcev, animatorjev in skladateljev ustvarita kratka, čustvena filma, s katerima sorodnikom in prijateljem pokažeta, kako v resnici delujejo njuni možgani.INSIDE OUR MINDS, DYSLEXIA / Velika Britanija / 2025 / Režija: Joe Myerscough.

programme.title: What's going on?: Boris Kokalj, Mon. / Kaj dogaja?: Boris Kokalj, pon.
programme.desc: I: ALENKA MARINIC - SELF-EMPLOYED IN CULTURE, PERFORMER, TEACHER, ACTRESS, DIRECTOR AND SCREENWRITER (Tanja Fajon, grandmother, judge), Admir Baltić (driver), Andrič Tim, Artač Tilen (grandfather, Jan Plestenjak, Klemen Klemen), Piletič Luka; R: Novak Tina... The season in the NBA league doesn't start until next week, so you can leave this Saturday quietly on the first program of RTV Slovenia and watch the new show What's going on? Which new face is flying high, until when will the vignette be valid and why is the marathon promising again? In the field, we accompanied a volunteer who drives pensioners as part of the Prostofer program, and this time our Robi Petan visited us right in the studio, with a song dedicated to a very special week. Whether it's raining or not, we'll discuss this time in our column Kdo ma prav, and in the telenovela Palomar, the Strunjan stallion will say goodbye to Tanja Fajon. Our guest will be Boris Kokalj - radio presenter and singer of the band Kokosy, who will of course also join us on the Little Terrace, where we will open Lukat's year together. / I: ALENKA MARINIČ - SAMOZAPOSLENA V KULTURI, PERFORMERKA, PEDAGOGINJA, IGRALKA, REŽISERKA IN SCENARISTKA (Tanja Fajon, stara mama, sodnica), Admir Baltić (šofer), Andrič Tim, Artač Tilen (dedek, Jan Plestenjak, Klemen Klemen), Piletič Luka; R: Novak Tina... Sezona v ligi NBA se začne šele naslednji teden, zato lahko to soboto mirno pustite na prvem programu RTV Slovenija in si ogledate novo oddajo Kaj dogaja? Kateri novi obraz visoko leta, do kdaj bo veljala vinjeta in zakaj maraton spet obeta? Na terenu smo spremljali prostovoljca, ki vozi upokojence kot del programa Prostofer, naš Robi Petan pa nas je tokrat obiskal kar v studiu, s pesmijo, posvečeno zelo posebnemu tednu. Ali dež pada ali gre, bomo tokrat razpravljali v naši rubriki Kdo ma prav, v telenoveli Palomar pa se bo strunjanski žrebec poslavljal od Tanje Fajon. Naš gost bo Boris Kokalj – radijski voditelj in pevec skupine Kokosy, ki se nam bo seveda pridružil tudi na Mali terasi, kjer bomo skupaj odprli Lukatovo leto.

programme.title: Love Is Blind, Canadian - French Movie, Mon. / Ljubezen je slepa, kanadsko - francoski film, pon.
programme.sub-title: Nature Of Love; Love comedy drama and romance. Sophia is a forty-year-old philosophy professor who lives with Xavier in a solid but somewhat predictable relationship. A decade of their relationship passed at exhibition openings and endless dinners with friends / Nature Of Love; Ljubezenska komična drama in romanca. programme.desc: One day, Sophia has to go to a meeting with a craftsman who will be renovating their holiday home in the countryside. That's how Sophia meets the craftsman Sylvain, who turns her head upside down in one day. Sophia falls head over heels in love and so does Sylvain. A romance develops between them that lasts, and they cannot live without each other. It's clear that they're very different, and it's clear that opposites attract. But do they last? The film is a profound yet funny and witty study of a love relationship. Med njima se razvije romanca, ki kar traja, in nikakor ne moreta eden brez drugega. Jasno je, da sta si zelo različna, in jasno je, da se nasprotja privlačijo. Toda ali tudi trajajo? programme.sub-title: Bastarden / The Promised Land; Historical drama with Mads Mikkelson about the difficult settlement of the vast Danish landscape in the 18th century. / Bastarden / The Promised Land; Zgodovinska drama z Madsom Mikkelsonom o težavnem naseljevanju prostrane danske pokrajine v 18. stoletju.
programme.desc: In 1755, the impoverished captain Ludvig Kahlen sets off into a relentless, almost uninhabitable landscape with a seemingly impossible goal. He wants to establish a new colony there in the name of the king. In exchange, he expects what he has longed for all his life: to climb higher in the social ladder with a prestigious title. However, the cruel local governor, Frederik de Schinkel, claims that the land belongs to him, not the king. When de Schinkel learns that his maid has defected to Kahlen with her husband, he begins to forge revenge. But Kahlen is fearless and goes into battle, with which he sacrifices not only his life, but also the life of the extended family that has grown up around him. Original title: BASTARDEN Year of production: 2023 Country: co-production Genre: historical drama Director: Nikolaj Arcel Screenplay: Anders Thomas Jensen and Nikolaj Arcel based on the novel by Ida Jessen Starring: Mads Mikkelsen, Amanda Collin, Simon Bennebjerg, Kristine Kujath Thorp. / Leta 1755 se obubožani stotnik Ludvig Kahlen odpravi v neizprosno, domala nenaseljivo pokrajino z na videz nemogočim ciljem. Tam želi v imenu kralja postaviti novo kolonijo. V zamenjavo pričakuje tisto, po čemer hrepeni že vse življenje: da bi se z uglednim nazivom povzpel višje po družbeni lestvici. Vendar pa kruti lokalni upravnik Frederik de Schinkel trdi, da zemlja pripada njemu in ne kralju. Ko de Schinkel izve, da je njegova služabnica skupaj z možem prebegnila h Kahlenu, začne kovati maščevanje. A Kahlen je neustrašen in se spusti v boj, s katerim ne žrtvuje le svojega življenja, ampak tudi življenje razširjene družine, ki je zrasla okoli njega.Originalni naslov: BASTARDENLeto produkcije: 2023Država: koprodukcijaŽanr: zgodovinska dramaRežija: Nikolaj ArcelScenarij: Anders Thomas Jensen in Nikolaj Arcel po romanu Ide JessenIgrajo: Mads Mikkelsen, Amanda Collin, Simon Bennebjerg, Kristine Kujath Thorp.

programme.title: Century of the Soviet Union, British documentary series, 3/3, Mon. / Stoletje Sovjetske zveze, britanska dokumentarna serija, 3/3, pon.
programme.sub-title: The Soviet Union, 100th Anniversary 1922; After five years of civil war, the Soviet Union was founded on December 30, 1922, the first socialist country in the world, which left an indelible mark on the entire twentieth century. Documentary series in three / The Soviet Union, 100th Anniversary 1922; Po petih letih državljanske vojne je bila 30. decembra 1922 ustanovljena Sovjetska zveza, prva socialistična država na svetu, ki je vtisnila neizbrisen pečat vsemu dvajsetemu stoletju. Dokumentarna serija v treh
programme.desc: Part 3: After the Soviet intervention in Czechoslovakia in the 1970s, there was a period of relaxation, and for the Soviet Union also a period of stagnation. The United States got burned in the Vietnam War, and the Soviet Union in the Afghanistan War, but it could not afford to make mistakes. The last straw was the Chernobyl nuclear disaster, and the first socialist countries in the world could no longer save even Gorbachev's reforms. The end of 1991 also brought the end of the Soviet Union. THE SOVIET UNION, 100TH ANNIVERSARY 1922 / Great Britain / 2022 / Director: Lyndy Saville. / 3. del:Po sovjetskem posredovanju na Češkoslovaškem je v 70. letih prejšnjega stoletja nastopilo obdobje popuščanja, za Sovjetsko zvezo pa tudi obdobje stagnacije. ZDA so se opekle v vietnamski vojni, Sovjetska zveza pa v afganistanski, toda ta si ni smela privoščiti napak. Kaplja čez rob je bila jedrska nesreča v Černobilu, in prve socialistične države na svetu niso mogle več rešiti niti reforme Gorbačova. Konec leta 1991 je tako prinesel tudi konec Sovjetske zveze.THE SOVIET UNION, 100TH ANNIVERSARY 1922 / Velika Britanija / 2022 / Režija: Lyndy Saville.

programme.title: Slovenian jazz scene: Robert Jukič, Drama, concert recording from SNG Drama, Mon. / Slovenska jazz scena: Robert Jukič, Drama, posnetek koncerta iz SNG Drama, pon.
programme.desc: R: Bastič Aljaž... Recording of the concert of the original project of Robert Jukic from SNG Drama Ljubljana. Jukič introduces himself as a bassist, event host, author of music and lyrics, and producer. With a ten-member band and 7 vocal soloists, Jukič presented his original project Women, in which he tackles love, relationships, loss, hope and other life topics in his own original style. Renowned Slovenian singers Ana Bezjak, Tjaša Fabjančič, Gordana Hleb, Nina Strnad, Katja Šulc, Nina Vodopivec and Mia Žnidarič performed at the concert. In addition to Robert Jukic, instrumentalists Andraž Mazi, Steve Klink, Saša Lušić, Tonč Feinig, Sergej Ranđelović Runjoe, Jelena Ždrale, Klemen Bračko, Matjaž Sekne and Gregor Marinko also performed. / R: Bastič Aljaž... Posnetek koncerta avtorskega projekta Roberta Jukiča iz SNG Drama Ljubljana. Jukič se predstavlja kot basist, prireditelj, avtor glasbe in besedil ter producent. Z desetčlansko glasbeno zasedbo in 7 vokalnimi solistkami je Jukič predstavil svoj avtorski projekt Ženske, v katerem se v lastnem izvirnem slogu loteva ljubezni, odnosov, izgube, upanja in drugih življenjskih tem. Na koncertu so nastopile priznane slovenske pevke Ana Bezjak, Tjaša Fabjančič, Gordana Hleb, Nina Strnad, Katja Šulc, Nina Vodopivec in Mia Žnidarič. Poleg Roberta Jukiča so nastopili še intrumentalisti Andraž Mazi, Steve Klink, Saša Lušić, Tonč Feinig, Sergej Ranđelović Runjoe, Jelena Ždrale, Klemen Bračko, Matjaž Sekne in Gregor Marinko.

programme.title: Witnesses: Dominik Gregorič, Mon. / Pričevalci: Dominik Gregorič, pon.
programme.sub-title: Dominik Gregorič, born in 1930 in Zalošče, described life in Goriška during fascism, the Second World War and the post-war years with a refined memory. He tells about his childhood in an Italian school, the suppression of the Slovenian language, and the difficult farm life / Dominik Gregorič, rojen leta 1930 v Zaloščah, je s pretanjenim spominom opisal življenje na Goriškem v času fašizma, druge svetovne vojne in povojnih let. Pripoveduje o otroštvu v italijanski šoli, zatiranju slovenskega jezika, težkem kmečkem življenju
programme.desc: The description of post-war communist violence also stands out in the testimony - from the repression of priests, secret baptisms, political interrogations and pressures to liquidations. Among other things, he tells about the liquidation of an entire family in the Šempaške polje due to suspicion of collaboration with the Italians, a priest who was brought to court 13 times, about the cruel fate of his relative Dominik Zorn, a member of the VOS, who disappeared without a trace, and about the humiliating mandatory donations of food and livestock after the war, which he vividly remembers with pain even today. Dominik does not hide the feelings of fear and helplessness that existed then ruled among the population. Partisans, Chetniks, fascists, soldiers and then the post-war authorities took away people's dignity, freedom and often life. His testimony is a valuable document of the time, which comprehensively sheds light on the lesser-known, often silenced sides of the history of Primorska. / V pričevanju izstopa tudi opis povojnega komunističnega nasilja – od represije nad duhovniki, tajnih krstov, političnih zaslišanj in pritiskov do likvidacij. Med drugim pripoveduje o likvidaciji cele družine na Šempaškem polju zaradi suma sodelovanja z Italijani, duhovniku, ki so ga 13-krat privedli pred sodišče, o kruti usodi sorodnika Dominika Zorna, pripadnika VOS-a, ki je izginil brez sledu, ter o ponižujočih obveznih oddajah hrane in živine po vojni, česar se z bolečino živo spominja še danes.Dominik ne skriva občutkov strahu in nemoči, ki so tedaj vladali med prebivalstvom. Partizani, četniki, fašisti, vojaki in nato še povojna oblast so ljudem jemali dostojanstvo, svobodo in pogosto tudi življenje. Njegovo pričevanje je dragocen dokument časa, ki celovito osvetli manj znane, pogosto zamolčane plati zgodovine Primorske.

programme.desc: Toni is a single mother of five children who has devoted her life to her family for years. Her youthful dreams of a singing career gave way to everyday responsibilities. When the oldest children slowly start to leave home, Toni is faced with the question of what she wants in the future. Despite precarious jobs and financial worries, he tries to rediscover his own desires and courage for a new life path. A warm and sincere film about motherhood, dreams and the fact that it's never too late to start over. Original title: TONI / French film, 2023 / Director, screenplay: Nathan Ambrosioni / Starring: Camille Cottin, Lea Lopez, Thomas Gioria. / Toni je samska mama petih otrok, ki svoje življenje že leta posveča družini. Njene mladostne sanje o pevski karieri so se umaknile vsakdanjim obveznostim. Ko najstarejši otroci počasi začnejo zapuščajo dom, pa se Toni znajde pred vprašanjem, kaj si želi v prihodnosti. Kljub negotovim službam in finančnim skrbem poskuša znova odkriti lastne želje in pogum za novo življenjsko pot. Topel in iskren film o materinstvu, sanjah ter o tem, da nikoli ni prepozno začeti znova.Izvirni naslov: TONI / Francoski film, 2023 / Režija, scenarij: Nathan Ambrosioni / Igrajo: Camille Cottin, Lea Lopez, Thomas Gioria.

programme.desc: A Johann Strauss Celebration The Wiener Symphoniker In Trieste; On the occasion of the 200th anniversary of the birth of composer Johann Strauss Jr., the Vienna Symphony Orchestra performed in the magnificent Trieste Teatro Rossetti. The recording of the concert is enriched by visually luxurious shots of Miramar Castle and its surroundings. / A Johann Strauss Celebration The Wiener Symphoniker In Trieste; Dunajski simfoniki so ob 200. obletnici rojstva skladatelja Johanna Straussa mlajšega nastopili v veličastnem tržaškem gledališču Teatro Rossetti. Program so zaznamovale priljubljene Straussove skladbe ter skladbe Franza Lehárja in Petra Iljiča Čajkovskega. Dunajske simfonike po novem vodi dirigent Petr Popelka. Posnetek koncerta bogatijo vizualno razkošni posnetki gradu Miramar in okolice.

programme.title: Matins
programme.desc: Morning program that gives the keys to the day that begins, explains the news that has happened by providing the context to understand them and analyzes with accredited voices the current affairs nearest and beyond the world. / Programa matinal que dona les claus del dia que comença, explica les notícies que han passat aportant-ne el context per entendre-les i analitza amb veus acreditades lactualitat mes propera i la darreu del mon.

programme.title: Everything is soft / Tot es mou
programme.desc: Helena Garcia Melero runs this daily magazine that follows current affairs, gives voice to the protagonists of the moment and deals with those issues that most closely affect the citizens with a friendly and distracted tone. / Helena Garcia Melero condueix aquest magazín diari que segueix lactualitat, dona veu als protagonistes del moment i tracta aquelles questions que toquen mes de prop els ciutadans amb un to amable i distret.

programme.title: Telenotícies comarques
programme.desc: Daily news, directed and presented by Núria Sole, with local and regional information that highlights the voice of the street, the witnesses and the protagonists of the news. TN Comarques explains and reflects the reality of towns and cities in Catalonia. / Informatiu diari, dirigit i presentat per Núria Sole, amb informacio local i comarcal que posa en valor la veu del carrer, els testimonis i els protagonistes de la notícia. TN Comarques explica i reflecteix la realitat dels pobles i ciutats de Catalunya.

programme.title: Telenotícies migdia
programme.desc: Daily news that includes the most outstanding current events, collected by TVC's news services, with the support of chronicles and connections with correspondents and special envoys around the world. / Informatiu diari que inclou els esdeveniments mes destacats de lactualitat, recollits pels serveis informatius de TVC, amb el suport de les cròniques i les connexions amb els corresponsals i enviats especials arreu del mon.

programme.title: Cuines
programme.desc: Space where chef Marc Ribas offers recipes that anyone can make and with easy-to-find ingredients. In addition, the program has the advice section in which Ribas explains curiosities about the products and tricks to know how to buy better. / Espai en el qual el cuiner Marc Ribas ofereix receptes que tothom pot fer i amb ingredients fàcils de trobar. A mes, el programa compta amb la seccio el consell en la que Ribas explica curiositats dels productes i trucs per saber comprar millor.

programme.title: Cuines
programme.desc: Space where chef Marc Ribas offers recipes that anyone can make and with easy-to-find ingredients. In addition, the program has the advice section in which Ribas explains curiosities about the products and tricks to know how to buy better. / Espai en el qual el cuiner Marc Ribas ofereix receptes que tothom pot fer i amb ingredients fàcils de trobar. A mes, el programa compta amb la seccio el consell en la que Ribas explica curiositats dels productes i trucs per saber comprar millor.

programme.title: Like it was yesterday / Com si fos ahir
programme.desc: A group of former high school classmates meet again, after twenty-five years, at the funeral of one of them. The time at the high school turned them into a heterogeneous group, hooligans and full of life, but life dealt them very different cards. TV3's new bet on the table, after the end of La Riera, which was broadcast for eight seasons. As if it were yesterday takes place in Barcelona and the protagonists live spread over the entire geography of the city. The series, starring Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d'ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) and Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), wants to present an everyday life that can sometimes be raw, sometimes pathetic, but which can also be tender, light and even funny. / Una colla dantics companys dinstitut es retroben, despres de vint-i-cinc anys, al funeral dun dells. Lèpoca de linstitut els va convertir en un grup heterogeni, gamberro i ple de vida, però la vida els va anar repartint fitxes molt diverses.Nova aposta de TV3 per la sobretaula, despres del final de La Riera, que es va emetre durant vuit temporades. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. La sèrie, protagonitzada per Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d’ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) i Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), vol presentar una quotidianitat que de vegades pot ser crua, de vegades patètica, però que tambe pot ser tendra, lleugera i, fins i tot, divertida.

programme.title: Ladies' paradise / El paraíso de las señoras
programme.desc: Betrayed by her boyfriend, Teresa leaves the village and flees to the big city. There he discovers that his uncle's store is going through difficulties due to the opening of a large warehouse El Paradís de les Senyores. / Traïda pel seu xicot, Teresa sen va de poble i fuig a la gran ciutat. Allà descobreix que la botiga del seu oncle passa per dificultats a causa de lobertura duns grans magatzems El Paradís de les Senyores.

programme.title: The jungle: Episode 34 / La selva: Episodi 34
programme.desc: Xavier Grasset presents this afternoon magazine in which the current affairs of the day are reviewed in a relaxed way. A meeting full of knowledge and follow-up of the events of the day, but also with a lot of entertainment and with various collaborators. / Xavier Grasset presenta aquest magazín de tardes en el que es fa un repàs a lactualitat del dia de forma distesa. Una trobada plena de coneixement i seguiment dels fets del dia, però tambe amb molt dentreteniment i amb diversos col·laboradors.

programme.title: Atrapam si pots: Episode 188 / Atrapam si pots: Episodi 188
programme.desc: Llucià Ferrer presents this question and answer contest in which six contestants compete to win the pot. The questions cover the whole field of knowledge, focus on trivia and make use of word games and riddles. / Llucià Ferrer presenta aquest concurs de preguntes i respostes en què sis concursants competeixen per guanyar el pot. Les preguntes abasten tot el camp del coneixement, se centren en curiositats i fan ús de jocs de paraules i endevinalles.

programme.title: It's Happening: Episode 34 / Està passant: Episodi 34
programme.desc: Satirical news presented by Òscar Andreu, Jair Dominguez, Natza Farre and Queco Novell, which analyzes the keys to the current affairs of the day. Lespai also gives voice to experts to give their opinion on current events and interview its main protagonists. / Informatiu satíric presentat per Òscar Andreu, Jair Dominguez, Natza Farre i Queco Novell, que analitza les claus de lactualitat del dia. Lespai tambe dona veu a experts perquè donin la seva opinio sobre lactualitat i entrevista els seus principals protagonistes.

programme.title: Telenotícies vespre
programme.desc: Daily information that collects the most outstanding events in the Catalan, national and international sphere. From Monday to Friday, Toni Cruanyes is in charge of presenting the news of the day. / Informatiu diari que recull els esdeveniments mes destacats en làmbit català, estatal i internacional. De dilluns a divendres, Toni Cruanyes es lencarregat de presentar les notícies de la jornada.

programme.title: Euphoria Dance Kids: Gala 5 / Eufòria Dance Kids: Gala 5
programme.desc: The Euphoria Dance Kids grand finale is here and we will finally know which of these four groups: UKA Junior, the Kanalles, the 9KS and the Black Bubbles, is the most euphoric children's dance group in Catalonia and will be traveling to London to see a musical. / Arriba la gran final dEufòria Dance Kids i per fi coneixerem quin daquests quatre grups: UKA Junior, els Kanalles, les 9KS i els Black Bubbles, es el grup de ball infantil mes eufòric de Catalunya i semportarà el viatge a Londres per veure un musical.

programme.title: Euphoria Dance: The great ending / Eufòria Dance: La gran final
programme.desc: The 16 applicants who have managed to reach the grand final gala will have to fight with all their weapons to obtain one of the 12 places that will allow them to dance in the second edition of "Euphória". / Els 16 aspirants que han aconseguit arribar a la gran gala final hauran de lluitar amb totes les seves armes per obtenir una de les 12 places que els permetran ballar a la segona edicio d’“Eufòria”.

programme.title: Mesnit
programme.desc: Informative space with Marina Romero at the head, which has the will to be a center for debating ideas and analyzing political activity. / Espai informatiu amb Marina Romero al capdavant que te la voluntat de ser un centre de debat didees i danàlisi de lactivitat política.

programme.title: Like it was yesterday / Com si fos ahir
programme.desc: A group of former high school classmates meet again, after twenty-five years, at the funeral of one of them. The time at the high school turned them into a heterogeneous group, hooligans and full of life, but life dealt them very different cards. TV3's new bet on the table, after the end of La Riera, which was broadcast for eight seasons. As if it were yesterday takes place in Barcelona and the protagonists live spread over the entire geography of the city. The series, starring Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d'ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) and Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), wants to present an everyday life that can sometimes be raw, sometimes pathetic, but which can also be tender, light and even funny. / Una colla dantics companys dinstitut es retroben, despres de vint-i-cinc anys, al funeral dun dells. Lèpoca de linstitut els va convertir en un grup heterogeni, gamberro i ple de vida, però la vida els va anar repartint fitxes molt diverses.Nova aposta de TV3 per la sobretaula, despres del final de La Riera, que es va emetre durant vuit temporades. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. La sèrie, protagonitzada per Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d’ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) i Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), vol presentar una quotidianitat que de vegades pot ser crua, de vegades patètica, però que tambe pot ser tendra, lleugera i, fins i tot, divertida.

programme.desc: Short archive. Kjell Svensson and "Totte" Bengtsson had a chance to become the first Swedes in the NHL. With dishes such as carrot hot dogs, chili sin carne and vegan cone buns, the hope is to create a menu that even the most die-hard cone lover cannot refuse. / Vegetariskt har de lagat tidigare, men nu tar matbroderna James och Adam Price ytterligare ett steg och lagar 100 procent veganskt. Med ratter som hot dogs gjorda på morot, chili sin carne och veganska kottbullar ar forhoppningen att skapa en meny som inte ens den mest inbitne kottalskaren kan tacka nej till.

programme.desc: It is early summer when Markus Torgeby meets the actor Ewa Froling in Roslagen's skargård, for a conversation about the spirituality of life. Ewa is often associated with being belligerent, very funny, and has said that she hates the forest. But does she really do that? / Det ar forsommar nar Markus Torgeby traffar skådespelaren Ewa Froling i Roslagens skargård, for ett samtal om livets andlighet. Ewa forknippas ofta med att vara stridbar, sylvasst rolig, och har sagt att hon hatar skogen. Men gor hon verkligen det?

programme.title: Skavlan och Sverige
programme.desc: Are you ready to die for Sweden? We test the Swedish will to defend with Alexander Karim, Robert Aschberg, Ewa Skoog Haslum, Emil Hansius, Gudrun Schyman and Alice Stenlof. There will also be an exclusive interview with Jens Stoltenberg about the 10 turbulent years as NATO's Secretary General. / Är du beredd att do for Sverige? Vi testar den svenska forsvarsviljan med Alexander Karim, Robert Aschberg, Ewa Skoog Haslum, Emil Hansius, Gudrun Schyman och Alice Stenlof. Det blir aven en exklusiv intervju med Jens Stoltenberg om de 10 turbulenta åren som NATO:s generalsekreterare.

programme.title: Dorsey Plays Up! / Dorsey spelar upp!
programme.desc: Music-filled biography of the two brothers Tommy and Jimmy Dorsey, who play themselves in the film. We get to follow the brothers from growing up in Pennsylvania, with a father who insisted they learn music, to their breakthrough in the late 1920s. But Jimmy and Tommy bicker constantly, which leads to a split between them. / Musikfylld biografi om de två broderna Tommy och Jimmy Dorsey, som spelar sig sjalva i filmen. Vi får folja broderna från uppvaxten i Pennsylvania, med en pappa som insisterade på att de skulle lara sig musik, till deras genombrott i slutet på 1920-talet. Men Jimmy och Tommy gralar konstant vilket leder till en splittring dem emellan.

programme.title: Dromslottet
programme.desc: Follow Dick and Angel as they swap their three-bedroom flat in Essex for an abandoned chateau in France. Med liten budget, storslagna drommar och en rejal dos driftighet återger de slottet sin forna glans.

programme.title: Allt for Sverige
programme.desc: Postcard-beautiful Bjarehalvon welcomes ten Swedish-Americans who arrive by boat to Torekov. Have them learn everything about Bjarehalvon's most famous tuber - the potato. programme.desc: Jannika and Dennis were welcomed into the experiment when they had almost given up hope of male sex. The path there has been lined with impotence problems, deep wounds from previous relationships, panic attacks and damaged self-images - but their masculinity has only grown stronger! , Now a new everyday life together in Malmo and soon their first child is needed. The hopes are high, but the worries are there: Jannika is in a new city, far from her network, and her previous miscarriage worries her. Dennis has battled panic attacks - but now the big question is whether he is ready to become a father. It will be a sensational continuation of one of GVFÖ's most tested - and strongest - male play stories. / Jannika och Dennis mottes i experimentet nar de nastan hade gett upp hoppet om karlek. Vagen dit har varit kantad av impotensproblem, djupa sår från tidigare relationer, panikångest och stukade sjalvbilder - men deras karlek har bara vuxit sig starkare! , Nu vantar en ny vardag tillsammans i Malmo och snart aven deras forsta barn. Forhoppningarna ar stora, men oron finns dar: Jannika ar i en ny stad, långt från sitt natverk, och hennes tidigare missfall gor henne orolig. Dennis har kampat mot panikångesten - men nu ar den stora frågan om han ar redo att bli pappa. Det blir en kanslosam fortsattning på en av GVFÖ:s mest provade - och starkaste - karlekshistorier.

programme.title: Married at first sight - in winter clothes / Gift vid forsta ogonkastet - i vinterskrud
programme.desc: "Now you're going to nibble on my boar's snout." Time for honeymoons that offer both possibilities and trials. Can Abtin and Hanna enjoy the silence? Can Jimmy and Malin manage an adventure? Is playfulness the key for Yury and Patrik? And what happens when Tobias and Hampus are challenged in truth or trickery? / "Nu ska du nafsa på min orsnibb." Dags for brollopsresor som bjuder på både mojligheter och provningar. Kan Abtin och Hanna njuta av tystnaden? Klarar Jimmy och Malin ett aventyr? Är lekfullhet nyckeln for Yury och Patrik? Och vad hander nar Tobias och Hampus utmanas i sanning eller konka?

programme.title: Kulturfrågan Kontrapunkt
programme.desc: Stardom in the studio when the court singer Anne Sofie von Otter performed high-class music. In the qualifying match, it is decided which teams go to the finals, under the strict supervision of Stina Ekblad, presenter Ella Petersson and judge Rickard Soderberg. / Stjarnglans i studion då hovsångerskan Anne Sofie von Otter framfor hogkaratig musik. I kvallens match avgors vilka lag som går till final, under strang overvakning av Stina Ekblad, programledare Ella Petersson och domare Rickard Soderberg.

programme.title: Cyklopernas land
programme.desc: A smart, silly and funny program about the week's cultural gossip. Host Christopher Garplind invites some of the country's smartest cultural minds to tackle big and small issues from the past week. There will be fun talk, sharp exchanges, intellectual deep dives and a lot of completely normal nonsense. / Ett smart, dumt och roligt program om veckans kultursnackisar. Programledare Christopher Garplind bjuder in några av landets smartaste kulturhjarnor som tar sig an stora och små frågor från veckan som passerat. Det blir kul snack, vassa meningsutbyten, intellektuella djupdyk och riktigt mycket helt vanligt trams.

programme.title: Husdrommar
programme.desc: Juha and Nika have lived together and now decided to build a house together, an architect-designed house on five levels. Will they be able to row ashore this difficult project? / Juha och Nika har bott i lagenhet och nu bestamt sig for att bygga hus tillsammans, ett arkitektritat hus i fem nivåer. Kommer de att kunna ro iland detta svåra projekt?

programme.title: Spisa med Price
programme.desc: They have cooked vegetarian before, but now food brothers James and Adam Price are taking another step and cooking 100 percent vegan. With dishes such as carrot hot dogs, chili sin carne and vegan cone buns, the hope is to create a menu that even the most die-hard cone lover cannot refuse. / Vegetariskt har de lagat tidigare, men nu tar matbroderna James och Adam Price ytterligare ett steg och lagar 100 procent veganskt. Med ratter som hot dogs gjorda på morot, chili sin carne och veganska kottbullar ar forhoppningen att skapa en meny som inte ens den mest inbitne kottalskaren kan tacka nej till.

programme.title: Stromso
programme.desc: Creating your own textile monster prints is fun and with potatoes you can make stylish and stylish monsters very easily. Hanna Enlund gives ideas on different monster combinations. Jim and Camilla create two completely different interior details with odd cabinet and flea market finds. Jim decorates a lamp cord with everything from salt shakers and massage candles to tools and trinkets. Camilla glues and paints bowls with fun shapes to create different shaped vases. Alexandra explains how to make a warming oil from fir needles and shows how to use massage cones. / Att skapa egna textila monstertryck ar roligt och med potatis kan du få till snygga och stilrena monster valdigt enkelt. Hanna Enlund ger ideer på olika monsterkombinationer. Jim och Camilla skapar två helt olika inredningsdetaljer med udda skåp- och loppisfynd. Jim dekorerar en lampsladd med allt från saltstroare och massingsljusstakar till verktyg och trakulor. Camilla limmar och målar skålar med roliga former for att skapa olika figurvaser. Alexandra berattar om hur du gor en varmande olja av granbarr och visar hur du anvander massagekottar.

programme.title: Gokvall
programme.desc: Interview with actress and director Sissela Kyle. Johanna Westman inspires in cooking and florist Gabriella Ytterbom shows what the host can offer. Program manager: Beppe Starbrink. / Intervju med skådespelerskan och regissoren Sissela Kyle. Johanna Westman inspirerar i koket och floristen Gabriella Ytterbom visar vad hosten kan bjuda på. Programledare: Beppe Starbrink.

programme.title: Age crisis with Keyyo and Rheborg / Ålderskris med Keyyo och Rheborg
programme.desc: The trip to Spain has offered cigars, liters of wine and spontaneous dancing at tapas restaurants. At home in Sweden, they choose to find out their biological age. Keyyo shares everything about organ donation, about life as a single mother and a lot about botox procedures. Johan offers Keyyo the first sailing of his life on the newly acquired sailboat. At sea they celebrate birthdays and shout at the top of their lungs, just like the monk in Japan said you should. / Spanienresan har bjudit på cigarrer, litervis av vin och spontandans på tapasrestauranger. Hemma i Sverige valjer de att ta reda på sin biologiska ålder. Keyyo lar sig allt om aggdonation, om livet som ensamstående mamma och en hel del om botox-ingrepp. Johan bjuder med Keyyo på livets forsta seglats på den nyinskaffade segelbåten. Till havs firar de fodelsedag och skriker for full hals, precis som munken i Japan sa att man skulle.

programme.title: Svenska nyheter
programme.desc: The program that explains why things are the way they are, how they should be, and jokes about things that are politics and things that you don't know are politics. , Host is the comedian Messiah Hallberg. / Programmet som forklarar varfor saker ar som de ar, hur de borde vara, och skamtar om sånt som ar politik och sånt som man inte vet ar politik. , Programledare ar komikern Messiah Hallberg.

programme.title: Under bar himmel
programme.desc: It is early summer when Markus Torgeby meets the actor Ewa Froling in Roslagen's skargård, for a conversation about the spirituality of life. Ewa is often associated with being belligerent, very funny, and has said that she hates the forest. But does she really do that? / Det ar forsommar nar Markus Torgeby traffar skådespelaren Ewa Froling i Roslagens skargård, for ett samtal om livets andlighet. Ewa forknippas ofta med att vara stridbar, sylvasst rolig, och har sagt att hon hatar skogen. Men gor hon verkligen det?

programme.title: Sverige!
programme.desc: Dick Harrison is a guest of Farah Abadi. Historian Dick Harrison has written more than 100 books. As a child and youth, his parents tried to curb his tantrums. Education was not important and too much knowledge was dangerous. Nowadays, Dick Harrison takes every opportunity to spread knowledge about history in order to learn from it and warn our democracy. , Giving new life to dilapidated houses is a heart project for many. We meet one of these who has taken on an old general store in Skåne. In addition, we encourage the artist from Småland who creates works in bronze together with casters in Vadstena. / Dick Harrison ar gast hos Farah Abadi. Historikern Dick Harrison har skrivit fler an 100 bocker. Som barn och ung forsokte hans foraldrar begransa hans lasande. Bildning var inte viktigt och for mycket kunskap var farligt. Numera tar Dick Harrison alla tillfallen att sprida kunskap om historien for att lara av den och varna vår demokrati. , Att ge nytt liv åt forfallna odehus ar ett hjarteprojekt for många. Vi traffar en av dessa som tagit sig an en gammal lanthandel i Skåne. Dessutom moter vi den smålandska konstnaren som skapar verk i brons tillsammans med konstgjutare i Vadstena.

programme.title: Under the cap on Bengan Janson / Under kepsen på Bengan Janson
programme.desc: Bengan Janson is the accordion player who works with almost everyone. Importantly and musically, he swings between genres and styles. In the film we portray Bengan's charm and great versatility together with: Helen Sjoholm, Lennart Jahkel, Lars Ericsson, Ann Sofie von Otter, Tommy Korberg, Allan Janson, Eva Janson, Östen med Resten, Linda Pettersson, Thomas Di Leva, Anders Eriksson from Galenskaparna, Uppsala Storband, Emil Ernebro, Matte Lagerwall from The Boppers, Loa Falkman, Per Gudmundson, Janne Åstrom, Malin Foxdal and Hans Backenroth. / Bengan Janson ar dragspelaren som jobbar med nastan alla. Vigt och musikaliskt svingar han sig mellan genrer och stilar. I filmen moter vi Bengans charm och stora mångsidighet tillsammans med: Helen Sjoholm, Lennart Jahkel, Lars Ericsson, Ann Sofie von Otter, Tommy Korberg, Allan Janson, Eva Janson, Östen med Resten, Linda Pettersson, Thomas Di Leva, Anders Eriksson från Galenskaparna, Uppsala Storband, Emil Ernebro, Matte Lagerwall från The Boppers, Loa Falkman, Per Gudmundson, Janne Åstrom, Malin Foxdal och Hans Backenroth.

programme.title: On track / På spåret
programme.desc: It's finally time for a new season of På spåret, Sweden's most popular quiz show. Kristian Luuk is the host and Fredrik Lindstrom the judge. / Äntligen ar det dags for en ny sasong av På spåret, Sveriges mest populara frågesportprogram. Kristian Luuk ar programledare och Fredrik Lindstrom domare.

programme.title: Carina Bergfeldt
programme.desc: In the first program of the season, Carina Bergfeldt meets Princess Martha Louise and Durek Verrett. They talk about their first year as married and the criticism from the Norwegian people after the talked about documentary Rebel Royals on Netflix. We encourage Daniel Nannskog, who for 13 years engaged and entertained as a football expert on SVT. But now it's time for new adventures - in the USA. Tania Gazi was sexually abused by her foster father. It turned out that she was far from alone in being affected in the family home. Now she has written a book about the case. Also: Pelle Almqvist and The Hives are out on their biggest world tour to date. The band ends the program with the song "The Hives Forever Forever The Hives". / I sasongens forsta program traffar Carina Bergfeldt prinsessan Martha Louise och Durek Verrett. De berattar om forsta året som gifta och kritiken från norska folket efter den omtalade dokumentaren Rebel Royals på Netflix. Vi moter Daniel Nannskog som i 13 år engagerat och roat som fotbollsexpert på SVT. Men nu ar det dags for nya aventyr - i USA. Tania Gazi utsattes for sexuellt ofredande av sin familjehemspappa. Det visade sig att hon var långt ifrån ensam om att vara drabbad i familjehemmet. Nu har hon skrivit en bok om fallet. Dessutom: Pelle Almqvist och The Hives ar ute på sin storsta varldsturne hittills. Bandet avslutar programmet med låten ”The Hives Forever Forever The Hives”.

programme.title: Allt for Sverige
programme.desc: Postcard-beautiful Bjarehalvon welcomes ten Swedish-Americans who arrive by boat to Torekov. Have them learn everything about Bjarehalvon's most famous tuber - the potato. There will be a morning dip and Swedish coffee with singing at Hasse Andersson's. For Maybeth, she is also in for several unpleasant surprises when she learns more about her slaughter history. Program manager: Anders Lundin. / Vykortsvackra Bjarehalvon valkomnar tio svenskamerikaner som anlander med båt till Torekov. Har får de lara sig allt om Bjarehalvons mest beromda knol - potatisen. Det blir morgondopp och svenskt fika med sång hos Hasse Andersson. For Maybeth vantar dessutom flera kanslosamma overraskningar nar hon får veta mer om sin slakthistoria. Programledare: Anders Lundin.

programme.title: Spelet
programme.desc: The simple game of rock, scissors, bag turns into bloody seriousness when ice-cold strategy decisions are made if the team is to win - or perhaps be forced to watch someone disappear. The stress increases. Some eager players continue to look for secret clues in the suite and overanalyze every detail, but perhaps the stable should focus on their team, their tactics and avoiding elimination. A cunning plan persuades a habit of spending money on the wrong person, which boils down to a more long-term strategy. Who dares to risk his loyalty among his friends to rust out the strongest player? / Den simpla leken sten, sax, påse blir till blodigt allvar nar iskalla strategibeslut avgor om laget ska vinna - eller kanske tvingas se någon forsvinna. Stressen tilltar. Några ivriga spelare fortsatter leta hemliga ledtrådar i sviten och overanalyserar varje detalj, men borde kanske istallet fokusera på sitt lag, sin taktik och att undvika utrostning. En slug plan overtalar en van att spendera pengar på fel person vilket kokar ner till en mer långsiktig strategi. Vem vågar riskera sin lojalitet bland sina vanner for att rosta ut den starkaste spelaren?

programme.title: The Hack
programme.desc: Following a tip from an anonymous caller, journalist Nick Davies begins to examine information about systematic wiretapping at Rupert Murdoch's News of the World. / Efter ett tips från en anonym kalla borjar journalisten Nick Davies granska uppgifter om systematisk telefonavlyssning på Rupert Murdochs News of the World.

programme.title: Forsta dejten
programme.desc: It's time for the end of the season, but before Andrea, Cato and Daniel shut down the restaurant for the time being, the last guests will have a chance to fall in love. After 10 years of heartache, 31-year-old Josefine from Gothenburg is probably ready for manhood. Hopefully that man is Ina, 31, from Ljungby. Ina has stagnated in her dating, but with a little pressure from home, she has ventured out on a date. In the bar, Josefine offers a real plot twist that makes Ina's jaw drop. Minna, 26, from Uppsala has never had a relationship but now she has decided to tear down her walls and go all in on the date! Max, 31, from Norrkoping longs to become such a crazy guy and maybe now it will probably happen. As if that wasn't enough, Cato offers a romantic surprise that rubs off on all the couples in the restaurant, and Daniel looks back on a season full of masculinity and courage. / Det har blivit dags for sasongsavslutning, men innan Andrea, Cato och Daniel stanger ner restaurangen for den har gången ska de sista gasterna få chans att bli foralskade. 31-åriga Josefine från Goteborg kanner efter 10 år av hjartesorg sig antligen redo for karlek. Forhoppningsvis ar den karleken Ina, 31, från Ljungby. Ina har stagnerat i sitt dejtande men med lite påtryckningar hemifrån har hon vågat sig ut på dejt. I baren bjuder Josefine på en riktig plot twist som får Ina att tappa hakan. Minna, 26, från Uppsala har aldrig haft en relation men nu har hon bestamt sig for att riva sina murar och gå all in på dejten! Max, 31, från Norrkoping langtar efter att bli sådar galet kar och kanske ar det nu det antligen hander. Som om inte det vore nog bjuder Cato på en romantisk overraskning som smittar av sig på alla par i restaurangen och Daniel blickar tillbaka på en sasong full av karlek och mod.

programme.title: Alone Norge
programme.desc: Only two people remain, while the others have given up due to hunger, loneliness and the harsh landscape. The last participants fight to prove that they are the strongest - both mentally and physically. / Bara två personer ar kvar, medan de andra har gett upp på grund av hunger, ensamhet och det hårda landskapet. De sista deltagarna kampar for att bevisa att de ar starkast - både mentalt och fysiskt.

Fredde thinks he knows a stable where Linus might have gone, but when it comes down to it, they are struck by the confusion of what they might find. Medverkande: Julia Heveus, Molly Nutley, Oskar Laring, Ulf Stenberg och Otto Fahlgren.

programme.desc: The past and the present begin to merge for Fia and when a body is found in a lake, suspicion is directed at the city's most powerful man - Bill McGuire. / Det forflutna och nuet borjar smalta samman for Fia och nar en kropp hittas i en sjo riktas misstankarna mot stadens maktigaste man - Bill McGuire.

programme.title: Vapenbroder
programme.desc: Sweden and Finland were long one and the same country and we fought together against our common enemy. Now we are united again through NATO. But what weapons and fighting techniques have we used over the centuries? How effective was the knight's sword, how hard could you shoot with a crossbow and how accurate was the musket? Mirka Kettunen tests old weapon techniques and talks about our common defense history. / Sverige och Finland var lange ett och samma land och vi stred tillsammans mot vår gemensamma fiende. Nu ar vi åter forenade genom Nato. Men vilka vapen och stridstekniker har vi anvant genom århundradena? Hur effektivt var egentligen riddarsvardet, hur hårt kunde man skjuta med ett armborst och hur traffsaker var muskoten? Mirka Kettunen testar gamla vapentekniker och berattar om vår gemensamma forsvarshistoria.

programme.desc: What is required to transform one's innermost thoughts into a book that depends and changes? Gunilla and Åsa open up about their strong journey to write a book that helps deaf parents understand their deaf children, an account filled with vulnerability and insight. Marcus talks about his long struggle and the joy of apparently having his book published - a dream that came true after many attempts. / Vad kravs for att forvandla sina innersta tankar till en bok som beror och forandrar? Gunilla och Åsa oppnar upp om sin starka resa att skriva en bok som hjalper horande foraldrar att forstå sina dova barn, en berattelse fylld av sårbarhet och insikt. At the same time, Anders and Kinderick head out in search of hot outfits for the beach. / Emma och Annie bjuder på en fartfylld bilfard och parkeringstrubbel innan de kommer fram till en karibisk strand. Samtidigt beger sig Anders och Kinderick ut på jakt efter heta outfits for stranden.

programme.title: Svenska Truckers
programme.desc: Blixten must deliver a stone crusher between two different gravel tracks, but the time pressure will be great. Linnea tries to keep track of the transports during her delivery round - and it's no easy feat. / Blixten ska leverera en stenkross mellan två olika grustakter, men tidspressen blir stor. Linnea forsoker hålla ordning och reda på transporterna under sin leveransrunda – och det ar ingen latt match.

programme.title: A-X-L
programme.desc: Miles meets A.X.L., a modern military dog ​​with artificial intelligence, and they become friends. But A.X.L.'s creators are on a desperate hunt for him and Miles must do everything to stop it. / Miles moter A.X.L., en modern militarhund med artificiell intelligens, och de blir vanner. Men A.X.L.s skapare ar på desperat jakt efter honom och Miles måste gora allt for att stoppa det.

programme.title: Uncharted
programme.desc: The street-smart thief Nathan Drake is recruited by the treasure hunter Sully to solve one of the world's oldest mysteries - and at the same time bring home the form age that disappeared 500 years ago. / Den gatusmarta tjuven Nathan Drake rekryteras av skattjagaren Sully for att losa ett av varldens aldsta mysterier – och samtidigt kamma hem den formogenhet som forsvann for 500 år sedan.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Wanted is one of Sweden's oldest television programs, which over several seasons has helped the police solve hundreds of serious crimes, mainly thanks to the viewers. The program is broadcast live from Stockholm with police officers and experts in the studio and on the spot where the crimes take place, around Sweden. The viewers not only get the latest news, but also an overall picture of the current crimes, which can often be difficult to see when the headlines are blowing in the media. / Efterlyst ar ett av Sveriges aldsta tv-program, som under flera sasonger har hjalpt polisen att losa hundratals grova brott, framst tack vare tittarna. Programmet sands live från Stockholm med poliser och experter i studion och på plats dar brotten hander, runt om i Sverige. Tittarna får inte bara de senaste nyheterna utan också en helhetsbild av de aktuella brotten, som ofta kan vara svåra att overblicka nar rubrikerna briserar i medierna.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: NCIS agents from Washington, D.C., L.A. and Hawaii, all of which are in D.C. to attend the party for a beloved professor must soon investigate his shocking suicide. / NCIS-agenter från Washington, D.C., L.A. och Hawaii, som alla ar i D.C. for att delta i festen for en alskad professor måste snart utreda hans chockerande sjalvmord.

programme.title: Amagermannen
programme.desc: The 18-year-old Stine Geisler was murdered in the colder in his law unit in 1990. More than 3,500 people were interrogated, but the murderer was never found. After new tips, the investigation now points towards the Amagerman. / Den 18-åriga Stine Geisler mordades i kallaren i sin lagenhet 1990. Mer an 3 500 personer forhordes, men mordaren hittades aldrig. Efter nya tips pekar nu utredningen mot Amagermannen.

programme.title: Chaos Walking
programme.desc: Two unlikely henchmen embark on a dangerous adventure through the wilderness of an unexplored planet as they try to escape a dangerous reality where every thought can be seen and heard by everyone. / Två osannolika foljeslagare ger sig ut på ett farligt aventyr genom en outforskad planets odemark nar de forsoker fly från en farlig verklighet dar alla tankar kan ses och horas av alla.

programme.title: Nanny
programme.desc: Maxwell's brother, Nigel, comes to town. Maxwell himself doesn't have time to guide him around New York, so Fran gets the job. It turns out that Nigel is a nice guy - so nice that Fran gets a little excited. / Maxwells bror, Nigel, kommer till stan. Sjalv har inte Maxwell tid att guida honom runt i New York, så Fran får uppdraget. Det visar sig att Nigel ar en trevlig prick - så trevlig att Fran blir lite småfortjust.

programme.title: Nanny
programme.desc: Maggie wants a tattoo but both Maxwell and Fran firmly say no. Fran admits that she herself has a tattoo, which she got a long, long time ago and has often bitterly regretted. / Maggie vill ha en tatuering men både Maxwell och Fran sager bestamt stopp. Fran erkanner att hon sjalv har en tatuering, som hon skaffade for lange, lange sen och ofta har ångrat bittert.

programme.title: Unga Mammor
programme.desc: In the last episode of Unga mammor, it's time to kick off 2017 and leave 2016 behind us. Our mothers look back at the highlights from the past year and set goals for the new one. / I det sista avsnittet av Unga mammor ar det dags att kicka igång 2017 lamna 2016 bakom oss. Våra mammor ser tillbaka på hojdpunkterna från det gångna året och satter upp mål for det nya.

programme.title: Nanny
programme.desc: Maggie wants a new car but won't get one from her strange father. Then Fran enters a beauty pageant where the first prize is a car. First, she just has to learn how to handle a gear lever, which is easier said than done. / Maggie vill ha en ny bil men får ingen av sin strange far. Då staller Fran upp i en skonhetstavling dar forsta priset ar en bil. Forst måste hon bara lara sig att hantera en vaxelspak, vilket ar lattare sagt an gjort.

programme.title: Nanny
programme.desc: Fran and Val - two pretty single girls go on vacation to Jamaica over the Christmas weekend. En orkan forstor dock halva nojet och dessutom saknar Fran Maxwell, mer an hon hade trott.

programme.desc: Sasongsavslutning. Sanningen narmar sig samtidigt som misstanksamheten splittrar familjerna. Cathy och Michael dras till en farlig konfrontation dar gamla synder och forodande beslut stalls på sin spets.

programme.title: Fire Country
programme.desc: Station 42 and the Three Rock Crew respond to an alarm from a chemical plant where toxic waste has spilled and caught fire. / Station 42 och Three Rock Crew svarar på ett larm från en kemifabrik dar giftigt avfall har spillts ut och fattat eld.

programme.title: Oxen
programme.desc: Margrethe heads to Corfitzen's hunting lodge and together with Oxen, she makes a surprising discovery. Kajsa looks for Oxen in the forest, but things don't go according to plan. Kajsa soker upp Oxen i skogen, men saker och ting går inte enligt plan. Mossman borjar tvivla på Margrethes lojalitet.

programme.title: Dead and Buried
programme.desc: After the brutal attack on Sally, suspicions grow against Michael. Cathy forsoker overtyga polisen om hans skuld, men sanningen ar svårfångad och faran kryper narmare nar någon tar sig in på sjukhuset.

Folj familjerna Sugden, Dingle och Kings levnadsoden på landsbygden. Drama, karlek och intriger utlovas i denna såpaklassiker som gått i rutan sedan 1972.

programme.title: Speed
programme.desc: Hold on tight and get ready for high-pressure thrills, hair-raising effects and unusual romance, in a film you'll want to watch again and again. Jack Traven, a bomb expert tasked with defusing a bomb placed on a bus by a greedy extortionist. To begin with, Jack, along with passenger Sandra Bullock, must manage to keep the bus cruising through the streets of Los Angeles at more than 80 km/h - otherwise the bomb will explode. A high-octane chase with nerve-wracking tension, non-stop action and surprising turns. / Håll i dig ordentligt och gor dig redo for spanning på hogtryck, hårresande effekter och ovantad romantik, i en film som du kommer att vilja se om och om igen. Jack Traven, en bombexpert med uppdraget att desarmera en bomb som en hamndgirig utpressare har placerat på en buss. Till att borja med måste Jack, tillsammans med passageraren Sandra Bullock, lyckas hålla bussen korande genom Los Angelsles gator i mer an 80 km/h - annars exploderar bomben. En hog-oktanig jakt med nervpirrand spanning, non-stop action och overraskande vandningar.

programme.title: Premeditated murder / Överlagt mord
programme.desc: In the 1930s, Henri Young was sentenced to prison for shoplifting and ends up on the unknown Alcatraz. After an escape attempt, he was put in solitary confinement for three years and when he gets out, he murders his fellow prisoner like crazy. A young lawyer, James Stamphill, is assigned to the case and when he digs into it, he realizes how Young has been treated - Alcatraz has created the killer. Drama thriller with Christian Slater and Kevin Bacon. / På 1930-talet doms Henri Young till fangelse for snatteri och hamnar på okanda Alcatraz. Efter ett rymningsforsok satts han i isoleringscell i tre år och nar han kommer ut mordar han medfången som tjallat. En ung advokat, James Stamphill, tilldelas fallet och nar han nystar i det upptacker han hur Young behandlats - Alcatraz har skapat mordaren. Dramathriller med Christian Slater och Kevin Bacon.

programme.desc: Some of the UK's leading antique experts take to the streets in a collection of classic cars. programme.desc: The refugee Francis tries to find his place in a cold Berlin without papers or a work permit. He takes temporary jobs and tries to keep his head high, but is soon lured by the charismatic drug dealer Reinhold's offer to earn easy money. programme.desc: An old hippopotamus bull hides under the water in the darkness. Once a stately king in Africa's Luangwa Valley. The hippopotamus is a fascinating and often misunderstood animal. programme.title: The history of the world in three minutes / Varldens historia på tre minuter
programme.desc: When man sows a seed, everything changes. We go from hunters and gatherers to settled farmers. And eventually great civilizations are created. But how does it happen? programme.title: Agenda
programme.desc: The agenda delves into the most important trades in Sweden and the world and sets the agenda for next week's debate. The program finds new surprising angles and portrays trends on the rise. / Agenda fordjupar sig i de viktigaste handelserna i Sverige och varlden och satter agendan for nasta veckas debatt. Programmet hittar nya overraskande vinklar och skildrar trender på uppgång.

programme.title: Dokument utifrån
programme.desc: Libertarians in the United States dream of absolute freedom. Their house god is Elon Musk and Donald Trump is their ally. On an island in Honduras, many of the movement's younger fans gather to experiment with digital implants in the body. / Libertarianerna i USA drommer om den absoluta friheten. Deras husgud ar Elon Musk och Donald Trump ar deras allierade. På en o i Honduras samlas många av rorelsens yngre fantaster for att experimentera med digitala implantat i kroppen.

programme.title: Gudstjanst
programme.desc: Sunday's ecumenical service comes from the Salvation Army in Nassjo. Choir leader Evangelina Bergh from Fralsningsarmen preaches and singers and musicians from various local congregations stand for song and music. / Sondagens ekumeniska gudstjanst kommer från Fralsningsarmen i Nassjo. Kårledare Evangelina Bergh från Fralsningsarmen predikar och for sång och musik står olika lokala forsamlingars sångare och musiker.

programme.title: Kortfilmsklubben - engelska
programme.desc: Eleven-year-old Jenny wants to get closer to her older sister Lisa and hangs around her and her new cool habits, against Lisa's will. But everything takes an unusual turn when Jenny witnesses Lisa being bullied. / Elvaåriga Jenny vill komma narmare sin storasyster Lisa och hanger efter henne och hennes nya coola vanner, mot Lisas vilja. Men allt får en ovantad vandning nar Jenny bevittnar hur Lisa blir mobbad.

programme.title: Kortfilmsklubben - spanska
programme.desc: When they are born they are adorable, almost perfect - but they grow so fast! Petit Toujour combines the latest advances in gene therapy and hormone blocking to allow baby happiness to last forever. Humorous depiction of the future possibilities of technology. / Nar de fods ar de bedårande, nastan perfekta - men de vaxer så fort! Petit Toujour kombinerar de senaste framstegen inom genterapi och hormonblockering for att låta bebislyckan vara for evigt. Humoristisk skildring av teknikens framtida mojligheter.

programme.title: Sveriges historia från 1800- till 1900-tal
programme.sub-title: Sex, masculinity and the state / Sex, karlek och staten
programme.desc: The view of masculinity and sex has changed in Sweden over 200 years. From forced celibacy to Stockholm celibacy, the rights of homosexuals, contraceptives and changed divorce laws. How has the Swedes' cohabitation been affected by new laws and norms? / Synen på karlek och sex har forandrats i Sverige under 200 år. Från tvångsaktenskap till Stockholmsaktenskap, homosexuellas rattigheter, preventivmedel och forandrade skilsmassolagar. Hur har svenskarnas samliv påverkats av nya lagar och normer?

programme.title: Fashion with (sign language) / Mote med (teckenspråk)
programme.sub-title: Authorship - the struggle and courage behind a story / Forfattarskap - kampen och modet bakom en berattelse
programme.desc: What is required to transform one's innermost thoughts into a book that depends and changes? Gunilla and Åsa open up about their journey to write a book that helps deaf parents understand their deaf children, an account filled with vulnerability and insight. / Vad kravs for att forvandla sina innersta tankar till en bok som beror och forandrar? Gunilla och Åsa oppnar upp om sin resa att skriva en bok som hjalper horande foraldrar att forstå sina dova barn, en berattelse fylld av sårbarhet och insikt.

programme.title: Norra distriktet
programme.desc: Maria and Samu find out that an internationally wanted triple murderer is hiding in an abandoned cabin. Maria is annoyed that Essi's ex comes and presses on. Niko takes the situation into account. / Maria och Samu får reda på att en internationellt efterlyst trippelmordare gommer sig i en ode stuga. Maria ar irriterad over att Essis ex kommer och tranger sig på. Niko tar tillfallet i akt.

programme.title: 15 minuter från News / 15 minuter från Uutiset
programme.desc: More and more young people in Finland and Sweden choose to adopt conservative consular roles. On social media, some encourage a housewife life, where the woman takes care of the home and children, while the man is responsible for the family's income. What causes the phenomenon? / Allt fler unga i Finland och Sverige valjer att anamma konservativa konsroller. På sociala medier uppmuntrar vissa till ett hemmafruliv, dar kvinnan tar hand om hem och barn, medan mannen står for familjens inkomst. Vad beror fenomenet på?

programme.title: 15 minutes in sign language / 15 minuter på teckenspråk
programme.sub-title: RFSL The Rainbow - An uncertain future / RFSL Regnbågen - En oviss framtid
programme.desc: RFSL Regnbågen has existed for many years, but the future is uncertain. What is the reason for that? What do young people say about the RFSL Rainbow, is it needed? Håkan Collin, who took the initiative to form the association in Sweden, visits the studio. / RFSL Regnbågen har funnits i många år, men framtiden ar oviss. Vad ar orsaken till det? Vad sager unga om RFSL Regnbågen, behovs den? Håkan Collin, som tog initiativ till att bilda foreningen i Sverige, gastar studion.
