programme.title: Monk
programme.sub-title: Mr. Monk conquers Manhattan / Il sig. Monk conquista Manhattan
programme.desc: Detective Monk tells the story of Adrian Monk (Tony Shalhoub), a former policeman suspended from duty due to an obsessive-compulsive disorder aggravated by the death of his wife Trudy (killed by a bomb believed to have been intended for him). Nonetheless, due to his great powers of observation, his wit and intelligence, the police employ him in the most difficult cases as an external consultant. / Detective Monk narra le vicende di Adrian Monk (Tony Shalhoub), ex poliziotto sospeso dal servizio a causa di un disturbo ossessivo-compulsivo aggravato dalla morte della moglie Trudy (uccisa da una bomba che si ritiene fosse destinata a lui). Ciononostante, a causa del suo grande spirito di osservazione, della sua arguzia e intelligenza, la polizia lo impiega nei casi più difficili come consulente esterno.

programme.title: Le indagini di Sister Boniface
programme.desc: England, 1960s. Sister Boniface, Catholic nun and winemaker at the St. Vincent convent, is a forensic scientist who collaborates in local police investigations. / Inghilterra, anni 60. Sister Boniface, suora cattolica e enologa al convento St. Vincent è una scienziata forense che collabora nelle indagini della polizia locale.

programme.title: Serengeti
programme.desc: A fictional story based on the real life animals of the African savannah. The situation is reversed for powerful predators. Those at the top of the food chain find themselves alone and in grave danger, while younger prey are taking a stand and holding on. / Una storia di fantasia basata sulla vita reale degli animali della savana africana. La situazione si capovolge per i potenti predatori. Quelli in cima alla catena alimentare si ritrovano soli e in grave pericolo, mentre le prede più giovani stanno prendendo posizione e tenendo duro.

programme.title: Tiny House - Small houses for living large / Tiny House - Piccole case per vivere in grande
programme.desc: John Weisbarth e Zack Giffin esperti in ristrutturazione viaggiano attraverso lAmerica per mostrarci case minuscole con arredi multifunzione, innovative e dotate di ogni comfort.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: Murder, She Wrote (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American crime drama series starring Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. It aired weekly on CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV movies, until 2003 (such as Sleeper Murder, The Rime of the Lost Boy and Appointment with Death). Angela Lansbury served as executive producer of the show in its final seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspicacious crime writer, who often finds herself dealing with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small town, the fictional Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of Murder, She Wrote is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the producer's first choice. The part was initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however turned it down. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni.Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The butt of... Al Pacino / Il sedere di... Al Pacino
programme.desc: Joey gets his big break in the movie business when he is hired to lend his butt on video, passing it off as Al Pacino's. / Joey ha la sua grande occasione nel mondo del cinema quando viene ingaggiato perche presti il suo sedere in video, facendolo passare per quello di Al Pacino.

programme.desc: Shawn Spencer has the opportunity of a lifetime: opening a detective agency with his friend Gus. And a psychic, or rather, pretends to be one, in reality just has a great gift for noticing details at all times. / Shawn Spencer ha loccasione della sua vita: aprire unagenzia investigativa con il suo amico Gus. E un sensitivo, o meglio, si finge tale, in realtà ha solo una grande dote nel notare i dettagli in ogni momento.

programme.title: Padre Brown
programme.desc: Father Brown is the parish priest of St. Mary's Catholic Church, thanks to his intuition and his passion for detective stories, as well as being the spiritual reference of the inhabitants of the small village, he manages to solve the most complex crimes together with the local police who are not always enthusiastic about his interference. / Padre Brown è il parroco della Chiesa cattolica di St. Mary, grazie al suo intuito e alla sua passione per i gialli, oltre a essere il riferimento spirituale degli abitanti del piccolo villaggio, riesce a risolvere i crimini più complessi insieme alle forze dellordine locali che non sempre sono entusiaste della sua interferenza.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School
programme.desc: In the heart of Borneo, every day at dawn a small community of volunteers goes to a rehabilitation center for orphaned or injured orangutans, where they help them develop the fundamental skills to return to living in freedom in the jungle. / Nel cuore del Borneo, ogni giorno allalba una piccola comunità di volontari si reca in un centro di riabilitazione per oranghi orfani o feriti, dove li aiutano a sviluppare le abilità fondamentali per tornare a vivere in libertà nella giungla.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Two astronauts while they are working on some repairs to an orbiting station are hit by a rain of debris. Left alone, they embark on a race through space to reach another orbiting station and manage to return to Earth. With the oxygen available decreasing little by little, they will have to deal with themselves and what they could lose forever. / Due astronauti mentre stanno lavorando ad alcune riparazioni di una stazione orbitante, vengono investiti da una pioggia di detriti. Rimasti soli, intraprendono una corsa in mezzo alla spazio per raggiungere unaltra stazione orbitante e riuscire a rientrare sulla Terra. Con lossigeno a disposizione che diminuisce poco alla volta, dovranno fare i conti con se stessi e con quello che potrebbero perdere per sempre.

programme.title: I Puffi
programme.sub-title: Rowena's piant / La pianta di Rowena
programme.desc: Among the series most loved by Italian children of multiple generations, many years after the classic cartoon collection, the Smurfs return with a new editorial project. Created by the Belgian author Peyo, the Smurfs represent a magical and fun world that will involve the little ones and their families. Furthermore, the new series is made in a high-quality CGI technique that maintains the warmth of the original. / Tra le serie più amate dai bambini italiani di più generazioni, a distanza di molti anni dalla classica collezione di cartoni animati, i Puffi tornano con un nuovo progetto editoriale. Creati dallautore belga Peyo, i Puffi rappresentano un mondo magico e divertente che potrà coinvolgere i più piccoli e i loro familiari. Inoltre, la nuova serie è realizzata in una tecnica CGI di alta qualità che mantiene il calore delloriginale.

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep / Shaun vita da pecora
programme.sub-title: Balls on the run / Balle in fuga
programme.desc: On the small farm in the English countryside, the life of Shaun the sheep and the flock that follows her in her exploits is disturbed by the farmer's new acquisition: a small group of very bad llamas. As always, the very strong myopia confuses the farmer about the real state of things and the warnings of the faithful dog Bitzer are of no avail. Shaun with his optimistic approach tends to underestimate new guests, until he realizes he has made them a little too comfortable... / Nella piccola fattoria della campagna inglese la vita della pecora Shaun e del gregge che la segue nelle sue imprese è turbata da un nuovo acquisto del fattore: un gruppetto di lama cattivissimi. Come sempre, la fortissima miopia confonde il fattore sul reale stato delle cose ed a nulla valgono gli avvertimenti del fedele cane Bitzer. Shaun con il suo approccio ottimista tende a sottovalutare i nuovi ospiti, finche si rende conto di averli messi un po troppo a loro agio...

programme.title: Segni dei tempi
programme.desc: There are seven thousand Muslims in Ticino. In this episode we will enter the new Sopraceneri mosque. In Giubiasco, this is the news, the Islamic community has purchased a space specifically dedicated to prayer and interreligious meetings. We will meet imam Luan Afmataj with whom we will address some very current issues, from relations with other religions to the role of women in the Islamic world today. / Sono settemila i musulmani in Ticino. In questa puntata entreremo nella nuova moschea del Sopraceneri. A Giubiasco, è questa la novità, la comunità islamica ha acquistato uno spazio appositamente dedicato alla preghiera e agli incontri interreligiosi. Incontreremo l’imam Luan Afmataj con cui affronteremo alcuni temi di stretta attualità, dai rapporti con le altre religioni al ruolo oggi della donna nel mondo islamico.

The woman is in prison, suspected of tax evasion, but proclaiming her innocence, she uses all her charm to convince Florian to help her. / Lavvocato Florian Faber gestisce un prospero studio legale insieme allelegante moglie Eva. Limprovvisa ricomparsa della sua ex fidanzata Sarah, una giornalista, lo coglie di sorpresa. La donna è in carcere, sospettata di evasione fiscale, ma proclamando la sua innocenza, usa tutto il suo fascino per convincere Florian ad aiutarla.

programme.title: Un incontro inaspettato
programme.desc: Original title: Then Came You Director: Adriana Trigiani Cast: with Craig Ferguson, Kathie Lee Gifford, Ford Kiernan, Elizabeth Hurley Genre: Drama Country: USA Year: 2020 Widowed for a year, Annabelle prepares for a journey with her husband's ashes to all the places they both learned to love in the movies. The first stop is a Scottish castle that the owner, Howard, tries in every way to save from bankruptcy. A sparkling and provocative relationship is established between Annabelle and Howard, not without a certain mutual attraction. Howard, however, is about to remarry, albeit to the wrong woman, and Annabelle is determined to carry on with her travel plan. / Titolo originale: Then Came You Regia: Adriana Trigiani Cast: con Craig Ferguson, Kathie Lee Gifford, Ford Kiernan, Elizabeth Hurley Genere: Drammatico Paese: USA Anno: 2020 Vedova da un anno, Annabelle si prepara a un viaggio con le ceneri del marito alla volta di tutti i luoghi che entrambi hanno imparato ad amare nei film. La prima tappa è un castello scozzese che il proprietario, Howard, cerca in ogni modo di salvare dalla bancarotta. Tra Annabelle e Howard si instaura un rapporto frizzante e provocatorio, non privo di una certa attrazione reciproca. Howard però sta per risposarsi, anche se con la donna sbagliata, e Annabelle è determinata a portare avanti il proprio progetto di viaggio.

programme.title: Albert's Garden - Hunt for the oldest DNA / Il giardino di Albert - Caccia al DNA più antico
programme.sub-title: Hunt for the oldest DNA / Caccia al DNA più antico
programme.desc: Under the ice of the great North, a group of scientists has done the unthinkable: they have recovered DNA over two million years old, rewriting the limits of genetics and paleontology. DNA coming not from fossils, but directly from the soil. It is the birth of a new science: environmental DNA. The documentary follows the biologist and geneticist Eske Willerslev and his team on an almost impossible mission, between brilliant intuitions, failures and technological revolutions. Thanks to genetic confetti preserved in the permafrost, a lost world emerges: arctic forests, mastodons, caribou, plants never seen before at those latitudes. An ecosystem that thrived in a warmer climate, similar to the one ahead. In an era of climate change, the past becomes a guide for the future. Ancient genes are studied and inserted into modern plants to make them more resistant. Because perhaps the key to our survival is hidden in the DNA of a vanished world? / Sotto il ghiaccio del grande Nord, un gruppo di scienziati ha compiuto limpensabile: ha recuperato DNA vecchio di oltre due milioni di anni, riscrivendo i limiti della genetica e della paleontologia. DNA proveniente non da fossili, ma direttamente dal suolo. È la nascita di una nuova scienza: il DNA ambientale. Il documentario segue il biologo e genetista Eske Willerslev e la sua squadra in una missione quasi impossibile, tra intuizioni geniali, fallimenti e rivoluzioni tecnologiche. Grazie a coriandoli genetici conservati nel permafrost, emerge un mondo perduto: foreste artiche, mastodonti, caribù, piante mai viste prima a quelle latitudini. Un ecosistema che prosperava in un clima più caldo, simile a quello che ci aspetta. In unepoca di cambiamenti climatici, il passato diventa guida per il futuro. I geni antichi vengono studiati e inseriti in piante moderne per renderle più resistenti. Perche forse, nel DNA di un mondo scomparso, si nasconde la chiave della nostra sopravvivenza?

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School
programme.desc: In the heart of Borneo, every day at dawn a small community of volunteers goes to a rehabilitation center for orphaned or injured orangutans, where they help them develop the fundamental skills to return to living in freedom in the jungle. / Nel cuore del Borneo, ogni giorno allalba una piccola comunità di volontari si reca in un centro di riabilitazione per oranghi orfani o feriti, dove li aiutano a sviluppare le abilità fondamentali per tornare a vivere in libertà nella giungla.

programme.title: Cuntrasts
programme.desc: From refined pink silk dresses and whalebone sleeves, to tulle caps, from gold and wool parade hats, to Napoleonic bicorns. In the attic of the Chesa Planta in Samedan you can find all this and much more. A treasure of fabrics, made up of around 500 pieces, covering three centuries of history. This year the Chesa Planta was finally able to start a scientific inventory of the heritage kept in Samedan. The textile historians, Thessy Schoenholzer Nichols and Briony Langmead, as well as the designer and costume designer Bernhard Duss, were enthusiastic about the unique value of the collection made up of objects belonging to two noble families: the de Salis and de Planta. Each piece in the collection can thus be matched to the real person to whom it belonged. For the director of Chesa Planta, Martina Shuler-Fluor, it is not only an attraction for the public, but also an important resource for research on material culture and historical fashion in the Engadine. Part of the fabrics will be presented to the public next summer. Those who don't want to wait can take advantage of the exclusive preview guaranteed by the RTR cameras. / Dai raffinati abiti in seta rosa e maniche in osso di balena, ai berretti in tulle, dai copricapi da parata in oro e lana, ai bicorni napoleonici. Nel sottotetto della Chesa Planta di Samedan si trova tutto questo e molto altro ancora. Un tesoro di tessuti, composto da circa 500 pezzi, che coprono tre secoli di storia.Quest’anno la Chesa Planta ha finalmente potuto avviare un inventario scientifico del patrimonio custodito a Samedan. Le storiche del tessile, Thessy Schoenholzer Nichols e Briony Langmead, nonche il designer e costumista Bernhard Duss, si sono mostrati entusiasti del valore unico della collezione composta di oggetti appartenuti a due nobili casati: i de Salis e de Planta. Ogni pezzo della collezione può così essere abbinato alla persona reale alla quale è appartenuto.Per la direttrice della Chesa Planta, Martina Shuler-Fluor, non si tratta solo di un’attrazione per il pubblico, ma anche di una risorsa importante per la ricerca sulla cultura materiale e sulla moda storica in Engadina.Una parte dei tessuti sarà presentata al pubblico la prossima estate. Chi non vuole aspettare approfitti dell’anteprima esclusiva assicurata alle telecamere della RTR.

programme.title: The Christmas spell / Le sortilège de Noël

Que ce soit en ligne ou dans le monde reel, elle a tendance à disparaître sans crier gare. Mais lors de la fete de Noël de son bureau, une diseuse de bonne aventure lavertit que si elle ne se reconcilie pas avec tous les hommes quelle a "ghostes" dici Noël, elle sera condamnee à ne jamais trouver le grand amour.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.sub-title: Christmas will be hot / Noël sera chaud

programme.title: Magnum

programme.title: Passe-moi les jumelles
programme.desc: : In the very old ordinary wood-fired oven in Moiry, Jack Capt makes sourdough bread, kneaded by hand. He is also a husband, a father, a father-in-law of a blended family.: Mila, 20 years old, studied philosophy at the University of Geneva. She thought she could remake the world but this academic journey made her sad. She took a 180° turn and chose to become a mason. . / : Dans le très ancien four banal à bois de Moiry, Jack Capt fait du pain au levain, petri à la main. Un defi mais aussi une evidence pour cet homme qui a decide de changer de vie pour se consacrer à sa passion. programme.title: Meurtres en Pays Catalan
programme.desc: During a speleological expedition to Prades, a woman's body surrounded by black snakes with red collars was found in a part of the site closed to the public. Inspector Lionel Orphus is in charge of the case. Having a horror of dark and confined spaces, he must collaborate with the group of underground investigators led by Eleonore Vallance, his great childhood love. Their reunion, 20 years later, does not fail to reawaken old sensations. / Lors d’une expedition speleologique à Prades, un corps de femme entoure de serpents noirs à colliers rouges est retrouve dans une partie du site fermee au public. Linspecteur Lionel Orphus est en charge de l’affaire. Ayant en horreur les espaces sombres et confines, il doit collaborer avec le groupe enqueteurs en milieu souterrain dirige par Eleonore Vallance, son grand amour de jeunesse. Leurs retrouvailles, 20 ans plus tard, ne manquent pas de reveiller de vieilles sensations.

programme.title: Des vivants
programme.sub-title: The days after / Les jours daprès
programme.desc: On November 13, 2015, at the Bataclan, Marie and Arnaud, Caroline, Sebastien, Gregory, Stephane and David were taken hostage by two terrorists in a narrow corridor on the first floor, between 9:59 p.m. and 12:18 a.m. Liberated by the BRI assault, they emerged alive, but devastated. A few days later, they decide to meet again. They are aged 23 to 49, with very different life paths, but they all struggle to restore meaning to their existence. / Le 13 novembre 2015, au Bataclan, Marie et Arnaud, Caroline, Sebastien, Gregory, Stephane et David ont ete pris en otages par deux terroristes dans un etroit couloir du premier etage, entre 21h59 et 00h18. Liberes par l’assaut de la BRI, ils en sortent vivants, mais devastes. Quelques jours plus tard, ils decident de se revoir. Ils ont de 23 à 49 ans, des parcours de vie très differents, mais tous peinent à redonner du sens à leur existence

programme.title: Des vivants
programme.sub-title: The weeks after / Les semaines daprès
programme.desc: The survivors try to get back on track with their lives, but everything seems to be stalled, as if the world was moving forward without them. The nightmares repeat themselves, everyday life becomes difficult to bear. Many begin therapy and gradually understand the extent of the trauma. Exceptionally, the men of the BIS agree to see them again. The exchange is intense, overwhelming, for the saviors as well as for the saved / Les survivants tentent de reprendre le fil de leur vie, mais tout semble decale, comme si le monde avançait sans eux. Les cauchemars se repètent, le quotidien devient difficile à supporter. Plusieurs commencent une therapie et prennent peu à peu la mesure du traumatisme. Exceptionnellement, les hommes de la BRI acceptent de les revoir. L’echange est intense, bouleversant, pour les sauveurs comme pour les sauves

programme.desc: In the absence of Abacus, Louis plays with BA's friends. Mais ceux-ci decident des activites du groupe en votant et en se ralliant à la majorite, ce qui est pour Louis une grande nouveaute…

programme.title: Trollstopia
programme.sub-title: Pass the ball to your neighbor / The Valley of the Future / Passe le ballon à ton voisin / La Val du Futur
programme.desc: All the Trolls in TrollsTopia are having a blast spinning a ball, but when Poppy and Smidge discover that Dolly is hosting a special event, they do everything in their power to stop the game by letting the ball hit the ground. / All the Trolls are delighted that the plants Poppy gave them on their first day in TrollsTopia have finally flowered, except Val. To make sure she has a plant for the party, Val enlists the help of Rhythme and Blue to travel back in time and convince herself to take care of her plant before Poppy finds out. / Tous les Trolls de TrollsTopia samusent comme des fous à faire tourner un ballon, mais lorsque Poppy et Smidge decouvrent que Dolly organise un evenement special, ils font tout ce qui est en leur pouvoir pour arreter le jeu en laissant le ballon toucher le sol. / Tous les Trolls sont ravis que les plantes que Poppy leur a offertes lors de leur premier jour à TrollsTopia aient enfin fleuri, sauf Val. Afin detre sûre davoir une plante pour la fete, Val demande laide de Rhythme and Blue pour voyager dans le temps et se convaincre de prendre soin de sa plante avant que Poppy ne le decouvre.

programme.title: Trollstopia
programme.sub-title: The too original soundtrack of our lives / The Troll-a-Thon / La bande trop originale de nos vies / Le Troll-a-Thon
programme.desc: Poppy attempts to make life in TrollsTopia more exciting by adding an intense soundtrack and narration, courtesy of Dante Crescendo and Barry Groovy. / Synthe and Smidge discover that Sonate Minuet's training for the big race is going to be more difficult than they thought because she never learned to walk. / Poppy tente de rendre la vie à TrollsTopia plus enthousiasmante en ajoutant une bande sonore et une narration intenses, grâce à Dante Crescendo et Barry Groovy. / Synthe et Smidge decouvrent que lentraînement de Sonate Minuet pour la grande course va etre plus difficile quils ne le pensaient car elle na jamais appris à marcher.

programme.title: La famille Weasy
programme.desc: The cans blame Weasy for eating the entire supply of popcorn. Weasy denies: it’s not him! The girls bring back a new package from the farm, part of which disappears almost immediately behind their backs. They decide to lock themselves with the rest in their room, angry with their father. Victim of an injustice, Weasy sets up a trap to find out who the real thief is and prove his innocence to the girls. / Les canettes reprochent à Weasy d’avoir mange toute la reserve de popcorns. Weasy dement : ce nest pas lui ! Les filles ramènent de la ferme un nouveau paquet dont une partie disparait presque aussitôt dans leur dos. Elles decident de s’enfermer avec le reste dans leur chambre, fâchee contre leur père. Victime d’une injustice, Weasy met en place un piège pour decouvrir qui est le veritable voleur et prouver aux filles son innocence.

programme.title: La famille Weasy
programme.desc: The girls are rallying in the radio-controlled jeep. Weasy, who fears that his belongings will be damaged by the girls' more or less controlled vehicle, draws zones prohibited to traffic with chalk. But the girls do not respect the “highway rules” imposed by their father. / Les filles font du rallye dans la jeep radiocommandee. Weasy qui craint que ses affaires soient abimees par le vehicule plus ou moins contrôle des filles, trace des zones interdites à la circulation avec une craie. Mais les filles ne respectent pas le « code de la route » impose par leur père.

programme.title: La famille Weasy
programme.desc: The girls have assembled items from the attic to build an impressive sailing boat on which they play pirates, with a minute's turn for whoever will be the captain. Weasy inserts himself into their game, playing the role of the old sea dog. The girls are over the moon, until Weasy no longer wants to give up his captain's hat, ignoring the rules of the game. The girls have only one solution: mutiny! / Les filles ont assemble des objets du grenier pour construire un impressionnant bateau à voile sur lequel elles jouent aux pirates, avec un tour de rôle minute pour celle qui fera le capitaine. Weasy s’incruste dans leur jeu, à fond dans le rôle du vieux loup de mer. Les filles sont aux anges, jusqu’au moment où Weasy ne veut plus rendre son chapeau de capitaine, ignorant les règles du jeu. Les filles n’ont plus qu’une solution : la mutinerie !

programme.title: Bienvenue chez les Casagrandes
programme.sub-title: Par's dojo / Red tacos / Le dojo de Par / Les tacos rouges
programme.desc: Carl can't stand to see Adelaide take his place as best student in karate class. // Hector decides to sell Rosa's red tacos but finds himself overwhelmed by their success. / Carl ne supporte pas de voir Adelaide prendre sa place de meilleur elève au cours de karate. // Hector decide de vendre les tacos rouges de Rosa mais se retrouve depasse par leur succès.

programme.title: The Rebels of the Forest, the series / Les rebelles de la foret, la serie
programme.desc: After a clash on the lake between the inhabitants of the camp and the animals of the Palais Paradis, Elliot (feeling out of reach in the camp boat) becomes a little too confident and utters hilarious insults against the inhabitants of the Palais. Cleo is shocked and suggests that all these problems be resolved by a duel. Elliot accepts, thinking that these are just empty words, until he discovers who Cleo has chosen to represent her and "cleanse her honor": Susucre, the white tiger of Siberia. An unequal fight if ever there was one. Elliot won't last five minutes. The only way he could beat Susucre would be by choking it while trying to swallow it raw. But the camp residents don't want to give up (and neither does Cleo), so Elliot gets a crash course in self-defense. Less gifted than Elliot for violence, there is no such thing. At the end of his training, he knows he is doomed to certain defeat. But for great evils there are great remedies, Elliot decides to confront Susucre in person, to beg for his mercy before this whole story ends up going badly. He is shocked to discover that Susucre is not very enthusiastic about fighting either. She's tired of being seen as scary and serving as Cleo's foil, but it will be difficult for her to break away from her commitment, for the same reasons as Elliot. Everyone is waiting for the confrontation and we must not disappoint them. That's when they come up with a cunning plan: organize the fight so that no one gets hurt, but everyone is satisfied. But how will this work? / Après un accrochage sur le lac entre les habitants du camp et les animaux du Palais Paradis, Elliot (se sentant hors datteinte dans la barque du camp) prend un peu trop la confiance et profère des insultes hilarantes à lencontre des habitants du Palais. Cleo soffusque et suggère que tous ces problèmes soient regles par un duel. Elliot accepte, pensant que ce ne sont que des paroles en lair, jusquà ce quil decouvre qui Cleo a choisi pour la representer et "laver son honneur" : Susucre, le tigre blanc de Siberie. Un combat inegal sil en est. Elliot ne tiendra pas cinq minutes. La seule façon pour lui de battre Susucre serait quelle setouffe en essayant de lavaler tout cru. Mais les habitants du camp ne veulent pas abandonner (et Cleo non plus), alors Elliot reçoit un cours accelere dautodefense. Moins doue quElliot pour la violence, ça nexiste pas. À la fin de son entraînement, il sait quil est voue à une defaite certaine. Mais aux grands maux les grands remèdes, Elliot decide daffronter Susucre en personne, pour implorer sa pitie avant que toute cette histoire ne finisse par mal tourner. Il est choque de decouvrir que Susucre nest pas non plus très enthousiaste à lidee de se battre. Elle en a assez detre consideree comme effrayante et de servir de faire-valoir à Cleo, mais il lui sera difficile de se defaire de son engagement, pour les memes raisons quElliot. Tout le monde attend laffrontement et il ne faut pas les decevoir. Cest alors quils elaborent un plan astucieux : organiser le combat de manière à ce que personne ne soit blesse, mais que tout le monde soit satisfait. Mais comment cela va-t-il fonctionner ?

programme.title: The Rebels of the Forest, the series / Les rebelles de la foret, la serie
programme.sub-title: Like a fish out of water / Comme un poisson hors de l’eau
programme.desc: Boog thinks he's good at fishing, but in reality he's not. Elliot managed his ego by putting bait on his hooks, even hooking fish on them, which gave Boog a serious overconfidence. When Boog hears about a competition to catch Lake Boogabooga's most famous fish - Liontooth - he decides it will be the greatest catch of his life. He accepts the challenge, leaving Elliot facing a terrible dilemma: should he confess to Boog the danger he is in and reveal to him that he has been lying to him all this time? Or should he continue the charade of keeping his friend in the dark? It ends up being too much and it's a furious Boog and a repentant Elliot who are forced to work together to survive when they find themselves faced with the fishing contest of their lives. / Boog pense quil est doue pour la peche, mais en realite, il nen est rien. Elliot a menage son ego, en mettant des appâts sur ses hameçons, allant meme jusquà y accrocher des poissons, ce qui a donne à Boog un serieux excès de confiance en lui. Lorsque Boog entend parler dun concours pour attraper le poisson le plus celèbre du lac Boogabooga - Dentdelion - il decide que ce sera la plus belle prise de sa vie. Il accepte le defi, laissant Elliot face à un terrible dilemme : doit-il avouer à Boog le danger quil court et lui reveler quil lui a menti pendant tout ce temps ? Ou bien doit-il continuer la mascarade qui consiste à maintenir son ami dans lignorance ? Cela fini par etre trop et ce sont un Boog furieux et un Elliot repentant qui sont obliges de collaborer pour survivre qaund ils se retrouvent confrontes au concours de peche de leur vie.

programme.title: Big Nate
programme.desc: According to a rumor going around Middle School 38, a sad fate awaits Nate the next detention he receives. And if that wasn't enough, an unbalanced student is determined to become his sidekick. / Selon une rumeur qui court au collège 38, un triste sort guette Nate à la prochaine retenue quil recevra. Et comme si cela ne suffisait pas, un elève desequilibre est determine à devenir son acolyte.

programme.title: Big Nate
programme.desc: Martin lends Nate his credit card to make up for his disappointing birthday gifts. After a day of excessive spending, Nate and his friends must pay off their debt. / Martin prete sa carte bancaire à Nate pour compenser ses cadeaux danniversaire decevants. Après une journee de depenses excessives, Nate et ses amis doivent rembourser leur dette.

programme.title: Les super pouvoirs du vivant
programme.sub-title: The Whale and plankton: Droppings to the rescue / La Baleine et plancton : Crottes à la rescousse
programme.desc: Thanks to photosynthesis, phytoplankton produce 50% of the oxygen on earth. And guess what he loves? Whale droppings! Let's find out how whales and phytoplankton contribute to a healthier planet! / Grâce à la photosynthèse, le phytoplancton produit 50 % de l’oxygène sur terre. Et devinez de quoi il raffole ? Des crottes de baleines ! Decouvrons comment baleine et phytoplancton contribuent à une planète en meilleure sante !

programme.title: Les super pouvoirs du vivant
programme.sub-title: Le Blob : Lomelette giant / Le Blob : Lomelette geante
programme.desc: Neither animal nor plant, the blob is an organism that never ceases to surprise us! Scientists recently discovered that it was capable of learning... and even transmitting information to another blob! / Ni animal, ni vegetal, le blob est un organisme qui ne cesse de nous surprendre ! Les scientifique ont decouvert recemment qu’il etait capable d’apprendre… et meme de transmettre des informations à un autre blob !

programme.title: #DansLaToile
programme.desc: Noah discovers that you need to be more careful when giving out your personal data on the Web. We sometimes give them away when we download an application or a game for free. This is information about our daily lives, our tastes, our thoughts, our friends, our private life that we have shared on social networks. But this information collected has value. They are resold to make advertisements that perfectly match our tastes. You think it's free, but your personal information has important value! How to protect your personal data? When possible, it is better to refuse to give this personal information to anyone or else you can create another profile, another invented personality, to keep your information private. / Noah decouvre qu’il faut etre plus vigilant lorsque l’on donne ses donnees personnelles sur le Web. On les donne parfois quand on telecharge gratuitement une application ou un jeu. Ce sont des informations sur notre quotidien, nos goûts, nos pensees, nos amis, notre vie privee qu’on a partagees sur les reseaux sociaux. Mais ces informations recuperees ont de la valeur. Elles sont revendues pour fabriquer des publicites qui correspondent parfaitement à nos goûts. Tu crois que c’est gratuit, mais tes informations personnelles ont une valeur importante ! Comment proteger ses donnees personnelles ? Quand c’est possible, mieux vaut refuser de donner ces informations personnelles à n’importe qui ou sinon on peut se creer un autre profil, une autre personnalite inventee, pour garder ses informations privees.

programme.title: #DansLaToile
programme.sub-title: E-sport or electronic sports / Le E-sport ou Les sports electroniques
programme.desc: Mitzi and Noah discover the sports car for the upcoming race! Electronic sport, ou-sport, is the practice of a video game over a network or on the Internet. There are plenty of them, from violent survival games reserved for older adults, to those recreating a tennis match or a car race... We can play as an amateur from time to time for fun or as a professional, when our scores reach super high levels, and the passion becomes a profession. What is the life of an e-athlete like? The life of an e-sportsman is dedicated to his sport: he trains every day, develops strategies, watches videos of all the tournaments, and he is financed by brands. You have to play a lot when you're a pro. But be careful: an amateur who spends all his time playing means he has become addicted. So we must remain vigilant about the time devoted to games. / Mitzi et Noah decouvrent la voiture de sport pour la course à venir ! Le sport electronique, ou e-sport, est la pratique d’un jeu video en reseau ou sur Internet. Il en existe plein, du jeu de survie violent reserve aux plus grands, à celui recreant un match de tennis ou une course de voiture… On peut jouer en amateur de temps en temps pour le plaisir ou en professionnel, quand nos scores atteignent des niveaux super hauts, et que la passion devient un metier. A quoi ressemble la vie dun e-sportif ? La vie d’un e-sportif est consacree à son sport : il s’entraîne chaque jour, elabore des strategies, regarde les videos de tous les tournois, et il est finance par des marques. Il faut jouer beaucoup quand on est un pro. Mais attention : un amateur qui passe tout son temps à jouer, c’est qu’il est devenu dependant. Alors il faut rester vigilant sur le temps consacre aux jeux.

programme.title: Les metiers
programme.desc: Curious about the job of his friend's mother, Bernard questions her: "dog trainer for the blind". So that!... What exactly is that? Follow the training of a dog who will make his master happy... and more independent! / Curieux du metier de la maman de son camarade, Bernard linterroge : "educatrice de chienpour aveugle".Alors ça !... Quest-ce que cest exactement ? Suivez la formation dun chien qui rendra son maître heureux... et plus independant !

programme.title: Les metiers
programme.desc: Curious about his friend's mother's job, Bernard asks her: "herbalist". Excellent! But uh... what exactly is it? Mais euh... cest quoi exactement ? Decouvrez avec cette super maman lextraordinaire pouvoir guerisseur des plantes !

programme.title: In the heart of Switzerland / Au coeur de la Suisse
programme.sub-title: The Horn of Gesero / La Corne du Gesero
programme.desc: Transitional stage to leave Graubünden and return to Ticino. Departing from the Monti di Laura, the hike begins on the ridge, with a splendid sunny day and a spectacular view, before climbing the Corno del Gesero. / Étape transitoire pour quitter les Grisons et revenir au Tessin. Au depart des Monti di Laura, la randonnee commence sur la crete, par une splendide journee ensoleillee et une vue spectaculaire, avant de gravir le Corno del Gesero.

programme.title: Doc Portrait
programme.desc: Femme fatale with androgynous features, dandy, avant-garde, world star or popular star, Amanda Lear played with all the labels. She remains one of the symbols of pop culture, an enigmatic, sulphurous figure, and the incarnation of a certain idea of ​​transgression. Portrait of an icon. / Femme fatale aux traits androgynes, dandy, avant-gardiste, star mondiale ou vedette populaire, Amanda Lear s’est jouee de toutes les etiquettes. Elle demeure l’un des symboles de la pop culture, une figure enigmatique, sulfureuse, et l’incarnation d’une certaine idee de la transgression. Portrait d’une icône.

programme.title: Trains like no other / Des trains pas comme les autres
programme.desc: Bolivia is a country that flirts with the sky, a country perched high, sometimes at an altitude of more than 6,000 meters, a country above all where the scenery is breathtaking. Philippe Gougler decided to approach this country, truly unlike any other, from the bottom, at an altitude of 400 meters, where vegetation is abundant, in the city of Santa Cruz, departure station for the main cities of the country: La Paz, Sucre or Cochabamba. In Bolivia, trains are rare and take their time, and all the charm of the trip lies in the unique scenery they pass through and in the people you meet. / La Bolivie, cest un pays qui flirte avec le ciel, un pays haut perche, parfois à plus de 6000 mètres daltitude, un pays surtout où les decors sont epoustouflants. Philippe Gougler a decide daborder ce pays vraiment pas comme les autres par le bas, à 400 mètres daltitude, là où la vegetation est foisonnante, dans la ville de Santa Cruz, gare de depart pour les principales villes du pays : La Paz, Sucre ou Cochabamba. En Bolivie, les trains sont rares et prennent leur temps, et tout le charme du voyage tient dans les decors uniques quils traversent et dans les rencontres.

programme.title: Dans le viseur
programme.sub-title: Japan, my country of heart / Le Japon, mon pays de coeur
programme.desc: Find the chronicles and reports produced by the team of columnists who surround Joëlle Rebetez in the cultural program Ramdam. Yacine Nemra, Arthur Du Sordet, Camille de Pietro, Raphaël Harari and Pierre-Do Bourgknecht compile essential cultural discoveries. / Retrouvez les chroniques et reportages realises par l’equipe de chroniqueurs qui entourent Joëlle Rebetez dans l’emission culturelle Ramdam. Yacine Nemra, Arthur Du Sordet, Camille de Pietro, Raphaël Harari et Pierre-Do Bourgknecht compilent des decouvertes culturelles incontournables.

programme.title: Doc Nature
programme.sub-title: Ibex, the lookout of the mountains / Bouquetin, la vigie des montagnes
programme.desc: In the heart of the Alps, an animal has made this ecosystem its kingdom: the ibex. A goat and his herd wage a fierce struggle to survive in a changing environment, as majestic as it is pitiful. Will their instinct be enough to save them? / Au cœur des Alpes, un animal a fait de cet ecosystème son royaume: le bouquetin. Un cabri et sa harde livrent une lutte acharnee pour survivre dans un environnement en mutation, aussi majestueux quimpitoyable. Leur instinct suffira-t-il à les sauver?

programme.title: Domestic scenes / Scènes de menages
programme.desc: Is your relationship saddening you? Do you lament living alone? Scènes de Menages will help you put things into perspective! / Votre couple vous desole ? Vous vous lamentez de vivre seul ? Scènes de Menages va vous aider à relativiser !

programme.title: Monk
programme.sub-title: Monk and the Paperboy / Monk et le livreur de journaux
programme.desc: Nestor, a newspaper delivery boy, is murdered while trying to arrest a thief who had just stolen Adrian Monk's diary. He is convinced that a clue is found in the daily newspaper that he was supposed to read that morning. / Nestor, un livreur de journaux, est assassine en voulant arreter un voleur qui venait de derober le journal dAdrian Monk. Celui-ci est convaincu quun indice se trouve dans le quotidien quil devait lire le matin meme.

programme.title: Monk
programme.sub-title: Monk and the Three Pies / Monk et les trois tartes
programme.desc: By playing a raffle, an elderly woman wins a cherry pie. But before going home with her prize, a man approaches and asks her to give him her cake. She refuses. Unknown murders him and takes his body in his car. Captain Stottlemeyer and Lieutenant Disher are convinced that the murderer actually wanted to steal the victim's car. But Monk is not as sure as they are. / En jouant à une tombola, une femme âgee gagne une tarte aux cerises. Mais avant de rentrer chez elle avec son prix, un homme sapproche et lui demande de lui donner son gâteau. Elle refuse. Linconnu lassassine et emporte son corps dans sa voiture. Le capitaine Stottlemeyer et le lieutenant Disher sont persuades que le meurtrier voulait, en fait, voler la voiture de la victime. Mais Monk nen est pas aussi certain queux.

programme.title: Family Law
programme.desc: Abby finds herself having to play both lawyer and counselor, as she helps a paranoid and deeply private actor avoid revealing his homosexuality to the public when his bitter ex-partner writes a play about him. / Abby se retrouve à devoir jouer à la fois le rôle davocate et celui de conseillère, alors quelle aide un acteur paranoïaque et profondement discret à ne pas reveler son homosexualite au public lorsque son ex-compagnon amer redige une pièce de theâtre sur lui.

programme.title: Sandhamn Murders / Meurtres à Sandhamn
programme.desc: A nautical dealer falls into a coma after an attack. The suspects multiply, from his ex-partner to a friend of his wife. Continuation of the series adapted from the best-sellers of the queen of Swedish crime fiction Viveca Sten. / Un concessionnaire nautique tombe dans le coma après une agression. Les suspects se multiplient, de son ex-associe à une amie de son epouse. Suite de la serie adaptee des best-sellers de la reine du polar suedois Viveca Sten.

programme.title: Le Miracle Suisse
programme.desc: Aaah marriage! The institution has evolved considerably, from traditional marriage to unions between two people of the same sex, but it stands firm! Seeing images of the role of women in marriage in the 1960s is often shocking. But already at that time, there were people who refused marriage and its conventions. We also found a couple who were preparing their wedding in front of our cameras in 1992. We also discovered the madness of bachelor parties. Finally, marriage also means divorce, and hearing the children of divorce in the 70s is very moving. The Swiss Miracle is pure happiness and it’s for life! / Aaah le mariage ! L’institution a considerablement evolue, du mariage traditionnel aux unions entre deux personnes du meme sexe, mais elle tient bon ! Revoir des images du rôle des femmes dans le mariage dans les annees 60 est souvent choquant. Mais à cette epoque dejà, il y avait des personnes qui refusaient le mariage et ses conventions. Nous avons egalement retrouve un couple qui preparait son mariage devant nos cameras en 1992. Nous decouvrons aussi les folies des enterrements de vie de celibataire. Enfin, qui dit mariage dit aussi divorce, et entendre les enfants du divorce dans les annees 70 est très emouvant. Le Miracle Suisse, c’est que du bonheur et c’est pour la vie !

Pour couronner le tout, leur fille unique Anna et son compagnon Thomas, vires de leur appartement, viennent squatter chez eux. C’en est trop pour Catherine qui decide de trouver un moyen de les mettre dehors.

programme.title: The snowman / Le bonhomme de neige
programme.desc: When the detective of an elite section investigates the disappearance of a victim during the first snows of winter, he fears that a wanted serial killer has struck again. With the help of a brilliant recruit, he will try to establish a link between dozens of unsolved cases and the brutality of this latest crime in order to put an end to this scourge, before the next snow falls. / Lorsque le detective d’une section d’elite enquete sur la disparition d’une victime lors des premières neiges de l’hiver, il craint qu’un serial killer recherche n’ait encore frappe. Avec l’aide d’une brillante recrue, il va tenter d’etablir un lien entre des dizaines de cas non elucides et la brutalite de ce dernier crime afin de mettre un terme à ce fleau, avant la tombee des prochaines neiges.

programme.title: Passe-moi les jumelles
programme.desc: : Charbel El Feghali is the charismatic guardian of the “Lyzamir” grocery store. From the mountains of Beirut where he grew up, to Geneva, the grocer weaves links between cultures, reduces the distance between origins and recounts the flavors that unite souls: Jane and Etienne met thanks to their shared passion for music. Nomads at heart, they decide to adopt three donkeys and set off on the path of simplicity, to the rhythm of their hooves. A musical journey to the heart of the Dolomites, in the footsteps of bards and donkeys. / : Charbel El Feghali est le charismatique gardien de lepicerie « Lyzamir ». Des montagnes de Beyrouth qui l’ont vu grandir, jusqu’à Genève, l’epicier tisse des liens entre les cultures, reduit la distance entre les origines et raconte les saveurs qui unissent les âmes.: Jane et Etienne se sont rencontres grâce à leur passion commune pour la musique. Nomades dans l’âme, ils decident d’adopter trois ânes et de partir sur le chemin de la simplicite, au rythme des sabots. Un voyage musical au cœur des Dolomites, sur les traces des bardes et des ânes.

programme.title: Objectif Monde Lhebdo
programme.desc: In recent months, kidnappings in the cryptocurrency sector have increased in the United States, but also in France. Racketeering, kidnapping, sometimes mutilating, the victims of these kidnappings are both the parents of the wives and children. More recently a Swiss man was kidnapped near Valencia. He was then released after an impressive police operation. Today, many people in the industry fear for their safety and that of their families. A report by Aurèle Cuttat and Adeline Percept for Mise au Point sur la RTS. / Ces derniers mois, les enlèvements dans le secteur de la crypto-monnaie se sont multiplies aux Etats-Unis, mais aussi en France. Racketter, enlever, parfois mutiler, les victimes de ces rapts sont aussi bien des parents des epouses ou des enfants. Plus recemment un Suisse a ete enleve près de Valence. Il a ensuite ete libere au terme d’une impressionnante operation de police. Aujourdhui de nombreux acteurs du milieu craignent pour leur securite et celle de leur famille. Un reportage d’Aurèle Cuttat et d’Adeline Percept pour Mise au Point sur la RTS.

programme.title: Die Aquarium-Profis
programme.desc: Big, bigger, biggest! Commercially available indoor aquariums are also nice, but Wayde King and his partner Brett Raymer have little to do with 10-liter tanks. Her specialty is breathtaking underwater worlds! From the octagonal ecosystem with morays and stingrays to the telephone booth aquarium to the shark tank for the doctor's office: there is almost no idea that the boys don't dare to try. Accordingly, the motto of the two New Yorkers is: What others dream of, we make it happen! And their super aquariums not only appeal to the underwater inhabitants, but also to the public. Wherever Brett and Wayde present their impressive custom-made products to the public, people cannot help but be amazed. / GroSS, groSSer, am groSSten! Handelsubliche Zimmer-Aquarien sind auch nett, doch mit 10-Liter-Becken haben Wayde King und sein Partner Brett Raymer wenig am Hut. Ihr Spezialgebiet sind atemberaubende Unterwasserwelten! Vom achteckigen Ökosystem mit Muranen und Stachelrochen uber das Telefonzellen-Aquarium bis zum Haifisch-Tank fur die Arztpraxis: Es gibt fast keine Idee, an die sich die Jungs nicht herantrauen. Dementsprechend lautet das Motto der beiden New Yorker: Wovon andere traumen, setzen wir in die Tat um! Und ihre Super-Aquarien gefallen nicht nur den Unterwasserbewohnern ausgesprochen gut, sondern auch dem Publikum. Wo immer Brett und Wayde ihre beeindruckenden Spezialanfertigungen der Öffentlichkeit prasentieren, kommen die Leute aus dem Staunen nicht heraus.

programme.title: The Empty Man
programme.desc: THE EMPTY MAN is a supernatural horror film full of action, suspense and pure terror! After several teenagers in a small Midwestern town mysteriously disappear, the townspeople fear it's connected to a frightening urban myth. James Lasombra (James Badge Dale), a troubled ex-cop suffering from the deaths of his wife and son, returns from retirement and investigates the events that have rocked the town. The story takes a bizarre turn when Lasombra discovers a secret group of occultists seemingly trying to conjure up a terrible mystical being. Lasombra soon realizes that his life – and those of his loved ones – are in terrible danger. The highly exciting shocker THE EMPTY MAN also stars: Marin Ireland, Stephen Root, Ron Canada, Robert Aramayo, Joel Courtney and Sasha Frolova. It was directed by David Prior, who also wrote the screenplay and the screenplay based on the novel by Cullen Bunn. / THE EMPTY MAN ist ein ubernaturlicher Horrorfilm voller Action, Spannung und purem Terror! Nachdem einige Teenager einer Kleinstadt im Mittleren Westen auf mysteriose Weise verschwinden, befurchten die Menschen der Stadt, dass dies mit einem furchterregenden urbanen Mythos zusammenhangt. James Lasombra (James Badge Dale), ein von Problemen geplagter Ex-Cop, der unter dem Tod seiner Frau und seines Sohnes leidet, kehrt aus dem Ruhestand zuruck und erforscht die Ereignisse, die den Ort erschuttert haben. Die Geschichte nimmt eine bizarre Wendung, als Lasombra eine geheime Gruppe von Okkultisten entdeckt, die scheinbar versucht, ein schreckliches mystisches Wesen heraufzubeschworen. Lasombra wird bald klar, dass sein Leben – und das seiner Lieben – in schrecklicher Gefahr ist. In dem hochspannenden Schocker THE EMPTY MAN spielen auSSerdem mit: Marin Ireland, Stephen Root, Ron Canada, Robert Aramayo, Joel Courtney und Sasha Frolova. Regie fuhrte David Prior, der auch die Drehbuchvorlage und das Drehbuch basierend auf dem Roman von Cullen Bunn schrieb.

programme.desc: A spacious garden and a huge terrace: Yossi and Aviva David are living the American dream in Florida. The two emigrated from Israel to the USA and built a successful company there. However, the couple's pool is tiny and totally outdated. But that can be changed: Lucas Congdon and his helpers have exactly the right ideas in the “Sunshine State”. The team is designing a backyard paradise in XXL format for its customers - including a giant whirlpool, water slide and open-air kitchen. / Ein weitlaufiger Garten und eine riesige Terrasse: Yossi und Aviva David leben in Florida den amerikanischen Traum. Die beiden sind aus Israel in die USA ausgewandert und haben dort ein erfolgreiches Unternehmen aufgebaut. Der Pool des Ehepaares ist jedoch winzig und total veraltet. Aber das lasst sich andern: Lucas Congdon und seine Helfer haben im „Sunshine State“ genau die richtigen Ideen parat. Das Team entwirft fur seine Kundschaft ein Hinterhof-Paradies im XXL-Format - inklusive Riesen-Whirlpool, Wasserrutsche und Freiluftkuche.

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters - Gold Rush in Alaska / Die Schatzsucher - Goldrausch in Alaska
programme.desc: When Parker Schnabel returns to the Klondike from the US state of Alaska in five days to inspect the gold production, the new airstrip should be ready. The major project provides the team on the Indian River with additional work. / Wenn Parker Schnabel in funf Tagen aus dem US-Bundesstaat Alaska in den Klondike zuruckkehrt, um die Goldausbeute zu begutachten, soll die neue Flugpiste fertig sein. Das GroSSprojekt beschert dem Team am Indian River zusatzliche Arbeit.

programme.title: Goldrausch in Australien
programme.desc: Greg pulls his car wash onto Mat's land with a heavy excavator. The men negotiated a deal. They form a team in the treasure hunt. They want to share the profits Down Under. But does the land provide enough precious metal to justify the effort? And then suddenly a helicopter approaches the camp. It's a big surprise when Matthias Maurer gets out of the helicopter. Mat and Andreas gave the German astronaut a nugget as a good luck charm on his way to the ISS space station. / Greg zieht mit einem schweren Bagger seine Waschanlage auf Mats Land. Die Manner haben einen Deal ausgehandelt. Sie bilden bei der Schatzsuche ein Team. Den Gewinn wollen sie sich in Down Under teilen. Aber gibt der Grund und Boden genug Edelmetall her, um den Aufwand zu rechtfertigen? Und dann nahert sich plotzlich ein Helikopter dem Camp. Die Überraschung ist groSS, als Matthias Maurer aus dem Hubschrauber steigt. Mat und Andreas hatten dem deutschen Astronauten auf seinem Weg zur Raumstation ISS ein Nugget als Glucksbringer mit auf den Weg gegeben.

programme.title: Goldtaucher der Beringsee
programme.desc: Gold fever has flared up again in the coastal town of Nome, Alaska. Because the news of lucrative gold discoveries has made the rounds, which is attracting more and more fortune seekers to the icy north. Using heavy special equipment, expensive floating excavators and clever home-made constructions, the gold divers set out to uncover the valuable precious metal. Along the coast of the Bering Sea _ on the hunt for previously untouched claims _ competing family clans meet daring greenhorns, all pursuing a common goal: to defy the dangers of the business and to exchange ounce after ounce of gold for hard dollars at the end of the season! / Im Kustenstadtchen Nome, in Alaska, ist das Goldfieber neu entflammt. Denn die Nachricht von lukrativen Goldfunden hat die Runde gemacht, was immer mehr Gluckssuchende in den eisigen Norden lockt. Mit schwerem Spezialgerat, teuren Schwimmbaggern und cleveren Konstruktionen Marke Eigenbau rucken die Goldtaucher:innen aus, um das kostbare Edelmetall zutage zu fordern. Entlang der Kuste der Beringsee _ auf der Jagd nach bislang unberuhrten Claims _ treffen konkurrierende Familienclans auf wagemutige Greenhorns, die alle ein gemeinsames Ziel verfolgen: Den Gefahren des Geschafts zu trotzen und am Ende der Saison Unze um Unze Gold gegen harte Dollars einzutauschen!

programme.title: Mini Tits, Mini Tits / Mini Chuchi, dini Chuchi
programme.desc: Franz from Auw in the canton of Aargau likes to ride an e-bike in his free time. The 58-year-old postal worker can relax and clear his head while cycling. Franz wants to impress his guests with a water buffalo ragout. He also serves vegetables and potato dumplings. / Franz aus Auw im Kanton Aargau steigt in seiner Freizeit gerne aufs E-Bike. Beim Velofahren kann der 58-jahrige Postangestellte entspannen und seinen Kopf luften. Seine Gaste will Franz mit einem Wasserbuffel-Ragout uberzeugen. Dazu serviert er Gemuse und Kartoffelknodel.

programme.title: Eco Talk
programme.sub-title: Welchen Stempel wollen Sie Postfinance aufdrucken, Herr Rothlisberger?
programme.desc: Postfinance's board of directors was looking for a new CEO for over a year. He found it with Beat Rothlisberger. He wants to reorganize the company: accelerate the development of new products, expand the core business around payment transactions and, in the medium term, also be able to grant loans to corporate customers. Andi Luscher will discuss this and other topics in the next “Eco Talk” with the Postfinance boss. / Über ein Jahr lang suchte der Verwaltungsrat von Postfinance einen neuen CEO. Er fand ihn mit Beat Rothlisberger. Dieser will das Unternehmen reorganisieren: Die Entwicklung neuer Produkte beschleunigen, das Kerngeschaft rund um den Zahlungsverkehr ausbauen und mittelfristig auch Kredite an Firmenkundinnen und -kunden vergeben konnen.Daruber und weitere Themen diskutiert Andi Luscher im nachsten «Eco Talk» mit dem Postfinance-Chef.

programme.title: Club: America, let’s talk
programme.sub-title: Trump's economic deals - who pays the price? / Trumps Wirtschaftsdeals – wer zahlt den Preis?
programme.desc: Barbara Luthi und Peter Duggeli zeigen, wie Trumps Entscheidungen das wirtschaftliche und soziale Gefuge der USA umkrempeln. Zudem werden die Auswirkungen auf die Unternehmen und die US-Konsumentinnen und -konsumenten beleuchtet. Barbara Luthi und Peter Duggeli reden auch mit Unterstutzern von Trumps Zollpolitik und zeigen auf, wo seine Politik der Re-Industrialisierung Fruchte tragen kann. Ebenfalls Thema sind die kontroversen Kurzungen bei Sozialprogrammen sowie der Krankenversicherung.Ein «Club» uber Burgerinnen und Burger, Unternehmer und Wirtschaftsexpertinnen, die Trumps Versprechen, Jobs zuruckzuholen und Amerika umzugestalten, kritisch unter die Lupe nehmen oder mitttragen.

programme.title: Zu Tisch
programme.desc: In La Sagne, a small mountain village in the Provençal Prealps, the Togolese Pierre Koffi Alanda grows organic vegetables. He delivers his products to customers in the region. With his neighbors he cooks traditional and African dishes such as stuffed zucchini flowers and gboma gnagna made from chard. / In La Sagne, einem kleinen Bergdorf in den Provenzalischen Voralpen, baut der Togolese Pierre Koffi Alanda Biogemuse an. Seine Produkte liefert er an Kunden in der Region. Mit den Nachbarn kocht er traditionelle und afrikanische Gerichte wie gefullte Zucchinibluten und Gboma Gnagna aus Mangold.

programme.title: Einstein
programme.sub-title: Dying Alpine pastures: The search for the perfect cow / Sterbende Alpweiden: Die Suche nach der perfekten Kuh
programme.desc: Sterbende Alpweiden: Die Suche nach der perfekten KuhDie Schweiz verliert jedes Jahr Alpflachen in der Grosse des Walensees. Ein massgeblicher Grund dafur ist, dass hochgezuchtete Rinderrassen auf den Alpweiden nicht mehr zurechtkommen. Moderne Hochleistungskuhe konnen steile oder entlegene Flachen nicht ausreichend nutzen und fressen selektiv nur die nahrreichsten Graser und Pflanzen. Die Folge: Immer mehr Weideland und Biodiversitat gehen verloren.Agrarokologin Caren Pauler und ihr Team wollen diesen Trend brechen. Am Albulapass, auf der einzigen Forschungsalp der Welt, suchen und testen sie Rinderrassen, die die fortschreitende Vergandung der Schweizer Bergwiesen stoppen sollen.

programme.title: Rosamunde Pilcher
programme.desc: Lawyer Sienna is overjoyed when her partner proposes to her. However, the upcoming wedding presents her with the problem that she is still married to her childhood sweetheart Tyler, whom she left years ago because of his infidelity. In order to finally get a divorce, Sienna travels to Tyler in Cornwall. But he only wants to sign the divorce papers if Sienna plays his happy wife for a while. Because he is currently fighting for custody of his daughter Ivy, who was the result of the affair. If he lost, Ivy would have to move to the USA to live with her grandmother. / Anwaltin Sienna ist uberglucklich als ihr Lebensgefahrte ihr einen Heiratsantrag macht. Allerdings stellt sie die bevorstehende Hochzeit vor das Problem, dass sie noch immer mit ihrer Jugendliebe Tyler verheiratet ist, den sie vor Jahren wegen seiner Untreue verlieSS. Um sich endlich scheiden zu lassen, reist Sienna zu Tyler nach Cornwall. Er will die Scheidungspapiere aber nur unterschreiben, wenn Sienna fur einige Zeit seine gluckliche Ehefrau spielt. Denn er kampft momentan um das Sorgerecht fur seine Tochter Ivy, die aus der Affare damals hervorging. Sollte er verlieren, musste Ivy zu ihrer GroSSmutter in die USA ziehen.

programme.title: SRF DOK
programme.desc: How does mountain weather affect life? What if the Alps weren't there? SRF meteorologist Thomas Bucheli and his counterpart from Servus TV, Sebastian Weber, set off on an adventurous journey across the Alpine arc and research weather phenomena. / Wie beeinflusst das Bergwetter das Leben? Was ware, wenn die Alpen nicht da waren? SRF-Meteorologe Thomas Bucheli und sein Pendant von Servus TV, Sebastian Weber, machen sich auf eine abenteuerliche Reise quer durch den Alpenbogen und erforschen Wetterphanomene.

programme.title: In aller Freundschaft
programme.desc: Shipping entrepreneur Eric Kalowski leads a family life as a husband and father, but secretly he has always felt like a woman. When he ventures out in public in women's clothing for the first time in his life, he has an accident and is taken to the clinic with a serious flesh wound. His wife Karen, who has suspected something for a long time, is completely overwhelmed by the situation. / Speditionsunternehmer Eric Kalowski fuhrt ein Familienleben als Ehemann und Vater, insgeheim aber fuhlt er sich schon immer als Frau. Als er sich zum ersten Mal in seinem Leben in Frauenkleidern in die Öffentlichkeit wagt, verungluckt er und wird mit einer schlimmen Fleischwunde in die Klinik eingeliefert. Ehefrau Karen, die seit langerem etwas ahnt, ist mit der Situation vollig uberfordert.

programme.title: SRF bi de Lut – Hotel zum Gluck
programme.desc: Bettina Scherz, 60, biologist, Tony Kivanc, 54, former limousine chauffeur, both from Zurich, Andre Luscher, 25, trained bodywork mechanic from Birmenstorf in Aargau, Ruedi Herzig, 60, living in Basel, carpenter and cake maker, and Mirjam Keller, 31, former tour guide and living in Ruti - they are all currently are looking for a job and are the new hoteliers on probation at the Hotel Chesa Salis in Bever. The motley crew doesn't have much time to get to know each other. After a short hotel tour, they are allowed to move into the staff rooms and given the task of creating a food and beverage concept by the owner couple Jurg and Sibylla Degiacomi. This means that they have to consider whether they can run the hotel as a bed and breakfast or whether they can offer full board. Not an easy task. But that was just the beginning. Before the owners say goodbye, they offer an aperitif that the new hoteliers have to organize. The aperitif is not just their trial by fire – they are also being watched. About their future coach, who they don't know anything about yet. / Bettina Scherz, 60, Biologin, Tony Kivanc, 54, ehemaliger Limousinen-Chauffeur, beide aus Zurich, Andre Luscher, 25, gelernter Carrosserie-Spengler aus dem aargauischen Birmenstorf, Ruedi Herzig, 60, in Basel wohnhaft, Schreiner und Kuchenbauer, sowie Mirjam Keller, 31, ehemalige Reiseleiterin und in Ruti wohnhaft – sie alle sind zurzeit auf Stellensuche und sind die neuen Hoteliers auf Probe im Hotel Chesa Salis in Bever.Viel Zeit, sich gegenseitig kennenzulernen, hat die bunt zusammengewurfelte Truppe nicht. Nach einer kurzen Hoteltour durfen sie die Personalzimmer beziehen und bekommen vom Besitzerehepaar Jurg und Sibylla Degiacomi die Aufgabe, ein Food-and-Beverage-Konzept zu erstellen. Das heisst, sie mussen sich uberlegen, ob sie das Hotel zu funft als Garni fuhren oder ob sie Vollpension anbieten konnen. Keine einfache Aufgabe.Doch das war erst der Anfang. Bevor sich die Besitzer verabschieden, kunden sie einen Apero an, den die neuen Hoteliers organisieren mussen. Der Apero ist nicht nur ihre Feuerprobe – sie werden auch beobachtet. Von ihrem zukunftigen Coach, von dem sie aber noch nichts wissen.

programme.title: Inga Lindstrom – Lover Sven / Inga Lindstrom – Geliebter Sven
programme.desc: Alba and Sven are about to start breeding horses when Sven gets caught in a tsunami on his sailboat. Alba is the only one who believes that the missing person will survive. Alba opens a holiday guesthouse until Sven's hoped-for return. When veterinarian Marius settles in with his bad-tempered daughter Line, their life plan is thrown into disarray. Her mother Elvira also wants to bring her back to the city. Only the dropout Hannes, who has settled nearby with his trailer, is there to support... / Alba und Sven sind kurz davor, eine Pferdezucht aufzuziehen, als Sven mit seinem Segelboot in einen Tsunami gerat. Alba ist die Einzige, die an das Überleben des Verschollenen glaubt. Alba eroffnet ¿ bis zu Svens erhoffter Ruckkehr ¿ eine Ferienpension. Als sich Tierarzt Marius mit seiner schlecht gelaunten Tochter Line einquartiert, wird ihr Lebensplan durcheinandergewirbelt. Zudem will ihre Mutter Elvira sie zuruck in die Stadt holen. Einzig der Aussteiger Hannes, der sich in der Nahe mit seinem Bauwagen niedergelassen hat, ist eine Unterstutzung...

programme.title: SRF bi de Lut – Huttengeschichten
programme.sub-title: Wintereinbruch, Neuorientierung und eine letzte Hurde
programme.desc: At the Gandegghutte, Alessandro handles his job as hut attendant with ease. The team is also happy with him. Nevertheless, everyone is looking forward to seeing Felix again. When winterizing the hut, Felix and Alessandro are put to the test again: the water doesn't drain away. The onset of winter in the Uri mountains throws a spanner in the works for the hut keeper of the Voralp hut. Instead of a full house at the end of the season, there is now one rejection after another. The three Muotathal women look back on the first summer season and take stock. The balancing act between life in the hut and life in the valley robs Sarah and Christoph of energy. After a strenuous hutting season, the nervous system becomes thinner. The Sagers spend the last weekend of the season together at the hut. After careful reflection, it looks like an era is coming to an end. / Auf der Gandegghutte bewaltigt Alessandro den Job als Huttenwart souveran. Auch das Team ist mit ihm zufrieden. Nichtsdestotrotz freuen sich alle auf das Wiedersehen mit Felix. Beim Einwintern der Hutte werden Felix und Alessandro nochmals auf die Probe gestellt: Das Wasser lauft nicht ab.Der Wintereinbruch in den Urner Bergen macht der Huttenwartin der Voralphutte einen Strich durch die Rechnung. Anstatt eine volle Hutte zum Saisonabschluss folgt nun eine Absage nach der anderen. Die drei Muotathalerinnen schauen zuruck auf die erste Sommersaison und ziehen Bilanz.Der Spagat zwischen Hutten- und Tal-Leben raubt Sarah und Christoph Energie. Nach einer anstrengenden Huttensaison wird das Nervenkostum dunner. Das letzte Wochenende der Saison verbringen die Sagers gemeinsam auf der Hutte. Nach grundlicher Reflektion sieht es ganz danach aus, als ob eine Ära zu Ende geht.

programme.title: Notrufzentrale
programme.sub-title: Polizeinotruf: Intime Bilder einer Minderjahrigen im Chat
programme.desc: From the abuse of intimate images to alpine rescue: the finale shows the range of emergency calls. A woman is worried about her appearance despite being in pain and two men call an ambulance after consuming cannabis. It becomes clear: dispatchers are the invisible heart of the rescue chain. / Vom Missbrauch intimer Bilder bis zur alpinen Rettung: Das Finale zeigt die Bandbreite der Notrufe. Eine Frau sorgt sich trotz Schmerzen ums Aussehen und zwei Manner rufen nach Cannabiskonsum die Ambulanz. Klar wird: Einsatzdisponenten und -disponentinnen sind das unsichtbare Herz der Rettungskette.

programme.title: M.A.S.H.
programme.desc: An der Frontlinie im Koreakrieg versehen die Chirurgen Hawkeye und Trapper ihren Dienst mit Galgenhumor und entlarven mit anarchischen Aktionen den Irrwitz des Militarmaschinerie. Regie: Robert Altman; mit Donald Sutherland und Elliott Gould.

programme.title: SRF bi de Lut – Huttengeschichten
programme.sub-title: Wintereinbruch, Neuorientierung und eine letzte Hurde
programme.desc: At the Gandegghutte, Alessandro handles his job as hut attendant with ease. The team is also happy with him. Nevertheless, everyone is looking forward to seeing Felix again. When winterizing the hut, Felix and Alessandro are put to the test again: the water doesn't drain away. The onset of winter in the Uri mountains throws a spanner in the works for the hut keeper of the Voralp hut. Instead of a full house at the end of the season, there is now one rejection after another. The three Muotathal women look back on the first summer season and take stock. The balancing act between life in the hut and life in the valley robs Sarah and Christoph of energy. After a strenuous hutting season, the nervous system becomes thinner. The Sagers spend the last weekend of the season together at the hut. After careful reflection, it looks like an era is coming to an end. / Auf der Gandegghutte bewaltigt Alessandro den Job als Huttenwart souveran. Auch das Team ist mit ihm zufrieden. Nichtsdestotrotz freuen sich alle auf das Wiedersehen mit Felix. Beim Einwintern der Hutte werden Felix und Alessandro nochmals auf die Probe gestellt: Das Wasser lauft nicht ab.Der Wintereinbruch in den Urner Bergen macht der Huttenwartin der Voralphutte einen Strich durch die Rechnung. Anstatt eine volle Hutte zum Saisonabschluss folgt nun eine Absage nach der anderen. Die drei Muotathalerinnen schauen zuruck auf die erste Sommersaison und ziehen Bilanz.Der Spagat zwischen Hutten- und Tal-Leben raubt Sarah und Christoph Energie. Nach einer anstrengenden Huttensaison wird das Nervenkostum dunner. Das letzte Wochenende der Saison verbringen die Sagers gemeinsam auf der Hutte. Nach grundlicher Reflektion sieht es ganz danach aus, als ob eine Ära zu Ende geht.

programme.title: Rundschau
programme.desc: Valais resistance: mountain guides mobilize against the Gornerli reservoir. Hydropower plays a central role in the energy transition. One of the most important planned projects is the Gornerli. Above Zermatt in Valais, Grande Dixence AG is planning a reservoir - in a landscape under national protection. But criticism is growing: mountain guides, hoteliers and nature conservationists want to reduce the size of the project - or prevent it entirely. Valais State Councilor Franziska Biner answers questions from Gion-Duri Vincenz.Blocked tunnel boring machine on the Gotthard: construction company also warned in vainA month ago, the “Rundschau” made it public: During the construction of the second Gotthard pipes, experts warned against using a tunnel boring machine in the delicate rock at the beginning in Airolo TI. Now further research shows: Even the tunnel construction company commissioned warned several times during the excavation that the machine could get stuck. But the Federal Roads Office (Astra) ignored the warnings. Vigilante justice against pedophiles: revengers and right-wing extremists? They pose online as 14-year-old girls, lure suspected pedophiles into a trap - and strike. “Pedo hunters” have become a Switzerland-wide phenomenon. Behind their zeal lies a problematic form of vigilantism - with violent fantasies and right-wing extremist rhetoric. Who are the self-proclaimed pedophile hunters? “SRF Impact” met her. / Walliser Widerstand: Bergfuhrende mobilisieren gegen den Gornerli-StauseeBei der Energiewende spielt die Wasserkraft eine zentrale Rolle. Eines der wichtigsten geplanten Projekte dabei ist das Gornerli. Oberhalb von Zermatt im Wallis plant die Grande Dixence AG einen Speichersee – in einer Landschaft unter nationalem Schutz. Doch die Kritik wachst: Bergfuhrende, Hoteliers und Naturschutzende wollen das Projekt verkleinern – oder ganz verhindern. Dazu stellt sich die Walliser Staatsratin Franziska Biner den Fragen von Gion-Duri Vincenz.Blockierte Tunnelbohrmaschine am Gotthard: Auch Baufirma warnte vergeblichVor einem Monat machte die «Rundschau» publik: Experten warnten beim Bau der zweiten Gotthardrohre davor, eine Tunnelbohrmaschine im heiklen Gestein am Anfang in Airolo TI einzusetzen. Jetzt zeigen weitere Recherchen: Selbst die beauftragte Tunnelbaufirma warnte wahrend des Vortriebs mehrfach, dass die Maschine stecken bleiben konnte. Doch das Bundesamt fur Strassen (Astra) ignorierte die Warnungen.Selbstjustiz gegen Padophile: Racher und Rechtsextreme?Sie geben sich online als 14-jahrige Madchen aus, locken mutmassliche Padophile in die Falle – und schlagen zu. «Pedo-Hunter» sind zu einem schweizweiten Phanomen geworden. Hinter ihrem Eifer steckt eine problematische Form von Selbstjustiz – mit Gewaltfantasien und rechtsextremer Rhetorik. Wer sind die selbsternannten Padophilen-Jager? «SRF Impact» hat sie getroffen.

Kurz vor seiner Pensionierung tritt Julia Durgnat, 28, horend und versiert in Gebardensprache, seine Nachfolge an.

programme.title: Kassensturz in Gebardensprache
programme.sub-title: Expensive ski accidents – when the insurance doesn’t want to pay / Teure Skiunfalle – Wenn die Versicherung nicht zahlen will
programme.desc: Expensive skiing accidents – If the insurance doesn’t want to payA skiing accident abroad can quickly cost several thousand francs. In the case of “Kassenrutsch”, those affected come forward whose insurance companies do not want to cover the costs – a financial disaster. “Kassenrutsch” shows the insurance pitfalls and gives tips on how to protect yourself from them. Overpriced tourist tickets on online platforms The online platform “Get your Guide” sells, among other things, entry tickets to attractions around the world. But tickets there often cost more than through the official sales channels. The platform charges 125 euros to visit the Eiffel Tower instead of the regular 36 euros. A self-experiment in “Kassenrutsch”. Sunglasses in the test: good UV protection for little money. Good sunglasses are available from just 15 francs. This is what the laboratory test in “Kassenrutsch” shows. More expensive models did not pass the test as well: some deform under little pressure, while in others the glazing ages poorly. / Teure Skiunfalle – Wenn die Versicherung nicht zahlen willEin Skiunfall im Ausland kann schnell mehrere tausend Franken kosten. Bei «Kassensturz» melden sich Betroffene, deren Versicherungen die Kosten nicht ubernehmen wollen – ein finanzielles Desaster. «Kassensturz» zeigt die Versicherungsfallen und gibt Tipps, wie man sich davor schutzen kann.Überteuerte Touristentickets auf Online-PlattformenDie Onlineplattform «Get your Guide» verkauft unter anderem Eintrittstickets zu Sehenswurdigkeiten in aller Welt. Doch kosten die Tickets dort oft mehr als uber die offiziellen Verkaufskanale. So verlangt die Plattform fur den Besuch des Eiffelturms 125 Euro anstelle der regularen 36 Euro. Ein Selbstversuch in «Kassensturz».Sonnenbrillen im Test: Guter UV-Schutz fur wenig GeldEine gute Sonnenbrille gibt es bereits ab 15 Franken. Das zeigt der Labortest in «Kassensturz». Teurere Modelle haben den Test weniger gut bestanden: Einige verformen sich bereits unter wenig Druck, bei anderen altern die Glaser schlecht.

programme.title: Sternstunde Kunst
programme.desc: Wassily Kandinsky could hear colors. This phenomenon is called synasthesia. In this special form of perception, several senses mix. The film “Kandinsky – The Colors of Sounds” shows how this experience influenced Kandinsky’s painting. / Wassily Kandinsky konnte Farben horen. Dieses Phanomen nennt sich Synasthesie. Bei dieser besonderen Form der Wahrnehmung vermischen mehrere Sinne. Der Film «Kandinsky – Die Farben der Klange» zeigt, wie diese Erfahrung Kandinskys Malerei beeinflusste.

programme.title: SRF Kids News

programme.title: SRF Kids – Next Level
programme.sub-title: FINAL LEVEL: Which team will crack the final course? / ENDLEVEL: Welches Team knackt den finalen Parcours?
programme.desc: In the third season of "SRF Kids - Next Level", three primary classes from the cantons of Obwalden, Nidwalden and Lucerne are doing everything they can to win the big trophy and main prize: The students from Sachseln OW, Dallenwil NW and Lucerne really wanted to go night walking in the Zurich Zoo - i.e. spend the night in a yurt and experience what the animals in the drift at night. But until then they first have to master six levels and lots of challenges. In the big finale, only two classes compete against each other - and here everything counts: speed, brainpower, teamwork, skill and a bit of luck. This spectacular course combines all elements of the previous challenges and demands everything from the students. The class that masters the final course fastest and reaches the finish line first will be crowned the winner of the third season of “SRF Kids – Next Level”. Pure excitement – ​​get excited and keep your fingers crossed for the two final classes. / Bei der dritten Staffel von «SRF Kids – Next Level» geben drei Primarklassen aus den Kantonen Obwalden, Nidwalden und Luzern alles, um den grossen Pokal und Hauptpreis abzustauben: Die Schulerinnen und Schuler aus Sachseln OW, Dallenwil NW und Luzern mochten unbedingt im Zoo Zurich Nachtwandeln – also in einer Jurte ubernachten und erleben, was die Tiere in der Nacht treiben. Doch bis dahin mussen sie erst einmal sechs Level und jede Menge Challenges meistern.Im grossen Finale treten nur noch zwei Klassen gegeneinander an – und hier zahlt alles: Schnelligkeit, Gehirnschmalz, Teamwork, Geschicklichkeit und ein Quantchen Gluck. Dieser spektakulare Parcours vereint alle Elemente der bisherigen Challenges und verlangt den Schulerinnen und Schulern alles ab. Die Klasse, die den finalen Parcours am schnellsten meistert und als Erste die Ziellinie erreicht, wird zur Siegerin der dritten Staffel von «SRF Kids – Next Level» gekront.Spannung pur – fiebere mit und drucke den beiden Finalklassen die Daumen.

programme.title: SRF school
programme.sub-title: Mental Health bei Jugendlichen – Einsamkeit uberwinden
programme.desc: How does loneliness affect our brain? How do friendships affect our feelings? And how are we doing in relationships in the digital age?
